shin tu zhi ba'i phyir dang / yid tshim par byed pa yin pa'i phyir zla ba dang 'dra bas nakhya/ thub dbang zla ba zhes smos ༅pa yin te/ ji ltar bkres pa rnams la kha zas sam/ skom pa rnams la btung ba dang phrad na bkres pa dang skom pa sel ba dang 'dra bar phun sum tshogs pa thob par byed pa yin no/ /khyab 'jug la dad pa rnams 'di la dad pa yin par smra ste/ de yang sngon gyi gtam rgyud kyi nang nas / rlung gi gtam rnying pa las tshul 'di ltar thos so zhes smra ba dag dgag pa'i phyir/ gna' sngon zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos pa yin te/ 'jig rten gsum gyis mchod pa'i sangs rgyas gang yin pa de nyid ni khyab 'jug yin te sngar/nya dang rus sbal phag dang ni/ /zhes bya ba la / sogs pa smos pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang khyab 'jug 'dis 'jig rten pa skyeb dang rga ④ba la sogs pa'i dbang du gyur cing —/ gzhan dbang du gyur pa thos nas de'i phyir snying rjes ༅mi 'di rnams bskyab cing gdon par bya'o snyam nas/ rmad du byung zhing thams cad mkhyen par gyur pa/ ngo mtshar du gyur pa'i blos snying brtse /༅ bas 'di dag 'di las gdon par bya'o snyam nas/ shākya'i rigs rgyas pa go ta ma zhes bya ba'i rigs dag par skyes shing / tshig gzung ④bar 'os par byas nas 'jig rten 'dir yang sangs rgyas zhes bya bar gyur cing / de kho na nyid ston pa yin la phan par byed pa yang yin no zhes gtam du grags par thos so zhes zer ba de ni de lta /ma yin te/ skyebo rmongs shing blun par gyur pa des sa gsum gyi ston pa de kho na nyid ston par mdzad pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad la phan 'dogs pa ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yin par shes shing / ma rtogs pa yin no/ /de yang sangs rgyas ni brgya ༅ lam na/ lan 'ga' zhig 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ shes pa ma yin te/ ji 1—150

skad du/ bskal pa bye ba phrag stong dang / /brgya phrag bye ba dag tu yang / /sangs rgyas sgra yang mi thos na/ /sangs rgyas mthong ba smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /khyab 'jug 'di ni rtsod pa'i dus su 'byung ba yin pas kho bo cag de la mchod par mi byed pa yin no zhe stin/ de'i phyir gang tshe zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos khrupa yin te/ 'dod chags ni rin po che la sogs pa la chags shing zhen pa'o/ /zhe sdang ni gzhan la gnod pa bya ba'i sems te/ de 'chang bar byed pa ni dgra bo rnams la sdang bar byed pa'o/ /de bas na 'dod chags dang /zhe sdang de dag gis 3/lha dang lha ma yin zhes bya ba ni/ bdud rtsi bsten pa dang mi bsten pa'i bye brag gi khyad par gyis ⑤'o ma can gyi rgya mtsho bsrubs ༅ tshun chad ming 'di gnyis byung bar gyur pa yin no/ /de yang 'di ltar thos te/ tshangs pas bsgo bas phyogs gcig nas ni lha rnams/ phyogs gcig nas ni 3 lha ma yin rnams 'dus nas ri bo manda ༅ra'i steng nas ni khyab 'jug gis gzung / klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyis srub ༅thag byas pa las/ 'og nas ni rus sbal gyi rgyab kyis bsten te / 'o ma can gyi rgya mtsho chen po bsrubs par gyur to/ /de nas shin tu 'jigs su rung ba'i dug gi skyes bu nag po brtsegs pa zhes bya ba zhig byung bar gyur pa dang / de khyab 'jug gis rgyamid par gyur pa na dran pa stor tem/ sa la 'gyel bar gyur nas cang mi rdzabar gnas pa dang / lha chen pos de las drangs te mgrin par bzhag par gyur to/ /des de'i mgrin pa sngon por gyur to/ /de nas zla ba tshes pa byung bar gyur pa dang / de lha chen pos blangs te mgo la gzhag 'go/ de nas dpal mo zhes bya ba byung ste/ rang nyid kyis ༅ khyab 'jug blangs te 'dus so/ /de'i 'og tu rta mgrin rings dang / shing yongs 'du la 1—151

sogs pa byung ste/ de dag ni brgya byin la sogs pa lha rnams kyis ci rigs par khyer ro/ /de nas bud med shin tu yid du 'ong ba zhig byung ba dang / de dag la khyed su yin zhes dris pa dang ①/ nga ni chang zhes bya ste/ nga 'thungs na myos pa dang / brgyal ༅ba dang / dregs pa la sogs pa'i rnam par 'gyur ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes smras pa dang / lha ma yin rnams 'jigs nas ma 'thungs pa dang —/ lha ma yin zhes bya bar gyur la/ lha rnams kyis 'thungs pas ni lha zhes bya bar gyur to/ /bdud rtsi byung ba na snod chen po brgyad gang ba lha ma yin rnams kyis ④khyer bar gyur pa dang / lha rnams shin tu yi mug par gyur pa na khyab 'jug gis shin tu yid du 'ong zhing gzugs bzang ba'i bud med kyi gzugs su bsgyur te / der song ba la phyobargya byin yang mi snang ba'i gzugs kyis ༅ nam mkha' la 'dug go/ /de'i tshe lha ma yin rnams kyis 'di ni kho bo cag gi bud med yin no snyam nas/ bdud rtsi'i srung ④mar gzhag go/ /rang nyid ni khrus la song ste chos kyi bstan bcos las/ ma bkrus dri ma spyod 'gyur bas/ /khrus ma byas par zas mi bza'/ /zhes smos pa'i phyir de dag khrus la song ngo / /skabs der khyab 'jug dang / brgya byin gyis mibadud rtsi brkus te brgya byin gyi khang par khyer ro/ /de rnams khrus byas nas slar log pa dang / bdud rtsi ma mthong nas de tshol ba la brtson pa na/ lha rnams kyis tsho khyer ro zhes thos nas lha rnams ni steng du 'gro ba yin pas/ lha ma yin ma yin pa bden no snyam mo/ /de'i tshe lha rnams bdud rtsi la longs spyod pa'i phyir 'dus pa dang / sgra gcan 'dzin lha'i cha lugs su bsgyur te / der zhugs nas bdud rtsi'i skal ba thob pa dang / nyi mas mthong ste/khyab 'jug la 'di ni sgra gcan 'dzin no zhes smras pa dang / des 'khor los mgo 1—152

bcad par gyur la/ 'on kyang bdud rtsi la longs spyod cing bldags pas mgo ni deng sang na yang gnas la/ lus lhag ma rnams ni shi bar gyur to/ /de nas sgra gcan 'dzin dang nyi ma zhe 'gras khyapar gyur pas/ gang gi tshe/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'gebs shing sgrib gro par byed pa yin no zhes gtam du grag go/ /lha dang lha ma yin gyi rin po che 'phrog /pa na/ des ji ltar byas pa de brjod par bya ste/rgyal po gsal ba zhes bya ba la sa marnya ga zhes bya ba'i nor bu zhig yod par gyur la/de khyab 'jug gis bslangs ④pa dang / ma byin par gyur nas khyab 'jug dpung gi tshogs bcu dgu dang bcas par de'i don du g.yul 'gyed du song ngo / /gsal ba yang nor bu'i mthu yid ༅/la bsams pa tsam gyis dpung gi tshogs stobs che zhing —/ pha rol gnon pa dang bcas pa nyi shu dang bcas te g.yul bkye ba dang /de khyab 'jug las rgyal te gyes so/ /dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po gsal ba ri dwags shor ④du song ba dang / seng ges bsad do/ /dred kyi bdag po 'dzam bu'i bu zhes bya bas seng ge'i lkog mar nor bu yod pa mthong ste/ de bsad nas khyer ro/ /rin po che'i don du khyab 'jug gis 3 rgyal po gsal ba bsad do zhes grags pa ma yin pa byung bar gyur pa dang / khyab 'jug gis de btsal ba'i phyir lhar bcas btang nas/ des ༅phug gcig gi nang na gzhon nu ma ngu ba dang /ma mas spro bsring ba'i phyir smras pa/ gsal ba seng ges bsad )gyur la/ /seng ge 'dzam bu'i bu yis bsad/ /khyed kyis sa manta ga 'di/ /gzhon nu bzang mo ma ngu zhig /de lta bu'i gtam zer ba thos nas/ de la bzlas pa dang / de blang ba'i phyir de nyid pho nyar btang ngo / /pho nya de shin tu blo dang ldan zhing dka' ba med pas thob par bya ba'i phyir 'dzam bu'i bu mo khyab 'jug gi don du blangs so//1/de153

dred kyi bdag pos kyang bu mo dang / nor yang ngas khyed la sbyin par bya'o zhes khas blangs so/ /khyab 'jug khros te smras pa/ bu mos ci zhig bya ste/ 'thabs la 'di bsad de dbrog par bya'o/ /lhar bcas kyis ༅smras pa/ nga rgyal brnyas dang de bzhin du/ /ngo tsha gzi byin spangs nas ni/ /brtan ༅pas rang don bsgrub bya ste/ /rang don nyams pa gleng pa yin/ /zhes smras pa dang / des kyang de'i tshig mnyan te/ thams cad thob par byas so/ /'dzam bu'i /1bu ni lha ma yin yin te/ dred kyi gzugs kyis rtse rnam par rgyu bar byed la/ de lta bu'i rin po che yod pa phrogs pa yin no/ /lha rnams kyi rin po che ni ba ri dza ta la sogs pa ste/ de yang brgya byin las phyophrogs pa yin te/ rin po che phrogs pa'i snyan dngags las gtam du grags pa ltar sbyar bar bya'o/ /chags shing zhen pa'i blo gros 'di la yod pas na chags pa'i blo gros te/ des gzhan dag slu ba'i ngan g.yo byas par gyur la/ des kyang sa dag phrogs par gyur pa ste/ dang po stobs ldan gyis /zhus thams cad dbang du byas par gyur pa las/ de las dbrog par bya'o snyam du chags pa'i blo skyes pas/ gang gi tshe mi'u thung gi gzugs su bsgyur te / sa 'phrogs ༅par gyur la de lta bu'i 'phrogs pa po'i rang bzhin can du gyur cing —/ de'i tshe 'dod chags la sogs pa'i 'ching ba las ma grol bar gnas pa yin du zin kyang / skyebo blun po shes rab dang mi ldan pa dag me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pas mchod par byed cing phyag 'tshal bar byed pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid ni bag la nyal gyi tshogs rnams las rnam par grol bar gyur kyang skye bo phal cher phyag mi 'tshal te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyon mongs pa'i tshogs las rnam par grol zhing / dngos po ma lus pa'i don thugs su 1—154

chud la phyi dang nang zhi zhing rnam par dag pa yin du zin kyang / phyag 'tshal bar mi byed do/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ rmongs pas zhes bya ba smos te/ mi shes pa'i mun pas khebs pa'i phyir bye brag mi shes pas phyag 'tshal bar mi byed do zhes bya ba'o / /gzhan yang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid bsod nams kyi zhing dam pa yin gyi/ gzhan dag ni de lta ①ma yin no zhes bstan pa'i phyir/ sa 'di zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos pa yin te/ sa chen po ni ②shar la sogs pa na gnas pa'i rgya mtsho bzhi po'i tshogs yon tan mang po dang ldan pas/ ska rags ltar kun nas bskor te gnas pa de nyid ni khur bu lta bu ste/ 'degs par dka' bas na lngid kyis lci bar 'dug cing / des shin tu snyoms pa ltar gnas pa'i phyir/lci ①lci ltar 'dug pa'i sa de lta bu de stobs ldan gyis khyab 'jug la byin du zin kyang —/ de'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal bas sa 'og tu btson rar bcings pas bsdams pa'i sdug bsngal ba'i gnas skabs thob par gyur pa ste/ nyon mongs shing sdug bsngal bas bcom pa'i gnas skabs thob cing myong bar gyur pa yin no/ /'dir khyad par ni thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la sa'i rdul tsam phul bas kyang —/ rgyal po mya ngan med pa zhes bya bar gyur pa yin te/ de yang bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la gshegs par gyur pa dang / khye'u rgyal ba zhes bya bas mthong ma thag shin tu dad par gyur nas srang bar gyi phyag dar las snyim pa gang phul bar gyur pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ༅nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya lon pa na khye'u 'di mya ngan med pa zhes bya ba stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /khye'u rnam par rgyal ba ⑤ la rjes su yi rang bar byas pas de'i blon po'i mchog shing rta sbas pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes 1—155

lung bstan to/ /des thob pa'i sa gzhi yang ji lta bu zhe na/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i sa steng ma lus pa mtha' dag thob cing /de yang dge ba ste dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang / mu ge dang / yams la sogs pa'i gnod pa med pa dag thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /de ltar na 'di gnyis zhing dang zhing ma yin pa'i khyad par las bsod nams su gyur par ston to/ /khyed ni phyogs su lhung bas de skad smra ba yin no snyam pa la/ de'i phyir bdag ni zhes bya ba la sogs pa smras pa yin te/ kho bo ni rgyu med pa'am/ nyes pa rgyur byas nas sangs rgyas kyi phyogs 'dzin cing / phyogs su lhung ba'ang ma yin la/ drang srong ser skya la sogs mu stegs kyi ston pa rnams la yang sdang zhing gnod par sems pa yang med de / rgyu med par spyir thams cad du snyoms par nyi ma ltar gnas par bya ba yin pas / gang dag gi tshig rigs pa dang ldan zhing / tshad mas gzhal bar bzod pa de nyid la ston pa nyid du yongs su gzung nyubar bya zhing / de nyid la dam pa rnams skyabs su 'gro bar bya ba yin no zhes bya ba'i don to/ /'jig rten 'di thams cad ni skyabs kyi 'os ma yin te/ 'dod chags dang bral ba med pa'i phyir dang —/ nyon mongs pa'i srin pos kun du bsten pa'i phyir/ tshangs pa'i srin pos gnas su byas pa'i khang pa lta bu yin no zhes dpyod pa dang ldan pa dag 'dod pas / de'i phyir 'di ltar zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos pa yin te/ bzhi po 'di dag gi nang nas nges par na 'ga' zhig thams cad mkhyen par gyur pa yin gyi/thams cad ni mthar thug pa ma yin te/ de yang ji ltar 'od can rnams kyi nang na nyi ma lta bu dang / mtsho phran rnams kyi nang na rgya mtsho lta bu dang / ri bo rnams kyi nang na ri rab lta bur blo dang ldan pa rnams kyi nang na thams cad mkhyen 1—156

pa ni khyad par du 'phags pa yin gyi/ gzhan dag ni shes bya'i don thams cad shes pa ma yin no/ /de bzhin du de'i bstan pa yang 'gro ba la gcig tu phan zhing / bstan pa'i lugs shin tu rgya che ba yin te/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong la sogs pa'i bstan pa gang zhig nye bar ston pa de nyid blo dang ldan pas btsal bar bya ba yin no/ /ji lta bu'i blos she na/ blo gros zhib mo'i mig gis btsal bar bya ste/ de la blo gros nyid phra mo mthong ba'i mig yin te/ des btsal zhing brtags nas bsten rgya par bya'i/ gzhan dag ni thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin zhing / phung khrol la mkhas la/ sems can rnams la nye bar gnod par byed pa de rnams la bsten zhing tsheston par bzung / ba ci zhig mkho ste/ dgos pa ci zhig byed / phan pa'i dgos pa ci yang med do zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de ltar na gang zhig la bsten ④ na dgos pa ma lus pa 'grub par 'gyur zhe na/ de'i phyir 'dir gang la zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos pa yin te/ ston pa gang la nyon mongs pa'i skyon bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus pa kun yod pa ma yin la/ tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i yon tan ma lus pa thams cad rnam pa thams cad du yod par gyur na de nyid ni bdag gi ston pa yin zhing / de nyid kho na 'gro ba ma lus pa'i skyabs yin gyi/ gzhan ni ma yin te/ kho bo ni ming tsam ma bzod pa'i phyir de skad du smra ba ma yin gyi/ gzhan du na don gyi nyes pa yod pa yin no/ /des ni 'di skad ston pa yin te/ gal te lha chen po dang / khyab 'jug dag la ni ji skad bshad pa'i nyes pa yod pas de dag ston par gyur pa ma yin no zhes smra ba ni rigs na/ tshangs pa la ni nyes pa 'ga' dang yang (naldan pa ma yin pas/de'i phyir de ni sa ma lus pa'i ston par rigs pa yin no/ /yang na 'di la nyes pa 1—157

yod na smros shig ce na/ de brjod par bya ste/ yang dag par na 'dod pa'i khams kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba yang ma yin na/ nyes pa'i dri ma ma lus pa 'di la med do zhes brjod par lta ga la bya ste/ nyes pa de nyid 'di la brgya phrag yod de/ lha 'di gnyis dang tshangs pa mtshungs pa nyid du bshad de/ de yang lha mo u ma bag mar blangs pa'i tshe/ kha khyer la bskor ba byed pa na/ de'i gzugs phul du byung ba mthong bas sems shor te brgyal zhing / tshangs pa khu ba shor bar gyur to zhes grag la/ de nas ngo tsha bas rkang pas mnyes pas dum bu brgya phrag du mar gyes pa dang / de las byis pa brtse ba zhes bya ba'i drang srong stong phrag brgyad cu skyes par gyur to zhes bshad pa dang / tshangs pas mchog byin pa las/ sa gsum la sun rnya nyudang / u pa sun dha ⑤zhes bya ba spun gnyis kyis shin tu gnod pa ༅byas pa dang / de dag gsad ༅pa'i phyir lha thams cad kyis khya rang gi 0 lus kyi gzi byin gyi cha bsdus pa las thig le'i mchog ma zhes bya ba sprul la/ de ji tsam na tshangs pa la phyag byed pa na de la chags pa'i dbang gis tshangs pas ngos bzhir gdong bzhi sprul la/ lha chen pos de'i mgo dbus ma ni bcad par gyur to zhes bya ba ༅la sogs pa 'chol pa'i spyod pa mang du smos pa yin no/ gzhan yang 'di'i ming gi rjes thogs las nyes pa gzhan yang 'byung zhing / gzhan yang khyed rnams ni ngas —/sprul pa yin zhes log pa nyid du byed pa por yang ston pa yin no zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'di dag gi tshig ༅la nyes pa mang po yod par thos kyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la ni nyes pa'i dri ma 'ga' yang mnga' ba ma yin no/ /de yang —/ mos ldan phongs pa las 'don khyapa/ /'tsho ba'i tshe na mi nus kyi/ /de ni 'chi nas gdon bya zhes/ /lha de zob brdzun ⑩tshig yin/ /mes ni reg pas 1/de158

mi tshig gi/ /dran na tshig ces gang zob/ /gal te tshig de bden gyur dam/ /'di gnyis kyang ni de dang 'dra/ /bcom ldan yang ni de rgya'adra na/ /las kyi bdag nyid can mi gsung / /nyi mas sa yi gzhi lta bur/ /'gro ba'i rang bzhin gsal bar mdzad/ /'jig rten las min 'bras mi spyod/ /rang gi nyon mongs kyis las bsags/ /dge dang mi dges ༅ 'dod mi 'dod/ /'bras skyed ①sa bon lta bu yin/ /chos kun yongs su mkhyen pa dang / /nyes pa thams cad zad pa dang / /sems can kun la phan gyur pa/ /de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos pa yin no/ /don 'di nyid rgya cher bstan pa'i phyir/ /gang la zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos pa yin te/ dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba ni tshad med pa'o/ /thugs rje can zhes bya ba ni thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa ste/ de yang lha'i spyan rnam par dag pas 'jig rten ma lus pa la rgyun du rnam par gzigs par mdzad de/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis ④nyin dus gsum/ mtshan dus gsum du 'jig rten rnams la gzigs par mdzad do zhes ji skad smos pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas 'gro ba 'di dag sdug bsngal las gdon par mdzad cing / skyabs dang rten gyi dam pa yin pas de la skyabs su mchi zhing rten par byed do zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de ltar bstod pa de yongs su bsngo ba'i phyir/ padma zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos pa yin te/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de ni gzugs kyi yon tan phul du byung ba dang ldan pa'i phyir/ utpal sngon po kha phye zhing / 'dab ma rgyas pa ltar dkyus ring la mdzes pa'i spyan mnga' ba gang yin pa de la de skad ces bya ste/ gzugs kyi sku'i dbang po'i mchog yin pa'i phyir/ spyan gyi mtshan nyid nye bar mtshon pa tsam du 1—159

smos pa yin no/ /de 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi yon tan thams cad kyi gnas su gyur pa yang yin te/ ji ltar chu klung stong phrag du ma 'bab pa'i rten dang gnas ni rgya mtsho yin pa dang 'dra bar yon tan gyi bstod pa'i chu klung brgya stong mang po 'byung ba'i gnas dang gzhi ni bcom ldan 'das yin la/ de lta bu'i bstod pa'i gnas su gyur pa de la tshul de ltar bstod cing bsngags pa brjod pa'i bstod pa'i tshig las/ bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun cing bskyed pa cung zad ci mchis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces smos pa yin te/ 'dir nges par legs pa ni bde ba kha na ma tho ba med pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces bya ba'i don to/ /skyob la lha las phul byung bar/ /bstod pa bdag gis rnam phye bas / /'di las bsod nams gang bsags pa/ /des ni mya ngan 'das thob shog /lha las phul du byung ba'i ༅bstod pa'i rgya cher bshad pa/ slob dpon shes rab go chas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzā ran da ༅ na'i zhal snga nas dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o༅ //bsdur mchan/122 ༅ mar byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shā/ gye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/123 ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉te/ ༅ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsog khya 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ bu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gri gye〈〈pe 〉〉1—160

154 ①〈pe 〉〈〈snar 〉gri ②〈〈be 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstan/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉'dzaspu'i/ ④〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gri⑤〈pe 〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga ⑥〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba ⑦〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mi ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phrogag155 ①〈pe 〉〈 snar 〉〉ltar/ ②〈〈pe 〉 snar 〉〉'gi ②〈 snar 〉〉gi ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi ⑤〈pe 〉〈snadī bag156 ① 〈 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzungan157 0〈pe 〉〈〈snar 〉brten/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉brten cingaka ②〈pe 〉〉༅ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉brten/pe⑤〈 〉〈〈snar 〉 pasangaka158 ①②〈snar 〉〉surta/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/ ④〈〈pe 〉〈snar 〉〉bas she ⑤〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi⑦〈〈pe 〉〈〈snar 〉〉gig ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ne/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〈snar 〉〉deg ⑨〈pe 〉〉gag⑩〈〈pe 〉〈〈snar 〉〉'dog ⑪〈pe 〉〈snar 〉sa/159 ①〈〈snar 〉nga ②pe 〉〈〈snar 〉dge ⑤〈pe 〉〉〈snar bskyes ④〈〈pe 〉〈snar 〉gri16༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nga/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉/ma rga1—164

0006༄༅/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa jig bya ba/①༄dza/ /rgya gar skad du/ budhe 0 phya sto tra nā ma/ bod skad du/ sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa zhes bya bakhya/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis lhun po'i tshad las lhag pa'i dbu ni rab tu byin/ /gang gis rgyu skar bas kyang mang ba'i brgya phrag spyan rnams kyang ni btang ༅ / /sa gzhi dang mnyam rgya mtsho lta bu'i sha dang khrag rnams kyang / /de ltar dka' ba spyod mdzad sangs rgyas bcom ldan rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yo zhing 'khyug 'gro'i glog 'dra'i sems ni gang gis dbang du gnas pa dang / /'jig rten gsam po mi ༄shis rgya mtsho las ni gang gis yang dag sgrol/ /srid 'joms bdud 'jig phyir du gang zhig slar yang srid par 'jug /de ltar dka' ba spyod mdzad bcom ldan sangs rgyas rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis snying rje'i sdom pa'i khur bus sems can don ༅la dgyes pa'i phyir/ /lha dang lha min 'jig rten gsum po'i gtso bos 1—166

mi rtog rnam par spong / /bkres sdug srog chags rnams la brtse ba mchog gnas gang zhig lus rab ster/ /de ltar dka' ba spyod mdzad bcom ldan sangs rgyas rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis snying rjes 'thob pa'i sems can myur du bsgral zhing bskyab pa'i phyir/ /gang zhig phyugs dang nya dang ri dwags 'gro bar dgon pa'i nang du gnas/ /yun ring ngal dang dub pa bzod cing lus rnams kyang ni kun du gtong / /de ltar dka' ba spyod mdzad bcom ldan sangs rgyas rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig sems can mang po'i ༅lus kyi nad la sman gyi phyir du ni/ /'gro la byams pa'am snying rje'i dbang gis mchog tu mu ge'i dgon pa ru/ /nags tshal rnams su glang chen lus rnyed gzhan gyi sdug bsngal sel la sbyor/ /de ltar dka' ba spyod mdzad bcom ldan sangs rgyas rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /mu ge'i zug rngu gyezug pa'i dus su dbu la skyes pa'i rin po che/ /bcad nas byin pas bram ze dang ni mi bdag la sogs gnas pa'i phyir/ /kun du de bzhin thugs kyi byed pa sla bas thams cad sems can don/ /de ltar dka' ba spyod mdzad bcom ldan sangs rgyas rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /nags rnams so sor gnas mdzad rmi lam bzang pos yang dag smra ba thob/ /ma dang rgyal po pha rol phan pa spyod pa rnams kyi seng ge'i khrir/ /gnyis 'thung mche ba drug par 'khrungs te 'gro ba gang phyir chos rnams kun/ /de ltar dka' ba spyod mdzad bcom ldan sangs rgyas rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims yon tan bzod pa'i rang bzhin ltobs brtson dobasam gtan dang / /shes rab rab gsung mtshungs par spyod pa'i byams dang snying rje'i yon tan gyis/ /'brog dgon gnas pa'i 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon thob cing yang dag rtogs/ /de ltar dka' ba spyod mdzad bcom ldan sangs rgyas rtag 1—167

tu phyag 'tshal 'o/ /'phags ma nor rgyun mas mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa rdzogs so// //rab tu bsngags pa'i gnas chen po bal po yam bu'i grong khyer du sgra'i mkhan po dpal rgyal ba'i ①bzang po dang / shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bsgyur ba'o//② //bsdur mchan/166 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bud ma 0〈〈pe 〉〉 sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa zheyobya ba/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉gtangan ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'don/167 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtson 'grug168 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 snyan/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 sa'i steng du nyi tshaltar gyur cigabasdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs (6)1wa 168

07༄/ /chos kyi sku la gnas pa'i yon tan thun mong ma yin pa la bstod pa/①༄7༅/ /chos kyi sku la gnas pa'i yon tan thun mong ma yin pa la bstod pa / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can rnams la thugs brtse ba/ /phrad dang bral bar dgongs pa can/ /mi 'bral dgongs shing bde ba can/ /dgongs pa yo la phyag 'a༅ lo/ /sgrib pa kun las nges par grol / /thub pas 'jig rten kun zil mnan/ /yo kyi mayo pas shes bya khyab / /sems grol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can kun gyi nyon mongs kun / /ma lus pa dag 'dul mdzad pa/ /nyon mongs sel ba nyon mongs pa/ /brtser bcas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhun gyis grub cing chags mi mnga' /thogs pa mi mnga' rtag tu yang / /mnyam par gzhag ②cing 'dri kun gyi/ /lan ldon nga la phyag 'a༅ lo/ /gnas dang gnas pa bshad bya dang / /tshig dang shes pa ston pa la/ /rtag tu blo gros mi thogs pa/ /ston mchog khyod la phyag 1—169

'a༅ lo/ /ra du zhu ①dang de dag gi/ /tshig dang spyod malo 'ongs pa dang //'gro dang nges 'byung sems can la/ /legs 'doms yo la phyag 'tshal lo /lus can kun gyis yo mthong na/ /skyes bu mchog tu rtogs par 'gyur/ /mthong ba tsam gyis dad 'pha bar/ /mdzad pa lo la phyag 'a༅ lo/ /len dang gnas dang gtong ba dang / /sprul pa dang ni bsgyur ba dang / /ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes la/ /mnga' brnyes yo la phyag 'a༅ lo/ /thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang / /nges 'byung theg pa ja po la/ /sems can rnams la slu ba yi/ /bdud 'joms yo la phyag 'a༅ lo/ /ye shes dang ni spangs pa dang / /nges 'byung bgegs byed ston mdzad pa/ /bdag gzhan don la mu stegs gzhan/ /mi tshugs yo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor du tshar bcad gsung mdzad pa/ /kun nas nyon mongs gtan spangs la⑤/ /bsrung ba mi mnga' bsnyel mi mnga'/ /tshogs sdud nga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshegs bzhugs kun du rtag par yang / /kun mayo ma lags spyod mi mnga'/ /yo ni yang dag don du na//kun mayo yo la phyag 'a༅ lo/ /sems can kun gyi don mdzad pa/ /yo ni dus las yong mi 'da'/ /rtag tu ༅sa bu yod mdzad pa/ /mi bsnyel yo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten kun la gdugs zhag gcig /lan drug tu ni gzigs mdzad pa/ /thugs rje che dang ldan pa po/ /phan dgongs yo la phyag 'a༅ lo/ /gshegs ba thugs su ma pa dang / /mayo pa dang ni phrin las kyis / /nyan thos dang ni rang sangs rgyas/ /kun mchog lo la phyag 'a༅ lo/ /byang sa po po'i rnam pa kun/ /sku gsum༅dag gis brnyes gyur pa/ /kun du sems can thams cad kyi/ /dogs gcod khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sri ba mi 1—170

mnga' skyon mi mnga'/ /rnyog pa mi mnga' bzhugs mi mnga'/ /g.yo ba mi mnga' chos kun la/ /ma spros khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sku la gnas yon tan 'di la bdag gis rab bstod pas/ /yon tan drug ldan sku gsum po ni yongs su rdzogs par ni/ /bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams kyis myur du rtogs par shog /chos kyi sku la gnas pa'i yon tan thun mong ma yin pa la bstod pa/ slob dpon thogs med kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar kyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī lend+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ①ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //1—171

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ tatna sta 4②/ bod skad du/ de kho na nyid la bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thogs pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /kha dog bral zhing ma skyes shing / /rang gi ngo bo 'jig med pa'i/ /sku mnga' de bzhin gshegs phyag 'tshal/ /nyon mongs rags dang phra spangs pa/ /bdag gi mi mnga' sgrib pa dag /dang khyapo yod pas stong pa'i phyir / /don dam mkha' dkyil 'dra phyag 'tshal/ /rnam rtog sbrul ni spangs pas na| /ci dgyes par ni mdzad gyur pa/ /gter mchog de nyid rtag gzigs pa/ /ngan 'gro'i rgud pa spangs phyag 'tshal/ /rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /nyid kyis dgyes bdar ma byas sku/ /'khor dang zhi bar ro mnyam sku/ /rnam rtog dri ma med phyag 'tshal/ /yang dag dgongs pas mnal ④mi mnga'/ /gti mug bral zhing spangs pas bzhugs/ /rtag tu de nyid ma gsal ⑤ba/ /rang bzhin 1—173

mkhas pas shar phyag 'tshal/ /bsam gtan tshes grangs yongs rdzogs pas/ /mi rnams dga' ba skyed mdzad pa/ /rnam grol zla ba yid 'ong ba/ /lta ngan rab rib sel phyag 'tshal/ /dngos po dngos med gnyis 'das nas/ /rtog pa'i dri ma las grol ba/ /rtsen dor med de sa mnyam gnas/ /spros mi mnga' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri med chu rlabs bde ba'i rgyu/ /ma lus srog chags 'tsho mdzad pa/ /che zhing mtha' med tshad dang bral/ /de nyid rgya mtsho che phyag 'tshal/ /legs spyad du ma rgyas thob pa/ /dpe med ro zhim yid la 'bab/ /rga shi'i 'jigs pa med mdzad pa/ /de nyid bdud rtsi la phyag 'tshal/ /rang gi yid la brtan ldan yang //khyab 'jug dbang phyug tshangs dbang dang / /lha dang drang srong thabs med pa/ /thabs de skad cig brnyes phyag 'tshal/ /dri med rin thang mnyam med pa/ /ngo bos 'dod ༅rnams yongs rdzogs mdzad/ /bsod nams bsags pas dmigs gyur pa/ /yid bzhin byang chub sems phyag 'tshal/ /srid pa'i 'khor bas yongs dub pa'i/ /mchog tu lta ba bde ba'i gnas/ /byang chub yan lag me tog ldan / /zhi ba'i dpag bsam shing phyag 'tshal/ /shes bya shes med gnyis med cing —/ /phra sbom dbye ba rnams las grol/ /sna tshogs dpe las 'das gyur pa/ /tshig gis brjod mi nus phyag 'tshal/ /rtag tu rgyal zhing bsnyengs gami mnga'/ /gzhan stobs 'joms byed mdud pa med/ /gnyis med sku mnga' ༅bsam mi khyab / /gcig dpa' srid pa 'joms phyag 'tshal/ /bye brag med par dbang 'gyur zhing / /dngos tshogs skad cig la bsregs pa/ /shin tu drag pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /rab 'bar de nyid me phyag 'tshal/ /'di ltar yang dag bstod las ⑤dge ba gang thob pa'i/ /bsod nams des ni 'gro ba ma lus zad 1—174

'gyur zhing / /sems can rnams ni sdug bsngal dag dang bral gyur pa/ /bde ba dang ldan sgrib med mya ngan 'das thob shog /de kho na nyid la bstod pa shākya'i dge slong dpal gyi go chas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po mañdzu :/bha dra dang / dge slong shākya 'od kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //bsdur mchan/173 nyamatshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta twa sta ba/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dag④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brnag ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉bsag174 ①〈〈snar 〉〉dog ②〈〈pe 〉〉'dong ni〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsnyemag du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉su med skudu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgopa lasabadag gigabasdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/ (8)1—175

༄wa༅/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsayo gtan phyin ci log gis ci zhig dgongs mdzad skad cig legs par spyan dbye gzigs/ /lus med mda' yis gzir ba'i skye bo bdag cag skyob pas kyang ni bsrung bar mi mdzad na / /thugs rje ldan pa phyin ci log gyur khyod las mchog tu ma rung skyes bu gzhan ma mchis/ /phrag dog ldan pa bdud kyi bud med de skad smra yang rgyal ba skyob pa byang chub gyur/ /gzhan yang 'dod dbang gis ni kun du gzhu bkang bdud gzhan lag pa myur ba pa ṭa ha sgra 'jebs dang ldan/ /dpa' bo smin ma baspyod dang nyer g.yo lta bur sgeg dang 'dzum dang rol pa med rnams kyis/ /thub dbang skyob pa byang chub ma brnyes bar du bsam gtan las ni baspyod ma nus pa mthong gyur nas/ /ngo mtshar gyur pas ba spu langs pa'i lus kyis grub pa rnams dang yan lag mchog rnams 'dud/ /ral pa 'khrugs shing lce rnams g.yogs la kun du bltams pas 1—176

gang gi thugs rnams 'khrul par ma gyur cing / /rab gsal 'dod lha'i bdud rnams rtse mo mchog dag lag thogs glang po rta rnams gdong ldan seng ge dang / /stag gi gdong rnams rtswa bzhin grangs med gyur pa 'khor ba yis ni gang zhig bsnyengs par ma gyur pa/ /de ni kun la gnod pa'i rnam pa 'dres pa med par skyob pa sangs rgyas thub dbang 'jig rten mgon/ /bdud btul ba la bstod pa/rab dga'i lha'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so//①/ //bsdur mchan/176 /nyu/mtshan byang 'di sgrig pa pos bkod cingan〈〈sde 〉〉bdud btul ba la bstod pa bzhugs so//177 7〈〈pe 〉〉/masgo bsdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/ (9)1—177

0010༄༅/ /chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa/ ༄lo/ /rgya gar skad du/ dharma jo tu lta bo ༅ / bod skad du/ chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa/ 'phags pa ba/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig kun du ma shes na/ /srid pa gsum du rnam 'khor ba/ /sems can kun la nges gnas pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal 'dud ④/ /gang zhig 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ /de nyid sbyang ba byas pa las/ /dag pa de nyid mya ngan 'das/ /chos kyi sku yang de nyid do/ /ji ltar 'o ma dang 'dres pas / /mar gyi snying po mi snang ba/ /de bzhin nyon mongs dang 'dres pas/ /chos kyi dbyings kyang mi mthong ngo / /ji ltar 'o ma rnam sbyangs pas/ /mar gyi snying po dri med 'gyur/ /de bzhin nyon mongs rnam ༅ sbyangs pas/ /chos dbyings shin tu dri med 'gyur/ /ji ltar mar me bum nang gnas/ /cung zhig snang bar mi 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin nyon mongs bum nang gnas/ /chos kyi dbyings kyang mi 1—178

mthong ngo / /phyogs ni gang dang gang dag nas/ /bum pa bu ga btod ①gyur pa/ /de dang de yi phyogs nyid nas/ /'od kyi rang bzhin 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gang tshe ting 'dzin rdo rje yis/ /bum pa de ni bcag gyur pa/ /de tshe de ni nam mkha' yi / /mthar thug bar du snang bar byed/ /chos kyi dbyings ni skye ma yin/ /nam yang 'gag par 'gyur ba med/ /dus rnams kun du nyon mongs med/ /thog ma bar mthar ②dri ma bral/ /ji ltar rin chen bai ḍūrya/ /dus rnams kun du 'od gsal yang / /rdo yi nang na gnas gyur na/ /de yi 'od ni gsal ma yin/ /de bzhin nyon mongs kyis bsgribs pa'i/ /chos dbyings shin tu dri med pa'ang / /'khor bar 'od ni gsal ma yin/ /mya ngan 'das na 'od gsal 'gyur/ /khams yod na ni las byas pas/ /sa le sbram dag mthong bar 'gyur/ /khams med na ①ni las byas na④/ /nyon mongs 'ba' zhig bskyed par zad/ /ji ltar spun pas g.yogs gyur pas/ /so ba 'bras bur ⑤mi 'dod ltar/ /de bzhin nyon mongs kyis g.yogs pas/ /de ni yisangs rgyas zhes mi brtag /ji ltar sbun pa las grol na/ /'bras nyid snang bar 'gyur ba ltar/ /de bzhin nyon mongs las grol na/ /chos kyi sku nyid rab tu gsal/ /chu shing snying po med do zhes/ /'jig rten na ni dper byed kyang / /de yi 'bras bu snying po nyid/ /mngar po za bar byed pa ltar/ /snying po med pa'i 'khor ba las/ /nyon mongs gzeb dang bral gyur na/ /de yi 'bras bu sangs rgyas /༅nyid/ /lus can kun gyi bdud rtsir 'gyur/ /de bzhin sa bon thams cad las/ /rgyu dang 'dra ba'i 'bras bu 'byung / /sa bon med par 'bras yod par/ /shes ldan gang gis sgrub ༅par nus / /sa bon gyur pa khams de nyid/ /chos rnams kun gyi rten du 'dod/ /1—179

rim gyis sbyangs par gyur pa las/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /dri med nyi ma zla ba yang / /sprin dang khug rna du ba medang / /sgra gcan gdong dang rdul la sogs/ /sgrib pa lnga yis bsgribs par gyur // /de bzhin 'od gsal ba yi sems/ /'dod dang gnod sems le lo dang / /rgod pa dang ni the tshom ste/ /sgrib pa lnga yis bsgribs par gyur / /ji ltar me yis dag pa'i gos/ /sna tshogs dri mas dri ma can/ /ji ltar me yi nang bcug na/ /dri ma tshig 'gyur gos min ltar / /de bzhin 'od gsal ba yi sems/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma can/ /ye shes me yis nyon mongs bsreg /de nyid 'od gsal ma yin no/ /stong pa nyid ni ston pa'i mdo/ /rgyal bas ji snyed gsungs pa gang / /de dag kun gyis nyon mongs ldog /khams de nyams par byed ma yin/ /sa yi dkyil na yod du pa'i chu/ /dri ma med par gnas pa ltar/ /nyon mongs nang na ye shes kyang / /de bzhin dri ma med par gnas/ /chos dbyings gang phyir bdag ma yin/ /bud med ma yin skyes pa'ang / min/ /gzung ba kun las rnam grol ba/ /ji ltar bdag ces brtag par bya/ /chags pa med pa'i chos kun la/ /bud med skyes pa dmigs ma yin/ /'dod chags kyis ldongs rjegadul bya'i phyir/ /bud med skyes pa zhes /rab bstan/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa zhes/ /bya ba gsum pos sems sbyong byed/ /mchog tu sems ni sbyong byed pa'i/ /chos ni rang bzhin med pa yin/ /ji ltar sbrum ma'i lto na bu/ /yod kyang mthong ba ma yin pa/ /de bzhin nyon mongs kyis g.yogs pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings kyang mthong ma yin/ /bdag dang bdag gi rnam rtog dang / /ming gi 'du shes rgyu mtshan gyis/ /rnam rtog bzhi po 'byung ba yang / /'byung dang 'byung las gyur pas so/ /sangs rgyas 1/de180

rnams kyi smon lam yang / /snang ba med cing mtshan nyid med/ /so sor rang rig sbyor ldan nyid/ /sangs rgyas rtag pa'i chos nyid can/ /ji ltar ri bong mgo yi rwa/ /brtags ༅pa nyid de med pa ltar/ /de bzhin chos rnams thams cad kyang —/ /brtags ④pa nyid de yod ma yin/ /phra rab rdul gyi ngo bo yis/ /glang gi rwa yang dmigs thum yin/ /ji ltar sngon bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /de la ci zhig brtag par bya/ /brten nas 'byung bar gyur pa phyodang / /brten nas 'gag par 'gyur bas na/ /gcig kyang yod pa ma yin naX / /byis pa rtse ji ltar rtog par byed/ /ri bong ba glang co/rwa yi dpes/ /ji ltar bde gshegs chos rnams nyid / /dbu ma nyid du sgrub par byed/ /ji ltar nyi zla skar ma'i gzugs/ /dang ba'i snod kyi chu nang du/ /gzugs brnyan mthong bar gyur pa miltar/ /mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'ang de dang 'dra/ /thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba/ /bslu ba med cing brtan pa yi/ /gang zhig de ltar bdag med pa'ang rgya/ /ji ltar bdag dang bdag gir brtag /ji ltar so ga'i khyadus su chu/ /dro'o bu zhes ni rjod par byed/ /de nyid grang ba'i dus su ni/ /grang ngo zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /nyon mongs dra bas g.yogs pa ni༅ / /sems can zhes ni brjod par bya/ /de nyid nyon mongs bral gyur na/ /sangs rgyas zhes ni brjod par bya/ /mig dang gzugs la brten nas ni/ /dri ma med pa'i snang ba 'byung / /skye med 'gag pa med nyid las/ /chos kyi dbyings ni rab tu shes/ /sgra dang rna ba la brten nas//rnam par dag pa'i shes pa gsum/ /mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi dbyings/ /rtog dang bcas pas thos par 'gyur/ /sna dang dri la brten nas snom/ /de ni gzugs su med pa'i dpe'akha/ /de bzhin sna yi rnam shes kyis/ /chos kyi 1—181

dbyings la rtog par byed/ /lce yi rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ /ro yi khams kyang dben pa ste/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo yin①/ /rnam par shes pa gnas med pa / /dag pa'i lus kyi ngo bo dang / /reg bya'i rkyen gyi mtshan nyid dang ༅/ /rkyen dag las ni grol gyur pa/ /chos kyi dbyings zhes brjod par bya/ /yid gtsor gyur pa'i chos rnams la/ /rtog dang brtag pa rnam spangs nas/ /chos rnams rang bzhin med pa nyid/ /chos kyi dbyings su bsgom par bya/ /mthong dang thos dang bsnams pa dang / /myangs dang reg par gyur pa dang / /chos rnams de ltar rnal 'byor pas/ /shes na ①mtshan nyid rdzogs pa yin/ /mig dang rna ba sna dag dang / /lce dang lus dang de bzhin yid/ /skye mched drug po rnam dag pa/ /'di nyid de nyid mtshan nyid do/ /sems nyid rnam pa gnyis su mthong ④/ /ji ltar 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das/ /bdag tu 'dzin las 'khor ba ste/ /so sor rig na de nyid do/ /'dod chags zad pas mya ngan 'das/ /zhe sdang gti mug zad pa dang / /de dag 'gags pa ⑤sangs rgyas nyid/ /lus can kun gyi skyabs nyid do/ /shes dang mi shes pa dag las/ /lus 'di nyid la ④thams cad de/ /rang gi rnam par rtog pas bcings/ /bdag nyid shes na ༅grol bar 'gyur/ /byang chub ring min nye ba khru/min/ /'gro min 'ong ba 0ma yin zhing / /nyon mongs gzeb gyur 'di nyid la/ /mthong ba dang ni ma mthong yin / /shes rab mar me la gnas nas/ /mchog tu zhi bar gyur pa yis/ /bdag la brtags pas byaganas bya zhes/ /mdo sde'i tshogs las gsungs pa lags/ /stobs bcu'i stobs kyis byis pa rnams/ /byin rlabs ⑫zla ba tshes pa bzhin/ /nyon mongs can gyi sems can gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi mthong 1—182

ngo / /ji ltar yi dwags rnams kyis ni/ /rgya mtsho skams ༅par mthong ba ltar/ /de bzhin mi shes pas bsgribs pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni med par brtags ༅/ /dman dang khyabasod nams dman pa la/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ci bgyir mchis/ /ji ltar dmus long lag pa ru/ /rin chen mchog ni bzhag pa 'dra/ /sems can bsod nams byas rnams la/ /'od kyis gsal zhing dpal ldan pa'i/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'bar ba/ /sangs rgyas de yi mdun na gnas/ /mgon po de yi gzugs kyi skus④ / /bskal pa mang por bzhugs nas kyang ༅/ /gdul bya rnams ni gdul ba'i phyir/ /dbyings nyid tha dad gyur pa lags/ /sems kyi yul ni nges rtogs nas/ /der ni shes pa 'jug par gyur/ /so so rang rig rnam dag na/ /sa rnams de yi bdag nyid gnas/ /dbang phyug chen po'i gnas mchog dang / /'og min nyid de rnam mdzes pa/ /shes pa gsum po gcig nyid du / /'dres par gyur la bdag smra'o/ /byis pa'i nang na yongs ༅ mkhyen dang / /'phags pa'i nang na sna tshogs nyid/ /dbang phyug chen po tshe dpag med/ /bskal pa'i tshe yi rgyu gang yin/ /phyi rol sems can khams /mekyi yang / /dpag tu med pa'i bskal par ni/ /tshe yang gang gis bsrungs gyur cing / /srog chags3mas kyi /༅srog gnas pa'i/ /rgyu gang 'umi zad pa de nyid/ /gang gi ⑫'bras bu mi zad gang / /snang ba med pa'i bye brag gis/ /shes rab don du rab tu 'jug /byang chub ring bar mi bsam zhing / /nye bar yang ni bsam mi bya/ /yul drug snang ba med par ni/ /yang dag ji bzhin rig gyur pa'o/ /ji ltar 'o ma dang 'dres chu/ /snod gcig na 7ni gnas pa las/ /ngang pa cha'o ma 'thung byed cing / /chu ni ma yin de bzhin gnas/ /de bzhin nyon mongs kyis g.yogs 1—183

nas / /ye shes lus 'dir gcig gnas kyang / /rnal 'byor pa yis ye shes len / /mi shes pa ni 'dor bar byed/ /bdag dang bdag gi zhes 'dzin pas/ /ji srid phyi rol rnam brtags ①pa/ /bdag med rnam pa gnyis mthong na(— // /srid pa'i sa bon 'gag par 'gyur/ /gang phyir sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das/ /gtsang ba rtag pa dge ba'i gzhi/ /gang phyir gnyis ni byis pas brtags 3/ /de yi gnyis med rnal 'byer gnas/ /dka' spyod sna tshogs sbyin pa dang / /tshul khrims sems can don sdud dang / /sems can phan byed bzod pa ste/ /gsum po 'dis ni ④khams rgyas 'gyur/ /chos rnams kun la brtson 'grus dang / /bsam gtan la sems 'jug pa dang / /rtag tu shes rab bsten /⑤pa ste/ /'di yang byang chub rgyas byed yin/ /thabs dang bcas pa'i shes rab dang / /smon lam rnam par sbyangs pa dang / /stobs la nges nas ④ye shes te/ /khams rgyas byed pa'i chos bzhi'o⑦/ /byang chub sems phyag mi bya zhes/ /smra ba ngan par / che smra ba ste/ /byang chub sems dpa' ma byung bar/ /chos kyi sku ni 'a byung ma yin/ /bur shing sa bon la sdang gang / /kha ra spyad par 'dod pa de༅ / /bur shing sa bon med par ni/ /kha ra 'byung bar 'gyur ma yin/ /bur shing sa bon gang bsrungs nas/ /nye bar gnas shing bsgrubs pa las/ /bu ram kha ra hwags rnams ni/ /de las 'byung bar 'gyur ba ltar/ /byang chub sems ni rab bsrungs nas/ /nye bar gnas shing bsgrubs pa las/ /dgra bcom rkyen rtogs sangs rgyas rnams/ /de las skyezhing 'byung bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar sā lu'i sa bon sogs/ /zhing pas srung ༅bar byed pa ltar/ /de bzhin theg mchog mos rnams la'ang rgya/ /'dren pa rnams kyis srung bar ⑫mdzad/ /ji ltar mar ngo'i bcu 1/de184

bzhi la/ /zla ba cung zad ༅mthong ba ltar/ /de bzhin theg mchog mos rnams la'ang / /sangs rgyas sku ni cung zad mthong / /ji ltar tshes pa'i zla ba la/ /skad cig skad cig rgyas par mthong / /de bzhin sa la zhugs rnams kyang / /rim gyis rim gyis 'phel bar ༅mthong / /ji ltar yar ngo'i bco lnga la/ /zla ba rdzogs par 'gyur ba ltar/ /de bzhin sa yi mthar thug na/ /chos kyi sku yang rdzogs shing gsal/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu mos pa brtan po yis/ /sems de yang dag skyed 3byas nas/ /phyir mi ldog par ༅yang yang 'byung / /nag po'i gzhi ni yongs spangs nas/ /dkar po'i gzhi ni rab bzung bas/ /de tshe de ni nges rtogs pa/ /dga' ba zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /'dod chags la sogs sna tshogs pa'i/ /dri mas rtag tu dri ma can/ /dri ma med par ༅ gang dag pa/ /dri ma med ces brjod pa yin/ /nyon mongs dra ba rab 'gags nas/ /dri med shes rab rab gsal bas/ /tshad med pa yi mun pa dag /sel bar byed pas 'od byed pa'o/ /rtag tu dag pa'i 'od kyis gsal/ /'du 'dzi rnam par spangs pa yi/ /ye shes 'od kyis rab bskor bas/ /sa de 'od 'phro can du 'dod/ /rig dang sgyu rtsal bzo gnas kun/ /bsam gtan rnam pa sna tshogs nyid/ /nyon mongs shin tu sbyang dka' las/ /rnam par rgyal bas sbyang dkar 'dod/ /byang chub rnam pa gsum po dang / /phun sum tshogs kun bsdu ba dang / /skyedang 'jig pa zad pa la/ /sa de mngon du 'gyur — bar 'dod/ /'khor lo'i bkod pa spurnam kun du/ /'od kyi dra bas rtse ba dang / /'khor ba'i mtsho yi 'dam rgal ༅bas/ /de la ring du song zhes bya/ /sangs rgyas kyis nges 'di bzung zhing / /ye shes rgya mtshor zhugs pa dang / /'bad med 1—185

lhun gyis grub gyur pal/ /bdud kyi 'khor gyis mi g.yos pa'o⑤ so so yang dag rig kun la/ /chos ston pa yi 'bel ba'i gtam/ /rnal 'byor pa de mthar son pas/ /sa de legs pa'i blo gros 'dod/ /ye shes rang bzhin 'di yi sku/ /dri med nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'dzin pa las/ /chos kyi sprin ni kun du 'byung / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos kyi gnas/ /spyod pa'i 'bras bu yongs 'dzin pa༅/ /gnas ni yongs su gyur pa de/ /chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin/ /bag chags las grol bsam mi khyab/ /'khor ba'i bag chags bsam du yod/ /khyod ni kun du bsam mi khyab/ /gang gis khyod ni shes par nus / /ngag gi spyod yul kun las 'das/ /dbang po kun gyi spyod yul min/ /yid kyi shes pas rtogs bya ba/ /gang yang rung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rim gyis 'jug pa'i lugs nyid kyis/ /sangs rgyas sras po grags chen rnams/ /chos kyi sprin gyi ye shes kyis/ /chos nyid stong pa mthong gyur nas/khru /gang tshe sems ni rab bkrus pas/ /'khor ba'i gzeb las 'das gyur nas/ /padma chen po'i rang bzhin gyi/ /stan la de ni rab gnas 'gyur/ /'dab ma rin chen du ma'i 'od / /'dod par bya ba'i ze 'bru can/ /padma bye ba du ma yis/ /rnam pa kun du yongs su bskor/ /stobs bcu po yis yongs su gang / /mi 'jigs pa yis gang ⑤dag ngoms/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i sangs rgyas chos/ /spros med rnams las nyams mi mnga'/ /legs par spud pa'i lam ④kun gyis/ /bsod nams ye shes rab bsags pa'i/ /zla ba nya la skar ma yis/ /'khor du rnam pa kun gyis bskor/ /sangs rgyas phyag gi nyi ma der/ /dri med rin chen 'bar gyur te/ /sras kyi thu bor ༅dbang bskur bas/ /dbang bskur ba ni kun du stsol/ /rnal 1—186

'byor chen po der gnas nas/ /rmongs pas dman pa'i 'jig rten rnams/ /sdug bsngal gyis g.yengs 'jigs pa la/ /lha yi spyan gyis gzigs gyur nas/ /de yi sku las cha'od zer rnams/ /'bad pa med par 'byung 'gyur te/ /rmongs pa'i mun par zhugs de yi/ /sgo rnams 'byed par mdzad pa yin/ /lhag bcas mya ngan 'das pa rnams/ /lhag med mya ngan 'das par 'dod/ /'dir ni mya ngan 'das pa nyid/ /dri ma med par sems gyur pa'o/ /sems can kun gyi dngos med pa'i/ /ngo bo de yang de khyaspyod yul/ /de mthong byang chub semasadabang po②/ /shin tu dri med chos kyi sku/ /dri ma med pa'i chos sku la/ /ye shes rgya mtsho gnas gyur nas/ /sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin du/ /de las ④ sems can don rab lamadzad/ /chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa slob dpon po po ༅klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// // rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛji paṇḍi ༅ ta dang / lo tsā ba khya465 khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/ 178 khya mar byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod/ du 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sto tra/ co/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 'phagasapa④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉go ༅ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnamag179 lha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gtog 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mtha'/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/ ngu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na'angaka༅ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bu/ 〈〈pe 〉〉nag nya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snying po/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba / 180 ༅ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du ba khug rna/ ༅2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gyur/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dri ma sreg 'u〈〈pe ༅〈〈snar 〉〉nang na gnag rta〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gdungag gro〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sheg1—187
bsdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/(1༷)1wa 189

0011 ༄/ /dpe med par bstod pa/①༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ ni ru ⑤pa ma sta cha④/ bod skad du/ dpe med par bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig lta bas phongs pa yi/ /'jig rten 'di la phan brtson yo/ /dngos po med pa'i don rig pas/ /dpe med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gang zhig khyod kyis ④ cung zhig kyang / /sangs rgyas spyan gyis ma gzigs pa/ /khyod kyis ①gzigs pa bla med de/ /de nyid don ni rig pa lags/ /don dam pa yi yod pa nyid/ /rtogs dang rtogs bya mi mnga' zhing / /e ma'o ༅mchog tu rtogs dka' ba'i/ /chos nyid sangs rgyas rnams kyis rtogs/ /khyod kyis cung zhig ma bskyed cing / /chos rnams bkag pa'ang ma lags la/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi lta ba yis/ /bla na med pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ /'khor ba spangs par gyur pa yis/ /mya ngan 'das khyod mi bzhed kyi④/ /'khor ba ma dmigs pa nyid kyi/ /zhi de mgon po khyod kyis 1—190

rtogs/ /khyod kyis kun nas nyon mongs dang / /rnam byang ro gcig gyur rig pas / /chos dbyings mngon par dbyer med pa/ /kun du rnam par dag par gyur / /gtso bo khyed kyis 'ga' /༅zhig tu/ /yi ge gcig kyang ma gsungs la/ /gdul bya'i 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /chos kyi char gyis chim par khyamadzad/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i thugs mnga' khyod/ /phung po khams dang skye mched la/ /chags par gyur pa mi mnga' bas/ /chos rnams kun la brten ma lags/ /mgon khyod sems can 'du shes kyis/ /'jug pa kun du mi mnga' yang / /sdug bsngal gyur pa'i sems can la/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid gyur pa'ang khyod/ /bde dang sdug bsngal de bzhin du①/ /rtag mi rtag sogs la ④gtso khyod/ /de lta'i rnam rtog sna tshogs kyis/ /thugs ni chags par gyur ma lags/ /chos rnams gang du'ang 'gro 'ong med/ /de bzhin khyod kyis ⑤gshegs pa'ang lags/ /'ga' ru srungs pa ma mchis pa⑥/ /de phyir ①don dam rig pa'ang lags/ /kun gyi rjes su zhugs gyur kyang / /'ga' ru 'byung ba'ang ma lags la/ /skye dang chos dang sku rnams kyang / /thub chen khyod kyi bsam mi khyab/ /gcig dang gzhan pa rnams spangs pa/ /brag ca lta bu'i 'gro ba rnams/ /'pho dang 'jig pa rnam ⑤spangs pa⑨ / /smad pa med pa tshu khyod kyis rtogs/ /rtag dang chad pa dang bral zhing / /mtshan nyid mtshon bya rnam spangs par/ /gtso bos rmi lam sgyu tshogs ⑫bzhin/ /'khor ba nges par rtogs pa lags/ /bag chags gzhir ⑩gyur mthar thug pa'i/ /khyod kyis nyon mongs sdig pa spangs/ /nyon mongs nyid kyi rang bzhin yang / /khyod kyis ⑩bdud rtsi nyid du bsgrubs/ /dpa' bo khyod kyis ⑫gzugs rnams kyi/ /mtshan ma med mthong gzugs med bzhin/ /mtshan gyis 'bar ba'i sku nyid kyang //1—191

gzugs su spyod yul nyid du mthong / /gzugs su mthong bas mthong min yang / /mthong ngo zhes ni rjod par byed/ /chos mthong bas ni shin du mthong / /chos nyid mthong ba ma yin no/ /khong stong khyod kyi sku la med/ /sha dang rus pa khrag med kyang ①/ /nam mkha'i dbang po'i gzhu bzhin du/ /khyod kyi sku ni ston par mdzad/ /sku la bsnyun med mi gtsang ⑤med/ /bkres dang skom pa 'byung med kyang / /khyod ni 'jig rten rjes 'jug phyir/ /'jig rten spyod pa'ang ston ③par mdzad/ /las kyi sgrib pa'i skyon rnams ni④/ /sdig med khyod kyis ④kun spangs kyang / /khyod kyis ⑥sems can rjes gzung ④phyir/ /las spangs par ⑤yang rab tu bstan/ /chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir/ /gtso bo theg dbyer ⑨ma mchis kyang / /khyod kyi ⑫theg pa gsum bstan pa/ /sems can gzhug pa'i ched du lags/ /rtag cing brtan la zhi ba yi/ /chos kyi rang bzhin khyod kyi sku/ /rgyal bas gdul bya 'gro ⑫ba'i phyir/ /khyod nyid ⑫mya ngan 'das par bstan/ /grangs med 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /'das dang bltams dang mngon byang chub/ /'khor ba'ang 'thar par mos rnams kyi/ /khyod la gus rnams kyis yang ④mthong / /mgon po sems pa mi mnga' zhing / /rnam rtog g.yo ba mi mnga' yang / /khyod nyid ⑫ngang gis 'jig rten la/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa'ang 'jug par 'gyur/ / de ltar bde gshegs yon tan tshad med bsam mi khyab / /me tog gis brgyan pa las ⑫bsod nams gang thob par/ /gyur pa 'di ⑫ni sems can ma lus pa 'di dag /mchog tu rtogs dka' thub pa'i chos kyi snod gyur cig /dpe med par bstod pa slob dpon 'phags pa ༅klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //1—192

rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛji ①paṇḍi ta dang / lo tsā ba dge slong ②sngo pa khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o//① //bsdur mchan/19༷ ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ru/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉pa/〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ ④⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma ho/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/191 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi gang / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'ang / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyur pa/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'ang ma lags la/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhin/⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnams/ ⑨⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sogag ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉bzhir/⑫⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/192 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyang med/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rus pa'ang / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsten/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyang / ⑤④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉2)rgyag ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dbye/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyig ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dgrol/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyang / ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyig ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de ltar bde las bdag gi ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'dig ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—'phags pa/192 ①〈〈pe 〉〉krisnye/〈〈snar 〉〉kro / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dge slong / ①〈〈pe 〉〉 maṅgago/1—193

0012༄7/ /'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa/phyo༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ lo kā tī ta sta (rgya / bod skad du/ 'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /dben pa'i ye shes rig gyur pa/ /'jig rten 'das khyod phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gang khyod 'gro la phan pa'i phyir/ /yun ring thugs rjes ngal bar gyur / /phung po tsam las grol ba yi/ /sems can med par khyod bzhed la/ /sems can ngan la'ang mchog gzhol bar/ /thub pa chen po khyod nyid zhugs/1 / /blo ldan khyod kyi phung de'ang / /sgyu ma smig rgyu dri za yi/ /grong khyer rmi lam ji bzhin du/ /blo ldan rnams la rab tu bstan/ /gang dag rgyu las byung ba rnams/ /de med par ni yod min pas/ /gzugs brnyan nyid dang mtshungs pa ru/ /gsal bar ci yi phyir mi 'dod/ /'byung ba mig gis gzung ④ min pas/ /de dngos mig gi ji ltar yin/ /gzugs nyid gzung bar rab bkag pa/ /1—195

gzugs nyid khyod kyis de ltar gsungs/ /tshor bya med par de med pas/ /tshor ba nyid ni bdag med pas/ /tshor ba de yang rang bzhin gyis/ /yod pa min ①par khyod nyid bzhed/ /ming dang don dag tha dad min/ /me yis kha nyid tshig ⑤par 'gyur/ /gzhan na'ang rtog ①pa med 'gyur zhes/ /bden pa gsung ba khyod kyis bstan/ /byed po rang dbang nyed las ④kyang / /tha snyad du ni khyod kyis bstan/ /phan tshun ltos ⑤pa can nyid du/ /grub par khyod ni bzhed pa lags/ /byed po yod min spyod po'ang med/ /bsod nams de min rten 'brel skyes/ /rten ④nas skyes kyang ma skyes zhes/ /tshig gi bdag po khyod kyis gsung ④/ /shes pa med par shes bya ⑤min/ /de med rnam par shes pa'ang med/ /de phyir shes dang shes bya dag /rang dngos med ces khyod kyis gsung ⑨/ /mtshan nyid mtshon bya gzhan nyid na⑫/ /mtshon bya mtshan nyid med par 'gyur/ /tha dad min na'ang med de ⑪par/ /khyod kyis gsal po nyid du bstan/ /mtshan nyid mtshan ⑫bya rnam bral zhing / /tshig gis brjod pa rnam spangs par/ /khyod kyi ⑫ye shes spyan nyid kyis/ /'gro ba 'di dag zhi bar mdzad/ /dngos po yod pa nyid mi skye /med pa'ang ma yin yod med min/ /bdag las ma yin gzhan las min / /gnyis min skyeb ⑫ji lta bu/ /yod pa gnas par rigs 'gyur gyi/ /'jig par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /med pa mi gnas par rigs ⑫pas/ /'jig par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /re zhig zhig pa'i rgyu las kyang / /'bras bu 'byung bar mi rigs la/ /ma zhig las min rmi lam dang / /'dra ba'i skye ba khyod nyid bzhed/ /zhig dang ma zhig pa dag gis/ /rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung ba dag /sgyu ma 'byung ba bzhin du 'byung / /kun kyang de bzhin khyod kyis gsungaske/ /de 1—196

phyir khyod kyis 'gro 'di dag /yongs su brtags pa las byung bar/ /kun du shes bya 'byung ba na'ang / /skye ba med cing 'gag med gsungs/ /rtag la 'khor ba yod ma yin/ /mi rtag pa la'ang 'khor ba med/ /de nyid rig pa'i mchog khyod kyis/ /'khor ba rmi lam 'dra bar gsungs/ /sdug bsngal rang gis byas pa dang —/ /gzhan gyis byas dang gnyis gas byas/ /rgyu med par ni rtog ge 'dod//khyod kyis ①rten nas 'byung bar gsungs/ /rten cing 'brel par gang 'byung ba/ /de nyid khyod ni stong par bzhed/ /dngos po rang dbang yod min zhes/ /mnyam med lhod kyi seng ge'i sgras⑤/ /kun rtog thams cad spang ①pa'i phyir/ /stong nyid bdud rtsi ston mdzad na/ /gang zhig de la zhen gyur pa/ /de nyid khyod kyis shin tu smad/ /beems po gzhan dbang stong pa nyid/ /sgyu ma bzhin du rkyen 'byung bar / /mgon po khyod kyis chos kun gyi/ /dngos med goms par mdzad pa lags/ /khyod kyis cung zhig ma bskyed cing / /'ga' yang bkag pa ma mchis la / /sngon gyi ji ltar phyis de bzhin/ /de bzhin nyid ni thugs su chud/ /'phags pa rnams kyis bstan rjopa yi/ /bsgom ④ma zhugs par mtshan med 'di/ /rnam par shes par 'gar 'gyur ram/ /mtshan ma med la ma zhugs par/ /thar pa med ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ /de phyir khyod kyis theg chen rnams/ /ma lus par ni de nyid bstan/ /bstod pa'i snod khyod bstod pa las/ /bdag gis ①bsod nams gang thob pa/ /des ni 'gro ba ma lus rnams/ /mtshan ma'i 'ching las grol gyur cig /'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛḍi ④paṇḍi ta dang / lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas 1—197

001na༄/ /sems kyi rdo rje'i bstod pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ chu badzra sta tha⑤/ bod skad du/ sems kyi rdo rje'i bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis sems byung dra ba ni/ /sems nyid kyis ①ni bsal mdzad de/ /sems kyi rmongs pa sel ba yi/ /rang sems de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs rnams/ /tha dad lha yi dmigs pa la/ /rin chen sems ni rnam grol las/ /lha gzhan bsgrub tu yod ma yin/ /sems ①thob pa ni byang chub ste/ /sems ni 'gro ba lnga po yin/ /bde dang sdug bsngal mtshan nyid dag /sems las ma gtogs cung zad med/ /'gro ba kun gyi ④mthong ba rnams/ /cung zad bsgom pa'i rnam pa yang / /de kun sems kyi dra ba ru/ /de nyid gsung bas bstan pa yin / /rnam par rtog pa spangs pa'i sems/ /rnam par rtog pas bsdos ④byas pa'i / /'khor ba rnam rtog tsam nyid de/ /rnam rtog med pa thar pa yin/ /de 1—199

bas kun gyis 'bad pa yis/ /byang chub sems la phyag bya'o/ /sems kyi rdo rje ①bsgom pa'i phyir/ /de ni byang chub mchog ces bya/ /khams bskyed sems ni lus kyis bcings/ /sems med khams ni bde bar ②'jug /de phyir sems ni kun du bsrung / /bde legs sems las ①sangs rgyas 'byung / /sems kyi rdo rje'i bstod pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so//du //bsdur mchan/199 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rimā du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgo/2༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉khed par/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉 maṅgast+waṃbasdur 'bras re'u mig bstod tshogs/ (13)1wa 200

༄/ /don dam par bstod pa/①༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ pa ra ma yotho sta tha⑤/ bod skad du/ don dam par bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye ba med cing gnas med la/ /'jig rten dpe las shin tu 'das/ /ngag gis brjod pa'i spyod yul min/ /mgon khyod ji ltar bstod ①par bgyi/ /de lta na yang gang 'dra bas/ /de bzhin nyid don spyod yul gyi/ /'jig rten btags pa la gnas nas/ /gus pa chen pos bdag gis bstod/ /skye ba med pa'i ngo bo yis / /khyod la skye ba yong ④mi mnga'/ /mgon khyod gshegs dang byon mi mnga'/ /dngos mi mnga' la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /dngos med ma lags dngos ma lags/ /chad pa ma lags rtag ma lags/ /mi rtag ma lags rtag ma lags/ /gnyis mi mnga' la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /dmar dang ljang dang btsod mdog min/ /ser dang gnag ①dang dkar ma lags/ /khyod la kha dog yong khyami dmigs/ /1—201

mdog mi mnga' la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /chen po ma lags chung ma lags/ /ring dang zlum pa ①ma lags la/ /tshad med pa yi dngos brnyes pa/ /tshad mi mnga' la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /ring min nye ba ma lags shing / /nam mkha' ma lags sa ma lags/ /'khor min mya ngan 'das ma lags/ /gnas mi mnga' la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /chos rnams kun la mi gnas pas/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi dngos gyur cing / /mchog tu zab pa gnyis ⑤brnyes pa/ /zab mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod 1 / /de lta'i bstod pas bstod bgyi'am/ /yang na 'dir ④/ni ci zhig bstod/ /chos rnams thams cad stong pa la/ /gang la bstod cing gang gis bstod/ /skyedang 'jig pa rnam ④spangs shing / /gang la mtha' dang dbus med patshu / /gzung dang 'dzin pa mi mnga' ba④/ /'dir ni nga bstod nus pa gang —/ /gshegs dang byon pa mi mnga' zhing / /'gro spangs bde bar gshegs bstod pa'i༅/ /bsod nams des ni 'jig rten rnams/ /bde gshegs gnas su 'gro bar shog /don dme par bstod pa/ slob dpon 'phags pa ༅klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛṇḍa paṇḍi ta dang / lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/201 ༅mab byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shāposta ba/ bu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brjod/④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yongag ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nag / ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yongag1—202

015༄༅/ /sku gsum la bstod pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ kā ya tra ⑤ya sto tra nā ma/ bod skad du/ sku gsum la bstod pa zhes bya ba⑤/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur ④pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gcig min du ma ma yin bdag dang gzhan la phan pa phun sum tshogs chen gzhir gyur pa/ /dngos min dngos po med pa ma yin mkha' ltar ro gcig rtogs par dka' ba'i rang bzhin can/ /gos pa med cing mi 'gyur zhi la mi mnyam mnyam pa khyab pa can te spros med pa/ /so so rang rig rgyal ba rnams kyi chos sku dpe med gang yin de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rang gi 'byor pa 'jig rten las 'das bsam gyis mi khyab legs mdzad brgya yi 'bras bu ni/ /blo can rnams kyi dga' ba bskyed phyir 'khor gyi nang du sna tshogs rgyas par ston mdzad cing / /rtag tu dam pa'i ༅chos kyi sgra skad rgya chen 'jig rten kun du 'phro bar mdzad pa po//sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs sku chos kyi rgyal srid gnas pa gang yin de la phyag 1—204

'tshal lo/ /sems can rnams ni smin par mdzad phyir la la dag tu me 'bar bzhin du gang snang zhing / /la lar yang rgyani rdzogs par byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu zhi bar gang snang la/ /sna tshogs thabs tshul ༅rnam pa du mar 'jug cing srid pa gsum gyi 'jigs sel ba/ /phyogs bcur chub mdzad thub pa rnams kyi sprul sku don chen gang yin de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can don gcig rgyun du mdzad cing bsod nams ye shes chen po dpag med las byung ba'i/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sku gsum yid dang tshig gi lam las rab tu 'das pa la/ /bdag gis ④dad pas phyag byas dge ba byang chub sa bon bsags par gyur pa gang yin des/ /sku gsum thob nas 'gro ba 'di dag ma lus byang chub lam la nges par 'dzud ④par shog /sku gsum la bstod pa zhes bya ba slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛji paṇḍi ta dang / lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //1—205

bsdur mchan/①'a di pe 'i ②le na pe 'a2༷4 ma sang 'a 〈〈 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar ba 〈〈 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 〈〈 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 sa bya ba/④〈〈pe〉〉ges/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/2༷5 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la sa ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 rnamasakyi/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsogabasdur 'bras wo migabastod tshogs(15)1—206

༄༅/ /sku gsum la bstod pa zhes bya ba'i rnam par 'grel pa/༅༄7༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ kā ya tra ya sto tra nā ma su bi ba ra nā ma/ bod skad du/ sku gsum la bstod pa zhes bya ba'i rnam par 'grel pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag nyid chen po'i sku gsum gyi/ /bstod pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ /gzhan gyi ༅gsol bas bskul bas na/ /ji ltar bkod pa rnam par dbye/ /de la gcig min du ma ma yin zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gsum gyis brjod par bya ba dang / dgos pa dang / 'brel pa dang / dgos pa'i yang dgos pa brjod par bya ste/ gang gi phyir brjod pa dang / dgos pa dang / 'brel pa med pa dag la ni so sor rtog pa sngon du gtong ba dag len par mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir 'dir ci zhig 'chad par 'gyur zhes 'di la yang dag par rmongs pa dag dran pa 'jug par bya ba'i phyir brjod par bya ba bshad do/ /bshad pa don med par rtog pa dag nges 1—207

par 'jug par bya ba'i phyir dgos pa bstan to/ /thabs med par dogs pa bsal ba'i phyir 'byel ba bshad de/ gzhan du na thabs med pa dag la ji ltar 'jug par 'gyur/ de la 'dir sku gsum ni brjod par bya ba'o/ /de'i rang gi ngo bo nyid bshad pa ni dgos pa ste/ de'i rang gi ngo bo nyid bshad pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad pa 'di byas so/ /de bas na dgos pa dang tshigs su bcad pa dag rjod pa dang brjod par bya ba'i mtshan nyid du 'brel ba'am/ tshig dang tshig can 'byel ba'am/ thabs dang thabs las byung ba'i mtshan nyid du 'brel ba'am/ sgrub pa dang bsgrub 0par bya ba'i mtshan nyid du 'byel ba'am/ bya ba dang byed pa'i mtshan nyid du 'brel ba ni 'brel ba'o/ /de nas 'bad pa dang rtsol ba'i brtson 'grus dang ldan par rang nyid kyis sku gsum gyi don dang bya ba mthar phyin pa ni dgos pa'i yang dgos pa yin par shes par bya ste/ 'di ni re zhig don gyi spyi yin no/ /da ni yan lag gi don brjod par bya ste/ gcig min du ma ma yin zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ gcig dang du ma ni gcig dang du ma ste/gnyis ④ni gnyis med pa nyid do/ /du ma ni mang po nyid de/ gcig dang du mar ma gyur pa'i chos kyi sku gang yin pa de la bdag phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go / /ci'i phyir gcig kyang ma yin la du ma yang ma yin zhe na/ de'i phyir gzod ma nas ma skyes pa'o zhes 'byung bas na gang thog ma nyid nas ma skyes pa de la gcig dang du ma'i gnas skabs su bya bar mi nus te/ nam mkha' ltar yongs su chad pa med pa'i ngo bo nyid do/ /chos thams cad kyang de bzhin nyid las byung bas na/de'i phyir gang zhig gang las byung bar gyur pa ste/ gang gis sna tshogs pa'i gzugs su gyur pa de ma mthong ste/ sā ④lu la sogs pa'i sa bon las ni sā ⑤lu'i 1—208

'bras bu'o/ /de bzhin du stong pa nyid las gang zhig 'byung bar 'gyur ba ni rtag pa dang chad par mi 'gyur te/ gang gi phyir kun du rtog pa ma lus pa dang bral ba'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis kyang stong zhing sgyu ma dang 'dra bar gzigs so/ /gzhan yang khyad par du bya ba'i phyir bdag dang gzhan la phan pa phun sum tshogs chen gzhir gyur pa zhes bya ba smos te/ bdag dang gzhan ni bdag dang gzhan te/ de dag la phan pa phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhir gyur pa ni mngon par mtho ba dang —/ nges par legs pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi phun sum tshogs pa chen po'i gzhir gyur pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /gang gi phyir chos kyi dbyings gcig dang du ma dang bral ba'i ngo bo thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid du bshad na/ ji ltar na bdag dang gzhan la phan pa phun sum tshogs pa chen po'i gzhir gyur pa yin zhe na / nyes pa med de/ 'di ltar ma rig pa'i bag chags kyi stobs kyis ①snod dang bcud kyi tshul du gnas pa ltar bdag dang gzhan la phan pa phun sum tshogs pa chen po'i gzhir gyur pa yin te/ rmi lam la sogs pa'i shes pa bzhin no/ /gal te ma rig pa'i bag chags dang chos kyi dbyings thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i ngo bo de yang ma rig pa'i bag chags su gyur pa ni gla rtsi la sogs pas bsgos pa bzhin te/dngos po rnams kyi chos nyid ni de lta bu'o/ /de bas na bdag dang gzhan la phan pa phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhir gyur pa yin no/ /gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad cing lam bzang po rnyed pas ma rig pa'i bag chags glo bur ba ring du byas shing yongs su dag par gyur pa ni gser dang zangs kyi dri ma dang bral ba bzhin te/ 'di la yon tan dang nyes pa len cing spong ba yod pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ /yang dag pa'i don rtogs pa kho na tsam du zad de/ de'i phyir/1—209

'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /gzhal ①bar bya ba gang yang med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta / /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /zhes gsungs pa gang 'di ltar rkyen dang ldan pa ni kun nas nyon mongs par thal bar 'gyur gyi ma skyes pa skye bar ni ma mthong ngo / /skyes pa 'gag pa dag las kyang cung zad skyeb med de/ mya ngan las 'das pa ni mar me dang mtshungs so/ /gzhan yang khyad par du bya ba'i phyir/ dngos min dngos po med ⑤ma yin/ /zhes bya ba smos te/dngos po ni gzugs su yod pa'o/ /de med par gyur pa ni dngos po med pa ste/gnyi ga las ldog par 'gyur bas na/ dngos min dngos po yod pa ma yin/ /zhes bya ba geste yod pa dang med pa dang dbus las 'das par gyur pa'o/ /de nyid kyis nam mkha' ltar ro gcig pa ste/ nam mkha' ltar zhes bya ba ni nam mkha' dang 'dra bar ro gcig cing mnyam pa'i rang bzhin du gang gyur pa de ni nam mkha' ltar ro gcig ces bya'o/ /de nyid kyis na rtogs par dka' ba'i rang bzhin can te / dngos po dang dngos po med pa gnyi ga dang gzhan las btsal ba dang bral ba nyid do/ /de bas na gos pa med pa ste/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyes pa'i dri ma dang bral ba nyid do/ /de nyid kyis na ⑤mi 'gyur ba ste rang gi ngo bo nyid la mi 'pho ba'o/ /zhi ba ni nyon mongs pa thams cad zhi bar gyur pa'o/ /mi mnyam pa ni mtshungs pa med pa'o/ /mnyam pa ni chos thams cad kyi gzhir mtshungs par gyur pa'o/ /khyab pa can ni thams cad du song bar gyur pa'o/ /spros pa med pa ni spros pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur pa'o/ /khyad par du bya ba gzhan yang so so rang rig ces bya ba ste/ sems can rnams kyi so so rang gis rig par gyur pa gzhon nu ma'i bde ba dris pa bzhin no/ /dpe med pa ni dpe 1—210

las 'das par gyur pa ste/ de skad du yang / mtshungs pa 'ga' yang yod min te / /tshig lam pa yang gang zhig yod/ /cung zad nye ba'am ring ba ni/ /'ga' yang yod pa ma yin no/ /'dren pa mnyam pa med gyur pa/ /de la dper bya gang zhig gzhal/ /skabs 'byed gzhi dang bral ba yi/ /mnyam med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bshad pas so/ /de lta bu'i chos kyi sku ste chos kyi lus de la bdag phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji lta bu su la zhe na/ rgyal ba rnams te shes bya ma lus pa thugs su chud pas thugs byin gyis brlabs pa la lus dang yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i don to/ /rang gi 'byor ba ni khams gsum pa thams cad kyi dbang phyug chen po'i mtshan nyid do/ /khyad par ji lta bu zhe na/ 'jig rten las 'das pa ste 'jig rten las rgal ba'o/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni sems kyi yul las ring du gyur pa'o/ /legs mdzad brgya yi 'bras bu zhes bya ba ni sbyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa rnams yun ring por nye bar bsags pa las skyes pa'o/ /gang gi zhe na/ blo can rnams kyi ste/ byams pa dang / mthong ba don yod dang —/ ngan song thams cad spong ba dang / mya ngan thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros la sogs pa'o/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ /dga' ba bskyed pa'i phyir te rab tu mgu ba'i rgyur ro/ /'khor ni byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs te de rnams kyi nang du'o/ /sna tshogs pa ni rnam pa du ma'o/ /rgyas par ston par mdzad pa zhes bya'o/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa dag gi bsam pa'i khyad par gyi dbang du mdzad nas bye brag du mar 'chad par mdzad pa'o/ /rtag tu dam pa'i chos kyi sgra skad rgya chen 'jig rten kun du 'phro bar mdzad pa po/ /zhes bya ba ni shin tu rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi gsung ngo / /thams cad du 'jug pas na rgya che 1—211

ba'o / /de nyid kyis na de rgyun mi 'chad par spro bas na shin tu mang zhing rgya che ba la sogs pa'i dam pa'i chos ston cing gsung bar 'gyur ba de la de skad ces bya'o/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya ba ni chos kyi de kho na nyid ji lta ba bzhin du brnyes shing thugs su chud pa'o/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku zhes bya ba ni rdzogs par longs spyod pa'i sku ste/sa bcu'i dbang phyug gi byang chub sems dpa' rnams la rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas longs spyod par mdzad pa'o/ /de'i phyir khyad par gzhan yang chos kyi rgyal srid chen po la bzhugs pa gang yin zhes bya ba smos te/ chos kyi srid kyang yin la chen po yang yin pas na chos kyi rgyal srid chen po ste khams gsum pa thams cad kyi bdag po'o/ /de la gnas pa'i sku gang yin pa de la de skad ces bya'o / /de ltar tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyis sku rnam pa gnyis po'i rang gi ngo bo nye bar bstan nas/ sprul pa'i sku'i ngo bo bstan pa'i phyir/ sems can rnams ni smin par mdzad phyir la la dag tu me 'bar bzhin du gang snang zhing / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ sems can rnams ni srogs chags rnams so/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ smin par mdzad pa'i phyir te yongs su smin pa'i don du'o/ /gang gis dus la la dag tu me dang 'dra zhing byin za bzhin du kun nas 'bar bar snang zhing 'od dang ldan pas rab tu 'bar bar snang ba'o/ /gnas gang du snang zhe na/ /smras pa/ rdzogs par byang chub ces pa ste/ byang chub pa nyid du'o/ /chos kyi 'khor lo ni bā rā ṇa sīr ༅drang srong zob ri dwags kyi nags /ldu su'o/ /rab tu zhi bar gang snang la/ /zhes pa ni gyad kyi nye 'khor shing sā la zung gi tshal du yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po ston pa'o/ /khyad par ci zhig ce na/ sna tshogs thabs tshul rnams kyis zhes bya ba ste/ sangs rgyas dang / rang sangs rgyas 1—212

dang / nyan thos dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / tshangs pa dang /brgya byin dang / dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i bdag nyid du ston pa'o/ /bye brag ji lta bu zhe na/ rnam pa du mar 'jug cing zhes pa ste / gdul bya sna tshogs pa rnam pa du ma'i rjes su 'jug par mdzad pa'o/ /khyad par ci zhig ce na/ srid pa gsum gyi 'jigs sel ①zhes bya ba ste/ 'dod pa dang gzugs dang gzugs med pa ste srid pa gsum gyi sems can rnams kyi skyeb la sogs pa'i nyes pa ring du mdzad pa ni 'jigs pa sel ba'o/ /gzhan yang khyad par du bya ba'i phyir phyogs bcur chub mdzad thub pa rnams kyi sprul sku don chen zhes bya ste/ phyogs bcur chub par mdzad pa ni phyogs bcu po rnams su rjes su khyab pa'o / /thub pa ni sku dang gsung thub pa dang ldan pas na thub pa ste sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das so/ /don chen ni mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i 'bras bu stsol ba'am thob par mdzad pa ste/ de lta bu'i sprul pa'i sku gang yin pa de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes slob dpon klu sgrub kyis gsungs pa yin no/ /de ni 'di skad du ston par 'gyur te/ gang gis bdag nyid kyis bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par mdzad nas/ gnas kyi mchog dga' ldan gyi gzhal yas khang na bzhugs pa byang chub sems dpa' dam pa tog dkar pos thugs kyi rang bzhin gyis byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dang / bsam gtan bzhi bsgoms pa'i rim gyis rnal 'byor chen po'i gnas 'og min du mngon par byang chub pa rnam pa lnga'i rim pas yang dag par sangs rgyas so/ /de nas sprul pa'i skus de bzhin gshegs pa ༅thams cad longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skus bzhugs pa dang / ri rab chen po'i steng du rdo rje nor bu 1—213

rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gi rtse mor gshegs te/ dkyil 'khor rnam pa bzhir mngon par sprul par mdzad nas/ slar yang dga' ldan gyi ①gnas mchog tu bzhugs pa'i dam pa tog dkar po dang gcig tu gyur nas lhums su 'jug pa dang / bltams pa dang / btsun mo'i nang na rol pa mdzad par bstan pa dang —/ mtshan mo mngon par byung ba dang / dka' ba mdzad pa dang / byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa dang / bdud btul ba dang / mngon par byang chub pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba nas ji srid du yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i bar gyis 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don mdzad par rab tu ston pa'i sprul pa'i sku la bdag lus dang ngag dang yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i don to / /de nyid kyi phyir na/ 'og min gnas ni nyams dga' bar/ /gtsang ma'i gnas kyi steng bzhugs te/ /yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa dag ni 'dir sangs rgyas/ /zhes bya ba gsungs pas so/ /de ltar tshigs su bcad pa gsum gyis sku gsum bstan nas/ gzhan yang spyon lam byed par 'dod pa'i phyir sems can don gcig rgyun du mdzad cing zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/sems can gyi don ni srog chags rnams kyi 'dod pa'i don rab tu sgrub ces bya ba'i don yin pas na/ 'gro ba'i don gcig rgyun du mdzad pa gang yin pa de ni sems can gyi don gcig rgyun du mdzad pa ste/ de lta bu'i sems can gyi don mdzad pa de la phyag byas pas zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ /yon tan ji lta bu dang ldan zhe na/bsod nams ye shes chen po dpag med las byung ba'i/ /zhes bya ba smos te/bsod nams dang ye shes chen po ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'o/ /de yongs su chad pa med par bsags pa ni dpag tu med pa ste/ bsod nams dang 1—214

ye shes chen po dpag tu med pa las byung ba ni de las skyes pa'o/ /de su zhig ce na / bde bar gshegs pa ste mdzes par gshegs pa'am slar mi ldog par gshegs pa'i chos can nyid yin pas na bde bar gshegs pa'o/ /yang na nyid kyi don mthar phyin pas na bde bar gshegs pa'o/ /rnams kyi sku gsum ni chos kyi sku dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / sprul pa'i sku zhes bya ba'i sku gsum pa'o / /de bas na de'i yon tan gyi khyad par ji lta zhe na/ yid dang tshig gi lam las rab tu 'das pa zhes bya ba ste/ dmigs su yod pa'i yid kyi yul las shin tu 'das pa'i don to/ /de lta bur gyur pa la mos pa'i dad pas 'dud cing phyag byas pa las so/ /bdag gis dge ba byang chub sa bon zhes bya ba ni byang chub pa'i sa bon ni byang chub kyi sems zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de bsgrubs shing bsags pa'o / /des na de'i bsod nams kyi tshogs gang yin pa des chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / sprul pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi sku gsum thob cing reg nas 'gro ba ma lus shing lhag ma med pa dag byang chub kyi lam la 'dzud pa ste/ byang chub pa'i lam ni byang chub lam ste/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i lam chen po de la rab tu 'dzud cing 'god par shog cig ces bya ba'i don to/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po mkhas shing yon tan phul byung spyod yul ba/ /shin tu nyams med rgya chen snying po don gyi tshogs sbas pa/ /bdag gis 'dir ni lo 'dab rtse tsam blangs nas rnam bshad kyis/ /mchog tu mkhas shing don gyi rjes 'brang 'dir ni tshad ma yin/ /slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sku gsum la bstod pa zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shradhwa ① ga ra warma dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba bande rin chen 1—215

bzang pos gsar du bsgyur cing zhus pa lags so// // bsdur mchan/2༷7 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyig2༷/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brjod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 pa/ du⑤ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga209 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/21༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bami ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 pa/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ba/⑤〈〈snar 〉〉ni212 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba ra ṇa sir/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gnathag213 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ba ②〈〈pe〉〉 pa/214 (1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyitheg215 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shra / bsdur 'azab ze'izu migabastod tshog ga(16)1wa 216

0017༄༅/ /sems can mgu bar bya ba'i bstod pa/khya /༄7༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa twa lda⑤ra dā na sta cha①/ bod skad du/sems can mgu bar bya ba'i bstod pa/ 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo /nga la gus pa sems can don te gus pa gzhan dag min/ /gang gis snying rje ma btang de yis nga la gus pa ste/ /snying rje btang nas gnas par gyur pa lhung ba gang yin pa/ /de ni de las snying rjes bslang bar nus kyi gzhan gyis min/ /gang gis ④snying rje sems can la ni rjes su zhugs gyur pa/ /des ni nga yang mnyes byas des ni bstan pa'i khur yang bzung / /tshul khrims thos pa snying rje dag dang blo dang gsal ba dag /gang la yod pa des ni rtag tu bde bar gshegs pa mchod/ /nga nyid sems can phan 'dogs gyur pas grub 'di brnyes pa ste/ /sems can kho na'i don du nga yis sku 'di yang dag bzung / /sems can rnams la yid kyis gnod par sems de gang gi phyir/ /nga la mi ltos pas na de'i don 1—217

ston par mi 'gyur ro①/ /sems can phan pa chung yang des ni mchod pa 'byung 'gyur te/ gang gis yid ni mgu bar byed pa mchod pa yin pas so/ /gnod pa'i bdag nyid can nam gzhan la rnam par 'tshe ba'ang rung / /legs par sbyar nas mchod par gyur kyang des ni mchod mi 'gyur/ /chung ma dag dang bu dang 'byor dang rgyal srid chen po dang / /sha rnams dang ni khrag dang tshil dang mig dang lus rnams kyang / /gang la brtse ba'i dbang du byas nas nga yis gye yongs btang ba/ /des na de la gnod pa byas na nga la gnod byas 'gyur/ /des na sems can phan pa byas na nga la mchod pa'i mchog /sems can gnod pa byas pa nga la shin tu gnod pa'i mchog /bde dang sdug bsngal nga dang sems can mtshungs par myong bas na/ /sems can rnams la 'tshe bar byed de nga yi slob ma ji ltar yin/ /sems can rnams la brten nas sangs rgyas mnyes dang dge ba byas / /sems can mang po'i don la rab gnas pha rol phyin pa thob/ /sems can don la brtson pa'i yid kyis bdud kyi stobs kyang bcom/ /sems can rnams la de lta de ltar spyad pa des na nga sangs rgyas/ /skyeb skye bar gces par gyur pa'i gnyen 'dra srog chags med gyur na/ /dngos po gang la 'dir ni snying rje byams las dmigs pa nges par 'grub/ /btang snyoms dga' ba la sogs dngos po'i yul dang rnam par thar la sogs gang la/ /gang gi don du snying rje de la 'bad pa'i yid kyis bzod pa yun rings bsgoms/ /glang po la sogs 'gro ba sems can rnams nyid du ma nga yis sbyin pa byas/ /sems can rnams nyid snod nyid du yang nye bar gyur pas nga yis sbyin pas bsdus/ /sems can rnams nyid sna tshogs dngos por gyur pas nga yi snying rje 'phel bar gyur/ /gal te sems can 1—218

rnams nyid bsrung ma byas na gang gi don du don 'di bsgrubs/ /gal te sems can med na 'khor bar nyon mongs mi bzad rab tu mang po las/ /skye ba brgyud par gnod pa mtshungs pa med las gang la brten nas phan 'di bsgrubs/ /bde bar gshegs kyi bdag nyid chen po ngo mtshar che ba 'khor ba'i rgyan gyur 'di/ /gal te nga la sems can rnams la brtse med gyur na gang gi don du nye bar bsgrubs//ji srid nga yi bstan pa 'gro ba rnams la phan pa 'dir ni 'bar gyur pa/ /de srid gzhan la mchog tu phan par 'dod pa khyed kyis gnas par gyis/ /thos pas nga yis legs par spyad pa sems can don la mi skyo thos bgyid la/ /skyo ba med par lus 'di las ni snying po dag ni blang bar gyis/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod ba tshu'i chu klung zhes bya ba'i lung las bcom ldan 'das kyis nyan thos chen po bcu drug la bka' srul pa/ /sems can mgu bar bya ba'i bstod pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas bsdus pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po 1chen po dī po 0ka ra ṭīdzñā na dang / lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //1—219

bsdur mchan/217 0mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉satwa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gli218 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gethu ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉brtan/219 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉/paṇḍi ta/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉 /brtsar 'bras re'u migabastod tshog ga(17)1wa 220

0018༄/ /rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bstod pa/shā ༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā badzra rnya ra sto tra/ bod skad du/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bstod pa/ phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas klas pa na bzhugs pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / rdo rje lha mo dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / khro bo'i rgyal po la sogs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po la bstod pa'i rgyal po 'dis bstod par gyur to/ /kun rdzob bden pa la phyag 'tshal/ /don dam khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bden gnyis dbyer med la phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje'i sku yo la phyag 'tshal/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs ni dag /sku ni gdod nas nam mkha'i sku/ /rnam par mi rtog dmigs pa med/ /rang bzhin med pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /dge dang mi dge'i rnam rtog dang / /yid la byed dang sems pa med/ /rang bzhin gyis ni nam mkha'i tshul/ /rdo rje sems 1—221

dpa' yo phyag 'tshal/ /'khor ba'i sgrub pas 'khor gyur pa'i/ /phung po lnga ni rnam par dag /sangs rgyas lnga yi ngo bo nyid/ /nam mkhar gnas pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /yongs su mi shes 'khor ba yi/ /rgya mtshor 'khyams pa'i lus can phyir / /yongs shes skya ba 'dzin pa yi/ /ded dpon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo /rtag dang mi rtag sogs rnams la/ /rtag dang mi rtag sogs rnams kyis/ /rnam dag lam ston la mkhas pa/ /rdo rje slob dpon khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rang gi sde dang gzhan gyi sde/ /lta ba'i rims kyis btab pa yi/ /nad pa rnams ni gso mdzad pa/ /sman pa'i rgyal po khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sna tshogs rnam par rtog pa yi/ /'dam gyis ma gos gtsang ba'i sku/ /'od gsal bar ni ngang gis gnas/ /padma chen po khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa nam mkha' chen po'i rgyud las 'byung ba/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bstod pa/ phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun gnas brtan pho po dpal rdo rje 'chang gi sku can spyan snga rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyi bka' bzhin zha lu lo tsā ba rnyarma pā las dpal gdan sa thel gyi yang dgon du bsgyur ba'o// //
bsdur mchan/221 ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung laspoblangasate bkod cing/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du chos tshan 'di med pasadape bsdur byung med do//bsdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/(18)1—223
