༄/ /lo rab kyi pha rol ca phyim ma'i bapong pa rgya/ri rwa sa sa sgo / /shā /༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra dzñā pā ra mi ta sto —༅/ bod skad du/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i ༅bstod pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ༅la phyag 'a༅ lo/ /gang yo sku kun nyes med la/ /nyes med rnams kyis gzigs mdzad pa/ /dpag med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rnam par mi rtog phyag 'a༅ 'dud/ /nam mkha' bzhin du gos med cing / /spros pa med cing yi ge med/ /bsam yas yo mthong gang yin pa/ /des ni de bzhin gshegs pa mthong / /'phags ma yon tan phyug yo dang / /sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i bla ma rnams/ /khyad par yod par ma 'khums te/ /zla ba dang ni zla 'od bzhin/ /gus la byams ma sangs rgyas kyi/ /chos kyi sngon sa yo brtan nas/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid mnyam med pa'i/ /bdag nyid po por bde blag yo/ /lan cig tsam yang bsam dag pas/ /yo la ༅ bzhin blta ba dang khya / /des 1—224

kyang mthong ba don yod kyi/ /dngos grub nges par thob par 'gyur/ /gzhan don mngon dga'i bdag nyid can/ /dpa' bo dag ni thams cad kyi/ /gso mdzad bskyed par mdzad pa ste/ /khyod ni byams ma'i yum lags so/ /gang slad sangs rgyas 'jig rten gtso/ /thugs rje can rnams khyod kyi sras/ /de yi slad du dge ma khyod/ /sems can kun gyi phyi mo lags/ /pha rol phyin pa dri med pa/ /kun gyis ma smad pa khyod kyi/ /dus kun rjes su 'brang lags pa/ /rgyu skar rnams kyis zla ris bzhin/ /gdul bya'i 'gro ba la brten nas/ /de dang de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis/ /khyod nyid gcig pu tshul mang du/ /sna tshogs mtshan gyis bsngags pa mdzad/ /zil pa'i chu yi thigs pa rnams/ /nyi ma'i 'od dang mjal ba bzhin/ /rgol ba rnams kyi rtsod dang skyon/ /khyod dang mjal na 'jig par 'gyur/ /khyod nyid byis pa rnams la ni/ /skrag byed mthong na 'jigs pa dang / /mkhas pa rnams la dbugs 'byin pa/ /skyed pas mthong na zhi ba lags/ /khyod mgon gang la khyod la yang / /mngon par chags pa mnga' min na/ /de la yum gcig khya ji ltar na/ /gzhan la 'dod chags zhe sdang 'byung / /khyod ni gang nas ma byon zhing / /gang du yang ni mi gshegs pas/ /gnas ni thams cad dag tu yang / /mkhas pa rnams kyis dmigs ma lags/ /gang khyod de ltar ma 'khums nas/ /bsam pa yis ni bsgrubs pa dang / /bsgrubs pa las ni rnam grol ba/ /de 'dir rmad byung chen po lags/ /khyod nyid mthong na 'ching 'gyur zhing / /ma mthong na yang 'ching bar 'gyur/ /yo nyid mthong na grol 'gyur zhing / /ma mthong na yang grol bar 'gyur/ /e ma ya mtshan cher 'ong ma/ /grags ldan ma khyod bzang mo lags/ /shin tu rtogs 1—225

dka' sgyu ma bzhin/ /snang zhing mi snang ba yang lags/ /sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /nyan thos rnams kyis nges bsten ma/ /khyod nyid gcig pu thar pa'i lam/ /de ltar gzhan dag med par nges/ /lus can rnams la phan don du/ /tha snyad mdun du mdzad nas ni/ /brtse bas 'jig rten mgon rnams kyis / /khyod bstan ma bstan par yang gda'/ /'dir khyod bstod par sus rngo thogs① / /mtshan ma med cing gos pa med/ /ngag gi yul kun las 'das ma/ /gang khrod 'gar yang rten mi mnga'/ /de ltar gda' yang kun rdzob tu/ /bdag cag ngag lam 'di 'dra bas/ /khyod ni bstod byar mi gda' na'ang / /bstod pas shin tu mya ngan 'das/ /shes rab pha rol phyin bstod las/ /bdag gis ⑤dge ba gang bsags pa/ /de yis 'jig rten ma lus pa/ /shes rab pha rol phyin gzhol shog /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i bstod pa slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //kha che'i paṇḍi ta thig le bum pa dang / lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur batshe(— 1—226

bsdur mchan/224 ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 shesarab kyi pha rol /waphyin pa'i bstod pa bzhugs son/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rta/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gangashe225 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cig226 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thog ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/bsdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/(19)1wa 227

༄/ /bsam gyis mi khyab par bstod pa/༅༄7ste/ /rgya gar skad du/ yochu sta bomi/ bod skad du/ bsam gyis mi khyab par bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig dngos po rten 'byung rnams/ /ngo bo med pa nyid du gsungs/ /ye shes mnyam med bsam mi khyab/ /dpe med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar khyod kyis theg chen la/ /nyid kyis chos la bdag med rtogs/ /de bzhin blo dang ldan rnams la/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis bstan pa mdzad/ /rkyen rnams las ni 'brel 'byung ba/ /ma skyes lags par khyod kyis gsungs/ /ngo bo nyid kyis de ma skyes / /de phyir stong par rab tu bstan/ /ji ltar 'di na sgra brten nas/ /brag ca kun du 'byung ba ltar/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu bzhin du yang / /de bzhin srid pa kun du 'byung / /sgyu ma dang ni smig rgyu dang / /dri za'i grong khyer gzugs brnyan dang —/ /rmi lam gal te ma skyes na/ /mthong ba la sogs dpe med 'gyur/ /ji 1—228

ltar rgyu rkyen las byung ba/ /de dag byas pa can du bzhed/ /de bzhin rkyen las byung ba kun/ /mgon po khyod kyis de ltar gsungasal/ /byis pa gang dag ci brjod pa/ /bgyis pa zhes bgyid de mchis te/ /chad pa stong pa 'dra ba lags/ /don bzhin ma lags rab tu bstan/ /gang tshe byas pa'i dngos ma skyes/ /de tshe da ltar byung ba yi/ /gang zhig pas na 'das par 'gyur/ /ma 'ongs pa yang ji ltar ltos/ /rang las dngos po skye ba med/ /gzhan dang gnyis ga las ma yin/ /yod min med min yod med min/ /de tshe gang las gzhan zhig 'byung / /ma skyes pa la rang bzhin med/ /de phyir gang las kun du 'byung / /rang bzhin dngos po med grub pas/ /gzhan las kyang ni 'byung ba med/ /rang nyid yod na gzhan yod 'gyur/ /gzhan nyid yod na rang nyid yod/ /de dag ltos ⑤pa can du grub/ /pha rol tshu rol bzhin du gsungs/ /gang tshe ci la'ang mi ltos ②pa/ /de tshe gang la gang zhig 'byung / /gang tshe ring la mi ltos ④pa/ /de tshe thung sogs ga la mchis/ /ji ltar gcig sogs ma mchis pa/ /'das dang ma 'ongs la sogs pa/ /nyon mongs rnams kyang de bzhin te/ /yang dag log pa'ang rang las ci/ /dngos gang rang las ma mchis na/ /de tshe thams cad ci zhig mchis/ /gzhan zhes brjod pa gang lags te/ /rang gi rang bzhin med na min/ /gang tshe gzhan gyi dngos med pa/ /de tshe dngos rnams rang bzhin med/ /de tshe gzhan dngos dngos 'dzin pa/ /don gyi theg pa ci zhig mchis/ /gdod ma nyid nas mnyam gyur pa/ /rang bzhin gyis kyang mya ngan 'das/ /yang dag par ni ma skyes lags/ /de slad chos rnams khyed kyis gsungs/ /blo ldan khyod kyis gzugs la sogs/ /ngo bo nyid med par bstan pa/ /dbu ba chu bur sgyu la sogs/ /smig 1—229

rgyu chu shing 'dra ba lags/ /dbang po rnams kyis gang dmigs de/ /gal te yang dag mchis gyur na/ /byis pas yang dag rig par 'gyur/ /gang tshe yang dag shes pas ci/ /dbang po rnams ni bems po dang / /tshad ma nyid kyang ma yin dang / /lung ma bstan pa nyid dang ni/ /log par yongs shes khyod kyis gsungs/ /gang gis ci zhig ma rtogs pa/ /yang dag ji bzhin thugs chud nas / /des na 'jig rten mi shes pas/ /bsgribs pa zhes kyang khyod kyis gsungs/ /yod ces pa ni rtag nyupar lta/ /med ces pa ni chad par lta/ /des na mtha' gnyis bral ba yi/ /chos de khyod kyis bstan pa mdzad/ /des na chos rnams mu bzhi dang / /bral bar khyod kyis bka' srul lags/ /rnam shes bya ba'ang khya ma lags la/ /rmi lam mig 'phrul las byung dang / /zla ⑤gnyis la sogs mthong ba ༅bzhin/ /'gro ba 'byung ba de dngos su/ /ma byung de bzhin khyod kyis gzigs/ /ji ltar rgyu las rmi lam na/ /'byung ba mthong ba de bzhin du / /dngos po thams cad 'byung ba bzhin/ /'jig pa'ang de bzhin bzhed pa lags/ /de bzhin chags sogs sdug bsngal dang / /'khor ba sdug bsngal kun nyon mongs/ /tshogs rdzogs pa dang thar pa yang / /rmi lam 'dra bar khyod kyis gsungs/ /de bzhin skyes dang ma skyes dang / /'ongs pa dang ni song ba yang / /de bzhin bcings grol ye shes la/ /gnyis 'dod yang dag rig ma lags/ /gang las skyes pa yod ma lags/ /de la mya ngan 'das gang yod/ /sgyu ma'i glang po 'dra bas na/ /don du gzod ⑤nas zhi ba nyid/ /skyes pa nyid na'ang ma skyes pa / /sgyu ma'i glang po ji bzhin bzhed/ /de bzhin thams cad skyes pa'am/ /yang dag par ni ma skyes lags/ /'jig rten mgon po dpag med kyis/ /1—230

sems can dpag tu ma mchis pa/ /so sor mya ngan 'das mdzad kyang / /de dag gis kyang gang ma bkrol/ /thub chen gang phyir sems can rnams/ /rang las ma skyes de yi phyir/ /gang yang gang gis ma bkrol zhes/ /de skad khyod kyis gsal bar gsungs/ /ji ltar sgyu ma mkhan gyis byas/ /dngos po stong pa de bzhin du/ /byas pa thams cad dngos stong gzhan/ /khyod gsung de bzhin byed pa po/ /byed pa po yang gzhan gyis bgyis/ /byas pa can du 'gyur ba lags/ /yang na de yi bya ba byed/ /byed pa por ni thal bar 'gyur/ /'di dag thams cad ming tsam zhes/ /khyod kyis gsang khyani bstod de gsungs/ /brjod pa las ni gzhan gyur pa/ /brjod par bgyi ba yong ma mchis/ /de phyir chos rnams thams cad ni/ /rtog pa tsam zhes khyod kyis gsungs/ /gang gis stong par rnam rtog pa'i/ /rtog pa yang ni med ces gsungs/ /dngos dang dngos med gnyis 'das pa/ /la lar ma 'das pa yang lags/ /shes pa med cing shes bya'ang med / /med min yod min gang lags dang / /gang yang gcig min du ma'ang min / /gnyis ga ma yin ci yang ༅med/ /gzhi ⑤med pa dang mi gsal dang / /bsam mi khyab dang dpe med dang / /gang yang mi skye mi 'gag dang / /chad pa med cing rtag med pa/ /de ni nam mkha' 'dra ba lags/ /yi ge ye shes spyod yul min/ /de ni rten cing 'byel par 'byung / /de ni stong par khyod bzhed lags/ /dam pa'i chos kyang de lta bu/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'ang de dang mtshungs/ /de ni de nyid don dang ni/ /de bzhin nyid dang rdzas su bzhed/ /de ni yang dag mi slu ④ba/ /de rdzogs pas na sangs rgyas brjod/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang chos dbyings dang / /des na don du tha mi dad/ /bdag nyid dang 1—231

ni gzhan rnams dang / /des na mnyam par khyod bzhed lags/ /dngos po rnams las stong gzhan min/ /de med par yang dngos po med/ /de phyir rten cing 'byung ba'i dngos/ /stong pa lags par khyod kyis bstan/ /rgyu dang rkyen las byung ba'ang lags/ /gzhan gyi ①dbang las kun rdzob ste/ /gzhan kyi dbang zhes rab tu gsungs/ /dam pa'i don ni bcos ma yin/ /ngo bo nyid dang rang bzhin dang / /yang dag rdzas dngos yod pa'ang lags/ /brtags pa'i dngos po med pa nyid/ /gzhan gyi dbang ni yod ma lags/ /brtags khyapa'i dngos po yod ces pa/ /sgro 'dogs lags par khyod kyis gsungs/ /byas pa chad nas med ces pa/ /chad pa lags par khyod kyis gsungs/ /yang dag shes pas chad pa med/ /rtag pa nyid kyang med par bshad/ /'gro ba dngos pos stong pa lags/ /de slad smig rgyu 'dra bar bzhed/ /ji ltar ri dwags skom chu ni/ /chad med rtag pa yod ma yin/ /de bzhin 'gro ba thams cad kyang / /chad med rtag pa med par gsungs/ /gang la rdzas shig skyo'agyur ba/ /de la chad sogs 'jig tshu pa 'byung / /de la 'jig rten mtha' yod dang / /mtha' med par yang 'gyur ba lags/ /shes pa yod pas shes bya bzhin/ /shes bya yod pas de shes bzhin/ /gang tshe gnyis na ma skyes par/ /rtogs pa de tshe ci zhig yod/ /de ltar sgyu ma la sogs dpe/ /sman pa'i mchog gis gsal bstan nas/ /lta ba thams cad 'gog byed pa'i/ /dam pa'i chos ni bstan pa lags/ /ngo bo med pa nyid bstan pa/ /de ni yang dag dam pa lags/ /dngos po'i gdon gyis zin rnams kyisangu/ /gso ba de ni bla na med/ /des na chos kyi mchod sbyin pa/ /mchod sbyin rim pas rtag rgyun du/ /'jig rten gsum po sbyin sreg mdzad/ /1—232

dngos 'dzin 'jigs pa gcod bgyid cing / /mu stegs ri dwags 'jigs bgyid pa / /bdag med seng ge'i nga ro'i sgra/ /rmad byung de ni khyod kyis gsungs/ /stong pa nyid dang ches zab pa'i/ /chos kyi rnga chen brdungs che pa lags/ /ngo bo nyid med sgra ⑤bo che'i/ /chos kyi dung ni bus pa lags/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bdud rtsi yi/ /chos kyi rdzas ni gsungs pa lags/ /chos rnams kun gyi ༅ngo bo nyid / /nges pa'i don to zhes kyang bstan/ /gang yang skye dang 'gag la sogs/ /sems can srog la sogs bstan pa/ /de ni bkri don kun rdzob tu/ /mgon po khyod kyis bstan pa lags/ /shes rab pha rol phyin mtsho yi/ /pha rol gang gis rang phyin te/ /bsod nams yon tan rin chen phyug /mgon khyod yon tan pha rol phyin/ /de ltar dpe med bsam mi khyab/ /'gro ba'i mgon po bstod pa yis / /bdag gis bsod nams gang thob des/ /'gro ba khyod dang mtshungs par shog /bsam gyis mi khyab par bstod pa slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// // 1—233

bsdur mchan/228 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/229 0)〈〈pe 〉〉btargyangamun 909)du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bltos/23༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉ltag ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'acan ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉/ba/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dab ⑤〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzog231 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gsungaka ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gcig kyangaka ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bas//232 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉btags/ 0)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'jigag ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/233 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brdungan ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dgra/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi cig bsdur 'bras zegazu migabastod tshogs/(2༷)1wa 234

༄༅/ /bstod pa las 'das par bstod pa/༅ ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ru ta ste sta 4khya/ bod skad du/ bstod pa las 'das par bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla med lam las gshegs pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bstod 'das kyang / /gus shing spro ba'i sems kyis ni/ /bdag gis bstod 'das bstod par bgyi༅/ /bdag dang gzhan dang gnyis sa las/ /rnam par dben pa'i dngos gzigs kyang —/ /khyod kyi thugs rje sems can las/ /ma log pa ni ngo mtshar lags/ /ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes shing / /tshig las 'das pa'i spyod yul gyi/ /chos rnams khyod kyis gang bstan pa/ /de ni khrod kyi ngo mtshar lags/ /phung po khams dang skyemached rnams/ /khyod kyis bsgrags par mdzad lags kyang / /de dag yongs su 'dzin pa ni/ /slad kyis kyang ni bzlog par mdzad/ /gang zhig rkyen las de ma mchis/ /dngos rnams rkyen las ji ltar skye /de skad mkhas pa khyod gsungs 1—235

pas / /spros pa rnams ni bcad pa lags/ /gang dag tshogs las rab grub na/ /tshogs pa rgyu las 'byung mthong ba/ /de dag mtha' gnyis brten par ni/ /khyod kyis shin tu gzigs pa lags/ /dngos po rkyen la brten grub par/ /khyod ni shin tu bzhed pa lags/ /de ltar byas pa'i skyon lags par/ /'di ltar ston pa khyod kyis gzigs/ /gang nas kyang ni mchi ma lags/ /gang du yang ni mchis ma lags/ /dngos po thams cad gzugs brnyan dang / /mtshungs par khyed ni bzhed pa lags/ /lta ba thams cad spang ba'i phyir/ /mgon po khyod kyis stong pa gsungs/ /de yang yongs su btags pa ste/ /dngos su mgon po khyod mi bzhed//stong dang mi stong bzhed ma lags/ /gnyis shar khyod dgyes ma lags te/ /de la rtsod pa ma mchis par/ /khyod kyis kyi gsung chen spyod pa lags/ /gzhan min dngos po yod min zhing / /gzhan min gnyis min zhes kyang gsungs/ /gcig dang gzhan nyid spangs pas na/ /ji lta bur yang dngos ma mchis/ /gal te skyosogs gsum mchis na/ /'dus byas mtshan nyid mchis par 'gyur/ /de dag gi yang skye la sogs/ /gsum pa tha dad 'gyur ba lags/ /skye sogs gsum po so so ni/ /'dus byas las la nus ma lags/ /gcig la gcig tu 'dus pa rnams/ /phrad par yang ni mchis ma lags/ /de ltar mtshan gzhi mtshan ma mchis/ /de ltar grub pa ma lags pas/ /'dus byas grub pa ma lags na/ /'dus ma byas lta ga la grub/ /zoba'i seng ges de skad du/ /khyod nyid gsungs na seng ge yis/ /'bigs byed glang chen smra rnams kyi/ /rgyags pa bsal bar gyur pa bzhin/ /lam zhugs gnod pa sna tshogs dang / /lta ba'i lam ngan mi rten 3/ ltar/ /yo la brten nas yod pa dang / /med pa nyid la'ang rten ma 1—236

lags/ /khyod kyis dgongs nas gsungs pa dang / /gang dag gis ni de ltar rtogs/ /de dag khyod kyis dgongs gsungs pa/ /phyir zhing rtogs par bgyi mi 'tshal/ /dngos kun mya ngan 'das mtshungs par/ /de ltar gang gis rnam shes pa / /de tshe de la ji lta ①bur/ /ngar 'dzin kun du 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de ltar yang dag rig pa'i mchog /de nyid rig pa khyod bstod pa'i/ /bdag gis rgyabasod nams gang yin des/ /'jig rten yang dag rig mchog shog /bstod pa las 'das par bstod pa slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //1—237

bsdur mchan/2 5 ①mtshanakhyang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉bgyig226 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsten/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brten/237 ①〈〈snar 〉〉ltar/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/bsdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/(21)1wa 238

0022༄/ /bla na med pa'i bstod pa/khya ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ni rutta sta thakhya/ bod skad du/ bla na med pa'i bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis ①tshu rol pha rol spangs/ /shes bya'i rang gi ngo bo mchog /ye shes rdzu 'phral ༄stobs kyis bsal④/ /bla med de la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gang la mkhyen dang mi mayo med/ /rnal 'byor pa dang tha mal dang / /gang la bsgom dang mi ba sgom med / /bla med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig gcig pu ye shes gsal/ /ma lus shes bya yongs su gcod/ /de ltar mnyam zhing gzhal med pa/ /bla med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig rags dang phra ba dang / /lci ba dang ni yang ba'i rdul / /sbrul gyi rkang pa'i rang bzhin med/ /bla med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis srin bu'i stobs kyis ni/ /gang zhig thang la mchi ba ltar/ /gang gis 'u snang bas mun bsal ba/ /bla med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig sprul 1—239

ldan rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /gar mkhan rkang pa bskyod pa la/ /gang gis ①lam gzigs lam mkhyen pa/ /bla med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig gis ni cha shas dang / /don stong min te gnyis ga spangs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dbang phyug gtso/ /bla med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shin tu nyes pa rnam spangs shing / /dri ma'i bdag nyid las ring ba/ /dngos dang dngos po med spangs pa/ /bla med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla na med pa'i bstod pa slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //1—240

bsdur mchan/①'a di pe ko labe pe 'i pe239 ma byang 'a 〈〈 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bad/ 〈〈 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉/ 0〈〈 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gago ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/24 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ bsdur 'bras phro migabastod tshogs/(22) 1—241

0023 ༄/ /'phags pa rje btsun 'jam dpal gyi don dam pa'i bstod pa/①༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ārya bhaṭwā ra ga masgru shrī pa ⑤ra ma satho ①stu ti nā /rdo// /byebye/ /byebye/bye /rdo //sde/ //ste/ma / da skad du/ 'phags pa btsun 'jam dpal na dam pa ba da pa zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byon pa ma lags bzhud mi mnga'/ /bzhengs pa ma lags bzhugs mi mnga'/ /'jig rten pa las shin tu 'das/ /tshig las 'das pa'i spyod yul lags/ /mgon po yo la ji ltar bstod/ /'on kyang 'jig rten btags rten ④gyis/ /yo ni ci 'dra de bzhin du/ /bdag gis gus pas bla ma bstod/ /ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes te/ /o la skye ba yong mi mnga'/ /mgon po gshegs dang byon mi mnga'/ /dngos med yo la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yo la dngos dang dngos med min/ /chad pa ma lags ther zug min/ /yo rtag ma lags mi rtag min/ /gnyis med yo la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dmar dang ljang dang le brgan dang / /ser dang dkar 1—242

dang gnag ma lags/ /yo la kha dog yong mi mnga'/ /mdog bral yo la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yo ni che dang chung ba dang / /sbom dang phra ba yo min te/ /ring dang thung ba'i khams ma lags/ /tshad med yo la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /shes pas srid la mi gnas shing / /snying rjes zhi la mi gnas te/ /mya ngan 'das dang 'khor mi gnas/ /mi gnas yo la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chos rnams kun la mi gnas shing / /chos kun rtogs par thugs su chud/ /mchog tu zab pa nyid brten ①pa/ /zab pa yo la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de ltar bstod na bstod bgrang gi/ /gzhan du yo la ji ltar bstod/ /chos rnams thams cad stong pa la / /sa la bstod cing sa yis bstod/ /mtha' ma mchis shing dbas ma mchis /ri ri ri rngo sari rgyagazung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa'i/ /rtog bral o la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bla ma mgon po 'jam dbyangs kyi/ /don dam yang dag mtshan brjod pa'i/ /bsod nams 'di yis 'jig rten 'di/ /bde bar gshegs pa 'dra bar shog /'phags pa rje btsun 'jam dpal gyi don dam pa'i bstod pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po ②klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //1—243

0024༄/ /rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi snying rje la bstod pa/① ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ārya mañdzu shrī bhas ra ga kā ru ṇa sto tra/ bod skad du/ rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi snying rje la bstod pa/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyes pa ma lus pa rnams rab bsal zhing —/ /thub pa'i grags pas 'gro ba ma lus khyab/ /dpal ldan rab tu brtan ②pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /dpal ldan khyed la rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /bos shing bos shing 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /phongs pa 'di dag kun las khyed skyob mdzad/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal gyur kyang dman khyed ces/ /ci yi phyir na nges par sel mi mdzad/ /bcom ldan khyod ni rtag par thams cad la/ /rnam pa kun du thams cad gsol grag na/ /bdag la mthong ba tsam yang ma stsal bas/ /de phyir bdag ni shin tu skal dman lags/ /yon tan ldan zhing nyes pa sel mdzad pa/ /blo bzang 'gro kun ༅ par brtson gyur na/ /bdag blo yo la mngon du zhen na 1—245

yang —/ /phongs pas gdungs pa nyid du ci phyir 'gyur/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid ldan pa khyed kyi ni/ /padma lta bu dag pa'i spyan gnyis kyis/ /'gro ba phan par mdzad kyang bdag sdug par/ /ma gzigs pa ni kye ma sdug bsngal lo/ /khyed kyis yid 'jigs dbugs 'byin mdzad pa yi/ /phyag gi padma ring du rtag rkyong yang 1/ /skal nyes pa yi tsha bas de yang ni/ /thag ring du ni mi snang nyid du 'gyur/ /khyed kyi snyan ni ma nyams gtsang ba dag /gnyis kyis kyang ni lus la sdug bsngal gyis/ /gzir te spyan sngar 'o dod 'bod gyur kyang / /bdag gi dman pa ci phyir gsan ma gyur/ /rnam pa kun du thugs rjes drangs khyed kyis/ /dmyal bar song ba'i 'gro rigs bde mdzad na/ /sdig can bdag la bcom ldan 'das kyis ni/ /thugs rje de yang brtse ba mi mnga' gyur 1/ /'jig rten dman la phan par mdzad pa yi/ /khyod la gzhon nu'i rol pa 'di mnga' na/ /gang 'dir bdag ni sdug bsngal gyis gzir kyang / /bskyab par mi mdzad sdig can bsam pas nyes/ /'di na sdug bsngal can ni gang yin zhes/ /glen gang gang gis phun tshogs zad gyur ces/ /de ltar rnam par rgyu zhing skyob mdzad kyang / /bdag phongs ma gzigs kye ma ngo mtshar che/ /gang zhig la ni tshig sbyin gang zhig la / /'phral du phun tshogs rgya chen sbyin bya zhes/ /de ltar brtson pa khyed kyi mkhyen rab kyis/ /ci yi phyir na bdag la skyob mi mdzad/ /khyed la dad par gyur pa su mi bde/ /khyed dang bsod nams dman pa zhig ma mchis/ /bdag ni khyed la dad kyang sdug bsngal bar/ /ci phyir gyur ces ngo mtshar rnam par 'khrungs/ /sdug bsngal gcod mdzad sman pa chen po ni/ /gang de ༅khyed kyang bdag la spong mdzad na/ /bsod nams bcom pa bdag gis gzhan su la/ /1—246

skyabs su mchi bar bgyi ba khyed kyis gsungs/ /'gro la rtag tu bu gcig 'dra ba yi / /brtse ba'i thugs ni mnga' zhing sgrol spyod pa/ /go kyang gal te bdag gnod mi sel na/ /de tshe bdag ni mgon med bcom pa lags/ /bcom ldan khyed ni dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /'gro la 'bras bu mnyam med kun stsol na/ /bdag ni bsnyen bkur bgyid kyang bdag gi phyogs/ /rnam pa kun du phyi bshol ci phyir mdzad/ /de ltar smre gsol ba yis khyod yon tan/ /cha tsam brjod las bdag gis dge bsags pa/ /gang yin des ni 'gro la bsod nams dag /rgya cher rang bzhin grub pa'i bum pa bzang / /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu gzugs sku yi / /zhabs gnyis rgyu ba'i dpag bsam 'dra ba yi/ /khyod kyi gzhon nu'i lus su bdag gyur cing / /skyeb kun du bdag po nyid gyur cig /rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi snying rje la bstod pa slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //1—247

bsdur mchan/245 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉bstan/246 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṭhāskyongan ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gyur/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rmu bsdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/(24)1wa 248

༄/ /gnas chen po brgyad kyi mchod rten la bstod pa/①༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ aṣṭa ma hā sthā ②na tsi khya khyasto tra/ bod skad du/gnas chen po brgyad kyi mchod rten la bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i bla ma gcig pu lusbyir ④bltams/ /ser skya'i grong khyer gzhi ru gnas par mdzad/ /yon tan rin chen bye bas brgyan pa yi/ /bde gshegs mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma ga ṅgā ⑤yi byang chub shing drung du/ /chu bo ṣpe rañdza na zhes bya ba'i/ /'gram bzhugs mchod rten yon tan rgya che ba/ /byang chub rten du gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ga shi ga yi bā rā ṇa sī rgya ru//chos kyi 'khor lo rnam grol rmad byung ni④/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa rnam par gcod mdzad pa/ /ye shes mchod rten bzhi ⑤ la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyan du yod par gzhan stobs tshar bcad nas/ /dze ta'i tshal du cho 'u'aphrul chen po bstan/ /sa gsum dgongs pa mchog tu bsgrub mdzad pa/ /mu stegs pham mdzad mchod rten 1—249

phyag 'tshal lo/ /grong khyer dam pa mchog ni gsal ldan du/ /lha rnams gnas gshegs bla na med par babs/ /zhabs la tshangs dbang cod pan gyis mchod pa//sum cu'i lhas mchod mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun dbyen du sngar gyur las / /ston pa'i nyan thos rab mthun pa/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi 'od ma'i tshal/ /byams ngos mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku tshe 'du byed btang ba las/ /slar yang sku tshe byin brlabs pa/ /rnam grol yangs pa can gyi ni/ /byin brlabs mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /ku sha'i grong du 'gro ba rnams/ /dge ba la ni sbyor mdzad cing / /'gran med gyad gnas zung gi tshal/ /mchod rten mya ngan 'das phyag 'tshal/ /shāka thub mchod rten brgyad po dag① /phyogs bcu gzhan dang gzhan rnams na/ /bzhugs pa'i chos sku kun la 'dud/ /zhi la rtag tu spyis phyag 'tshal / /'di ltar spros pa kun bral dpe med rtag cing dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /sangs rgyas chos sku mkha' ltar 'gro ba la khyab yang dag phyag 'tshal bas/ /bsod nams gangs ri'i kha dog ltar dkar bdag gi rgyud la gang bsags pa/ /des ni sems can ma lus ting ②'dzin bde rtogs byang chub thob par shog /gnas chen po brgyad kyi mchod rten la bstod pa/ /slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so//④ //1—250

bsdur mchan/249 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉sga ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lum pir/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rta/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba ra ṇa ge ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzhi/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉chu/25༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dngan ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 'a/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rigag du〈〈pe 〉〉 maṅgā tshan/ bsdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogatheg(25)1wa 251

0026༄/ /gnas chen po brgyad kyi mchod rten la bstod pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ aṣṭa ma hā sthā༅ na tsi khya ④sto tra/ bod skad du/gnas chen po brgyad kyi mchod rten la bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags te/ /byang chub snying por sangs rgyas bdud ni btul/ /byang chub chen po'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi gzhir gyur ser skya'i grong khyer du/ /sgyu ma'i yum las zas gtsang shāka rigs 'khrungs/ /sku bzhengs sta zur g.yas la ④tshangs pa ⑤bzhes/ /bkra shis 'byung ba'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ / bā rā ṇa sī ༅la sogs bsod snyoms gshegs/ /gzugs can snying po'i glang chen spyon pa rnams/ /phyag gi sor ④mo'i stobs kyis btul nas kyang —/ /grong khyer 'dul mdzad mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /ne gsing dag tu bsnyel so mdzad pa'i tshe/ /ha lu mañdzus sbrang rtsi phul nas kyang / /khron par dus 1—252

byas sum cu rtsa gsum skyes/ /thugs rje 'byung ba'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs pas 'khor lo phul nas 'khor lo bskor/ /mu stegs ston pa drug ni stobs kyis btul/ /sprul pa'i grangs kyis lha mi tshim mdzad pa'i/ /cho 'phrul bstan pa'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /dga' bo la sogs klu yi tshogs rnams kyis/ /bsnyen bkur 'bul ba'i ①bu mos 'o ma drangs/ /bka' chadang 'jig rten ma lus tshar gcod pa/ /nyer zhi rgyal ba'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dang rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /nyan thos dgra bcom tshogs kyis yongs bskor te/ /sdom dang tshul khrims la ni rab bkod pa'i/ /rnam par dag pa'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can mi rtag 'dul ba'i dgongs pa dang / /lha las babs nas mdzad pa kun gyi mthar/ /tsun das gsol btab zla gsum nas mthar phyin/ /mya ngan 'das mdzad mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnas chen po brgyad kyi mchod rten la bstod pa/ /slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyis ③ mdzad pa rdzogs so// //1—253

༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ dī da sha kā ra nā ma na ya dusto lnga/ bod skad du / mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul la bstod pa ༅ / sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis dang por byang chub thugs bskyed nas/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs mdzad cing / /dus 'dir mdzad pa rgya chen 'gro ba yi/ /mgon gyur khyod la bdag gis bstod par bgyi/ /lha rnams 'dul mdzad 'dul ba'i dus mkhyen nas/ /lha las babs nas glang chen ltar gshegs te / /rigs la gzigs nas lha mo sgyu 'phrul gyi/ /lhums su zhugs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla ba bcu rdzogs shākya'i sras po ni/ /bkra shis lumbi'i ༅tshal du bltams pa'i tshe/ /tshangs dang brgya byin gyis btud mtshan mchog ni/ /byang chub rigs su nges la ༅ phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhon nu stobs ldan mi yi duseng ge des / / lo ga khrum ga dhwar duni sgyu rtsal bstan/ /skyebo dregs pa can rnams tshar 1—255

bcad nas/ /'gran zla med par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten chos dang mthun par bya ba dang / /kha na grom tho spang phyir btsun mo yi/ /'khor dang ldan mdzad thabs la mkhas pa yis/ /rgyal srid skyong bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo / /'khor ba'i bya ba snying po med gzigs nas/ /khyim nas byung ste mkha' la gshegs nas kyang / /mchod rten rnam dag drung du nyid la nyid/ /rab tu byung bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtson pas byang chub 'grub par dgongs nas ni//nai rañdza na'i 'gram du lo drug tu/ /dka' ba spyad mdzad brtson 'grus mthar phyin nas / /bsam gtan mchog brnyes mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog ma med nas 'bad pa don yod phyir/ /ma ga dhwa yi byang chub shing drung du/ /spyil krung mi g.yo mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /byang chub rdzogs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo//thugs rjes 'gro la myur du gzigs nas ni/ / bā rā ṇa sa khya la sogs gnas mchog tu / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas gdul bya rnams/ /theg pa gsum la 'god mdzad phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan gyi rgol ba ngan pa tshar bcad nas/ /mu stegs ston pa drug dang lhas byin sogs/ /'khor ④mo 'jig gi yul du bdud rnams btula'u/ /thub pa g.yul las rgyal mdzad phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid pa gsum na dpe med yon tan gyis/ /mnyan du yod par cho 'phrul chen po bstan/ /lha mi 'gro ba kun gyis 4 rab mchod pa/ /bstan pa rgyas par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /le lo can rnams myur du bskul bya'i phyir/ /rtswa mchog grong gi sa gzhi gtsang ma ru / /'chi med rdo rje lta bu'i sku bshig ༅nas/ /mya ngan 'da' bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag nyid du 'jig pa med phyir dang / /ma 'ongs sems can bsod nams thob bya'i phyir/ /de nyid du ni ring bsrel mang sprul nas/ /cha 1/de256

brgyad sku gdung mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bstan pa'i bdag po bcom ldan gyi/ /mdzad pa'i tshul la mdo tsam bstod 44 yis ①/ /dge bas 'gro ba kun gyi spyod pa yang / /bde gshegs nyid kyi spyod dang mtshungs par shog /mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi 465 la bstod pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po 'phags pa ②klu sgrub kyis mjosad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/255 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉yā ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgozhes bya ba/④〈〈snar 〉〉lum bi'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mdzad/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yig ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉aṅga/ ri she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtar/256 ①〈〈pe 〉〉nas/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rta/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba ra ddha se/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉khor/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉btud/ ⑥〈〈snar 〉〉mi ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉bshigag257 ①〈〈snar 〉〉ba yī〈〈pe 〉〉pa gi ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 chen po 'phagasapa/bsdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/ (27) 1wa 257

༷028༄/ /phyag 'tshal ba'i bstod pa/① ༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ ban da ②na sto tra nā ma/ bod skad du/ phyag 'tshal ba'i bstod pa zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo / /gnod byed 'dod chags zhe sdang dang / /srid 'khor rmongs chen dra ༅ba spangs/ /mchog sbyin mdzad pa rgyal ba mchog /mchog byung sangs rgyas bdag phyag 'tshal/ /yang dag thugs chud rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /lha dang lha min mchod byas pa/ /'jig rten gsum gyi bla ma la/ /mi pham mnyam pa med gyur cing / /bdud stobs pham mdzad bdag phyag 'tshal/ /shākya'i rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs/ /gdung ni nyi ma'i rigs su grags/ /dpa' bo rmad byung sangs rgyas ni/ /yon tan tshogs ni bsdus pa la/ /lha mi rlung lhas mchod phyag 'tshal/ /gser gyi ri bo'i rtse 'dra'i sku/ /padma'i 'dab ma'i spyan mnga' ba/ /gser gyi mdog dang ldan gyur cing / /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan dang ldan/ /shis ldan mtshan bzang 1—258

phyag 'tshal lo/ /me dang glog dang me stag dang / /nyi zer stong ldan dkyil 'khor can/ /gang gis stobs ni brgyan gyur pa/ /mnyam med stobs ldan phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan mchog ni 'bar ba yi/ /bsod dang dul bar yang dag ldan / /thub pa'i dbang po mchog gyur pa/ /yang dag byang chub brnyes pa la/ /ches dregs phyag byas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig sems can phan mdzad cing / /bde ba'i don phyir snying rjes 'jug /yang dag don la zhugs gyur pas/ /mya ngan 'das grong gshegs phyag 'tshal/ /'dis ni lto 'phye mi 'am ci/ /lha dang lha min phyag byas pa/ /bdag gis rgyal ba bstod pa las/ /bsod nams bdag gis gang bsags pa/ /des ni sems can thams cad kyang / /byang chub khong du chud par shog /phyag 'tshal ba'i bstod pa slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //1—259
bsdur mchan/ —258 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod cing /〈〈pe 〉〉phyag 'tshal bstod pa zhegebya ba/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉brdo/①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byed 'dra/bsdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/(28)1wa 260

༄/ /dmyal ba nas 'don pa zhes bya ba/༅/༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ na rag urnya ri / ༅nā ma/ bod skad du/dmyal ba nas 'don pa zhes bya ba/ 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen por ni/ /dbul ba'i 'dam du bying ba la/ /yongs su mkhyen pa bskyed nas ni/ /de bzhin gshegs bye bdag la skyobs/ /bdag ni rab rib khang par zhugs/ /mgon med sdug bsngal nyams su myong / /bdag ni gnyen gyi tshogs kyis spangs/ /de bzhin gshegs kye bdag la skyobs/ /pha dang ma dang sring mo dang / /bu dang chung ma mdza' bshes mo/ /mig 'phrul lta bur bdag gis 'khums/ /de bzhin gshegs kye bdag la spyosas/ /bdag 'dir 'khor 'dab rnams kyi phyir/ /las gang legs dang nyes byas pa/ /de yis bdag ni gcig pur gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs kye bdag la skyobs/ /khron ༅rnying mi bzad chen po dang / /gting med rgya mtsho dag rnams su/ /mgon po bdag 1—261

cag long gyur na/ /de bzhin gshegs kye bdag la skyobs/ /rgya mtsho chen po rgal ba yi/ /gru ni gog por zhugs pa ltar/ /bdag gis kyang ni rgal dkar 'khums/ /de bzhin gshegs kye bdag la skyobs/ /chos dang chos min ma 'tshal zhing / /bgrod dka' bgrod min mi rig ①pas/ /'di ni sems med shing dang 'dra/ /de bzhin gshegs kye bdag la skyobs/ /pha bsad pa dang ma bsad pa/ /kho bos mtshams med lnga bgyis pa/ /mi bzad rab rib mun par 'khums/ /de bzhin gshegs kye bdag la skyobs/ /bdag gis mchod rten 'jig par bgyis/ /dge 'dun dkor ni rnam par 'joms/༅/ /bdag gis sems can 'tshe bar bgyis/ /de bzhin gshegs kye bdag la skyobs/ /'jig rten 'di na bde ma ①mchis/ /'jig rten pha rol 'tshal ma gyur/ /las kyi srad bus dkris pas na/ /de bzhin gshegs kye bdag la skyobs/ /de yi gson pa 'di 'dra ba④/ /mkha' la ga shi'i me tog ni/ /rlung gis btang nas 'phyan pa bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs kye bdag la skyobs/ /'brog dgon dang ni tsher ma yi / /ljon shing mang po rten ⑤med pa/ /de na bdag gis ④lam ma mthong / /de bzhin gshegs kye bdag la skyobs/ /nyes pa med par phyugs rnams dang / /ri dwags mang po mdas bsad pas/ /de tshe bdag ni rgyal por rlom/ /de bzhin gshegs kye bdag la skyobs/ /sems can dmyal bar 'tshed pa na/ /skyob pa 'ga' yang yong ma mchis/ /gang la skyabs su mchi bar bgyi/ /bdag la skyob par su zhig 'gyur/ /sman pa rnams kyi sman pa'i rgyal/ /nad rnams thams cad gso mdzad pa/ /khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu ba/ /skyob byed 'jig rten mgon po lagasaX/ /dmyal ba nas 'don pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyis 1—262

0༷30༄༅/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa las bstod par mi nus par bstod pa zhes bya ba/ nya༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ barṇarta barṇa 3bha ga ba to budha sto tra a ④shākya sta ba nā ma/ bod skad du/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa las bstod par mi nus par bstod pa zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhing dang zhing min ma 'tshal te/ /sgra tsam gyi ni rjes 'brangs nas/ /bdag gis nongs te sngon chad ni/ /bsngags min bsngags pa brjod pa gang / /ngag gi 'dam gyis gos pa de/ /thub pa bsod nams 'bab kyis 3 stegs/ /bzhud pa khyod la rten kyi bcas nas/ /rab tu bkru ba 'di brtsam mo/ /'di ni bdag gis mchog tshogs la/ /gti mug ldongs pas nongs bgyis gang / /sdig pa de yi nongs pa dag /sel bar bgyid pa'i bsang byed lags/ /bdag ni mya ngan 'das bar du/ /khyod kyi gsung dang khyod kyi ni/ /yon tan brjod pa gang lags pa'i/ /tshig lam gnyis las nyams ma gyur/ /1—264

gtam 'di tsam zhig snying por bas/ /de las gzhan don ma mchis pas/ /zon 'di nyid smra bar shog /yang na bdag ni mi smrar shog /yo kyi chos ni kho na dang —/ /khyod mnyam khyod ni nyid la mnga'/ /de slad chos gzhan thams cad ni//khyod las khyad du khor ma lags/ /gal ༅te sangs rgyas chos rnams ni/ /bsam pa bgyis na thams cad kyi/ /phul du phyin gyur dngos po gzhan/ /mi gtsang nyid dang 'dra bar gyur/ /khyod 'dra 'ga' yang ma mchis na/ /lhag pa lta zhig smos ci 'tshal/ /khyod bas khyad par cung zad kyis/ /dman pa tsam yang 'ga' ༅ma mchis/ /'dren pa khyod la gang zhig gis/ /dper brjod dpe ni ma mchis pas / /dpe yi glags ni spangs pa'o/ /dpe med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos ni gzhal las phyir/ /de las gzhan pa'i gang zag ni/ /rnam grol 'dra ba thob rnams kyang / /yo dang khyad par shin tu che/ /stong pa tsam du 'dra slad du/ /su zhig khyad par ma 'a༅ nas/ /ba spu'i bu ga stong pa ni/ /chung ngu nam mkha' dag dang bsgrun // /grangs med pa la su zhig bgrang ④/ /tshad med pa la su zhig 'jal/ /yo kyi yon tan grangs dang ni/ /mthu la dpogs pa ma mchis so/ /ji ltar dpag bsam shing gi tshal/ /'byams bu klas nang du 'khyams pa ltar/ /bdag ni khyod la legs spyad kyis/ /ngoms ma 'tshal te mtha' mi rtogs/ /yon tan rnams kyi yon tan mtsho/ /khyod kyi de bzhin gshegs chos rnams/ /gal te bstan du mchis gyur na/ /nam mkhar yang ni shong mi 'gyur/ /khyod kyi mngon sum bsnyen bkur ba/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi sde dpon po/ /nyan thos kun gyi tog gyur pa/ /zab mo rjes su sgrogs pa la/ /kun mkhyen nyid phyir bcom ldan gyis/ /rmas na ma mtshal zhes gsol pas/ /1—265

sangs rgyas chos kyi zab mo nyid/ /bas ma 'tshal bar bshad pa lags/ /gal te gtso bo de dag kyang / /khyod la nus pa rdugs lags na/ /bdag 'dra srid pa mi gtsang ba'i/ /srin bus bsam skabs ga la mchis/ /sā la'i shing chen khyod nyid kyi / /yon tan yal ga thugs brtse bas/ /btud pa rnams la skyebo 'di/ /cung zad 'ju ba tsam du bas/ /char sprin tshogs ni chen po yis/ /char gyi rgyun rnams phab pa las/ /so ga'i tsha bas gdungs pa yi/ /khug ①rtas 'tshal na'ang ci zhig 'tshal/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho las ni/ /chu bo chen po bzhi 'bab kyang / /de zad bgyid par mi nus na/ /gzhan dag 'bab pas smos ci 'tshal/ /rin chen 'byung khungs rnams kyis ni/ /'jig rten rgyas bgyis pas ma 'tshal/ /mgon yo yon tan brjod pa'ang / /bdag ni de 'dra kho nar sems/ /bsgrims ②nas khyod kyi bstan nyid las/ /yon tan me tog rnams btus te/ /rang gi me tog dag gis ni/ /shing bzhin khyod la me tog gsol/ /rang gi dbyig gi 'byung khungs bzhin/ /rang gi maza ②rtsis ri lta bur/ /rang gi dri yis tsandan bzhin/ /rang gi chu yis mtsho lta bur/ /rang las byung ba'i gser nyid kyis/ /gser 'byung ba yi rin chen bzhin/ /khyed bstan nyid las btus pa yi/ /yon tan rnams kyis khyod mchod do/ /nam mkha'i dkyil nas zla 'od thams cad du/ /'phros ④pa ril gyis ①'bab 'gyur pa ⑥yin la/ /zla 'od sa stengs ④bab pas kha phye na/ /me tog ku mu ta tshal mi rgyas min/ /de bzhin yon tan dpag med chu ldan pa/ /rgyal ba'i bsngags pa rgya mtsho mtha' med la/ /de yi phyogs gcig brjod pas dad ldan pa'i/ /skyebo'ang 'dod pa'i las bur mi ldan min/ /sangs rgyas bsngags pa brjod tshig 'bras bu yod/ /skyeba'i zong 1—266

brin bder 'gyur gegs med lam/ /tshangs pa'i theg 'gyur dad sogs yon tan gyi / /rtsa ba'i ser rme de la sogs pa yod/ /dbang po rab tu dad par gzhol gyur cing / /sangs rgyas bstod pa'i gzhung la brtson pa rnams/ /skad cig re rer chos rgyun 'byung ba gang / /kun mayo min pas cung zad bzung mi nus/ /mthu bdog mi rtag par yang zhugs gyur pa①/ /dal 'byor 'di yang shin tu dka' ba las/ /gang dag las 'di la ni mi brtson pa/ /de las bslus par gyur pa gzhan ci yod/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa bsngags pa 'os pa bsngags pa las bstod par mi nus par bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u dang po'o // //bcom ldan yo ni zhal bzhugs tshe/ /bdag ni dad dbang gzhol gyur pa/ /gang slad thugs rjes brlan pa yi/ /sangs rgyas spyan gyis gzigs mdzad pa/ /nga kyi thugs rje de nyid ni/ /yid la mchis pa mngon bgyis nas/ /phyag bgyir 'os pa khyod la bdag /mngon sum bzhin du phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun mayo ma lags gang gis kyang/ /kun mkhyen khyod ko ji ltar rtogs/ /bdag nyid che rgyas bdag nyid kyis/ /mayo pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di lags 'di 'dra'o zhes bgyir khyod/ /bdag 'dra ba yi yul ma lags/ /gang lags gang 'dra'ang mi bsdo ste/ /yo 'dra ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po yo ni nyid dang 'dra/ /rgyal rnams ci 'dra yo dang 'dra/ /gang ②gzhan 'ga' 'ang ma mchis pa de 'dra yo la phyag 'a༅ lo/ /ji ltar yo ni nyid kyis mayo/ /ji ltar a ni yo 'dras mayo/ /ji ltar yo gzhan ma 'tshal ba/ /de 'dra yo la phyag 1—267

'tshal lo/ /ji ltar yo ni bdag nyid kyis/ /thugs rje stobs bcu la sogs kyi / /yon tan rnams kyis bsgrags mdzad pa/ /de 'dra nga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /deng nas bzung nas yo kyi ni/ /yon tan 'byung gnas snying po dag /de nyid las ni mngon btus nas/ /ci nus khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra bcom khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /mchod 'os yo la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /rigs pa nga la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /nga la 'dud cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen te/ /rin chen chos kyi rang bzhin lags/ /dge 'dun rin pho 'byung gnas te/ /rin chen gsum tshogs go la 'dud/ /mchod 'os nga ni rin chen te/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa'ang rin chen lags/ /dam chos rin chen 'byung gnas te/ /kun nas rin chen nga la 'dud/ /rin chen kun gyi mchog gyur pas/ /rin chen thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /rin chen kun gyi 'byung gnas pa/ /yang dag rin za nga la 'dud/ /phyag 'a༅ rin chen thugs yo la/ /phyag 'tshal rin chen chos khyod la/ /phyag 'tshal thams cad rin chen la / /srid med bsgom pa goms mdzad pas/ /thub pa kun gyi mchog gyur pa/ /phyag bgyir 'os pa'i dgra bcom pa/ /khyod la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gal bar bgyis pa ta gang lags pa/ /yang dag mtha' la gnas pa po/ /dge sbyong gi ni mthar phyin pa/ /bla med nga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam pa thams cad phun tshogs pas / /mdzes pa gzhan kun zil gnon cing / /dus rnams kun tu dga' mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas padma nga la 'dud/ /kha dog bzang la dri zhim zhing —/ /blta na sdug la mi rings pa⑤/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas padma dkar/ /kha bye yo la phyag 'a༅ lo/ /bde ba'i snying khrukhu rab sbyangs pa/ /bzhed dgur 1—268

reg pa brnyes pa po/ /skyid par bskrun pa'i dge sbyong ni/ /rab gzhon nga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'o brgyal 'bras bu mchis gyur pas/ /mthar phyin mtha' dag brnyes nas ni/ /dam pa gsung bar dam bcas pa'i/ /dge sbyong yo la phyag 'a༅ lo/ /tshangs spyod brten cing rig byed dang / /rig byed kun gyi yan lag mayo/ /rig dang zhabs kyis bsangs pa yi/ /tshangs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo / /'phags pa'i chos ni ma 7'phrogs shing / /'phags pa'i phrin las phul du byung —/ /'jig rten slob dpon bya ba mdzad/ /'phags pa ma la phyag 'tshal lo / /thugs ni dka' thub brtul zhugs dag /yang dag blangs pas gtsang mar mdzad/ /sdig pa thams cad bkrus gyur pa/ /khrus mdzad yo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnga' bdag mchog ni brnyes gyur cing / /sems can thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /seng ge'i nga ro sgrogs mdzad pa/ /seng ge khyod la phyag 'tshal lo / /rtog khya pa brjod pa'i rjen shul che/ /dam chos spo la bsten mipa mdzad/ /chos gzhan thams cad 'jig pa po/ /glang chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid shin tu dka' ༅ba'i lam/ /khyod min gzhan gyis mi bzod pa/ /gsal mdzad gshegs pa 'jig rten gyi/ /lam gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /des la shin tu dul gyur bzod/ /shugs dang mdog bzang stobs dang ldan/ /yan lag rdzogs pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /cang mdza khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs dang 'bab stegs spyod yul mkhyen/ /brtan la gya gyur bzhud mi mnga'/ /khyu mchog gnas ni brnyes pa yi/ /khyu mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdul ba'i thabs ni mtha' dag la/ /mkhas shing le lo mi mnga' ba/ /skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur//mchog rab khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang slad khyod bstan ma mchis na/ /skal ba 1—269

can yang don ma mchis/ /de slad kun gyi tshangs spyod du/ /gyur pa nga la phyag 'a༅ lo/ /yon tan phun sum ldan pa kun/ /yang dag shin tu yongs rdzogs pas / /dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa kun/ /rgyun bcad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo /nyid kyi don ni yongs rdzogs shing / /gzhan gyi don la mngon brtson pa/ /dam chos bdud rtsi stsol ba po/ /tshim par mdzad pa a la 'dud/ /'jigs pa du mas 'jigs gyur pa/ /pha rol min pa'i mu spangs nas/ /chu bo chen po legs rgal ①zhing/ /pha rol gshegs pa khyod la 'dud/ /nyon mongs nad ni kun sel cing/ /zug rngu thams cad 'byin mdzad pa/ /rig sngags 'chang ba grub pa po/ /sman pa'i gtso bo khyod la 'dud/ /mchog dang mchog min lam mkhyen cing/ /zhi ba'i phyogs ni ston par mdzad/ /grub dang bde ba rsā ②pa yi/ /ded dpon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag tu mun pa sel mdzad cing/ /rtag tu spyan ni 'byed par mdzad/ /rtag tu mi bsnyel chos mnga' ba/ /shin tu bzhengs pa yo la 'dud/ /dri ma'i 'dam ni nges bkrus pas/ /dam chos dri ma med pa'i chu/ /mchog tu rnam par byang ba po/ /shin tu rnam dag a la 'dud/ /sdig dang bsod nams spangs gyur cing / /stong pa nyid kyis ⑤bsgos pa'i bdag /phan dang gnod pa bgyid snyoms ①pa/ /shin tu chags bral khyod la 'dud/ /kun nas nyon mongs bag chags kun/ /nges par bsal bas dri med thugs/ /rnam thar sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ /shin tu rnam grol khyod la 'dud/ /blta bas mi ngoms gzugs mnga' zhing/ /sku ni 'od kyis lhag ⑤ger mdzes/ /blta bya kun gyi nang na ni/ /blta na sdug mchog yo la 'dud/ /skyes bu chen po'i mtshan rnams ni / /dpe byad bzang po'i tshogs bcas pa/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pas/ /1—270

blta bar 'os pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas chos ni bla med pa/ /mi 'jigs pa dang stobs sogs kyis/ /'gro ba'i nang du sgra bsgrags pa/ /dga' bar 'os pa khyod la 'dud/ /'phags chos dkar po bla med pa/ /goms par bya ba rnams kyis ni/ /sku gnyis po dag bsgos gyur pa/ /bsgom par bya ba khyod la 'dud/ /sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las rnams/ /shin tu rnam par byang gyur pas/ /tshul khrims bsrungs ①pa las 'das pa/ /gtsang sbra dag pa khyod la 'dud/ /nyon mongs pa yi brjod pa spangs/ /zhi ba'i las kyi mtha' la dgongs/ /mi gsung dang du bzhes mdzad pa/ /thub pa zhi ba yo la 'dud/ /bde ba dang ni sdug bsngal gyis/ /thugs mi 'phrogs la brtan pa'i thugs/ /thams cad zil gnon sems can gyi/ /snying po mchog gyur khyod la 'dud/ /kun la rnam pa thams cad dang —/ /rten gyi blo dang dgongs pa dag /legs par gnas phyir mi bsnyel ba'i / /chos can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten 'das kyi yon tan phyug /'jig rten zang zing rnam par 'jig /'jig rten snang bar mdzad pa po/ /'jig rten mgon po nga la 'dud/ /bshes dang dgra dang bar mar snyoms/ /sems can kun la phan dgongs pa/ /rjes su brtse bar mdzad pa po/ /thugs rje chen po khyod la 'dud/ /chos kyi 'du shes kun rdzogs pa/ /skyob pa mngon shes chen po mnga'/ /byas mkhyen ma byas mkhyen pa po/ /thams cad mkhyen pa khyed la 'dud/ /glags kyi skabs ni kun spangs shing/ /kun nas 'ching ba bcad gyur pa / /shes rab gsal bar mdzad pa po/ /sred pa gsal ba ②khyod la 'dud/ /mnyes par bgyi 'os phyag bgyir 'os/ /brgal bar 'os min nongs mi mnga' /'bad de mchod par bgyi ②'os pa/ /rigs pa gsum ldan yo la 'dud/ /1—271

phan pa ma lags sel mkhas shing / /phan pa skyed ༅par mngon brtson pa/ /gcig tu brtse bar gzhol ba yi/ /bshes gnyen dam pa khyed la 'dud/ /skye dgu lam log zhugs pa rnams/ /rtag tu dam pa'i lam la ni/ /mngon phyogs mdzad par mngon brtson pa/ /rtsa lag dam pa khyod la 'dud/ /go 'phang mkhyen pa rnams kyi phul/ /khyod kyis go 'phang mchog brnyes nas/ /rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog gyur pa/ /de las go 'phang 'phags ma mchis/ /go 'phang bla na med brnyes nas/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel mdzad cing / /ma chags nyer len mi mnga' ba'i/ /rkang gnyis mchog gyur khyod la 'dud/ /khyod kyi bstan la ma brten par/ /'gas kyang de nyid mi mthong bas/ /'jig rten long ba lta bu yi/ /mig tu gyur pa khyod la 'dud/ /sa stengs ༅gdugs ni ma mchis na/ /zhugs mchis mar me'ang mchis gyur la/ /rgyu skar nor bu zla ba dag /mchis kyang gsal ba rdzogs mi 'gyur/ /snang ba de dang gzhan dang ni/ /de bas khyad par ches 'phags pa/ /mchis kyang khyod ni mi bzhugs na/ /'gro ba snang ba mchis ma lags/ /de ltar 'jig rten ma rig pa'i/ /mun nag thibs po'i 1ling tog gis / /bsgribs pa'i sems ldan smag gyur pa'i/ /sgron mar gyur pa khyod la 'dud/ /chos la blo gros ma byang bas/ /phan pa'ang phan par ma 'tshal zhing / /gnod pa'ang gnod par ma 'tshal la/ /byang ba'ang khyod la brten nas 'gyur/ /byis pa phal cher gnod pa dag /dor bar 'tshal la phan pa spong / /phan pa gnyer yang ma 'tshal bas/ /gnod pa so sor bsten par bgyid/ /de dag thabs ni ston mdzad phyir/ /khyod la brten nas gnyis ga yang / /yang dag ji bzhin rtogs 'gyur bas/ /sman par gyur pa khyod la 'dud/ /gtso khyod gang gi 1—272

blar gyur pa/ /de yang 'jig rten bla ma lags/ /de slad bla ma rnams kyi yang / /blar gyur bla ma yo la 'dud/ /'jig rten mkhas pas mchod pa yang yid ches ngo bo khyod la mchod / /mchod 'os rnams kyis mchod bya ba/ /mchod 'os dam pa khyod la 'dud/ /bsngags 'os bsngags pa gang lags pa'i/ /skyebo des kyang khyod bsngags te/ /bsngags par 'os pa rnams kyis kyang / /bsngags par bgyi ba ①yo la 'dud/ /lha rnams kyang ni yo la 'dud/ /yo la drang srong rnams kyang 'dud/ /phyag bgyir 'os pa rnams kyis kyang / /'dud par bgyi ba khyod la 'dud/ /sems dang bcas pa su zhig ni/ /bsod nams zhing ni dpag med pa/ /'dud 'os khyod la phyag bgyid pas/ /nam zhig na ni ngoms par 'gyur/ /de ltas yo la phyag 'a༅ 'dud/ /'dud par 'os pa yo la 'dud/ /phyag gi rgyun ni mi 'chad par/ /rtag tu khyod la phyag 'tshal lo /rtag tu dam pa'i spyod pa mdzad pa ⑤lam dang ldan/ /byas dang ma byas thob pa yang dag rig pa mayo/ /mchod pa che mnga' phyag bgyir 'os pa mtshungs med pa/ /'dud par 'os pa'i dgra bcom yo la phyag 'a༅ lo/ /dpe med yid 'ong sku mnga' khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog tu gsung snyan mngon sgogs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri med rnam dag thugs mnga' khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan tshogs bsgoms bdag nyid khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhing zhes bsam pas sangs rgyas la 'dud pa/ /dri ma med la bkra shis thams cad kyis/ /char yang mi phod mchod sbyin kun gyis min/ /dka' thub brtul zhugs min te khrus kun min/ /thub pa'i dbang po la 'dud pa/ /snyan par grags shing dpal du byed/ /sdig pa thams chad drungs nas 'byin/ /gzi brjid dag kyang rnam par 'phel/ /dgra 1—273

rnams thams cad sel bar byed/ /'jig rten dag na mi rnams kyi/ /rgyud ni bde mar nges byed cing / /nges mthar zhi ba'i 'bras bur yo/ /de ltar yon tan mang bsams shing / /lus kyang 'jig ①pa'i ngang bsams na/ /mkhas gang sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal las/ /lus kyi las gzhan spyad par byed/ /'chi bdag sel bar byed pa yi/ /bstan pa 'di ni nub gyur cing/ /kun nas mun pas khebs gyur na/ /gang zhig la ni bkur ste bya/ /de lta bas na mtshungs med pa'i//mar pa bya ba sgyur te gyis/ /ma 'ongs pa yi 'jigs pa dag/ /da lta nyid nas byung zin to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa las phyag 'tshal ba zhes bya ba ste le'u gnyis pa'o// //nyi ma'i gnyen gyur nyi ma yi/ /'od bas shin tu 'od gsal ba/ /phyag bya kun gyi rab dang mchog /phyag 'os phyag bgyis khyod la 'dud/ /stobs chen dpa' bo chen po ba/ /mngon shes che la mthu yang ge /g.yul ngor mda' ja 'phen mdzad pa/ /dga' ston ja po nga la mchod/ /'jig rten mar 'os mchod 'os mchog /'jig rten mchod pas mchod pa po/ /mchod pa'i snod ni bla med pa/ /mchod par 'os pa khyod la mchod/ /mchod dang mayo pas rtogs pa brnyes/ /dgongs pa nga rgyal bag mi mnga'/ /rjed ②'os yo la nga rgyal gyi/ /sems bor nas ni rjed ②par bgyi/ /gus bgyid ma gus pa la snyoms/ /'jig rten gus pas mchod bgyis pa/ /khyod la bkur stir gzhol ba yi/ /dbang po ④gus par bkur sti bgyid/ /yo dang 'dra ba 'ga' ma mchis/ /lhag pa ma byung 'byung mi 'gyur/ /de slad sems can kun la yo/ /dgra zin snyoms pa'i 1—274

mnyam med lags/ /ma 'dres ①'phags pa'i gdung las byung/ /sangs rgyas kun dang skal ba mnyam/ /mdog dang shes rab snang ba yis/ /phyogs rnams snang bar mdzad de 'khrungs/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mab dang ldan/ /'dom gang 'od kyi 'od zer ༅/ /mtshan dang mthun pa'i dpe byad bzang/ /brgyad cus 'bar ba'i gzi brjid can/ /rgyal chen dpal dang ldan pa'i sku/ /kun gyi mdzes pa zil gnon pa/ /'jig rten snang bar mdzad nas ni/ /nyi ma gzhan zhig lta bur bzhugs/ /bcom ldan dus kun rtogs pa'i chos/ /rnam kun 'byung gnas thams cad ni/ /phyag mthil skyu ru ra lta bur/ /khyod kyi thugs ni spyod yul gyur/ /chos rnams g.yo dang mi g.yor bcas/ /gcig dang sna tshogs so so la/ /mkha' la rlung dag rgyu ba bzhin/ /khyed kyi thugs ni thogs mi mnga'//bya ba mdzad pa khyod kyis ni/ /ji ltar thugs bskyed tsam gyis su/ /khyod la bzhed dgur kun 'grub pa/ /de ltar chos dbyings legs thugs chud/ /dge mthar phyin pa khyod la ni/ /sbyor byung dge ba 'ga' mi mnga'/ /khyod ni gang zhig bzhed na yang/ /bzhed pa tsam la rag las so/ /chos rnams kyi ni chos yod dang / /chos nyid dang ni chos kyi mthu/ /so sor rgyu dang bcas gnas shing / /rkyen dang lngos bur bcas pa dag② /khams dang dbye ba tha dad bcas/ /skyedang 'jig bcas rgyas pa de/ /thams cad so sor rnam kun du/ /kun mkhyen khyod kyis mkhyen gzhan min/ /khyod la shin tu bsgribs pa'ang mngon/ /shin tu ring ba'ang nye ba ste/ /shin tu 'dzings pa'ang sal gyis dag /shin tu mthon po'ang dma' ba lags/ /shin tu gnag pa'ang snang bar bcas/ /shin tu the tshom gnas kyang nges/ /shes bya shin tu zab mo yang / /khyod la sa ler 1—275

gda' ba lags/ /dbang po chen po'i glang chen kyi①/ /rked bcings rgyagaser las bgyis pa ltar/ /chos nyid shin tu zab mos kyang/ /yo ni 'o brgyal 'gyur ma lags/ /chos kyi nang na chags bral ltar/ /nges 'byin nang na drang po ltar/ /phun tshogs nang na sangs rgyas ltar/ /khyod ni sems can kun gyi mchog /rnam grol nang na mi g.yo ltar/ /rigs pa'i nang na chos nyid ltar/ /shes rab nang na kun mdza ltar/ /khyod ni lus can kun gyi mchog /dag pa'i nang na rnam grol ltar/ /de nyid nang na stong pa ltar/ /dka' thub nang na bzod pa ltar/ /khyod ni srog chags kun gyi mchog /gzugs kyi nang na khyod sku ltar/ /sems kyi nang na yo thugs ltar/ /chos kyi nang na yo chos ltar/ /yo ni srog chags kun gyi mchog /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa las/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid grub pa zhes bya ba ste le'u gsum pa'o // //bde bar gshegs pa yo gcig pu/ /chos gcig chos kun snang mdzad pa/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yis/ /de dang ldan gyi gzhan ma lags/ /khyod 'ba' zhig gi ye shes kyis/ /shes bya mtha' dag khyab lags kyi/ /khyod las gzhan pa thams cad kyi/ /shes bya kho na lhag pa lags/ /rgyu rkyen 'di las 'bras bu 'di/ /'di las 'di ni ma yin zhes/ /gnas dang gnas min nges pa kun / /khyod kyis mkhyen gyi gzhan gyis min/ /las chos yang dag blangs pa yi/ /rnam smin dus ni thams cad pa/ /sa kun rtogs pa thams cad ni/ /rnam kun khyod mkhyen gzhan gyis min/ /rnal 'byor sa ni ma lus pa/ /kun nas nyon 1—276

mongs rnam bzhag dang / /rnam par byang bcas zab mor bcas/ /khyod gcig kho nas thugs su chud/ /dbang po mchog dang mchog min pa/ /chung dang 'bring dang chen po dang / /cha shas dbye ba mtha' yas pa/ /khyod las gzhan gyis rtogs ma mchis/ /mthun par 'gyur ba gang lags dang / /mi mthun 'gyur ba gang lags pa/ /mi yi mos pa sna tshogs kun/ /khyod gcig kho nas thugs su chud| /'jig rten 'di khams sna tshogs te/ /sna tshogs khams nyid mtha' dag ni / /sna tshogs khams dbye khyod gcig pus/ /mkhyen gyi gzhan gyis ma lags so / /rgyu dang rkyen ni sna tshogs las/ /sna tshogs mngon par 'grub pa ni/ /kun du 'gro ba'i lam stobs kyis/ /thams cad khyod kyis thugs su chud/ /thog med srid par byung ba dang / /tha ma med par 'byung 'gyur khyagang / /de la yo kyi ༅ye shes ni/ /mngon sum bzhin du gzigs pa 'jug /sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha'acha/ /'jig rten yang dag 'grub pa dang / /de bzhin nying mtshams sbyor ba ni/ /mtha' yi bar bzhin khyod kyis gzigs/ /nye 'am yang na ring yang rung / /ji ltar yo la mngon sum pa/ /de ltar sgrib pa bag chags dang —/ /bcas te khyod kyis spangs pa lags/ /dngos 'di yongs su ma mkhyen cing / /nyon mongs 'di yi bag chags ni/ /lhag ma lus zhes mi bsnyad pa'i/ /go 'phang de ni khyod kyis brnyes/ /khyod kyis bar du gcod gsungs gang/ /nges par de dag bar du gcod/ /khyod kyis lam bstan gang lags pa/ /de gcig kho na nges par 'byin/ /de yis bar gcod mi nus she'am/ /de yis nges 'byin mi 'gyur zhes/ /gzhan gyi klan ga cha shas kyang / /de la srid pa ma mchis so /khyod kyis rgyal bgyi ma rgyal min/ /shes bya mi snang bgyis ma mchis/ /dbang phyug 1—277

khyod nyid kun mkhyen cing/ /kun rgyal lags kyi gzhan ma lags/ /stobs ldan 'jigs mi 'gyur bas khyod/ /mi bsnyengs gang lags rigs lags na/ /mthu mnga' bzhin du 'ga' la yang / /khyad du mi gsod gang de rmad/ /log pa'i nga rgyal can 'ga' zhig /dregs dang 'bral bar ①mdzad pa gang / /gdul ba yi ni thabs tsam ste/ /des ni stobs snyems yong ma lags/ /'jig rten dag na stobs ldan pas/ /kun las rgyal zhes gang brjod pa/ /de ni gzhan la bstod par bas/ /go 'phang de ni khyod la rdzogs/ /'dren pa khyod la chos mthun par/ /'gas kyang rgal ⑤bar nus ma lags/ /klan ga btsal 'os ma lags te/ /nongs mi mnga' ba'i bde ba brnyes/ /nongs mi mnga' bas gang las kyang / /bzhi ni bsrung bar bgyi mi 'tshal/ /bzhi po yongs su rdzogs slad du/ /khyod la khyasus kyang glags mi thod/ /kun la mi thogs blo gros can/ /dgongs pa kun du nye bar gnas/ /kun la thugs rje snyoms pa po/ /thugs ni kun la chags mi mnga'/ /shes bya'i rgya mtsho kun rgal ba/ /bag chags thams cad gtan nas spangs/ /bar chad kun gyi khyad par mayo/ /nges par 'byin pa kun la mkhas/ /kun gyi bsam pa mkhyen pa po/ /gdul ba thabs kyi pha rol gshegs/ /nyon mongs sna tshogs thams cad kyi/ /gnyen po la yang bsnyengs mi mnga'/ /khyod la brten nas zob po/ /byis pa shed bye ma gyur gang / /de ni ma rig mun pa yi/ /tshang tshing mi bzad mthu lags so/ /khyod kyi bka' la brten nas kyang //bral bar ma gyur gang lags pa/ /de dang de sgrib ces bgyi ste/ /de dang de sgrib mi zad lags/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa las stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u 1—278

bzhi pa'o// //ji ltar thub pa khyod kyi bka'/ /nyes dmigs brjod ldan thos pa ltar/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzad pa'i/ /me yi ①kun du spar kyang ni/ /'gro ba mi shes go bgos pa/ /de ltar skyo bar 'gyur ma lags/ /de ltar mgon po khyod kyi bka'/ /mngon sum pas kyang don gsal rab/ /chos nyid zab mo gting yangs pa/ /bshad pas sa ler gyur lags pas/ /khyod kyi bka' ni snrel zhi yi/ /cho 'phrul dag kyang mdzad pa lags/ /tshig gi mtha' ni mi mthong zhing / /don gyi gting yang mi dpogs la/ /phan tshun rjes su zhugs pa ni/ /de las ya mtshan che ci mchis/ /zoba'i dam pa khyod kyi bka'/ /rnam grangs du ma nyid mchis shing/ /zlos bu yang ni ma mchis la/ /sbyor ba'i lugs kyang rigs pa lags/ /smra ba'i dam pa khyod kyi bka'/ /gnas pa bzhi yi yon tan ldan/ /lung bstan bzhi yi rten gyur kyang / /don du gnyis su 'gyur ma mchis/ /gnang ba dang ni dgag pa la/ /khyod bka' la lar gcig tu nges/ /la lar nges pa ma lags la/ /phan tshun 'gal ba'ang ma mchis so/ /chos kyi de nyid don slad du/ /rtsod pa med pa'i go 'phang gzhi/ /rigs 'thad yon tan bzang po yis/ /ngan smra thams cad sun 'byin pa/ /gcig tu don dam la gzhol la/ /kun rdzob la yang skyon ma mchis/ /bden pa gnyis dang mi 'gal bas/ /khyod kyi bka' ni rigs pa 'byung / /nyon mongs med la gcig tu 'jam/ /nyon mongs can la nges bslang ②yang / /khyod kyi bka' ni bsnyen pa dang / /srid pa'i skyon dang ldan ma lags/ /rnam par byang ba'i rjes mthun la/ /de yi phyogs su lhung mi mnga' /1/de279

kun nas nyon mongs dgrar gyur la/ /mi bzod mi mnga' khyod kyi bka'/ /spyod pa'i tshig ni brgyas gang yang / /phyar ga gtong ba'i skyon ldan min/ /rab tu bsngags pa'i tshig phyung yang / /'ga' la'ang rten pa mnga' ma lags/ /bsnan dang dor ba mi mnga' la/ /bsdus dang rgyas pa dang yang ldan/ /brtags shing 'thad par 'gyur lags la/ /dang po nas kyang mi bzang tu min/ /shin tu snyan gsung chags mi 'gyur/ /mang la snying po ma mchis min/ /sna tshogs pa la don ma 'khrugs/ /bka' ni ngo mtshar mang po lags/ /gsung gi bdag po khyod kyi bka'/ /yid 'phrog mdzad la zhen mi mnga'/ /gzi byin can la gnod mi 'gyur/ /khyab la ngan pas rtogs ma lags/ /ba spu dag kyang ldang bgyid cing / /rdul yang kun du 'thon par bgyid/ /lus rnams dag ni ston bgyid cing / /'dar ba dag kyang skyed par bgyid/ /lha yi 'jig rten skyo bgyid cing / /sgra yang kun du sgrogs par bgyid/ /sa ni rnal mar gnas pa yang / /rnam pa drug tu g.yo bar bgyid/ /thog med dus nas goms pa yi/ /lus can rang bzhin bzlog mdzad cing / /rang bzhin 'dris pa ma lags pa/ /gzhan ni snying la 'jog par mdzad/ /rang gi nyes pas mi 'gal la/ /yid ni gdung bar bgyid dang 'dra/ /rigs pas ④zhugs pa mkhas rnams la/ /bdud rtsi'i char pa bab pa bzhin/ /khyod kyi bka' ni thog ma dang / /bar dang tha mar dge ba dag /thos dang sems dang sgom pa na/ /de sgrub pa la bdud rtsir 'gyur/ /mos pa du ma dang ldan pa/ /mang po 'khod par gyur pa la/ /gsung gcig bka' sgo ni stsal ba las/ /du ma lta bur snang 'gyur te/ /kun gyis 'di ni bdag gi ched/ /kho na'o ④snyam du go ba gang / /de las ya mtshan che ci mchis/ /de las ngo mtshar che 1—280

ci mchis/ /chos nyid 'dor bar mi mdzad la/ /'jig rten kun rdzob dang yang mthun/ /rjes su sgrogs par mdzad bzhin du/ /cig shos rnam par bsgom pa'ang mdzad/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam byang mchis/ /las dang las kyi 'bras bu'ang mchis/ /de ldan byed du 'jug pa dang / /byed pa ma mchis khyod kyi bka'/ /de ni lha dang mir bcas pa'i/ /'jig rten dag gis mngon thos nas / /chu yi zla ba g.yo ba bzhin/ /so sor rab tu g.yos par gyur/ /bzang dang ngan pa nyid du ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba tha dad pa/ /thams cad rkyen la rag las na/ /byed po ci ga mchis 'gyur ram/ /'ga' la rang dbang nyid mchis na/ /byed por 'gyur na de mi rigs/ /de lta lags pas chos kun la / /byed po med par khrod kyis gsungs/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la / /chos 'di stong pa nyid kyi ni/ /seng ge sgra yis rnga brdungs nas/ /mtshams bcad bgyis te gnas pa lags/ /de yis nyi ma'i 'od bzhin du/ /'jig rten snang bar bgyis pas na/ /de las gzhan pa'i tshig kun ni/ /shin tu cir yang ma rung gyur/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa las gsung rnam par dag pa la bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u lnga pa'o// //chos rnams thams cad bdag med pa/ /'dus byas thams cad skad cig ma / /mya ngan 'das zhi zhes bgyi ba/ /mtshan nyid 'di gsum chos kyi rgya/ /zob kun gyi yul min pa/ /mi phyed ①khyod kyis gzhag ⑤pa mdzad/ /ji skad brjod kyang 'jig rten na/ /rang bzhin las ni gang zhig 'da'/ /gal 'dzin pa yis 1—281

shags la ni/ /goms par bgyis kyang su zhig gis/ /me nyid grang ba lta bur ni//de nyid gzhan du bgyi bar nus/ /nam mkha' thogs pa med pa la/ /'ga' yis rma phyin 'gyur srid kyi/ /chos kyi phyag rgya 'di la ni/ /chos dang mthun par 'gal ma lags/ /chos nyid de nyid mkhyen khyod kyi/ /bka' ①la nag po chen po dag /bstan pas 'di ni mchis grags kyi/ /zob gzhan la mchis ma lags/ /tha dad lta la brten pa yis/ /'jig rten rnams ni rtsod par lhung / /khyod ni gcig pus rtsod med pa'i/ /gnas kyi go 'phang ⑤thugs su chud/ /long ba rnams ni rtsod gyur kyang / /mig can gzugs rnams mthong ba ni/ /ji ltar rtsod par mi 'gyur ba/ /de nyid a dang byis pa'i dpe/ /chos bzhin gsung ba yo la ni/ /'ga' dang lhan cig rtsod mi mnga'/ /legs par zophyir mkhas dang min / /khyad du gsod phyir mi mkhas min/ /'dod pa rnams ni mi snang gyur/ /lta ba'i dra ba rab tu bcom/ /gzhi ma mchis na ci slad khyod/ /gzhi ma mchis pa༅rtsod par 'gyur/ /rgyal thabs brnyes pa nga lta bu'i/ /brtan pa ci zhig rtsod pa mdzad/ /'od zer stong ldan ro lta bu'i/ /mun dang lhan cig ci zhig 'gyed/ /mkha' la lcag gis 'ju ba bzhin/ /brtsad pas khyod la brdzi ④mi 'gyur/ /rlung gis bzlog phyogs gtor ba'i rdul/ /'thor ba nyid la 'bab cing 'go /'jig rten rnams ni rtag ⑤par lhung / /yang dag ji bzhin spyod yul yo/ /de slad phyin ci log gyur pa/ /mang po rnams dang khyod mi mtshungs/ /dper na lcags dang gser bzhin du/ /log par mngon par zhen rnams dang / /mngon zhen mi mnga' khyod du ni/ /lhan cig bsgrun ④du ga la mchi/ /byis pa rnams ni ma 'tshal te/ /mgon po phan dang bde bzhed pa/ /de ⑦min khyod la 1—282

bsdo bgyid pa/ /bdag gis bdag nyid brlag par bas/ /bdag gis bdag nyid me 'bar ba'i/ /phreng ba 'khrigs par mi bsdo yi/ /rgyal ba thub pa med pa yi / /gzi byin can la bsdor mi rung / /khyod la 'dir brgal dus btab nas//khyod kyis slar gzhan dus btab pa/ /brtod pa dam pos btags pa bzhin/ /stan las ldang bar nus ma mchis/ /khyod kyis tshogs par bden smra'i bu'i/ /rgol ba'i mche ba bcag pas na/ /pha rol rgol ba thams cad kyi/ /rwa yang bcag pa nyid du 'gyur/ /pha rol rgol ba kha cig ni/ /khyod dang 'phrad ①nas 'dud par bgyid/ /kha cig thag ring slar ldog ste/ /gzhan dag spyan sngar zhum nas mchis/ /kha cig khyod kyis dam pa'i chos/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi char phab pas / /yang dag sgrub pa phun sum gyis/ /dam pa'i chos la bsten ②par bgyid/ /kye ma mgon po thugs rje'i bdag /kyi hud gti mug nyon mongs ngan//kyi hud sred pa rnam par 'phro/ /kyi hud nga rgyal phung bar byed/ /dam chos ma yin 'di gsum gyis/ /skyebo 'di ni kun dkrugs te/ /mi bzad rgyun gyis bdas ②pa bzhin/ /khyod kyi gzhung dang bral bar bgyid/ /'di yi gzhi yis lta ba dang / /the tshom la sogs nye nyon mongs/ /so sor lam gyi bar gcod pa/ /kun nas nyon mongs thams cad 'phel/ /yi la ping sha'i skad thos nas/ /khwa yi sgra la chags med ltar/ /khyod kyi chos kyi ro myong na/ /gzhan gyi tshig la chags mi 'gyur/ /gang dag chos la sgyu ④bshams nas/ /khyod kyi bka' la zhugs gyur pa//ngan ngon thos pa de la'ang de/ /rnga mo sbrang rtsi bzhin du 'gyur/ /bden zhing go sla don dang ldan/ /bsam pa dang ni cho ⑤'phrul bcas/ /zad mi shes la mdor 0'dus pa/ /gcig tu mthu ni chen por ldan/ /snying po mchog ldan ro 1—283

mchog ldan/ /rnam grangs ldan zhing thabs dang ldan/ /yongs su rdzogs la ma 'dres pa/ /gzi brjid dang ldan grags dang ldan/ /de 'dra'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i/ /khyod gsung thos pa su zhig ni/ /de las bzlog pa gzhan gyi tshig /rul ba lta bu snom par bgyid/ /sdug bsngal yang rung bde yang rung / /don dang mi ldan gang yin pa/ /de ni yongs su spang bya zhing / /bzlog pa bsten par bya bar gsungs/ /'dod dang mi 'dod bsten pa la/ /de ltar khyad par gsungs khyod kyi/ /lam mal thang chad zab rnams/ /ji lta bur na rjes 'brang 'gyur/ /spyad pa rnams la khyod kyis ni/ /'di yi ched du bstan pa gang / /de nyid khyod kyi bka' dang ni/ /gzhan gyi tshig gi mtshams rdzogs pa/ /khyod kyi bka' dang gzhan gyi tshig /ji ltar khyad par che zhugs pa/ /dug dang bdud rtsi de lta min/ /mun dang snang ba'ang ma lags so/ /khyod kyi bka' dang gzhan gyi tshig /ji ltar khyad par rgyang chad pa/ /mtho ris ngan song de ltar ①min/ /zil dngar bkus ⑤te bor ba'ang min/ /de ni tshig tsam snying po ste/ /'di ni tshig dang tshig don ldan/ /de yis khyod kyi bka' dang ni/ /gzhan gyi tshig gi khyad par bshad/ /bde bar gshegs pa khyod dang ni/ /smra de rnams kyi khyad par gang / /de nyid khyod kyi bka' dang ni/ /gzhan gyi tshig gi mtho dman lags/ /ji ltar srid dang thar pa'i chad/༅/ /de ni dpyad du med pa ltar/ /dpa' bo yo kyi bka' dang ni/ /gzhan tshig khyad kyang de dang 'dra/ /'jug dang ldog pa gang lags pa / /kun nas nyon mongs rnam byang gang / /de nyid dpa' bo khyod bka' dang / /gzhan gyi tshig gi khyad par lags/ /'di ni gcig pu de bzhin nyid / /de ni slu ⑤chos 'ba' zhig na/ /khyod kyi bka' dang gzhan gyi tshig /de 1—284

las khyad zhugs gzhan ci 'tshal/ /'di ni gcig pu dge la de/ /gcig tu bar chad bgyid lags na/ /khyod kyi bka' dang gzhan gyi tshig /de las mi 'dra ci zhig mchis/ /de yis bsgos shing nyer bsgos pa/ /'di yis dag par bgyid 'gyur ba/ /de nyid mgon po khyod bka' dang / /gzhan gyi tshig gi khyad par lags/ /de kun dam pa ma yin brdol/ /'di gcig legs gsungs de yi slad / /khyod kyi bka' dang gzhan gyi tshig /brtsan dang mi brtsan nges pa lags/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa las rtsod pa mi mnga' bar bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u drug pa'o// //'jug pa dang ni ldog pa la/ /'gro 'di'i rang bzhin gang lags dang / /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun/ /so sor gang las mi 'da' ba'i/ /lugs mthun lugs dang mi mthun pa/ /tshig bcu gnyis kyi yi ge gnyis/ /de ni dam chos nyi ma yi/ /nyi ma mchod pa'i 'os su bstan/ /de nyid rdzus ༅te skye ba yi/ /srid gcig yan lag ma tshang bas/ /ji bzhin yan lag so so la/ /bzhi ru bsgres pas gsum mchod lags/ /de nyid yan lag tshang ba las/ /yi ge bcu gnyis tshig dag gis/ /bden pa'i lugs su snga ma bzhin/ /bsgres na rab tu 'gro ba lags/ /tshangs pa 'di ni khyod bstan la/ /gang dag ji bzhin bsten bgyid pa/ /bram ze de dag tshangs 'gyur ba'i/ /gsang gsum mthun pa'i tshangs pa lags/ /tshangs pa'i tshul dang tshangs pa dang / /tshangs tshul 'bras bu tshangs pa'i don/ /tshangs mchog khyod kyi bstan pa las/ /gzhan la mchis pa ma lags so/ /tshangs pa'i tshul ni ma mchis par/ /'ga' yang bram zer 'gyur ma 1—285

lags/ /drang po yi ni lam 'di yang / /gzhan ni 'ga' la'ang ma mchis so /rig dang zhabs su ldan pa ni/ /tshangs pa lags par bram zes bshad/ /rig pa de dang zhabs de yang / /khyod kyi bstan las gzhan la min/ /slob dang mi slob rig pa de/ /zhabs ni de thob bgyid pa lags/ /gzhan la chos kyi lam de ni/ /ming yang mchis pa ma lags so/ /gang zhig goms par bgyis pa yis/ /rigs kun bram zer 'gyur bgyid pa/ /bdud rtsi'i sgo ni ring zhig ①nas/ /bcad pa khyod kyis dbye ba mdzad/ /lta ba ngan dang yid gnyis kyis/ /zin pa bram zer ci zhig 'gyur/ /khyod kyi gzhung lugs ma gtogs par/ /gzhan gyis mdud pa 'di mi ②chod/ /bram ze tshangs pa'i bu yin te/ /snying dang kha las skyes zhes pa//'jig rten gyi ni grags pa de/ /yo la ༅sa bu bcas par gyur/ /tshangs yo tshangs lam khyod la mnga'/ /khyod ni bram ze'i khyu mchog ste/ /nye bar 'dren dang ston ②pa'ang khyod/ /khyod ni dus mchod mdun na 'don/ /khyod kyis legs par bstan pa yi/ /bram ze mi gtsang 'gyur ma lags/ /nye bar drangs pa'i bram ze yang | /tshangs pa'i tshul las lhung mi 'gyur/ /khyod bstan las gzhan 'ga' la yang / /bram zer 'gyur ba'i chos ma mchis/ /tshangs pa yi ni mchod pa dang / /tshangs pa'i lam yang mchis ma lags/ /tshangs pa'i bden pa gsum dang ni/ /tshangs pa'i mtshan nyid rnam ①gsum dang / /tshangs pa'i mchog rab gsum dang ni / /tshangs pa'i rigs kyang mchis ma lags/ /'jig rten legs bshad ji snyed pa/ /thams cad khyod kyi bstan las 'byung / /skyon med mngon par brjod pa 'di/ /bde gshegs kho na'i ma 'dres pa/ /khyod las gzhan pa gang dag cig /ngag la ④skyon med gda' ba de/ /thams cad chos kun mkhyen khyod kyi/ /1—286

legs par gsungs pa'i bram ze lags/ /srin bus zos pa'i yi ge ltar/ /'di las gzhan pa'i legs bshad gang / /de ni lcags las ①gser bzhin du/ /de la 'tsham pa ma lags so/ /e raṇḍa yi shing khrod du/ /tsandan sa mchog bzhag pa ltar / /ltag 'og 'gal ba de la de/ /mchis par su zhig yid ches 'gyur/ /gang zhig nim pa'i shing la ni/ /a pra'i 'bras bu smin btags pa/ /de las skyes zhes yid ches te/ /gzhan la legs bshad yod sems grang / /ma la ya las tsandan bzhin/ /khyod las gzhan la lhar bcas pa'i/ /'jig rten 'di na legs bshad pa'i/ /rin chen 'byung ba ma mchis so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa las tshangs pa dang mthun par gsung bar bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u bdun pa'o// //brgya la res 'ga' gang zhig gis/ /mi gsung thugs las chud dgyes pa/ /rang byung bse ru lta bu rnams/ /rnam par 'gying zhing bzhud gyur pa/ /nyams par 'gyur ba'i lam mang bas/ /rtags ⑤par yang ni rab dga' ①ba/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam de ni/ /khyod kyis lam chen srol du btod/ /de ni glang po che rnams ltar/ /dga' mgur gzhon nu dag dang ni/ /stobs dang blo ni sor gnyis pa'i/ /bud med kyis kyang goms par bgyis/ /de ni gzi byin ldan pa'i mchog /khyod la bsten pa'i cho 'phrul te/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni ma 'dres pa/ /mthu dpag med pa'i gzi byin lags/ /kun nas nyon mongs sbrul dag gis/ /rnam pa du mar zin rnams la/ /khyod ni spyi yi gnyen po yi/ /skyon med 'byung gnas ma 'dres pa/ /'dod chags la sogs 'bags rnams la/ /skyon ni skyon 1—287

med mdzad khyod kyis/ /mi sdug sgom pa la sogs pa'i/ /chos kyang rab tu bstan pa mdzad/ /khyod kyis lam gyi tshogs kyi chos/ /dge ba zag bcas bstan mdzad pas / /dngos po rnams kyi nang gi ni/ /phan tshun khyad par dag kyang bstan/ /de yang nye ba'i nyon mongs dang / /'bags phyir spyi yi rnam pas rjedabacom/ /dur khrod mgal ba'i yog pa ltar/ /de dag ye shes me la bsregs/ /byang chub pa yi snga rol du/ /'jug pa bde ba'i rgyu chos bstan/ /de nas byang chub brnyes nas ni / /ldog pa bde ba'i chos kyang bstan/ /sangs rgyas nas kyang dge ba'i chos/ /zag bcas de dag ma bshad min/ /phal cher mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /rgyu mthun nyid du yongs su bsngos/ /khyod kyis gang las 'gro ba dag /ma drangs rgud pa de gang mchis/ /gang dang 'jig rten ma sprad pa'i/ /phun tshogs de yang gang zhig mchis/ /khyod kyis yid gnyis mdud pa bcad/ /lta ba ngan pa'i tsher ma dkrugs/ /sred pa'i dug gi lcug ma bsregs/ /khro ba'i dug kyang thams cad bcom/ /ma rig pa yi ling tog bsal/ /nga rgyal gyi ni rgyal mtshan bsgyel/ /sems kyi tha ba rnams kyang bcom/ /rnam par 'ching ba rnam par gtubs/ /mdud pa thams cad rnam par bkrol/ /chu bo la ni gzings kyang bcas/ /khyod kyis chu bo rnams kyi gzhi/ /mtsho chen gang lags de yang bskams/ /skyon dang snyigs ma yon po dag /sems la mi mngon 'khras bgyid pa/ /kun nas nyon mongs dug shing gi/ /rtsa ba khyod kyis drungs nas phyung / /phyin ci log gis 'tshal pa yi/ /ngan pa'i lam ni thams cad bcad/ /'chi med bgrod pa gcig pa yi/ /dpal ldan lam ni drang po phye/ /gzhan dag gdul bar bgyi ba yi/ /skyon brgyad las ni nges drangs nas/ /'dod pa'i yan lag brgyad ldan pa/ /1—288

cang shes bzang po'i gnas su bkod/ /kun nas nyon mongs srin 'khrug ①pa'i/ /mi gtsang rgyun nas drangs nas kyang / /nyon mongs min pa'i yan lag can/ /dri med chu la 'phyo ru 455/ /'chal ba'i tshul khrims spyon bsal nas/ /tshul khrims kyi ni byug pas byugs/ /ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod pa'i/ /dri med gos kyis dgab pa mdzad/ /dam pa'i chos rgyan dkar po ni/ /spa ba dag gis brgyan mdzad nas/ /de dag bsam gtan seng ge'i khri/ /chen po'i rkyen du 'bab la bzhag /byang chub yan lag me tog ni/ /zag med dri zhim rnams kyis gtor/ /chos kyi dga' ba 'phags pa'i ros/ /zang zing med pas tshim par mdzad/ /srid pa'i bran ni 'tshe mang ba/ /thog ma med pa las bton nas/ /nyid kyi sras po gtan du ni/ /nyams pa med pa kho nar mdzad/ /gzhan dag ma 'ongs dus na ni/ /rang rgyal ba yi snod du mdzad/ /gzhan dag theg pa chen po yi/ /rgyal tshab mchog tu dbang yang bskur/ /chos kun gyi ni tshig mkhyen cing/ /don rnams kun gyi gzhi la mkhas/ /skad kyi dbye ba kun mkhyen cing / /phyogs rnams kun du spobs dang ldan/ /nga ni mgon med khyed rnams kyi/ /grogs su gyur pa zhes sgrogs shing / /thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba ni/ /mtha' dag 'khyud pa bzhin du bzhugs/ /ston pa thugs rje che mnga' ba/ /brtse bar ldan zhing thugs brtser mdzad/ /der brtson le lo mi mnga' ba/ /khyod dang 'dra ba gzhan su mchis/khyod ni sems can kun gyi mgon/ /spyi yi rtsa lag bzang po lags/ /mgon du khyed bzhugs ma 'tshal bas/ /de slad skye bo bying bar gyurargya/ /gang zhig yang dag blangs nas ni/ /tha shal bas kyang grogs nus pa/ /grogs byed pa yi chos dag ni/ /khyod las gzhan pa 'gas mi rtogs/ /phyi yi yan lag stobs kun ni/ /1—289

khyod kyis yang dag bsgrubs lags te/ /nang gi stobs dag ma tshang bas/ /byis pa rnams ni sdug bsngal sten①/ /'jig rten spyod pa med dang sbyar/ /chos nyid zab pa dang yang sbyar/ /dman la mos pa nyid dang sbyar/ /lam ni ngan pa mang dang sbyar/ /thog med dus nas goms pa yi/ /brel ba ngang gi ②'byung dang sbyar / /bsgom ②pa 'bad pa po pos kyang / /thob par dka' ba dang sbyar na/ /'jig rten du ni yo lta bu/ /chos dkar yang dag blang ba yi/ /dngos po gsal bar ston pa'i rtsa/ /bzang po gal te ma byung na/ /'gro kun mun par 'gyur lags te/ /mi 'dod tshor ba byung ba yis/ /nyam thag 'o dod cher 'bod pa'i / /ngan song rang bzhin kho nar 'gyur/ /khyod la gang gis 'gro rnam gsum/ /de ni gzhan gyis sgrub par bas/ /khyod ni dgra bshes bar ma la/ /bshes mchog nyid du rtse ④bar mdzad/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa las phan par mdzad par bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u brgyad pa'o// //bgo bsha' mdzad pa'i chos nyid ni/ /khyod gcig pu la rdzogs mnga' yi/ /gzhan la phan gdags bgyi ba la/ /skyebo gzhan ni tshogs shing mchis/ /khyod kyi slob ma bsdu ba yi/ /dngos la mkhas par gda' ba gang / /de yang rdzogs par mi mkhas pas/ /khyod kyi cha shas rjes su 'brang / /bcom ldan khyod kyi zang zing gi / /bgo bsha' srog gi bar lags te/ /dam pa'i chos kyi bgo bsha' ni/ /slob dpon dpe mkhrud bral ba lags/ /khyod ni bgo bsha' bgyi ba'i las bla na med pa'i mdzad pa po/ /phun sum thams cad rdzogs mnga' ba/ /yo ni 1—290

btang bar bgyi ma lags/ /'gro ba phal cher mi bzad pa/ /gzhan la gnod pa bgyid par dga'/ /yo ni 'jig rten rang bzhin te/ /rgyun las bzlog pa'i phyogs su 'jug /byas pa gzo gang de dag nyung / /phan 'dogs bgyi ba 'ga' tsam ste/ /de yang phal cher re ba can/ /khyod gcig dag pa'i chos can lags/ /phan btags pa yis khyod mi 'jug /gnod pa bgyis pas ldog ma lags/ /skal pa mchis zhes thams cad la/ /khyod ni mnyam pa nyid du 'jug /mtshan mo me tog ku mu da/ /kha ༅ ①'gyur zhing padma zum/ /nyin par padma kha 'bye zhing //cig shos zum par 'gyur mod kyi/ /'on kyang nyi ma zla ba yi/ /'od la phyogs su lhung ma mchis/ /de nyid khyod kyis byis pa dang / /mkhas pa dag la bstan pa'i dpe/ /gang tshe mgon yo mdzad pa ni/ /thams cad gzhan don kho nar bas/ /dpag med phan pa mdzad pa po/ /yo la lan cis lon par 'gyur/ /sems can dar bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /sgrub pa yo la 'ga' mi mnga'/ /yo kyi dbugs phyung tsam yang ni/ /yo la phan dang bde ba rsā②/ /sangs rgyas dbugs ni phyung ba'i ngad / /dri kun zil gyis gnon mdzad pa/ /tshor na zhe 'gras gyur pa yang / /yo la dang ba barsā par bgyid/ /sangs rgyas dbugs kyi ngad bab na/ /bag med pa yi lha rnams kyang / /lha yi yul yang spangs nas ni/ /'dul ba dag la mngon phyogs 'gyur/ /khyod las dam pa'i chos mnyan pas/ /thams cad tshim par 'gyur ma 'tshal/ /de slad dam pa'i don du na/ /yo nyid ngoms 'gyur tshim mdzad lags/ /skyodagu rnams la char bzhin du/ /khyod ni mkhas pa kun gyi gsos/ /'di ltar khyod kyi gsos 'gyur gang / /de dang de ni mchis ma lags/ /dgrongs par 'tshal ba rnams la yang / /yo kyi 1—291

phan dgongs ci 'dra ba/ /de blo ma sbyangs byis pa yis/ /yid ches bgyi bar nus ma lags/ /khyod ni sdang ba rnams la yang / /legs pa ci 'dra sgrub mdzad pa / /sa de yid la smon pa'i yang / /yul las 'das par gyur pa lags/ /la la phan 'dogs mdzad pa yi/ /ro mchog rtogs pa de dag kyang / /khyod kyi chos kyi bgo skal la/ /spyod par 'gyur ba'i gnyen lags so/ /gal te sems can 'di dag gis/ /yo mnga' thugs rje'i dgongs pa 'tshal/ /yo kyi bstan pas 'tsho bzhin du/ /kun du 'bar ba'i mer yang 'jug /gang slad bdud kyi dgras thebs pas/ /rtogs par mi 'gyur de slad du/ /khyodakyi bstan las 'gal bgyid pa'i/ /byis pa rnams ni bdag nyid 'gums/ /khyod kyi bstan las gzhan phyogs pa/ /g.yang sa chen po'i mun pa dang / /yongs su gdung ba myong ba rnams/ /kye ma yun ring 'khyam 1 par 'gyur/ /khyod kyi chos la mi phyogs pa'i / /skyebo gti mug gis ldongs pa/ /srid rtse'i bar du son nas kyang / /sdug bsngal yang 'byung srid pa sgrub/ /khyod kyi bstan pa'i rjes 'gro ba/ /bsam gtan dngos gzhi ma thob kyang / /bdud kyi mig ras btsa' bzhin du/ /srid pa dag ni zlog par bgyid/ /nga kyis dang por lha bu yi/ /bdud kyi me tog rgyal mtshan bsnyal/ /de nas nyon mongs bdud kyi ni/ /nga rgyal rgyal mtshan mthon po brtib/ /khyod kyis byang chub ma brnyes par/ /'dod khams dbang phyug las rgyal te/ /byang chub bar chad med lam la/ /khams gsum dbang phyug las rgyal lo / /dbang phyug yo nyid 'jig rten 'dir/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi dpa' rab ste / /nyon mongs dbang gyur skye bo la/ /dpa' ba'i rab tu gang zhig rtsi/ /khyod kyis rang gzhan gnyis na yi/ /rgyud ⑤la nyon mongs sde bcom pas/ /khyod 1—292
