las dpa' mchog gzhan dang ni/ /mi bzad g.yul rgyal gzhan ma mchis/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa las lan mi lon par bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u dgu pa'o// //spyan gyi yon tan mthon mthing dang / /dkar gnag gsum po gang lags pa / /de la gtsor bcas 'jig rten gyi/ /yon tan rnams kyis khyad mi khor/ /sgros gang dpal gyis bla na med/ /'og ma dpal mnga' gnyis ga yang / /'byung dang 'byung ba las gyur pa'i/ /phun sum tshogs pa bla na med/ /de dag 'ga' zhig ma mchis na/ /zla mthun 'ga' yang ma mchis pas/ /gong ma gang gis ltag / gnas gyur/ /'og ma'ang gang gi gzhi bor 'gyur/ /khyod kyi sgos ni dpal gyi gnas/ /phan tshun 'tsham par gyur pa 'di/ /e ma'o legs par zung du 'brel/ /oma'o 'phrod pa bla na med/ /ston pa'i dus na g.yo 'gyur zhing / /gsal ba nyid la g.yo mi mnga'/ /tshems kyi zla ba shar ba'i dpal/ /nang nas bag tsam gda' 'gyur ba/ /nyid kyi gnas nas 'byung ba'i sgra/ /me tog bzhin du 'grems mdzad cing / /gzhan gyis nye bar bskyed rnams kyi/ /'gro ba'i lam la phan 'dogs pa/ /zangs zhun 'od 'dra 'di dag gi/ /dpal 'bar 'di yi thad na ni/ /bim khya pa'i 'bras bu mtshams sprin dang / /utpal dmar mdzes ro dang 'dra/ /khyod kyi sgros ni mdzes bskyod pa/ /gang gis mthong ba de dag gi / /legs par mig rnyed de dag gis/ /mthong ba'ang 'bras bu mchis pa lags/ /mgon po mu tig phreng bas min/ /kun da ④/ku mu ta phreng min/ /gangs ༅ can rtse mo sbrengs pa'i lus/ /zla ba'i 'od kyis bab pas min/ /ston ga'i chu bo sun 1—293

'byin pa/ /mkha' 'gro dkar po'i phreng bas min/ /sprin med mkha' la lhag ge ba| /ston ga'i zla ba tshes pas min/ /dul ba khyod kyis chems rnams kyi/ /phreng ba 'od gsal dkar 'di la/ /mar me'i 'od kyis nyi 'od bzhin/ /cha shas su yang phod ma lags/ /rdo rje myu gu'i phreng ba la/ /'phags pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i ros/ /bam pas bsgos pa 'di dang ni/ /'dra bar 'gyur ba'i dngos ci mchis/ /ku mu da zla kun da sogs/ /dkar po'i dper brjod bzhi pa ①dag /yo kyi ༅sa phreng byung ༅ nas/ /thabs ni shor ba lta bur gda'/ /'jig rten du ni 'di byung bas/ /dkar po dang ni mdzes pa gi /rdzas rnams thams cad ma lus pa/ /dri ma can dang 'dra bar ༅②/ /yo kyi ljags dang sgros bar na / /'di dag thags bzangs ①gnas pa ni/ /rtogs dang zhi ba'i bar dag na / /rnam par grol ba bzhin du mdzes/ /yo kyi dpal gyis 'gro ba 'di/ /chems kyi phreng bas zil mnan par/ /gzigs nas rgyal bar gyur to zhes/ /ru mtshon lta bur mche ba bsgreng ④/ /khyod kyi mche ba mnyam la ⑤ zlum/ /mdzes shing rtse mo no dkar ba/ /dpe kun thabs kyis mnan nas ni/ /'bar ba bzhin du gnas pa lags/ /zla ba tshes pa 'jig rten na/ /yon por gsal gyur gang lags te/ /khyod kyi mche ba mi yo zhing / /mdzes pa'i lus can rnams kyis bgyis/ /tshes pa'i gnas skabs mche ba yis/ /nya ba zhal ras bzang po yis/ /kham pa 'phral bas 'khyil pas ni/ /'dom gang 'od kyis zil mnan te/ /thub pa zla ba khyod kyi ni/ /gzugs kyi yon tan phun tshogs pas/ /zla ba'i yon tan phun sum kun/ /gnas skabs kun du nyams par bgyi/ /bde bar gshegs pa khyod kyi sku/ /gser gyi padmo'i ④snying po ltar/ /ba spu g.yas 'khyil nyag re ba/ /1—294

'jam la dri med gyen du 'khrungs/ /snum la ma 'dzings ma 'khrugs pa/ /ind+ra bee la'i rngams lta bur/ /sngon pos rin chen bskyil ba ni/ /phra mo lta bur spras par gda'/ /skyes bu glang chen khyod kyi ni/ /glang po che mtshan ma 'dres gang / /nang dang phyi yi dri ma yis/ /shin tu nye bar ma gos gang / /khyod kyi yan lag rgyan 'dra gang / /yan lag mdzes pa de legs te/ /lhad med gser las blugs pa yi/ /khor yug lta bur gnas pa lags/ /rang gi dbyibs ni mdzes pa yi /cang shes gtso bo thams cad kyi/ /skyes kyi mtshan ma mdzes pa dag /zil gyis mnan te gnas pa gang / /mgon po tshangs spyod gnas slad dang / /dbyibs kyang shin tu mdzes slad du/ /khyod kyis sba ba nyid lags shing / /sba bar bgyi ba min pa'ang lags/ /thugs rjes the tshom can rnams la/ /khyod kyis mtshan ma gzhan tshul gyis/ /sprin mthongs zla ba'i gzugs lta bur/ /shin tu lan 1/mang bstan pa gang / /ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod ri/ /mi g.yo bskyod pa ltar mdzad nas / /thugs rje chen po'i mig gis ni/ /blo yi yul du mdzad pa gang / /dal gyis 'bab pa'i padma ni/ /cung zad kha bye'i ze ba'i tshogs/ /mgon po yan lag mdzes khyod kyi/ /mdzes pa de la des mi bskyod/ /dpal ldan zla ba nya ba la/ /'khyil par gnas pa mchis na yang / /'on kyang yan lag mchog khyod kyi/ /dpe yi gzhi bor rdzogs mi 'gyur/ /bsod nams brgya phrag rgya chen gyi/ /las kyis sprul pa mdzes lam la/ /de las gzhan pa'i sems pa yis 'phangs pas yong yang rjes slebs sam/ /nyid kyi spubs dang na bza' dang / /sdom pas shin tu bkab kyang ni/ /mtshan gzhan phun sum tshogs pa yis/ /gsal bar gyur pa lta bu lags/ /yan lag dam pa ldan khyod kyi/ /yan lag mchog gyur de la ni/ /1—295

mgos btud yid rab dang ba dang / /ngag gis kyang ni mchod pa ①bgyi/ /dad par bgyi ba rnams kyi mchog /blta bas mi ngoms khyod la ni/ /gal te khong khro bgyid mchis na/ /mun nag tha shal ngan pa lags/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa las sku'i phyogs gcig la bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u bcu pa'o// //sems can rnams kyi mos pa ni/ /khams rnams ji bzhin gnas lags pas / /re zhig bdag gi bsam pa ni/ /yangs pa'i ljags la rgya cher dang / /su zhig mgo dang yid dang ni/ /ngag gis ljags yangs mchod mi bgyid/ /de ni gsung rab 'di kun gyi/ /yum ste rin chen bskrun pa lags/ /bdag la gtso bo khyod kyi ni/ /mdzad pa bla med thams cad kyi/ /nang na yangs pa'i ljags 'di ni / /bla na med pa'i phul du gda'/ /'gro la bstan pa rab sgrogs pa/ /chos kyi phrin las mdzad slad du/ /rgyal po bzhin du mtshan kun gyi/ /nang na gtso bo lags par gnas/ /gzhan gyi the tshom bcad slad du/ /gang zhig zhal nas mngon phyung ②na/ /ston gyi mtshams sprin tshogs lta bur/ /zhal ras zla ba khebs pa lags/ /de ltar yangs shing mdzes pa de/ /chems kyis gtams pa'i zhal nang du/ /dog ༅pa med par gnas pa yang / /de las ya mtshan che ci mchis/ /de ni nges par dpag med pa'i/ /mthu can bzang po de yi ni/ /shin tu 'jam pa nyid dang ni/ /mnyen pa nyid kyi mthu lags so/ /khyod zhal 'brug sgra sgrogs pa na/ /'dzam bu'i chu gser zhun ma ltar/ /zangs bzhu ba yi 'od lta bur①/ /glog phreng 'gyu ba lta bur mdzad/ /bslab pa bzang po phun sum gyi/ /rgyal thabs 1—296

lta bu brnyes nas ni/ /khyed kyi zhal nas bag yangs su/ /gnas gzhan dag tu rol zhing spyod/ /gang gi dri zhim tshor nas 'di/ /me tog gsung ①ba zhes sgrogs pa / /gsung gi me tog skyon med pa/ /de dag 'dis ni 'grems par mdzad/ /de nyid slad du rgyal khyod las/ /mchog tu snyan ⑤pa'i gsung snyan 'byung / /de yi dri rab zhim pas khyod/ /snyan pa gsung zhes rnam par grags/ /gang gi mthu yis khyod 'dra ba/ /bdud rtsi stsol bar rab grags pa/ /gdams ngag rjes su ston pa de / /'di nyid la ni rag las so/ /gang gis lhar bcas 'jig rten du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba de/ /nyid kyi 'o brgyal mi gzigs pa/ /dge ba 'di yis bgyis pa lags/ /gang gis rin chen bkram pa ltar/ /legs par bshad pa brgyas bkang nas/ /'jig rten 'di ni snang bgyis pa/ /de ni 'di yi mthu lags so/ /rigs dang spyad par mngon brjod pa/ /chos kun gsung ba'i 'phags pa ste/ /dpag bsam ljon pa'i lcug ma ltar/ /rin chen sna tshogs 'bras bu stsol/ /ljags yangs med par 'jig rten na/ /kun mkhyen nyid ldan spobs pa ni/ /so so yang dag rig pa yi/ /spobs pa'i khur ni su yis bskur/ /khyod kyis dgongs te de la ni/ /chos ni gang dang ༅gang bshad pa/ /'di ni snyom las mi mnga' bar/ /me tog bzhin du phreng bar brgyud/ /gal te 'di yis ma bstan na/ /khyod la kun mkhyen mngar sus 'tshal/ /thugs rje chen pos ④mnga' bar sus/ /yon tan gzhan yang mngar sus 'tshal/ /bstan pa dag ni ma mchis na/ /khyod 'dra'i mkhas pa mngon mi 'gyur/ /bstan pa yang ni ljags yangs la/ /gzhung la dngos grub bzhin du rten⑤/ /rnam pa sna tshogs chos gsung zhing / /rnam pa sna tshogs ro bstar yang / /'dam rdzab kyis ni nam 1—297

mkha' bzhin/ /ro la chags pas gos mi mnga'/ /mi gsung bzhugs pa'i rjes su mthun/ /gsung ba la yang skyon mi mnga'/ /mi mthun chos ni gnyis ga la/ /gcig tu yang ni mthun pa lags/ /mi gsung bzhugs na spro mi mdzad/ /ston par mdzad la skyo mi mnga'/ /cang mkhyen nyid kyi ༅dge ba ste/ /thams cad la ni snyoms par 'jug /'di ltar thams cad gsung spyod la mi/ /chos rnams 'ba' zhig bka' stsol ba/ /spyod pa la ni 'jug par mtshar༅/ /rigs pa la yang gzhol bar cho mtshar/ /'byung ba las gyur bsod nams dang / /chos gsung ba yi rang bzhin gyis/ /sangs rgyas pa yi dri zhim pa/ /gnyis kyis rtag tu bsgos pa lags/ /mig gi spyod yul dag pa dang / /bsod nams snyan pa'i rang bzhin gyis / /shin tu rnam par grags pa yi/ /snyan pa gnyis kyi phyogs su grags/ /gang gis skyon kun med pa 'di/ /zhal nas phyung ba mthong gyur pa/ /skyebo de dag mig dang ldan/ /mig de dag kyang dpal dang ldan/ /gang gis de yi gsung snyan pa/ /mngon sum rna ba'i snyim pa yis/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang 'dra 'thungs pa / /mkhas pa de dag ches dpal ldan/ /sgra rnams brgyan par mdzad pa bzhin/ /sgra yis sa rnams brgyan pa bzhin/ /bshad pa mdzad na khrod kyi zhal/ /shin tu sba bar mdzad pa bzhin/ /'di ni nyid mdzes yon tan gyis/ /thub pa khyod kyi zla zhal ni/ /'jig rten rgyan du gyur pa yang / /lhag pa'i rgyan du gyur par bugada'/ /mdog dang dbyibs dang snyan gsung dang / /shin tu 'jam pa nyid kyi mthus gye7 / /ljags yangs lta bu gzugs can gyi/ /rdzas ni 'ga' yang ma mthong ngo / /gal te lha mo dbyangs ldan ma/ /de ni gzugs can 'ga' mchis na / /skyon kun med pa'i yan lag can/ /ljags yangs 'di ni de lags grang //1—298

yangs pa'i ljags kyi ༅chos kyi rnga / /kun du rdung bar zhugs pa'i tshe/ /lha dang mi yi sgra rnams ni/ /thams cad ro bro med par 'gyur/ /ston pa khyod dang ljags 'di dang / /bla na med pa'i bka' 'di ni/ /nyon mongs dug kun 'joms pa yi/ /yan lag gsum ldan sman gyi mchog /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa las ljags la bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u bcu gcig pa'o// //khyod dang 'dra ba'i zhing dag ni/ /'jig rten gsum na ma mchis te/khyod ni sbyin gnas rnams kyi mchog /gral gtsang mdzad pa'i gtsang ma lags/ /nam mkha' mthar thug ma mchis pa'i/ /chu dang zhing ༅ dag ji lta bar/ /khyod la sman gnod bgyid pa yi/ /rnam par smin pa thug ma mchis/ /gang dag khyod la bar mar gnas/ /de yang re zhig tshad med pa'i/ /mun pas bsgos pas ma rung na / /skye bo log bgyid smos ci 'tshal/ /ji ltar bla med yon gyi gnas/ /khyod la yang dag sgrub bgyid pa/ /las gang lags pa de yi ni/ /dar ba'i mthar thug mi mthong la/ /yang dag sgrub pa'i mthar byon pa/ /khyod la log par zhugs pa gang / /las de rgud pa'i mthar yang ni/ /de bzhin thug pa ma mchis so /gang gis rnam pa thams cad du/ /stobs ldan khyod la ma btsas pa/ /rab tu mtshams ni mi zin pa'i/ /ma rabs mi rtag nyid reng na/ /kye ma'o 'khor ba bdag nyid ngan/ /kye ⑤ma'o mya ngan 'das pa zhi/ /khyod 'dra'i thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /mnga' mchis pa'ang de ru gshegs/ /ma 'ongs 'jigs pa rnams kyang gsungs/ /chos kyi tshul yang bshad pa mdzad/ /'khor ni rnam pa 1—299

bzhi po yang / /mi 'jigs pa dag thob par mdzad/ /lam bzang 'di ni bsrung slad du/ /blo gros sbyangs pa bgyis gyur pa/ /'od srung ①che dang kun dga' dang | /de la sogs pa bskos mod kyi②/ /'jig rten gyi ni mig gcig pu/ /dri ma med pa khyod zum na/ /snang ba mchis kyang 'jig rten 'di/ /mun pas khebs dang 'dra ba lags/ /bde bar gshegs pa bde gshegs kyi/ /bka' 'di'ang mchis la khyod kyi sras/ /sras kyi dam pa slob pa dang / /mi slob 'di yang mchis mod kyi/ /'gro ba'i mgon khyod mi bzhugs na/ /gza' skar gsal bas mtshan pa gi /nam mkha' zla bas stong pa bzhin/ /shin tu brlag gis ma mchis so/ /khyod mi bzhugs na gsung rab 'di/ /klu 'phos pa yi mtsho yi dpal/ /ring po mi thogs 'jig pa ltar/ /'tsham pa'i snying po dang bral bas/ /yon tan gzi yang mi spa ②la/ /cho ga gzhan dang lugs gzhan gyis/ /'phan dang rma yang phyung lags pas/ /lus kyi brjid kyang yal du cha/ /sangs rgyas mnga' dbang bskur ba rnams/ /yongs su mya ngan 'das bsams na/ /srid pa ral gri 'bar 'dra la/ /su zhig 'jigs par mi bgyid lags/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa las srid pa las skyo ba skyed ④par bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u bcu gnyis pa'o// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa zhes bya ba slob dpon ma ti tsitras ⑤mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba ①dzñā de ba dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande dpal brtsegs rakṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //1—300

snyan ngag rtsom la skal chen po/ /khyod la brten nas bdag gi blo/ /dbyar ga yi ni chu bo ltar/ /chung ngu'ang shin tu 'phel bar 'gyur/ /mi yi rnyed pa rnyed dka' dang / /lce 'di rnyed par gyur nas ni/ /mgon po'i ①yon tan sgrogs byed pa'i/ /rang la phan pa su mi byed/ /a sku mab gyis spras gyur pa/ /mdzes gyur mig gi bdud rtsi ni/ /sprin med ston sha'i nam mkha' la/ /skar ma'i tshogs kyis spras pa 'dra/ /thub pa gser gyi mdog ldan pa/ /chos gos kyis g.yogs mdzes gyur pa/ /gser gyi ri bo'i rtse mo ni/ /mtshams gyi sprin gyis dkris pa 'dra/ /mgon khyod rgyan gyis ma brgyan yang / /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mdangs gang yin/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas gyur pa/ /sprin dang bral la de ma mchis/ /khyod kyi zhal gyi padma dang / /padma nyi mas kha phye ba/ /bung bas mthong na padma ni/ /the tshom dpyang thag la 'ju 'gyur/ /khyod zhal gser gyi mdog ldan par / /chems dkar mdzes par gyur pa ni/ /gser gyi ri gseb ston ga yis⑤/ /zla zer dri med zhugs pa 'dra/ /mchod 'os khyod kyi phyag g.yas ni/ /'khor lo'i mtshan gyis mdzes gyur pa/ /'khor bas skrag pa'i mi rnams la/ /phyag gis dbugs 'byin mdzad pa lags/ /thub khyod gshegs par gyur pa'i tshe/ /zhabs gnyis dpal gyi padma 'dras/ /sa gzhi 'di ni bris gyur pa/ /padma can gyis ji ltar mdzes/ /khyod ni gshegs stabs mnyam med de/ /glang chen mchog ni myos pa dang / /ngang pa chung mar ldan pa'am/ /khyu mchog pas kyang brtan par gshegs/ /tshul khrims phung pos sku che zhing / /ting 'dzin shing gis rnam par brgyan/ /ye shes 'bab chus khyab gyur pa/ /rgyu ba'i gangs can ri bo lags/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyod gang gi/ /lus kyis tsho khyod la reg gyur pa/ /lha 1—301

dang mi yi ༅mchod gyur pa'i/ /'bab stegs su ni de de mdzad/ /khyod kyi gnas ni grub pa'i zhing / /mthong bas sems dag gyur lags na/ /dag par 'dod pa'i mkhas pa rnams/ /sgra ngan zhing gis ci zhig bya/ /khyod ni pha rol phyin drug dang / /ldan pas yang dag mdzes gyur pa/ /zla ba rgyas par gyur pa ni/ /smin drug gis ni brgyan pa 'dra/ /gdul bya'i skye bo padma ni/ /gnyid log khyod kyis sad mdzad pa/ /nyi ma shar bar gyur pa yis/ /padma kha byer byed pa 'dra/ /nyon mongs dug gis zin gyur la/ /khyod ni ye shes sman stsol ba/ /mche ba'i dug can gyis zin la/ /'gro skyob gyi ni dug bsal snematshungs/ /khyod kyi ye shes nags me yis/ /lta ba'i dra ba bsregs gyur pa // /nags mes shin tu 'bar ba yis/ /shing gi lcug phran bsregs dang mtshungs/ /ye shes rang bzhin 'bar ba yis/ /thub khyod nyi mas nyon mongs pa'i/ /rang bzhin 'dam ni skems mdzad pa/ /'di ni nyi ma'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /khyod kyi gsung gis mi yi sems/ /bya ba ma yin las bzlog 3/pa/ /kha lo sgyur chen zhags pa yis/ /ba glang mo ༅'khrul zlog dang mtshungs/ /gal te re ba khyod gcig pu/ /nyon mongs 'ching ba las grol na/ /'on kyang gzhan dag grol mdzad pas/ /phal cher mchod 'os nyid du 'gyur/ /khyod kyi gsung gi 'od zer gyis/ /nyon mongs kyis gdungs chim mdzad pa/ / sos sha'i tsha bas gdungs pa la/ /mtshan mo'i zla zer ji bzhin no/ /gdul bya'i skye bo chos kyis ni/ /skom 8 gdungs khyod 'al rtog pa ni/ /khug rta skom gyis gdungs pa ni/ /dbyar gyi char sprin tshogs ltar mtshungs/ /khyod gsung phyochos kyi sgra yis ni/ /gdul bya kun la dga' mdzad pa//snyan pa'i glu bye yi sgra yis ni/ /ri dwags 'gro ba'ang sdod dang mtshungs/ /skyabs 1—302

'dod gang dag skyabs 'os pa/ /khyod la skyabs su mi mchi ste/ /mu stegs la ni skyabs 'gro ba/ /skyabs med yun ring sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /brgya byin mig ni stong gis kyang / /de nyid mthong bar ma gyur gang / /yo kyis ye shes spyan gyis de / /gzigs shing gzhan la'ang ston par mdzad/ /bstan bcos ngas ①shes rlom pa can/ /rtsod pa smra ba mang po ni/ /khyod kyi gzigs pas zhum gyur cing / /bung ba lta bur rnam par 'khor/ /yo kyi gsung ni gcig tsam gyis/ /pha rol tshar gcod mdzad pa na/ /gzhan dag mi smra'i tshul gnas pa/ /dgun gyi khu byug lta bu lags/ /khyod kyi slob ma bzang po'i shing / /dge ba'i me tog ches rgyas pa / /dpyid sha'i shing ni me tog gis/ /brgyan pa lta bur mdzes pa lags/ /thub pa yo kyi blo gros mdas/ /shes bya'i 'ben ni phug gyur te/ /dga' byed grong na gzhu rgyal gyis/ /sngon chad phug par ma gyur to/ /mkhas par rlom pa'i dregs pa can/ /khyod kyi ⑤thar lam ma 'tshal bas/ /srid pa'i dgon par 'khyams gyur pa/ /'brog stong dmus long tshogs dang mtshungs/ /las 'bras yod dam med 'gyur zhes/ /'jig rten pa ni the tshom rsā/ /dge ba'i las kyi dpang ④por ni/ /gyur pa nga sku 'di lags so/ /yon tan rgya mtsho yo yon tan / /mthar thug bdag gis mi rtogs te/ /nam mkha' bai ḍūrya sngo mdog /bya yis mtha' rtogs mi 'gyur mtshungs/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa las dpe las bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u bcu gsum pa'o// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa zhes bya ba slob dpon ma ti tsi tras ⑤ mdzad pa rdzogs so// //1—303

stong gsum chos kyi char 'bebs pa/ /klu dbang rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo yo kyi ①bstan pa 'dis/ /bdud dang mu stegs skrag mdzad cing / /gdul bya kun mkhyen 'god mdzad pa'iṭa ra/ /dpa' bo'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rjes gzhan don rab bsgoms pas/ /nyid kyi sku srog gtong ba la/ / 'gums pa sos tsa ltar rab dgyes pa/ /dpal dgyes la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhas pa rnams la don snang mdzad/ /bar ma'i rgyud rnams smin mdzad cing / /tha ma'i nyon mongs sreg ④mdzad pa/ /rin chen me la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun dang skal pa mnyam/ / chos kyi bushes rab snang ba yis/ /phyogs rnams snang bar mdzad de 'khrungs/ /rin chen zla 'od phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku ni blta bas mi ngoms shing —/ /'dom gang 'od kyis sa le ba / /gang gis khyod mthong skal ldan pas/ /mthong ba don yod phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsung thugs ni rin chen mchog /dri med spros bral sangs rgyas pas/ /'gro kun nyon mongs gdung ba sel/ /rin chen zla ba phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam chos dri ma med pa'i chus/ /thog mar bdag nyid dag mdzad nas/ /gzhan dag mchog tu dag mdzad pa/ /dri med dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams byas pa'i tshogs dag ni/ /sems can kun la yongs bsngo bar/ /thub pa khyod kyis ston mdzad pa/ /dpal sbyin la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig ( dang zhabs su ldan pa po/ /tshangs pa lags par bram zes dubazhed/ / rig dang zhabs de khyed la mnga'akyi/ /tshangs pa'i mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs pa'i zhabs bzhi rab bsgoms ⑩shing / /tshangs spyod 'bras bu mchog brnyes ༅pa/ /tshangs pas 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /tshangs las byin bul phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs ni dka' thub brtul zhugs dag /yang dag 1—318

blangs pa gtsang mar mdzad/ /nyon mongs sdig pa 'khrud nya1mdzad pa/ /chu yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten pa dag bde byed mchod/ /bde byed klu chen ma dros mchod/ /chu lha des kyang khyod mchod pas/ /chu lha'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dren pa kun gyis mchod rgyagyur cing / /khyod ni mtshungs med rab zhi bas/ /'gro ba kun gyi dpal mdzad pa/ /dpal bzangs /la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod la rgol ba'i nyon mongs pa/ /do gal byed pa thams cad kyang / /tsandan spangs pa ltar bsil mdzad/ /tsandan dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i dpal dang gzi brjid ni/ /sus kyang 'gran par mi bzod de/ /mig gis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /gzi brjid mtha' yas phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub pa'i 'od zer rab byung bas/ /nga rgyal khengs pa zhi mdzad cing / /dman rnams spro ba bskyed par mdzad/ /'od dpal la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma mya ngan 'das pa gi zhi/ /khyed 3 'dra thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /mnga' brnyes pa yang bde gshegs pas/ /mya ngan med dpal phyag 'tshal lo༅/ /sred pa med pa goms mdzad cing / /'dren pa kun gyi mchog gyur pa/ /stobs chen thams cad zil gnon pa ༅/ /sred med bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pas/ /mdzes pa gzhan kun zil gyis gnon/ /mtshan dang dpe byad rab rgyas pa/ /me tog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang 'od zer gyis/ /'jig rten thams cad khyab mdzad pa/ /tshangs pa'i 'od zer rnam par rol/ /mngon par mkhyen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od kyis gang la reg pa yang / /chags med bde ba rab rgyas pasadu / /padma'i 'od zer rnam par rol/ /mngon par mkhyen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub pa'i bsod nams 'od zer gyis/ /'gro rnams 1—319

zang zing ༅ mdzad pa/ /༅ par 'phags pa'i nor sbyin pa①/ /nor dpal la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /dran pa rnams la mnga' brnyes pas/ / thogs pa ⑤med cing rab mayo pa/ /gang gis khyod dran phongs ②sel bas/ /dran pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub pas ④chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /snyan pa'i ba dan sa gsum grags/ /yon tan grangs med mtshan gyi dpal/ /shin tu yongs bsgrags ①phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs dang dbang po mchog brnyes pas/ /nag po'i phyogs rnams pham mdzad de/ /dbang po'i spyi0btud dbang po'i tog /rgyal mtshan rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos porasgogs pa'i rtog ge pa⑦// /phra zhib ye shes rdo rje yis/ /seng ges glang po ji bzhin du/ /shin tu rnam gnon phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gzhan nyon mongs sde bcom pas/ /khyed las dudapal mchog gzhan ma mchis/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug g.yul las rgyal/ /shin tu rnam rgyal phyag 'tshal lo/ /bgrod pa gcig pa'i ⑨lam chen du/ /'gro kun ded dpon rab mdzad de/ /bdud dang ngan song 'jigs las sgrol/ /rnam par gnon gshegs phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub pa'i rdzu 'phrul rmad byung bas/ /sprul babye ba dpag med 'gyed/ /gdul bya kun la snang gyur pas/ /kun snang bkod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mu stegs thar pa phyir ldog ⑫cing / /nyan thos zhi ba phyogs gcig la / /khyod kyi sa ⑫mchog rin chen rnams/ /padma ltar gnon /bophyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams tshogs las rin po che/ /ye shes tshogs rdzogs padma'i gdan/ /sku gsum lhun grub rab tu bzhugs/ /ri dbang rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde bar gshegs pa sum cu rtsa lnga'i mab/ /rin po spras pa'i bstod pa 'di brjod pas / /thub pa'i dbang po'i spyod pa ci 'dra bar0/ /bdag gi spyod kyang de dang 1—320

bsdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/ (34) 1—322

0na5༄/ /tshig brgyad pa'i bstod pa/ 1 ༄tso/ /rgya gar skad du/ pa da su khya.aṣṭa ga sto cha/ bod skad du/ tshig brgyad pa'i bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla rgyas zhal 'dra khyu mchog 'dra ba'i spyan/ /seng ge'i sgra 'dra glang po'i stobs 4 'dra zhing / /ri dbang rgyal phyo/brtan rgya mtsho 'dra ba'i thugs/ /lha dbang bla ma'i thugs nyadabang phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan gsum spyan legs padma ltar yangs spyan/ /gnod sbyin klu yi mi she'adras gzigs mdzad cing / /thar pa thob mdzad spyan ni dkyus ring ba/ /spyan stong gzigs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mchog du ma'i yan lag mchog gis btud/ /btso ma'i gser ltar 'bar sku mchod 'os sku/ /mtshan bzangs mdzes pas rnam par brgyan pa'i sku/ /bde gshegs de la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo gros rgyas shing gser ltar dri ma med/ /blo gros grags shing mkhas pa'i blo dang ldan/ /sangs rgyas mkha' ltar dri med spyan mnga' ba/ / 1—323

dpa' bo mi g.yo ①blo mnga' de la 'dud/ /smra ba'i mchog gyur ④snyan pa'i don g.yo ba/ /yang dag don gsung ⑤'dul ba'i don gsung zhing / /smra ba'i dbang phyug rgol bas mi bskyod gsung / /bden bzhi ④gsung ba'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan du mi 'dul 'dul ba'i don du 'du༅/ /nyon mongs spong sogs rnams ⑥par dag pas 'dul/ /thub pa tshul spyod chen pos legs par ga mdzad/ /snyoms shing mdzes pa'i tshems ldan mgon la 'dud/ /bsod nams dpag med bsags pas sku mdzes la/ /'dom gang 'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'bar ba'i sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma lta bur dri med sku/ /srid las grol sku rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'khor los zhabs gnas mchog gi mtshan ldan zhabs⑤/ /lha dbang spyi bos legs par btud pa'i zhabs/ /zhabs sor dra bas legs brgyan mdzes pa'i zhabs/ /dpal be'u g.yung drung gis mtshan ⑨zhabs la 'dud/ /tshig brgyad pa'i bstod pa dge bsnyen mtha' yas lhas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //1—324

༄/ /dgon mchog gsum gyi bstod pa/rgya ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ tri ratna sto (tshu// bod skad du/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bstod pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo ④ sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyob pa'i ༅chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum la rtag tu bdag phyag 'tshal/ /tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs mkhyen bzhi sku gsum grub/ /rnam rtog mi mnga' ci yang sa le mkhyen/ /chos sku mkha' 'dra gzugs sku mdzes sku la ldan/ /sangs rgyas dpag bsam 'dra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid rgyu mthun gsung rab bcu gnyis dang / /chos la skye 'gag med cing spros las gidaben/ /de la dmigs te yon tan kun grub pa/ /legs rgyu dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs sgrib dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dag /gnyen pos rim par bsal nas rjesar bzhugs shing she / /sems can don mdzad sangs rgyas zhing spyong batshe/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal 1—326

lo tsho rgya ba po che po ti ci—/ /dkon ma ga gsum ①bstod pa slob da na na ma ṭas ②mdzad pa rdzogs so// // bsdur mchan/6 ① 'a di nye ra: pe ra ga sto32 ma byang 'a gzhung lasacas ba nga / 〈〈 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉da ma gsum lab da pa/②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tra/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dar mar g.yo la phyag 'cha go⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skur/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 sangs rgyag⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉cha ba'i/〈〈snar 〉〉sbyong ba'i/327 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉trag bsdur 'bras phro migabastod tshogs/ (36)1—327

༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ tri ratna sto tra bṛbhi⑤/ bod skad du/ dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa'i 'grel pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid pa gsum gyi bla ma dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa ni 'gro ba rnams kyi mngon par 'dod pa'i 'bras bu mtha' dag skyed ①pa'i rgyu yin pas na de'i phyir de dag la phyag 'tshal ba sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ ma 'dres pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i ma rig pa dag ma lus par spangs pa ni sangs rgyas te ④gnyid rab tu sangs pa bzhin no/ /yang na nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'i mi shes pa spangs pas shes bya mtha' dag la blo rgyas pas rgyas pa ste padma rab tu rgyas pa lta bu'o/ /de ltaran de dag gi ⑤ni spangs pa dang ye shes phun sum tshogs pas bstod pa ste/ nyid kyi don phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /gzhan gyi don phun sum 1—328

tshogs pa'i dbang du byas te/ gtso zhes smos pa las sa gsum gyi ①dbang phyug chen por gyur pas na gtso bo ste/ de dag ma luyopas 'don pas lci ba ⑤ ni gzugs la la lci bar gyur las srong gi mgo gnon ②pa lta bu'o/ /des ni thams cad zil gyis mnan nas 'dul zhes bstan par 'gyur ro/ /yang na phyin ci ma log pa'i yon tan rin po che sbyin pas na bla ma ste/ de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba ni sgo gsum gyi 0rab tu 'dud par byed ⑤pa'o/ /skyob pa'i 0chos la phyag 'tshal lo / /zhes bya ba la ⑦'dis ngan 'gro dang srid par sdug bsngal ba las skyob cing sdug bsngal sel la bde ba ⑧sbyin pas na skyob pa zhes bya'o/ /de nyid kyis na chos te rnam par lhung ba las 'dzin pas so/ /de yang gang gis don dam pa'i chos de rtogs na ⑨slar ngan song dang 'khor bar mi lhung ba'i phyir ro/ /de rtogs pa'i rgyud pa'i rgyu ni bstan pa'i chos yin la/ dngos kyi rgyu ni lam gyi chos yin pas de dag la yang btags te 'dzin pa zhes brjod do/ /yang na skyob pa zhes bya bas ni gzhan la phan 'dogs pa phun sum tshogs pa bstan la/ chos zhes bya ba ༅ni rang gi mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa 'dzin pa phun sum tshogs pa bstan to/ /de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba ni snga ma bzhin no/ /dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya bgi 'di dag ⑩lha'i bu'i bdud dag gis kyang ston pa dang lta ba las ⑩mi phyed pas na dge 'dun te/ de la ston pa las mi phyed pa ni shes nas dad pa thob pas so/ /lta ba las ⑫mi phyed pa ni bdag med pa'i ye shes rnam par dag pa thob pa'i phyir ro/ /de la ⑫nyan thos dang rang rgyal ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' yang rung ste/ kun du sbyor ba gsum spangs pa'i 'phags pa rnams ni slob pa dang mi slob pa yang rung ste dge 'dun no/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs 1—329

rgyas ni shes bya'i sgrib pa mtha' dag kyang spangs la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs mtha' dag kyang rdzogs pas dge 'dun gyi nang du bgrang ①bar bya ba ma yin la/sa gsum gyi 'gro ba dam pa dang slob pa dang mi slob pa thams cad kyis mchod par 'os pas dgra bcom pa chen po zhes ni ⑤bya'o/ /de ltar mi phyed pa ni rang gi don thob pa yin la/ gzhan gyi don thob par byed pa'i phyir ⑤che zhes smos so / /'di dag gzhan gyi yon sbyong ba che bas na chen po ste/ phul ba dang yongs su longs spyod khyapa gnyis kyis 'gro ba'i rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams mchog 'phel ba'i phyir te/ de yang slob pa dang mi slob pa de dag ni ④ci rigs parasred pa'i ༅cha shas lhag ma lus ⑧zas dang gos la sogs pa la 'dun pa'i 'dod chags phra mo bsgom pas spang bar bya ba yod pa dang / sngon gyi rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu phung po lnga 'dzin pas ⑨zas la sogs pas da dung gso dgos pas longs spyod kyi / sangs rgyas dang chos ni de lta ⑩ma yin pas so/ /de dag la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba ni snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /gsum po de dag ⑫la rtag tu bdag phyag 'tshal zhes bya ba ni don go sla'o/ /de ltar phyag 'tshal ba'i rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu ni sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po thams cad kyi gtso bo spyi gtsug bltar ⑫mi mthong ba 'thob pa'o/ /rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu la myong ba rgyu mthun ⑫ni 'khor bar skye ba khyan mgo bo gdugs lta bur 'gyur ba dang / dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal ba la dga' bar 'gyur ba'o/ /dbang gi 'bras bu ni phyi rol gyi dngos po yid du 'ong ba rnams de'i shes pa'i yul du 'dud pa ltar snang zhing dgyed ༅pa dang gzung du mi rung ba ltar snang bar mi 'gyur ro⑩/ /de ltar dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa mdor gsungs pa de dag rab tu gsal bar bstan pas 'gro ba dam pa 1/de330

rnams de bas kyang shas cher dad parabu ba ①dang / rang gi tshogs dri ma med pa bsags pa'i phyir slob dpon ma ti tsi ṭa'i ②zhal snga nas bstod pa ①gsungs pa/tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs mkhyen bzhi sku gsum grub/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa brjod pa yin te/ 'dis rdzogs par byed pas na tshogs te①/ sbyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug go/ /de dag ⑤nyid chen po ste rang bzhin dpag tu med pa dang / bskal pa dpag tu med pa dang / yul dpag tu med pa la bsags 0 pa'o / /gnyis zhes bya ba ni bsod nams dang ye shes so/ /de yang sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang / bzod pa ni bsod nams te/ bsam gtan dang shes rab ni ye shes so/ /brtson 'grus ni de gnyis shar ⑦gtogs so zhes 'phags pa dgongs pa nges par 'grel ba las gsungs so/ /de gnyis rdzogs pa ni bskal pa chen po grangs med pa dang por ⑧sbyor ba'i lam sbyangs shing gnyis par sa bdun pa'i bar dang / gsum par sa bcu pa'i bar du ⑨sbyangs shing dag par byas pa ni rdzogs shing mthar thug par 'gyur ba'o⑫/ /des ni 7rgyu khyad par can bsags pa bstan nas/ da ni 'bras bu bstan pa'i phyir mkhyen bzhi zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ mkhyen ⑫bzhi ni me long lta bu'i ye shes la sogs pa bzhi'o/ /de la me long lta bu'i ye shes ni kun gzhi rnam shes gnas gyur pa shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med par ⑩mkhyen pa'i ye shes so/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes ni nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnas gyur pa bdag med pa la ⑫bdag med par mkhyen pa'i ye shes so/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnas gyur pa kun rdzob kyi dngos po ma lus pa padma'i 'dab ma ltar ma 'dres par mkhyen pa'o/ /bya ba grub ⑫pa'i ye shes ni sgo lnga'i ⑩rnam par shes pa gnas gyur pa 'gro ba rnams 1—331

gdul ba'i bya ba gang yin pa ma lus pa mdzad pa ①mayo pa'o/ /de dag bsdus pa ni sku gsum grub ces bya bas bstan te/ de yang bsod nams kyi tshogs chen po'i 'bras bu ②ni/ gzugs kyi ①sku gnyis 'grub la/ ye shes kyi tshogs po po'i 'bras ba ④ni chos kyi sku 'grub pa'o⑤/ /de la me long ⑥lta ba'i ye shes ni chos kyi ri sde sa ri sku ⑦gzung ba dang 'dzin pa las grol ba ⑤rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba tsam gyi ye shes so/ /de'i chos ⑨stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi la sogs pa ye shes tha dad pa du ma tshogs pas na chos kyi tshogs yin la⑫/ chos kyi sku zhes bya ba ni kā ⑪ya'i sgra tshogs la 'jug pas so/ /ye shes de yang dngos su na longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes so/ /so sor rtog pa dang mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste/ de yang sku de'i nang gi ye shes skye mched tha dad pa la rag las pa las grol ba kun rdzob sna tshogs mayo pa dang tsa skur bstan pas bgang 'dul bar 'os pa 'dul ba'o/ /des ni ༅'dir sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku thams cad kyi gzhi ni rnam par rsā pa'i sku ste/ de'i mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang / sgo lnga'i ye shes kyi 'od zer gyi snang ba las chos dang sprul pa'i skur bzhag cing / de gnyis kyi rten ye shes ⑫dang bcas pa de nyid longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhes brjod do/ / lang na ⑫bsod nams kyi tshogs mtha' yas pa las grub pa'i lus ga par can dang / de'i 'od zer gzugs khyad par can du snang ba ni ⑩gzugs kyi sku gnyis te/ gang mig gi yul du gyur pa de nyid gzugs so / /rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar ⑫snang ba'i ye shes ni gtso bo ste/ sna tshogs shes pa dang / bdag med par shes pa yang ye shes kyi tshogs las byung bar brjod par bya'o/ /de las gzhan pa bdag med pa tsam de ni don ⑫dam pa'i chos 1—332

dkon mchog tu bzhag gi byasangs rgyas suṣpe mi gzhag ⑤ste/ de ni rgyal ba rnams kyi ye shes kyi yul yin la/ thob par bya ba'i 'bras bur gzhag ①par bya'o/ /des na rang gi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i sku ni gsum kho nar brjod par bya'o/ /de ④ni sku gsum pode'i bdag nyid las dang ⑤/ dpe dang / mtshan nyid kyis gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir/ rnam rtog mi mnga' ci yang sa le mkhyen/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ rnam par rtog pa'i rigs gsum mam bzhi dang bral ba'i phyir rnam par rtog pa ④mi mnga' ba ste/ gnyis su 'dzin pa mtha' dag drungs nas phyung ba'i ye shes chen po'o/ /de'i phyir mi mnga' zhes bya ba'i dgag pa 'di ni ma yin par dgag pa ste/ rnam par rtog pa'i rigs de dag ni yod pa ma yin la/ des dben pa'i ye shes rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba ni mnga' bas ༅ / /des nades ci yang rung ste chos ci yang rung ba ⑤rdul phra rab dang ri rab la sogs pa de dag sa le zhes bya ba rab tu gsal bar mkhyen pa ⑨ste/ ji ⑩ltar mkhyen zhe na/ sgra'i ༅spyi'i rnam par rtog pa'i ⑫sgro btags pa dang skur ⑫pa btab pa dang bral zhing phan tshun mi sgrib la ༅thogs pa med cing mun pa med la shel dang lhang tsher ltar gsal ba'i rnam par dbyer med par ⑫mkhyen te/ de nyid ye shes de'i las yin no/ /de'i dpe bstan pa ni chos sku mkha' 'dra zhes bya ⑩ste/'dus ma byas nam mkha' thogs pa med cing mi sgrib pa ltar me long lta bu'i ye shes kyang shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med cing sgrib pa med la/ dmigs pa dang rnam pa ⑫yongs su ma chad par snang ba'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /'dir ye shes lhag ma gsum ni gzugs la sogs pa dang / gang zag la bdag med pa tsam dang / /'dul ba'i 'gro ba'i bsam pa dang bag la nyal la sogs ⑫pa dang 'dul ba'i 1—333

thabs shes las ①yul so sor nges pa'i ye shes yin la/ ye shes 'di ni yul de dag dang bcas pa'i ye shes de dag nyid ⑤chos can du gyur pa dang / de'i chong nyid ①rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba ④spyi'i mtshan nyid du gyur pa ste/ chos can dang chos nyid du bcas pa mtha' dag mkhyen par gyur pa'o/ /gzugs sku mdzes skur ldan zhes bya ba ni mtshan dang dpe byad rab tu 'bar ba'i longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / sprul pa'i sku'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi don ni sngar bstan pa bzhin no/ /dpag bsam 'dra zhes bya ba ni sku gsum char gyi dpe ste/ 'gro ba rnams kyis ji ltar sems kyis dpags shing bsams ⑤pa ltar yid la re ba yongs su rdzogs par byed pas na lha'i dpag bsam gyi shing chen po rnam pa bzhi po dang 'dra ba ste/bsod nams dpag bsam shing khyod de ring gang las ༅byung / /zhes bstod pa gsungs pa ⑦lta bu'o/ /de yang sku de dag gsum char yang sngon gyi smon lam gyi sa bon dpag tu med pa 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin du gnas pas⑤/ sngon ji ltar smon lam btab pa bzhin du da ltar ⑨gdul bya'i don ⑩'bad pa med par 'byung ba yin la/ khyad par du gzugs kyi sku ni mthu ⑩thogs pa med par byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyi tshe ba'i gang zag dang 'gro ba yongs su smin par byed pa la dngos 7su yang 'jug go/ /kha cig na re gzugs sku zhes bya ba ni spyir bstan pa than laX/ mdzes skur ldan zhes bya ba ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'o/ /dpag bsam 'dra zhes bya ba ni sprul pa'i sku'o/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya ba ni sku gsum char gyi dbang du byas pa'o zhes zer ro/ /de lta bu'i sku gsum po de dag la lus zhing gi rdul snyed du mos par ⑫sprul te phyag 'tshal lo 3zhes bya ba ste༅/ tshig gi donasnga ma ༅ji lta ba bzhin no/ /chos nyid rgyu mthun gsung rab bcu gnyis 1—334

dang / /zhes bya ba ni ①bstan pa'i chos la bstod pa ste/ chos nyid ces bya ba la chos nyid bdag rnam pa gnyis kyis dben pa ②stong pa nyid de⑤/ bdag med pa dang bdag dang bral ba'i mtshan nyid 'dzin pa ④rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i ⑤spyi'i mtshan nyid don dam pa'i ⑨ngo bo'o/ /de'i rgyu mthun pa ④bstan pa'i chos bdag med par ston ⑧pa'i gsung rab ste/ 'dir mthun pa'i rgyu ni rgyu mthun pa ste bskyed par rung ba dang / thob par nus pa'o/ /de la skyed ①par rung ba ni rgyu des phyin ci ma log par yongs su grub pa'i ye shes skyed pa'o/ /thob par nus pa ⑩ni ye shes de skyes pas mi 'gyur ba'i ⑩yongs su grub pa de bzhin nyid de thob par nus pa'o/ /de dag ni rab tu phul du byung ba'i gsung yin pas gsung rab ste / phyi rol pa'i tshig la ni snga ma lta bu'i rung ba dang / nus pa med pas rab ma yin no/ /bcu gnyis ni mdo'i sde dang / dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa'i sde ⑫dang /lung du bstan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang /gleng gzhi 0dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang / de lta bu byung ba dang / skyes pa'i ༅rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / rmad du byung ba dang / gtan la phab pa'i sde zhes bya ba khyaste/ de dag dang po ni ston pa'i zhal nas grag pa'o ⑩/ /de'i 'og tu ni ⑫gang zag gi blo la gnas pa'o/ /de'i 'og tu glegs bam la bris pa'o / /de yang dang por ༅de la dmigs nas thos pa dang bsams pa las byung ba'i ⑫shes rab skye zhing de nas bsgoms ༅pas chos nyid de thob ⑥pas mthun pa'i rgyu brgyud pa nyid du nges pa'o/ /de bas na slob dpon ba su ban thos rnam bshad rigs par chabashad pa/ ston pa'i zhal nas byung ba skyobo'i mig gi rab rib ༅zhi bar mdzad pa bkra shis kyi 3/ /'byung gnas sems la zhog cig gang phyir 'di ni 1—335

lus can rnams kyi rna ba'i bdud rtsi dang ①/ /nyon mongs pa yi nad ༅kun sel bar mdzad pa yin pas de don yang dag bsam par gyis/ /rgyu 'di rnams kyis rtag tu gus par sangs rgyas kyi ni gsung dag sanyan par bya ba'i ⑤rigs/ /zhes so / /chos la skye 'gag med cing spros las rjodaben/ /de la dmigs te yon tan kun grub ⑤pa/ /zhes bya ba ni don dam pa'i chos la bstod pa ste/ /chosani ④ dam pa'i chos so/ /de la don dam par skyeb dang 'gag pa med cing gzhan yang spros pa ste rtag pa dang / chad pa dang / 'ong ba dang / 'gro ba dang /gcig pa ④dang / tha dad pa'i spros pa de dag las dben pa'o/ /de yang ⑤dam pa'i chos ni bdag med pa'i rang bzhin yin la/ spros pa de dag ni bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dbang gis btags pa tsam du zad pas na bdag tu 'dzin pa log ma thag tu de dag kyang ldog la/ bdag med pa'i ngang la de dag dang po nas kyang med kyi btags pa glo bur bar zad pa'o⑨/ /de ltar spros pa dang bral ba bdag med pa de ⑫la bdag med par shes rab rnam pa gsum gyis dmigs pas bdag tu 'dzin pa la sogs ⑪de ma thag tu 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan thun mong ba rgyun du zhugs pa la sogs pa ⑫'phags pa'i 'bras bu rnam pa du ma dang / thun mong ma yin pa 0stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa'i yon tan kun grub pas na 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams ni 'dus ma byas las rab tu byung ba'o ⑫zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /legs rgyu dam pa'i chos la zhes bya ba ni lam gyi chos la bstod pa ste / /de la legs pa ni nges par legs pa ste nye bar zhi ba'i bde ba'o/ /de'i rgyu ni skyed khyapar byed pa ste/ des bdag med pa'i ye shes bskyed la/ des kyang nges par legs pa de thob ༅ pas so/ /'dis tsa zad pa dang mi skyeb shes pa'i 1—336

sngon du rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin skyes pa de ①ni legs rgyu ⑤mthar thug pa yin la/des mjug btul ⑤ba mthong ba'i lam gyi bar gyiye shes ni ④legs rgyur rig ①par bya'o / /de nyid dam pa ste/ 'phags pa rnams kyis nyams su myong bar gyur pa dang / ltung ba las ①'dzin pas na dam pa'i chos zhes bya'o/ /de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba ni snga ma bzhin no/ /nyon mongs sgrib dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dag /gnyen pos rim par bsal nas sar zhugs shing ༅/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa ④ni 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la bstod pa ste/ de la sems kun nas nyon mongs par byed pas na ⑨nyon mongs pa ste/ 'dod chags la sogs pa drug go/ /de dag nyid speb pa ste⑫/ zad pa dang mi skyeb shes pa'i ye shes la sgrib cing ༅mthong ba'i gegs byed pas so/ /shes bya ni chos kyi dbyings kun du 'gro ba rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'o/ /de la sgrib pa ni rjod ༅par byed pa sgra'i spyi la yod par 'dzin pa ste/ dngos su na chagazung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i rigs ji snyed pa'o / /sgrib pa de gnyis ga ༅yang rab tu dbye ba mang po dang ldan pas na dag ces pa ⑫mang po'i tshig can no/ /gnyis ༅pos zhes bya ba ni bdag med pa gnyen ⑫shes pa'i ye shes kyis ⑫so/ /rim par bsal nas zhes bya ba ni de dag cig༅car mi spong gi dang po mthong spang rgyaspong la/ /de'i 'og tu bsgom ༅pas spang bar bya ba spong ba'i phyir ro/ /de las 'bras bu thob yipa bstan pa ni 3sar zhugs shing ④zhes bya ba ste/ sa ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sa ste/ brgyad pa dang / mthong ba dang / bsrabs pa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba khru dang / byas pa rtogs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la zhugs pa dang /yang rab tu dga' ba dang / dri ༅ma med pa nas ༅chos kyi sprin gyi bar la zhugs 1—337

pa'o / /'dir bden pa bzhi ①rnam pa bcu drug dag yid la byed pa'i ②ye shes kyi skad cig bcu drug gis phra rgyas brgyad cu rtsa brgyad spangs pas mthong ba'i lam la brgyad pa'am rab tu dga' ba'i sa pa'o/ /de'i 'og tu tshul de nyid kyi ②bsgom pas spang bar bya ba bcu spangs pa las ni nyan thos dang rang rgyal ba'i sa ⑤lhag ma dag gzhag ste / 'dod pa'i 0rnam pa gsum pa'i bar dang / ⑦rnam pa drug pa dang / dgu pa dang / srid rtse'i dgu pa zad pa las mthong ba dang /bsrabs pa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / byas pa rtogs pa'i sa pa'o / /cig car kho nar spangs pa ⑧dang lam rdzogs pa ni bse ru lta bu'i sa'o⑨/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa lhag ma rnams ni pha rol tu phyin pa rnams yongs su rdzogs pa las rnam par gzhag ⑩par rig par bya zhing / de dag gi ⑩nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa bsgom ⑫pas spang bar bya ba ni rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis cig car spong la/ shes bya'i sgrib pa ni sa re re la yang rim gyis spang ngo / /la la ni nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa yang sa re re la rim gyis spong ste/ spong byed ni chos la bdag med pa'i ye shes kyis so ⑫zhes zer ro/ /de ltar ye shes kyi tshogs la gnas pa bshad ༅nas/ da ni bsod nams kyi tshogs la gnas pa bstan pa'i phyir/sems can don mdzad sangs rgyas zhing sbyong ba/ /zhes smos te/ sems can rnams kyi don ni dgos ⑫pa ste bde ba dang phan pa'o/ /de dag mdzad pa ni bsdu ba'i dngos po dang / tshad med pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa dag gis ji ltar nus par byed pa'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhing ni snod dang bcud do/ /de dag sbyong ba ni rgyal ba'i yum las gsungs pa ltar te/ sems can gos ngan pa dag mthong na bdag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing der ⑫sems can rnams lus gos dang rgyan 1—338

gyis brgyan par gyur cig ces smon lam gdab par bya'o/ /me tog dbul ༅na bdag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing der dus thams cad pa'i me tog rab tu rgyas par gyur cig ces spyon lam gdab par bya'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /mdor na sangs rgyas kyi zhing ni spyon lam gyi mthus sbyong bar rig par bya'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun che la zhes bya ba largya/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos las ring du song bas tshe 'phags pa ste/ dge 'dun ni sngar bshad pa bzhin no/ /che ba ni grangs dang yon tan gyis che ba ste/ grangs ④mtha' yas pa dang / legs par zhugs pa la sogs pa'i yon tan chen po mnga' ba'i phyir ro/ /phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba ni bstod pa dang bcas pa'i lus kyi khya/yan lag thams cad rab tu 'dud pa'o/ /de ltar yon tan mtha' dag 'dus gye pa'i dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal nas de dag la skyabs su song na ngan song rnams su mi skyobar lha'i gnas su skye ste/gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ ngan 'gro las yang dag par 'da' ba'o zhes gsungs pa dang / 'di ltar shin tu dang ba'i sems de la yid gzhungs pas /༅ gzhan du ma yengs pa'i yid gsal bas sangs rgyas sam chos sam dge 'dun la skyabs su song na/ de 'chi ba'i dus byas nas shebade 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten zur na gnas pa zhes bya ba yider shin tu dang ba'i sems dang skyabs su song ba'i rgyus skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang de'i lus gzi brjid dang ldan zhing / /khyalus rang gi 'od kyis brgyan la bde bar gnas par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gal te phyag 'tshal ba dang skyabs su song ba'i dge ba de yongs su bsngo ba dang ldan na ni ji ltar bsngos pa'i thar pa'i rgyur 'gyur bar rig par bya'o/ /de ltar nyes pa kun spangs shing / /yon tan mtha' yas 1—339

gter sdomar pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi ①bstod pa'i tshig /cung zad bshad pas dge ba'i tshogs/ /gang thob ⑤de yis 9)gro ba rnams/ /sangs rgyas sa la gnas par shog /dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon rgyal ba'i sras kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na shārnyi ②dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba bande dpal gyi lhun po'i sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/328 ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod/ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sta snyi ti/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bskyed/④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa sto ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de dag329 khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 gri ༅ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa gnon pas rdzibar gyur pa/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa ni srang gi mgo mnon/ ④ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyig ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 par byeg ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉ga ༅ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bag /bya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga'adi dag ni/ ༅ ⑩༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bag yi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yang /33༷ ༅ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉drang/ ༅ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ni/ 〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 na/ /༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉te/༅ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ni/ ༅ 〈〈pe 〉〉srid pag〈〈snar 〉〉sred pag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 pag ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nga de dag tsha 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—la myong ba rgyu mthun/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyes—pa / kyi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gyed/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba'o/331 ༅ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byas pa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tra'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 rgyas pa/ ④ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/༅ 〈〈snar 〉〉bdag ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sogs/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gnyi gar/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉 〈snar 〉〉par dang po/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 du/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'o/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ja/ khya〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 pa/⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ /mi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las/ khya 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lnga/332 7〈〈pe 〉〉par mdzag〈〈snar 〉〉par mdzod/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bug ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 kyi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉1—340

0038 ༄/ /dgon mchog gsum gyi bstod pa/༅༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ tri ratna sto ltu // bod skad du/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bstod pa/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dmigs med chos kyi sku/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /cir yang sprul sku la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam dag chos kyi dbyings/ /sgrub pa'i 'phags lam brgyad/ /bstan pa'i gsung rab la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems rnams dang / /dgra bcom dag la sogs/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bstod pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //1—344
bsdur mchan/ 344 ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung lasablangasate bkod go /②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tra/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ston/bsdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/(38) 1wa 345

༷ 9 ༄/ /brgya lnga bcu pa zhes bya ba'i bstod pa/ ༅ ༄tsho༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ sha ta pañtsa ⑤sha ti ga nā ma su sto tra/ bod skad du / brgya lnga bcu pa zhes bya ba'i bstod pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo / /gang zhig la ni nyes pa kun/ /gtan nas yong ye mi mnga' zhing / /gang la'ang rnam pa thams cad du/ /yon tan thams cad gnas gyur pa/ /gal te sems shig yod na ni/ /de nyid la ni skyabs 'gro zhing / /de bstod de ni bkur ba dang / /de yi bstan la gnas pa'i rigs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan kun / /mnga' la de yang nyam (mimi mnga'/ /nyes pa bag chags bcas de yang / /skyob pa gcig pu la mi mnga'/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sku dang ni/ /gsung dang thugs kyi phrin las la/ /zhe 'gras gyur pa gang gis kyang / /chos dang ldan par glags mi rnyed/ /rgya mtshor gnya' shing bu ga ru/ /rus sbal mgrin pa chud pa ltar / /dam chos dga' ston cher bcas pa'i/ /mi nyid bdag gis thob nas 1—346

ni / /mi rtag nyid dang rjes 'brel zhing / /las kyi glags la dogs bcas pa/ /bdag gi lce 'di nyid kyis go/ /snying po ci phyir blang mi bya/ /de ltar thub pa'i yon tan gyi/ /yul lta grangs med shes mod kyi/ /rang gi don la gus pa yis /de yi phyogs gcig bsgrims te brjod/ /gang gi yon tan grangs dag dang / /mthu la thug pa ma mchis la/ /rmad byung phrin las dpag med can/ /rang byung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di snyed bgyi ba'i mtha' med na/ /'di ltar lags zhes ci zhig smos/ /khyod kyi yon tan slad du bdag /bsod nams snyam nas spyi brtol skyes/ /bstod pa gleng bslang ba ste le'u dang po'o// //spyod dam mi spyod snyam pa yi/ /rnam par rtog pa rnam spangs nas/ /'gro ba 'di ni nyam thag ces/ /khyod bdag nyid kyis zhal gyis bzhes/ /khyod ni ma bcol legs mdzad pa/ /khyod ni rgyu med bzhin du byams/ /khyod ni ma 'dris ①mdza' bshes te/ /'brel pa med pa'i gnyen 'dun lags/ /nyid kyi sha yang stsol mdzad na/ /dngos po gzhan lta smos ci 'tshal/ /legs mdzad khyed kyis srog kyang ni/ /slong ba'i skye bo rnams la btang / /nyid kyi sku dang srog dag gis / /lus can gshed mas zin rnams kyi/ /lus dang srog kyang khyod kyis ni/ /lan brgya phrag tu bslu ༅ba mdzad/ /ngan 'gros bsnyengs slad ma lags la/ /bzhed pa'i 'gro ba'ang sgrub ma lags/ /dgongs pa dag pa 'ba' zhig gis/ /khyod kyis tshul khrims goms par mdzad/ /rtag tu gya gyu rnam khyaspangs shing / /drang brtan ④rnams ni rtag bsten pas/ /yongs su dag pa'i las rnams kyis/ /yo ni gzhi rten gcig pur gyur/ /sdug bsngal mang pos gzir ba na/ /yo 1—347

kyis dge ba'i thugs kyis ni/ /nyon mongs rnams la sran btsugs nas/ /skye bo nyon mongs can la brtse/ /khyod kyis gzhan gyi don slad du/ /sku srog btang nas dgyes gyur gang / /de 'dra srog chags 'gums khyapa las/ /sos ⑤pa rnams la'ang byung ④ma gyur/ /khyod ni lan 'ga' ma lags par/ /gtubs kyang sdug bsngal mi dgongs par/ /gshed ④ ma bgyid pa'i sems can la'ang / /gtso bo thugs rjer gyur pa gang / /khyod kyi thugs ni rin po che/ /rdzogs pa'i byang sa sa bon te/ /dpa' khyod kho nas snying por mkhyen/ /de gzhan skyebos 'ol mi mchi / /dka' spyad las ni ma bgyis par/ /go 'phang rnyed dka' mi 'thob ces / /de slad nyid la'ang ma gzigs par/ /khyod kyi brtson 'grus legs par spel / /khyad par 'phags par bgyi ba la/ /khyod la thang lhod 'ga' ma byung / /de slad khyod kyi khyad par rnams/ /thog drung rim pa dbyer ma mchis/ /thugs ni thugs rje chen po dang / /rtag tu rjes su ༅la slad du/ /ting 'dzin ༅sa bur bcas pa yi/ /shin tu bde la'ang yo ma chags/ /gzhan dang thun mong ma lags pa'i/ /bde ba gang de gya nom yang / /dam pa'i spyod ldan khyod 'dra la/ /gnod par bas kyi sman ma mchis/ /'dres pa las ni legs bshad nyid/ /snying po skyon med nyi tshe zhig /khyod kyis kun bzhes thugs la bzhag /nyes bshad dug bzhin yongs su spangs/ /rin chen snying po mayo khyod kyis/ /legs bshad srog gis 'jal ba na/ /skyeb de dang de dag tu/ /byang ba slad du dpa' rtsal bstan/ /de slad grangs med gsum dag tu/ /nga ni de ltar brtson pa na/ /brtson 'grus 'ba' zhig grogs gyur pas/ /go 'phang bla na med pa brnyes/ /rgyu la bstod pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o// //1—348

mtho la phrag dog mi mdzad cing / /dma' la rngan can 1mi mdzad la/ /mnyam la 'gran pa mi mnga' bas/ /khyod ni 'jig rten gtso bor gyur/ /khyod ni yon tan rgyu rnams la/ /mngon bgyis 'bras bu rnams la min/ /yang dag sgrub pa de nyid kyis/ /khyod kyi yon tan pha mthar phyin/ /ji ltar khyod kyi zhabs rdul yang —/ /bsod nams skye ba mched 'gyur ba/ /de ltar khyod kyis legs spyad pas / /bdag nyid rab tu bskrun pa mdzad/ /nyes pa nyams smad rtsa nas bton/ /yon tan spel nas rnam par sbyangs/ /gzhung lugs bzang po des na khyod—/ /grub mchog lhag par brnyes pa lags/ /ji ltar bdag gi rgyud la de/ /bag chags lhag ma'ang ma lus pa/ /de ltar rnam pa thams cad du/ /nyes pa khyod kyis rab tu bcom/ /ji ltar gzhan la de dag dang / /'dra ba tsam yang mi gda' ba/ /de ltar khyod kyis bsags bsags nas/ /bdag nyid la ni yon tan bsgrubs/ /'jig rten pa yi dpe dngos kun/ /gegs bgyid pa dang sgrib pa can/ /re zhig pa dang nyi tshe ba/ /shin tu rnyed par sra /nab lags/ /khyod kyis yon tan bla med la/ /gegs bgyid ma mchis rtogs ma mchis/ /brtan pa dang ni rgyun chags pas/ /dpe lta mchis par ga la 'gyur/ /gang tshe khyod kyi dgongs pa'i dkyil( / /gting dang pha rol med brtags na/ /rgya mtsho zab pa nyid kyang ni/ /gnag rjes lta bur sa ler gda'/ /chos rnams kun gyis mi bskyod pa/ /khyod kyi brtan pa mngon bsams na/ /sa yi brtan pa nyid kyang ni/ /shir sha'i ge sar rtse ltar chung / /thub pa khyod kyi ye shes kyi/ /snang bas mi shes rab rib dag /'joms pa'i thad na nyi ma yang / /me khyer tsam du'ang mi spyod 1—349

do / /khyod kyi gsung thugs mdzad spyod rnams/ /dag pa'i gan na ston zla dang //chu dang nam mkha'i dag pa rnams/ /dri ma can ni lta bur gda'/ /'jig rten legs pa gang ci'ang rung / /thams cad bsngos na'ang der bas te/ /nyon mongs 'jig rten chos rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas chos la khyad mi khor/ /rin chen chos gang brnyes nas khyod/ /mchog tu gyur pa de nyid dang / /khyad ①du bsgrun zhing de dang ni/ /khyod dang bsgrun ldom kho nar bag /gang la spyi tsam bstun nas ni/ /cung zad brjod par bgyid pa de/ /zob po yi rang dga' dang —/ /thabs dang gcam bu tsam du bas/ /dpe med pa la bstod pa ste le'u gsum pa'o// //khyod ni bdud las rnam rgyal te/ /'gro kun dad par mdzad pa yang / /bdag gis chos nyid rjes bsams na/ /chen po ltar gang ma mthong ngo / /sdang bas rgol bar rtsol byed pa/ /mang po'ang gzhom par bya ba ni/ /khyad par gnas la brten pa yi/ /bzod pa'i tshegs su mtshar mi che/ /gang tshe bdud rnams mngon btul ba/ /de yi nub mo kho na la/ /nyon mongs shin tu che spangs pa/ /de nyid rmad du byung ba lags/ /'od zer phreng ba stong ldan pa'i/ /nyi mas mun bsal gang lags dang / /dpa' bo khyod kyis mu stegs las/ /rgyal bar mdzad pa ci zhig mtshar/ /'dod chags bral bas chags bcas dang / /zhe sdang bral bas zhe sdang can/ /gti mug bral bas rmongs pa ste/ /gsum pos rtag tu gsum dag btul/ /dam chos rab tu bstod pa dang / /dam chos ma lags smod ② mdzad kyang / /dam pa dag dang tha ma la/ /khyod ni chags dang khro mi mnga'/ /1—350

dgra bcom pa dang mu stegs la/ /rjes su chags dang khong khro bar/ /khyod kyi thugs ni mi 'gyur na/ /khyed la bstod du ci zhig mchis/ /yon tan rnams la'ang ma chags la/ /yon tan can la'ang bzhed mi mnga'/ /kye ma'o khyod kyi thugs stobs ni/ /rab dang yongs su dag pa lags/ /dbang po rnams ni rab dang ba/ /dus rnams rtag tu mi nyams pas/ /khyod thugs rtag tu dang ba dag /mngon sum gyur pa bzhin du gda'/ /rang bzhin dam pa legs gsungs dang / /mdzad spyod bzang pos bsgrags pas na/ /khyod kyi blo gros dgongs pa dag /rnam dag byis pa'i bar la grags/ /rmad du byung ba'i bstod pa ste le'u bzhi pa'o// //nye bar zhi la yid du 'ong / /'bar la gnod pa mdzad mi mnga'/ /dul la rngom brjid che ba yis/ /sku 'dis su zhig dad mi mdzad/ /khyod kyi sku de gang gis na tu/ /lan brgyar mthong dang gang zhig gis/ /dang por mthong ba de gnyis ga /'dra bar mig ni mgu bar mdzad/ /khyod kyi sku ni mdzes pa'i phyir/ /blta bas mi ngoms rang bzhin pas/ /mthong ngo cog ni phyi phyir zhing / /dga' ba bskyed par mdzad pa lags/ /rten gyi yon tan dag dang ni/ /brten gro pa'i yon tan phan tshun du/ /'tsham pas khyod kyi sku dang ni/ /yon tan phun tshogs mchog dang ldan/ /mtshan dang dpe byad bzang 'bar ba/ /khyod kyi sku las ma gtogs pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan 'di/ /gzhan gang zhig la legs gnas 'gyur/ /khyod sku rten pa'i yon tan la/ /nga dpal che zhes gsung gsung ltar/ /de yi yon tan rnams kyang slar/ /nges legs bkod 1/de351

ces gsungs pa ①'dra/ /sku la bstod pa ste le'u lnga pa'o// //'gro ba 'di dag thams cad ni/ /khyad༅ med nyon mongs rnams kyis bcings/ /khyod ni 'gro ba'i nyon mongs dag /dgrol slad yun ring thugs rjes bsdams/ /dang por khyod la phyag bgyi'am/ /'on te gang gis 'khor bar khyod//skyon mkhyen yun ring de lta bur/ /bzhugs mdzad thugs rje che la bgyi/ /dben pa'i bde ba spang gyur khyod/ /mang po'i nang du bzhugs pa gang / /de khyod thugs rjes dus 'das pa/ /glags shig thod nas bgyis par bas/ /rig pa yis ni mtsho nang nas/ /klu bzhin khyod kyi thugs rje yis/ /dgon pa 1zhi gnas grong gi mthar/ /gdul ba'i don gyi slad du drangs/ /nyer zhi mchog la gnas bzhin du/ /thugs rje gtso dang ldan pas na/ /rol mo mkhan gyi sgyu rtsal yang / /khyod kyi zhabs kyi 'dor bar mdzad/ /rdzu 'phrul seng ge'i sgra dang ni/ /nyid kyi yon tan brjod pa gang / /de ni bzhed spyod mi mnga' ba/ /khyod kyi thugs rjes bstan pa lags/ /gzhan gyi don du rab bzang gi/ /nyid kyi don la brtse med pas / /mgon po khyod nyid 'ba' zhig la/ /thugs rjes thugs rje mdzad ma gyur / /'di ltar res 'ga' brtan pas gang / /gzhan don bsgrub pa mdzad slad du/ /khyod ni lan brgyar phyogs dag tu/ /gtor ma bzhin du btang ba lags/ /de ltar khyod la gnod mdzad kyang / /nongs pa can du mi rtsi bas/ /khyod kyi bzhed pa kho na dang / /mthun 'jug pa ni lags par gda'/ /thugs la bstod pa ste le'u drug pa'o// //1—352

tshig bzang ba dang don che dang / /bden pa dang ni snyan pa dang / /zab gsal gnyis sha'i don ldan dang / /bsdus dang spros pa dang ldan pa/ /khyod kyi gsung ni de lta bu/ /khyod kyi dgra bos thos na yang / /thams cad mkhyen pa lags so zhes/ /su zhig nges pa skye mi 'gyur/ /mang po ril gyis snyan pa 1nya lags/ /bcos ma 'ga' tsam snyan pa lags/ /khyod kyi gsung don grub pas kyang —/ /thams cad legs gsungs kho na lags/ /khyod kyi gsung ni rnam brtags na/ /gang zhig 'jam dang rtsub pa dang / /gang yang de gnyis ldan pa dag /thams cad ro gcig nyid du 'gyur/ /e ma'o shin tu yongs dag pa'i/ /phrin las rnams kyang rab tu bzo/ /de yis rin chen gsung rnams kyi/ /snod 'di 'dra ba 'di bgyis so/ /khyod zhal blta na rab sdug pa/ /de las mnyan na snyan pa yi/ /gsung 'di dag ni zla ba las/ /bdud rtsi 'dzag pa bzhin du gda'/ /khyod kyi gsung ni 'dod chags kyi/ /rdul rab zhi mdzad char sprin 'dra / /zhe sdang sbrul ni gdon pa'i phyir/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dra ba lags/ /yang dang yang du mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib 'joms pas gdugs dang 'dra/ /nga rgyal ri bo mngon 'joms pas/ /brgya byin mtshon cha 'dra ba lags/ /don gzigs pas mi slu tshub/ /nongs mi mnga' phyir rjes su mthun/ /legs par sbyar bas go sla ste/ /khyod kyi gsung ni legs gsum ldan/ /re zhig dang por khyod kyi gsung / /nyan pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog mdzad/ /de nas yid la bsam bgyis na/ /rdul dang mun pa dag kyang sel/ /phongs pa rnams kyi dbugs 'byin cing / /bag med rnams ni skrag par mdzad/ /bde ba can dag skyo bgyid pas—/ /khyod gsung kun dang 'tsham par 'jug /mkhas pa rnams kyi dga' ba 1—353

byed①/ /bar ma rnams kyi blo yang spel/ /tha ma'i rab rib rnam 'joms pas /gsung 'di skyebo kun la sman/ /lta ba dag las dgar mdzad cing / /mya ngan 'das par nye bar 'dren/ /nyes pa sel mdzad khyod kyi gsung / /yon tan rnams kyi char yang 'bebs/ /kun la ma thogs thugs mnga' zhing / /dgongs pa'ang kun du nyer gnas pas/ /de slad khyod kyis lung bstan kun/ /thams cad la yang slu ②mi mnga'/ /gang slad yul min dus min dang / /snod min rnams su mi 'jug pa/ /de slad khyod gsung don mchis te/ /brtson 'grus legs par brtsams ⑤pa bzhin/ /gsung la bstod pa ste le'u bdun pa'o// //bgrod pa gcig dang thabs bde dang / /legs par 'brel dang nyes pa med / /thog ma bar dang mthar dge bas/ /khyod kyi bstan 'dra gzhan la med/ /khyod kyi gzhung lugs de lta bu/ /gcig pu phangs la lta chags pas/ /byis pa gal te smod bgyid na/ /lta dang 'dra ba'i dgra ma mchis/ /gzhan ni 'gro ba'i don slad du/ /skug ④bsngal mang bstar gang lags pa/ /de bsams khyod bstan ngan na yang / /gnas par bgyi ba la thug na/ /phan pa gsung zhing phan mdzad pa / /khyod kyi bstan pa ci smos te/ /mgo la zhugs ni 'bar bas kyang / /ci yi slad du sgrub mi bgyid/ /khyed kyi bstan pas rang dbang dang / /byang chub bde dang zhi ba dang / /khyod kyi yon tan bsngags pa dang / /legs pa bzhi po 'di kun thob⑤/ /dpa' bo khyod kyi bstan pa 'di/ /mu stegs thams cad skrag mdzad la/ /bdud ni sems khong chud mdzad cing / /lha dang mi rnams dbugs kyang 'byin/ /'chi bdag bstan pa khams gsum gyi/ /sa chen dag na spyod 1—354

bgyid pa/ /mi thogs bzlog ༅pa ma mchis pa'ang / /khyod kyi bstan pas zil gyis mnan④/ khyod kyi bstan pa'i lugs 'tshal ba/ /dga' na bskal par yang gnas la/ /gang du bdud kyis mi rdzi / ba/ /der yang dga' mgur rab tu mchi / /lung gi don ni bsam pa dang / /bsgom dang gus par mnyan pa yi/ /dus gsum cha dbye khyod kyi ni/ /bstan las gzhan la mchis ma lags/ /drang srong skyes mchog khyod kyi bstan/ /de ltar legs pas khyab 'di la/ /ma gus gang lags de las ni/ /sdug bsngal chen po'ang ci zhig mchis/ /bstan pa la bstod pa ste le'u brgyad pa'o// //khyod thos pas ni spro ba skye /mthong bas dad pa skye bar 'gyur/ /khyod gsung thos pas dga' 'gyur te/ /bstan pas rnam par grol bar mdzad/ /khyod kyi sras kyis mgu bar 'gyur/ /'phel bas skyedagu rnams kyang dga'/ /gshegs pa na ni phan 'dogs mdzad/ /ldog pa na ni rgud par 'gyur/ /bsgrags pas sdig pa 'phrog par mdzad/ /khyod dran pas ni rangs par 'gyur/ /btsal bas blo gros skyo'agyur te/ /yongs su shes pas rnam par 'dag /khyod la bsu bas dpal du byed/ /bsten pas blo gros mchog tu 'gyur/ /bsten na 'jigs pa med par mdzad/ /bsnyen bkur bgyis pas bde bar 'gyur/ /tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pas dag /bsam gtan phun sum tshogs pas dang / /shes rab phun tshogs mi 'khrugs pas/ /khyod ni bsod nams mtsho chen lags/ /khyod sku bltar /'os rin chen te/ /legs gsungs mnyan 'os rin chen lags/ /chos ni spyad 'os rin chen pas/ /khyod ni rin chen 'byung gnas lags/ /khyod 1/de355

ni chu bos bdas ①pa'i gling / /smas pa'i bdag nyid skyob pa ste/ /srid pa'i 'jigs pas nyen pa'i skyabs/ /thar 'tshal rnams kyi 'dren pa lags/ /tshul khrims dag phyir snod kyi mchog /zhing gshin 'bras bu phun sum tshogs/ /srog chags kun la phan mdzad phyir/ /grogs kyi phul yang khyod lags so/ /phan 'dogs mdzad pas mdza' bshes te/ /'grogs na bde phyir snying du sdug /zhi phyir gcig tu yid du 'ong / /yon tan kun mnga' mchod 'os khyod/ /sdig pa med pas yid dang 'thad/ /sku gsung bzang bas dga' bar mdzad/ /don kun 'grub phyir dpal yangs te/ /yon tan legs rten bkra shis lags/ /smon lam la bstod pa ste le'u dgu pa'o// //khyod ni rngan gyethen bgyid la skul/ /chom rkun bgyid pa tshar yang gcod/ /gya gyu can rnams rnal du 'god/ /dal bus bgyid la gzhen skul 'debs/ /dul ba rnams ni lam la sbyor/ /dmu rgod rnams la btang snyoms mdzad/ /de slad skyes bu 'dul ba yi/ /kha lo sgyur ba bla med mchog /khyod ni nyam thag rnams la brtse/ /bde bar gnas la phan par dgyes/ /phongs par gnas la thugs rje bas/ /kun la phan par bzhed pa lags/ /khyod ni dgra bo rnams la'ang byams/ /nyams par gyur la phan 'dogs mdzad/ /gtum po rnams la thugs brtse bas/ /khyod ni ya rabs rmad cig lags/ /phan 'dogs bgyid slad pha ma dag /gal te bla mar 'tshal na go/ /khyod ni lhag par phan 'dogs pas / /bla ma nyid gyur smos ci 'tshal/ /rang gi don la mi lta bas/ /nyid kyi dgra bo ltar gyur cing / /g.yang sa'i mun na gnas rnams la/ /ra ba lta bur 1—356

gyur pa'ang khyod/ /'jig rten gnyis shar sman gdags dang / /'jig rten las ni 'da' slad du/ /mun par gyur pa'i 'jig rten la/ /khyod kyis shes rab snang bar mdzad/ /yul la nye bar spyod pa na/ /lha mi'i spyod pa tha dad kyang / /chos kyi longs spyod thun mong bas/ /khyod la dbye ba mi mnga'o/ /bcom ldan khyod kyis skyeb dang / /na tshod rigs dang yul dang ni/ /dus kyi skyon med chos rnams kyis/ /'di dag kun la sman yon btags/ /khyod kyi nyan thos srid bral zhing / /ya mtshan 'dzin pa med rnams la'ang / /lha rnams thal sbyar smon bgyid cing / /ya mtshan che ba lta bur mchod/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas 'khor ba yi//nying gur ༅gyur pa byung ba brjid/ /des ni ⑤mi yang lha rnams kyis/ /smon par bya ba nyid du gyur/ /lam la 'jug pa la bstod pa ste le'u bcu pa'o// //mnyel dang zhe ༅bde nyams gyur dang / /skye bo ngan dang 'grogs pa dang / /mi mthun pa dang mang po yi/ /skyon yang yon tan bzhin dgongs shing / /'gro ba'i don slad ma chags pa'i/ /thugs kyis brtson pa gang mdzad pa④/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi/ /chos nyid bcom ldan de rmad do/ /bshos kyang phal pa gsol mdzad cing / /res 'ga' smyung ⑤ba dag kyang mdzad/ /nyam nga'i shul du'ang gshegs mdzad cing / /rad rod can du'ang mnal ba mdzad/ /mgon khyod gtso bor gyur lags kyang / /gdul bya rnams la byams slad du/ /sku ngas brdo 0dang gcam tshul dang / /skad dang cha lugs sgyur ba'ang mdzad/ /kun gyis dga' mgur rang don phyir/ /bran bzhin bskor bar bsgrims pa las /mgon khyod rtag tu bdag nyid la/ /mnga' ma mchis pa'ang ma lags so/ /khyod 1/de357

la gang dang gang du yang / /ji skad bskul ba'ang mi spong ste/ /nyid kyi sgrub pa bzang po las/ /'da' bar 'gyur ba ma mchis so/ /ji ltar khyod ni gnod bgyid la/ /phan pa lhur mdzad de lta bur/ /skyebo dag ni phan bgyid la'ang / /phan pa de ltar lhur mi bgyid/ /khyod ni gnod bgyid dgra bo la/ /phan pa mdzad pa'i bshes lags te/ /rtag tu skyon dag tshol ba la/ /yon tan 'ba' zhig tshol ba lags/ /khyod ni gang na dug bcas shing / /zhugs dang bcas par spyan drangs pa/ /der ni brtser bcas gshegs pa dang / /nga la bdud rtsi can du gyur/ /bzod pas mi snyan brjod pa dang / /'khu ba dag ni bde legs kyis//mi snyan smra la bden pas te/ /khyod kyis sdang ba byams pas btul/ /thog ma med dus goms pa yisargya / /mi yi rang bzhin mang po yang / /khyod kyis ngan song rnam bzlog nas/ /skad cig nyid la yongs su bsgyur④/ /dka' ba mdzad pa la bstod pa ste le'u bcu gcig pa'o// //rtsub pa ngang 'jam bgyis pa dang / /'jungs pa rnams ni gtong phod dang —/ /gtum pa des par bgyis da pa gang / /de ni khyod kyi thabs mkhas lags/ /dga' bo'i dbang po nyer zhi dang / /nga rgyal khengs pa 'dud pa dang //sor mo'i phreng ba'ang zhi bgyis na/ /su zhig ngo mtshar babyed mi bgyid/ /khyod kyi chos kyi ros chim pas/ /gser las bgyis pa'i mal spangs nas/ /ran mang bting ba'i gnas mal du/ /brten ④/rnams bsod nyams nyal bar bgyid/ /khyod kyis dus dang bsam mkhyen pas/ /res 'ga' zhus na'ang mi gsung la/ /spros gyur gzhan la bstan pa dang / /drung du gshegs nas bshad pa'ang mdzad/ /1—358

dri med gos la tshon bzhin du/ /thog mar sbyin sogs gtam dag gis/ /sems la spro ba bskyed nas ni/ /phyi nas chos ni bstan pa mdzad/ /'khor ba mi bzad gting nas ni/ /'gro ba nyon mongs drang slad du/ /khyod kyis gang zhig ma stsal ba'i / /thabs dang spyod pa de ma mchis/ /sku yi cha lugs rnam mang dang / /gsung gis so so'i skad bzhin du/ /gdul bya'i bsam pa tha dad pa/ /de dang der ni khyod kyis mdzad/ /de dag kun kyang dag pa dang / /mi 'gal ba dang mchod 'os dang / /brjid dang lha mi rnams la ni/ /sman 'dogs bkur ba sha stag lags/ /smra dang bgyid pa phal cher ni/ /legs par rngo thogs ha)ma lags kyi / /bden par gsung ba khyod la ni/ /de gnyis gzhan du gda' ba lags/ /bdag nyid dag pa 'ba' zhig gis/ /khyod kyis 'gro ba'i dpal zhing mdzad/ /'di ltar rnam pa 'di 'dra'i zhing / /'jig rten gsum na mchis ma lags/ /thog med srid pa nyam nga bar/ /snga nas gcig tu nyams pa yi sems can kun la sman slad du/ /khyod ni de ltar brtson pa lags/ /mkhas pa la bstod pa ste le'u bcu gnyis pa'o// //gang gis khyod drin lan lon pa'i/ /sgrub de mchis snyam mi bgyid de/ /skye bo gang dag mya ngan 'das/ /de dag gis kyang lan ma lon/ /khyod kyi chos la gnas de dag /rang don kho na bgyid par bas/ /de yi slad du 'o brgyal gang //de la lan go ci zhig lon/ /khyod ni sems can gnyid log pa'i/ /rgyud la gzigs pa'i zhugs tse ba/ /bag med gyur pa rnams kyi ni/ /grogs bzang bag dang bcas pa lags/ /khyod kyis nyon mongs gzhom pa bshad/ /bdud kyi g.yo 1/de359

dag bstan pa mdzad/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin mi bzad brjod/ /'jigs pa med pa'i phyogs kyang bstan/ /phan dgongs thugs rje can gyis ni/ /sems can rnams la bgyi 'tshal ba/ /gang zhig khrod kyis ma mdzad panyu/ /gzhan go ci zhig mchis lags kye/ /gal te chos ni 'di dag dang / /spo ba zhig tu btub na ni / /gdon mi 'tshal bar khyod kyis ni/ / lha sbyin la brten kun la'ang stsol/ /de slad 'gro la brda sprod pa/ /'gro ba'i mgon po khyod kyis ni/ /'di na phan tshun byed pa po/ /med pa skad du nges par gsungs/ /'jig rten rnams la thugs brtse bas/ /yun rings sa stengs rgya dam chos bshad/ /'jig rten gsum phan 'dogs nus pa'i/ /slob ma dam pa'ang mang du bskrun/ /mngon du gdul bya'i tshogs kyang ni/ /mdzes bzangs yan chad btul lags pas/ /da go ④khyod la sems can gyi/ /bu lon lhag ma ci mchis na/ /'di ltar rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gyis / /sku gdung til 'bru bzhin blags nas/ /mjug tu'ang khyod kyis shin tu ni / /dka' spyad yal bar ma dor ro/ /gzugs kyi sku dang chos 'di dag /gzhan don kho nar mdzad do zhes/ /'jig rten yid ches dka' 'di la/ /khyod kyis mya ngan 'das pa bstan/ /de slad chos sku ma lus pa/ /sras kyi mchog la gtad mdzad de/ /gzugs sku til 'bru ltar bshig nas/ /khyod ni yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /e ma'o gnas pa e ma'o tshul/ /e ma'o yon tan e ma'o sku/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni chos rnams la/ /ya mtshan mi che 'ga' ma mchis phan 'dogs mdzad cing blta na sdug /sku gsung phrin las zhi gyur pa/ /khyod la'ang sdang bar rab bgyid pa'i/ /rmongs pa mi bzad pa la gzigs/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho rin chen gter/ /yon tan 'byung gnas chos kyi tshogs/ /khyod la 1/de360

sems can gang 'dud pa/ /de dag la yang phyag 'tshal legs gro / /mgon khyod yon tan mi bas kyang / /bdag gi zho sha bas 'tshal bas/ /des na 'jigs pa mchis slad du/ /glo ba la ni bcags ༅bzhin mchis/ /khyod kyi rang gi ngo bo nyid / /tshad ma mchis la bsam mi khyab/ /bstan min grangs kyang ma mchis pa/ /khyod bdag nyid kyis mkhyen lags grang / /mtsho chen chab du /ni bas par ma gyur kyang —/ /skye bo'i gdung ba rab tu zhi bgyid ltar/ /khyod kyi yon tan cha tsam ma bsgrags /3kyang / /bdag ni mchog tu glo ba dga' zhing mchis/ /bdag gis thub la dad pas spobs skyes pa'i/ /dge ba'i las 'di'i 'bras bu 'khrungs pa yis / /ngan rtog rlung dmar 'tshubs pas dkrugs pa yi/ /'gro ba'i sems ni rnal du gnas par shog /bu lon med par bstod pa ste le'u bcu gsum pa'o // //brgya lnga bcu pa'i bstod pa slob dpon mkhas pa chen po bram ze rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrīshraddhā ga ra wasmo dang / lo tsā ba shākya blo gros kyis khya bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o // //1—361

bsdur mchan/346 ①mang byang 'de gzhung las sa te bang cingaka〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brgya lnga bcu pa zhesabya bzamaze dbyangasakyis mdzad pa bzhugag 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pam ②〈〈snar 〉〉nyamag347 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉drin/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉blu/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〈snar 〉〉rnamag ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bam/348 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gum/ ⑤〈pe 〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsog ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'a༅/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉bshed/349 ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sga khya 〈〈snar 〉〉dbye ga350 ༅/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nga/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉〉/351 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉ni/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rten/352 ༅〈〈pe 〉〉gsung pa/〈〈snar 〉〉gsung ba/ 'u/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉yo/ ⑤〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉pa'i/353 ༅〈〈pe 〉〉gyis snyan ga〈〈snar 〉〉gyi snyan ma/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na mi baspu354 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba / ⑤〈pe 〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsga ①〈〈pe 〉〉bas bag ④〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdug ⑤〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'thob/355 /〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zlog ⑤〈〈pe 〉〈snar 〉gnan/ khya〈〈snar 〉〉bgi rgya 〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar/356 nyu〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'dag ⑤〈〈pe 〉rnga/357 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉khur/ khru 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zhi/ ④〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtsod pa mang pa gang ༅ pe 〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsnyung / 4 〈〈snar 〉〉rdo/358 ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉sgyur/ ༅〈〈snar 〉〉nges par bgyig ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma/359 khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thog360 khya〈〈pe 〉〉'a༅ pa/〈snar 〉〉'a༅ ba/ ⑤ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lhas nga/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉steng ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉de ko361 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lagag ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gcagag ①〈〈snar 〉〉65༄ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sgragagakhru/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/1—362
bsdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/(39)1wa 363

0040༄༅/ /brgya lnga bcu pa zhes bya ba'i bstod pa'i 'grel pa//༅ ༄7ste/ /rgya gar skad du/ sha ta pañtsa sha ti ga nā ma pya sto tra ṭī ga /bod skad du/ brgya lnga bcu pa zhes bya ba'i bstod pa'i 'grel pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spel mar bstod pa phyogs glang pos/ /zab mo nye bar bshad pa ni/ /brgya ni lnga bcu pa yi don/ /rmad byung de las rnam shes nas/ /rgyal ba la ni gus pa yi/ /dga' byed snyan pa'i dge slong gis/ /de yi phyogs la dad pa yis / /rnam par dbye ba rab tu bya/ /de la 'dir brgya lnga bcu pa'i bstod pa re zhig dang por gleng bslang ④ba dang / rgyu dang 'bras bu dang / sman 'dogs pa'i sgo nas bstod pa dang / bcu gsum du rab tu bstan pa ni 'di lta ste / gleng bslang ba'i bstod pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi rgyu thun mong ma yin pa'i phyir gcig tu byas nas rgyu la bstod pa'o/ /'bras bu la bstod pa ni dpe med pa la sogs pa'i dbye bas rnam pa gsam ste/ dpe med pa la bstod pa ༄1—364

dang —/ rmad du byung ba la bstod pa dang / sku la bstod pa zhes bya ba'o/ /sman 'dogs pa'i bstod pa ni snying rje la sogs pa'i dbye bas rnam pa brgyad de/ thugs rje la bstod pa dang / gsung la bstod pa dang / bstan pa la bstod pa dang / smon lam la bstod pa dang / lam la 'jug pa la bstod pa dang /dka' ba mdzad pa la bstod pa dang / mkhas par bstod pa dang / bu lon med pa la bstod pa zhes bya'o/ /de rnams kyi bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dag ni/gleng bslang bstod dang rgyu la ni/ /rnam drug 'bras bu dpe med dang / /rmad du byung dang de bzhin sku/ /sman 'dogs rnam brgyad de yang ni/ /thugs rje gsung dang bstan pa dang / /smon lam dang ni lam 'jug dang / /dka' mdzad nyid dang mkhas pa dang / /bu lon med dang bcu gsum mo/ /bstod pa bcu gsum po de rnams kyi re re'i bshad pa yongs su rdzogs pa ni phyis bshad par bya'o/ /de la gleng bslang ba zhes bya ba ni dang por brtsam pa'o/ /gleng bslang ba der don gang dang gang gis bshad pa zhes bya ba bstan pa dang / rgyu la bstod pa la sogs pa rnams la yang tshigs su bcad pa gang gis don gang bshad pa de yang rab tu bshad par bya'o/ /re zhig gleng bslang ba'i bstod pa'i tshig gi don ni de bzhin gshegs pa la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa'i mchod 'os nyid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyu nyid dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyes pa ma lus pa zad pa rjes su dpag pa dang / yon tan ma lus pa mi shes pas kyang bcom ldan 'das la yon tan gyi phyogs gcig tsam gyis bstod pa dang phyag 'tshal ba'i yon tan gyi phyogs ༅ tsam bshad pa zhes bya'o / /'dir yang bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ni/ /ston la skyabs 'gro sogs mchod 'os/ /nyes pa med pa rjes su dpag /yon 1—365

tan mtha' yas kyang ni chas/ /bstod pa 'dir ni phyag 'tshal phyogs/ /de la gang la'ang rnam pa thams cad du zhes bya ba rgyas par bshad pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad pa gnyis brtsam par bya ste/ gang zhig la ni nyes pa kun/ /gtan nas yong ye mi mnga' zhing / /gang la'ang rnam pa thams cad du/ /yon tan thams cad gnas gyur pa/ /gal te sems shig yod na ni/ /de nyid la ni skyabs 'gro zhing / /de bstod de ni bkur ba dang / /de yi bstan la gnas pa'i rigs/ /gang zhig la ni nyes pa kun/ /zhes smos pa la/ de nyid la ni skyabs su 'gro ba'i rigs zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshig dang sbyar ro/ /gang zhig ces bya ba ni thun mong gi sgra yin yang don gyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kho na la 'jug go/ /gang gi phyir nyes pa thams cad zad pa dang yon tan ma lus pa dang ldan pa ni gzhan med pa de'i phyir 'di ltar bshad de/ thams cad mkhyen la yon tan kun//mnga' la de yang nyams mi mnga'/ /nyes pa bag chags bcas gyede yang / /skyob pa gcig pu la mi mnga'/ /zhes bya'o/ /nyes pa zhes bya ba ni 'dod chags la sogs pa ste/ nyes pa byed pa zhes bya ba'i phyir ro/ /yang na lus dang ngag dang yid kyi rgyud la nyes pa byed pa ni snod ma yin par byed pa zhes bya bas na nyes pa'o/ /mi mnga' zhes bya ba ni mi mnga' ba ste/ skyon du gyur pa ma brnyes pa'i phyir ro/ /yong ye zhes bya ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyi spangs pa phun sum tshogs pas ngo mtshar ba gsal bar byed pa'o/ /yang na tshig kha bskang ba'i phyir tshig gi phrad do/ /gang zhig la nyes pa mi mnga' ba de skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa'i mchod 'os pa zhes bya'o/ /phyi rol gyi 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / slob pa rnams la nyes pa med pa'i phyir skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa'i mchod 'os su thal bar 'gyur zhes 1—366

pas na/ de bsal khyabar bya ba'i phyir 'di ⑤bshad de/ thams cad ces bya ba ni ma lus pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /gal te phyi rol gyi 'dod chags dang bral ba de rnams kyi nyes pa med na yang de bzhin du srid pa'i rtse mo'i nyes pa nges par ma spangs pa'i phyir dang / slob pa po rnams kyi yang ji lta bar sbyor bas khams gsum dang —/ gnyis dang gcig gi thob pa'i bsgom pas spang bar tshubya ba rnams ma spangs pa'i phyir ro/ /dgra bcom pa rnams la yang khams gsum gyi nyes pa med na de rnams kyang skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa'i mchod 'os su thal bar 'gyur zhes pas na bshad pa/ gtan nas zhes bya ba ni dus thams cad du'o zhes bya ba'o/ /don gang yin zhe na/ gal te dgra bcom pa rnams la yang nyes pa thams cad med mod kyi gtan nas med pa ni ma yin te/ yongs su spangs pa'i dus su yod pa dang ༷/ dgra bcom pa rnams kyis yongs su ma spangs pa'i chos can yin pa'i phyir ro / /'o na rang sangs rgyas rnams la yang nyes pa thams cad gtan nas med pas de la yang skyabs su 'gro ba'i ④/mchod 'os su thal bar 'gyur ro zhes bya bas na de rnams las kyang khyad par du bya ba'i phyir bshad pa/ rnam pa thams cad ces bya ba ni rnam pa thams cad kyis zhes bya ba'i don to/ /gang gi phyir de rnams kyis rnam pa thams cad du 'dod chags pa ༅la sogs pa spangs par ma gyur te/ de rnams kyis bag chags ma spangs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na de rnams kyang skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa'i mchod 'os ma yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das la yang nyes pa thams cad ni gtan nas rnam pa thams cad du mi mnga'o/ /de'i phyir na nyes pa ma lus pa shin tu mi mnga' ba'i slad du bcom ldan 'das khya kho na la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa'i mchod 'os pa yin no zhes bshad do/ /gang zhig la ni nyes 1—367

pa kun mi mnga'/ /zhes bya ba ni bshad pa'i go rims kyis latshigs su bcad pa 'di ltar gdon na rjes su mthun par mi 'gyur ro zhes pas na/ tshigs su bcad pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i phyir na gtan nas dang / rnam pa thams cad ces bya ba ni go rims su ༅/gdon pa'o/ /phyi rol gyi ri bo la sogs pa'i dngos po rnams la yang ①gtan nas rnam pa thams cad du nyes pa med na de rnams la yang skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa'i mchod 'os su thal bar 'gyur zhes pas na/ de dag dgag par bya ba'i phyir/ bshad pa thams cad nas rnam pa thams cad du zhes bya ba ni yon tan thams cad ④ces bya ba dang sbyar ro/ /yang yon tan thams cad gang zhe na / nyan thos dang thun mong du nyon mongs pa med pa dang smon lam gyi ye shes la sogs pa'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa rnams kyang ma 'dres pa dang / stobs dang /mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa'o/ /de rnams kyang chung ngu dang / 'bring la sogs pa'i dbye bas ni ma yin te/ 'on kyang chen po nyid la gnas pa zhes bya bas na bshad pa/ rnam pa thams cad ces bya ba ni khyad par thams cad kyis zhes bya ba'i don to/ /khyad par 'phags par bgyi ba la/ /khyod la thang lhod 'ga' ma byung //de slad khyod kyi khyad par rnams/ — /thog drung rim pa dbyer ma mchis/ /zhes pa gang 'chad par 'gyur ba'o/ /gang la zhes bya ba ni don gyis bcom ldan 'das kho na dang sbyar ro/ /'ang zhes bya ba'i sgra ni khyad par gyi rgyu gsal bar byed pa'o/ /nyes pa ma lus pa zad par gyur pa dang / yon tan gyi khyad par ma lus pa dang ldan pa'i phyir de nyid la ni skyabs su 'gro ba'i rigs so ⑤zhes bya ba ni rgyas pa'o/ /gnas gyur zhes bya ba ni yang dag par gnas pa ste/ bzhed pa tsam gyi phyir dang /mngon du gyur pa'i nus pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yon tan ni sngar bshad pa ste/1—368

nyes pa'i gnyen por bgrang zhing goms par byas na zhes bya ba'i phyir ro/ /bshad pa ni 'di yin te/ nyes pa med pa tsam gyis yon tan med pa khyaskyabs mi nus so//skyabs kyi don ni skyabs kyi don zhes bya ste grub pa'i mtha'o/ /ri bo la sogs pa de rnams kyang yon tan med pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ni nyes pa mi mnga' ba dang /yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /de bas na de nyid skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa'i mchod 'os pa yin gyi ri bo la sogs pa ni ma yin ⑤zhes bya'o/ /de nyid kyi phyir mang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ ri bo dag dang nags tshal dang / /skyed mos tshal dang shing drung dang / /mi rnams 'jigs pas bsdigs pa yi/ /skyabs 'gro 'di ni mchog ma yin/ /skyabs 'gro 'di ni dam pa min/ /de la skyabs su 'gro bas ni / /sdug bsngal kun las grol mi 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'o/ /gal te rnam pa thams cad du yon tan gnas par gyur pas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos la sogs pa rnams las khyad par du gyur pa'i phyir skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa'i mchod 'os pa yin na yang de bzhin du spangs pa phun sum tshogs pas kyang bcom ldan 'das bstod par 'gyur ro zhes bya bas na/gtan nas rnam pa thams cad du/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pas bshad do/ /de zhes bya ba ni sngar bshad pa'i nyes pa thams cad mi mnga' ba dang / yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa yang ngo / /nyid ces bya ba ni nges par gzung ba'o/ /nges par gzung ba gang yin pa ①na/ skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa'o / /de ltar gyur pa las gzhan pa ni skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa'i snod ma yin no zhes bya ba'o/ /skyabs 'gro zhing zhes bya ba ④ni skyabs khas blangs pa'i phyir ro / /skyabs kyi don niskyabs kyi don⑤/ /zhes sngar bshad de/ des ni yid kyi 1—369
