māng ༅khu mang ༅khu mang la khu mang khu sogs rnams kyis mi 'jigs lha dang mi yis phyag byas shākya seng ge khyod kyis srungs/ /gang gis bdud kyi chu 'dzin thogs pa'i lus kyis yongs su baspyings pa'i nga rgyal mtshan mo grol/ /bdud kyi lus can ma rnams kyi ni gdong gi padmo'i nags dpal mi mthun phyogs gcig pa/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub zla ba dang ni ston sha'i ku mu da bzhin yongs thob pa/ /de 'dir chos kyi pho nya sgogs pa chos kyi rgyal po bcom ldan 'das kyi gabhā'okyi// /bsod pa ma thob tshim med skad cig kyang ni rnam par dpyod pa'i mthar byed 'di la ring po nas/ /der ni sems rnams chud pas dus kun du ni rgyun mi 'chad par legs par spyod par byed pa yi/ /'dir ni dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bsgor zhugs pa yang yang srog chags rnams la slob pa gang yin pa/ 'di ni phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor du ni mi dman rab tu grags pa rtsub pa chos kyi gabhā'o / / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhin du skar ma'i tshogs las rnam rgyal bas/ /'bar te mu stegs skye bo dang ni rgyal ba'i bstan la 'dir/ /sa gzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi ni rgyan gyi snying po gabhā khya'adi/ /g.yul las rgyal ba'i cang te'u gtum po bzhin du grags pa'o / /gang yang khyod ni skrag pa ma yin dza mi dza mi ḍū zu ma ra nyi dza ra nyi dza sdo/ḍi na nā ḍi nā ḍi/ /ḍo ༅ban ḍim baṇa phyi ḍā dim 3ban ḍa saḍa zu zu zu bha /1nā ḍi bhan nā ḍi bhan tshu ḍam/ ra ṇa ḍi ruṇa rda yo/ru ru ṇa ḍi ya ra la ba kha kha paṃ chodzaḥkha paṃ rtakhaḥ kha paṃ ༅khaḥ/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i stobs kyis bdud kyi dpung rnams bcir la 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten pa yis ltos/ /sa gzhi rab tu g.yo ba'i g.yo ba las byung ri bo rab tu bskyod cing ri rab rgyal po g.yo/ /lha yi tshogs dang gdon gyi 'od zer dang ni klu yi rgyal po ma lus pa rnams skrag pa dang / /mu stegs rnams kyi gabhā snye 1—525

gtum po sna tshogs 'jigs par byed pa ①thos pas skrag pa dang / /sangs rgyas pa rnams kyi ni zhi ba zhi ba'i rgyur gyur pa bzhir sgra sgrogs dge 'dun la 'dir sgrogs/ /'di ni gtsug lag khang gi rtse mor rab tu sgrogs pa'i gabhā ⑤ste/ /sprin kyi sgra bzhin byed pa sgra rnams de ring yid du 'ong ba ni/ /ma ltar shin tu mnyes gshin pa yis legs par phyi rol song rnams kyi/ /bu rnams zas dus la ni yongs su 'bod par byed pa'i gabhā①'o/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo yongs su 'joms pa mchog tu gyur pa ste / /sangs rgyas yon tan rin chen thams cad kyis ni ma klubs pa'i/ /sgra sgrogs byed pa'i lha yi rnga chen dang mnyam sgra chen gyi/ / gabhās ༅sdig pa ma lus rnam par 'joms par byed pa'o/ /'dis ni lha dang lha min lto 'phye chen pos mchod byas pa/ /zhi ba mchog tu nye bar bzhud pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ / gabhā spu/ sgra sgrogs ༅'chi ba med pa'i rnga chen dang mnyam sgras/ /mu stegs can gzhan gyi ni snying ni rnam par 'joms pa'o/ /'dir ni gabhā ⑦'di sgrogs pa yis /༅mi rnams dang / /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin rnams 'bod pa ste/ /bzang po rnams kyi ⑨bde gshegs gabhā ⑫'di nyon cig /lus pa med pa'i dge slong tshogs kyis yongs su bskor/ /glang chen rnams kyis 'jigs pa'i dus tshigs 'khrugs pa'i dus kyi nam mkha' chu 'dzin khyab bzhin gyis/ /'gro ba rnams ni 'joms dang ya nga ba dang 'jigs pas 'dar ba zlog ⑩par byed pa'i rgyu/ /nye bar zhi bar mu stegs ma lus pa yi nga rgyal de yis shin tu med byed pa/ /thub pa tshogs rnams kun gyis chos rnams 'phel ba'i don bzhag pa de'i gabhā bokhyod kyis srungs/ /bsod nams mchog gyur de grub gyur cig 'tsho ba g.yo ba'i 'jig rten pa rnams kyi/ /mtho ris dang ni byang grol rab ster ngan 'gro ster byed sdig par 1—526

ma gyur cig /'dir ni dbus na 'dug pa'i sbrang ma sgra 'byin lta bur bdag gis smras 1pa yi/ /bdud dgra'i zhabs kyi chu skyes dag la me tog snyim pas gtor ro khyod kyis srungs/ /brgya byin la sogs lha tshogs rnams kyis shin tu gus pas me tog gtor rnams dang / /mkha' la sil snyan sgrogs pa rnams kyis yongs gang gus pas me tog gtor rnams dang / /mtho ris nas ni sa la babs par grags pa yun rings bskyal byas gang yin pa/ /snying rje'i gter chen bcom ldan 'das kyi gabhā ༷ rab gtum de yis 'gro ba srungs/ /yum gyi lhums nas 'thon pa tsam gyis rang gi snye gom pa bdun du bzhud pa po༅ / /'khor ba mthar phyung rang gi tshig ni rab tu brjod pa blo gros mi chung ba/ /gong / 5nyadu skyoba'i dngos por srid pa bsal / bar brjod pa rnams su gyur pa yis/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i mun pa dum bur byed pa'i gabhā nga de yis rgyal gyur cig /lhun po mchog gi stong dang rin chen ri bo nor bu'i 'od can kun gyi ngos dang ni/ /ri dbang rgyal po gangs ri'i steng dang mi yi yul dang klu yi 'jig rten dag na gnas pa yi/ /'chi med 'dod khams dbang po dang ni gling bzhi'i mi bdag nyi zla lha min dbang po rnams/ /bde gshegs chos kyi gabhā duthos pas thams cad bde gshegs dgongs pa bzang la 'bod pa'o/ /sa gsum kun na yod pa'i mi sdug rigs mang glang chen dregs pa mang po rnams bzung zhon/ /thams cad mche ba ring po phyir bton rdo rje 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i rtags ni bzung khyebyas nas/ /sdig pa'i rigs kun 'ongs pa rdo rje hūṃ mdzad bla ma mkhas pa'i rgyu sgras 'jigs mdzad pas/ /'jig rten kun las rgyal ba byung zhes sgra sgrogs zhabs drung 'dud cing sangs rgyas cod pan brgyan/ /bdud kyi bu mo khri snyan sa la dang 'dra mig ldan nu ma mkhrang zhing rgyas ldan pa/ /1/de527

ngang pa'i 'gros 'dra bran mo'i steng du zhon zhing glu len rnga yi tshogs brdung nya mgyogs 'gro ba/ /rgya mtsho chen po 'phyur ba'i chu bo bzhi ltar rgyun mi 'chad par mang po 'ongs rnams la/ / hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ gordo khyad 'phags sgra rnams rgyun mi 'chad par sgogs byed gabhā nyid yin no/ /bdud kyi stobs las rgyal byas 'jigs pa chen po bstan pa byas nas skyon zad pa'i/ /'dir ni de bzhin shin tu mdzes pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa gang / /ma lus yon tan bzang po dang ldan sangs rgyas dag pa'i thugs rje can de gi / gabhā ༅gtum po sdig 'phrog byed pas mi rnams kyi ni dum bur byed gyur cig /tshangs pa lkugs nga pa ltar gyur lha yi bla ma'i snyems pa med gyur thams cad du3 / /'tsho byed blo chung gyur to skal ba dang ldan khyab 'jug ci yang mi smrar song / /'dir ni gang gi yon tan grags pas lha rnams gang de ngo tshas yan lag 'khum༅ / /thub pa'i gabhā 'gro ba'i 'jigs pa med pas 'gro rnams ngan 'gro las ni srung / /tshangs pa mig stong dbang po khyab 'jug nyi zla srin po gnod sbyin rnams dang ni/ /dri za lto 'phye mi 'am ci dang lha min mi dang bdud ris yi dwags dang / /gang zhig langs pas sa yi /3 gzhi rnams gser 'od 'bar 'gyur gos ser can de kun/ /thams cad ma lus de bzhin gshegs pa bla mas chos ni nyan du 'bod pa'o/ /gang gis skyebar chung zhing dman pa'i dgongs can mu stegs pa rnams skrag pa 'thob/ /khyad 'phags 'phel ba'i blo can sangs rgyas pa rnams spro ba rab tu 'phel 'thob pa/ /gang 'di'i yon tan rnams 'thob rgya chen po yi skyon ni zad par 'gro ba yi/ / gabhā de yis rtag tu rtsod dus srid pa rnams kyi sdig pa zad gyur cig /rnam dag dgongs can gang la cho ga bzhin du phyag byas mthon po'i 'gro bgrod dang / /gang gis mi mthun phyogs 1—528

ni thams cad myur du zad pa ster bar byed pa dang / /'khrug long gti mug rab rib thub pa'i chos kyi ga rje shes de yis 'joms gyur cig /tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis srid pa las byung 'jigs pa de ni bad kyis la / /'di thos dge bas sa 'dzin pa yi tshangs sogs sa gzhi'i mthil du myur du ltung / /sa 'dzin rnams ni 'dar zhing sa gzhi myur du sa yi 'og tu 'gro ba dang / /mu stegs pa rnams 'jigs par byed pa gzhan la phan brtson 1dag pa'i bdag nyid can/ /sangs rgyas pa rnams myur du nye bar zhi 'gyur ga rje de ni 'du bar mdzod/ / ga rje'i 1 bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so—// //mkhas pa chen bo rgyal ba'i sde'i zhal snga nas dang / lo tsā ba btsun pa rnya mi yon tan gyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/522 tu mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod cing /8〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga lha'i bstod pa bzhug ga/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gaṇḍi/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gaṇḍi'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi drung du/ she 〈〈pe 〉〉(〈snar 〉〉bcings/zhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dngad pe(〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyig 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka rnyiḥzu thu zu ma che/ ḍa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dgongs/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—dang / 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉glu/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sab/48〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—tsita ku me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ kyi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ 523 1〈〈pe 〉〉mi/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉'khrug ga /— 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yis —〈〈pe 〉〉'pho/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bgyings/6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉si/sa/ sngo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'khrus ga —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gsal/ / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—par/ tshe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—dang / tshe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bcer/ 1la 529
bsdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/(41)1wa 531

༄༅/ /spel mar bstod pa zhes bya ba/khru ༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ mi sha ga sto tra nā ma/ bod skad du/ spel mar bstod pa zhes bya ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba yi/ /rgya mtsho'i nang du rnam par gnas/ /'dod chags la sogs mi bzad pa'i/ /chu srin gyis ni lus zos pas/ /de ring gang la skyabs su mchi/ /ji srid bdag la sems yod na/ /gang gi bstan la gnas pa dang / /gang bstod gang la bsnyen bkur bgyi/ /gang zhig la ni nyes pa kun//gtan nas yong ye mi mnga' zhing / /gang la'ang rnam pa thams cad du/ /yon tan thams cad gnas gyur pa/ /gzhan gyi gnod pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /gang gi nyes pa zad gyur pa/ /gzhan mngon mtho dang thar pa'i phyir/ /yon tan goms byas bdag gi min/ /gal te sems shig yod na ni/ /de nyid la ni skyabs 'gro zhing —/ /de bstod de ni bkur ba dang / /de yi bstan la gnas pa'i rigs/ /1—532

gang zhig nyes de gzhan la gnod/ /de ni yon tan gang gzhan smad/ /nyes pa rang gi nyes bcom pa/ /'tsho ba rang don yon tan no/ /thams cad mkhyen la yon tan kun/ /mnga' la de yang nyams mi mnga'/ /nyes pa bag chags bcas de yang / /skyob pa gcig pu la mi mnga'/ /spyod pa la ni mi smod phyir/ /thub pa skyon ni med par grub/ /bde bar grags pa'i chos spangs nas/ /skye bo dkar ba smod pa med/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sku dang ni/ /gsung dang thugs kyi phrin las la/ /zhe 'gras gyur pa gang gis kyang / /chos dang ldan par glags mi rnyed//che ba'i yon tan cha yis kyang / /tshig rnyed nges par ma blangs par/ /gal te ston bstod mi byed na/ /mi khom gnas bzhin bdag bcom 'gyur/ /rgya mtshor gnya' shing bu ga ru/ /rus sbal mgrin pa chud pa ltar/ /dam chos dga' ston cher bcas pa'i/ /mi nyid bdag gis thob nas ni/ /mang du bcad par gyur pa ste / /mthar yang bskal pa'i skyon gyis gnas/ /lce ni don can ma gyur te/ /gzhan du bdag ni bslus par gyur/ /mi rtag nyid dang rjes 'brang zhing / /las kyi glags la dogs bcas pa/ /bdag gi lce 'di nyid kyis go/ /snying po ci phyir blang mi bya/ /yon tan gyi mtha' ma rtogs pas/ /gal te bstod pa mi byed na/ /shā ri'i bu la sogs pas kyang / /nges par bstod par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar she thub pa'i yon tan gyis/ /yul lta grangs med shes mod kyis / /rang gi don la gus pa yis/ /de yi phyogs gcig bsgrims te brjod/ /gang zhig gzhan la slob pa dang / /dman phyir legs par ma bslabs gang / /nyes pa zad kyang de slob cing —/ /gang phyir don gyis khyod mi slob/ /gang gi yon tan grangs dag dang / /mthu la thug pa ma mchis la/ /rmad byung phrin las dpag med can/ /rang byung 1—na33

khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan grangs kyi mthu yis ni/ /slob la smra bar nus pa dang / /mtha' can gzhal bar byed nus kyi/ /mi slob pa yi mdun du min/ /'di snyed bgyi ba'i mtha' med na/ /'di ltar lags zhes ci zhig smos/ /khyod kyi yon tan slad du bdag /bsod nams snyam nas spyi brtol skyes/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dad pa las spobs pa skyes pa zhes bya ba las bstod pa gleng bslang ba zhes bya ba ste le'u dang po'o// //bde nas nyusnying rje med pa ni/ /spyod dam mi spyod rnam mi spyod/ /rang gi bde bas gzhan dbang phyir/ /de nyid dang ni nges par sbyar/ /spyod dam mi spyod snyam pa yi/ /rnam par rtog pa rnam spangs nas/ /'gro ba 'di ni nyam thag ces//khyod bdag nyid kyis zhal gyis bzhes/ /snying rje rnam par spangs nas ni/ /gzhan gyi ༅/gzham ni bcol ba byed/ /la lar bdag phan la brtson pas/ /rang gi bde phyir rab tu 'jug /khyod ni ma bcol legs mdzad pa/ /khyod ni rgyu med bzhin du byams/ /khyod ni ma 'dris mdza' bshes te/ /'brel ba med pa'i gnyen 'dun lags/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa'i phyir/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba blangs nas ni/ /slong la dgyes pa 'phel 'gyur ba/ /ba spu du ma ldang dang bcas/ /nyid kyi sha yang stsol mdzad na/ /dngos po gzhan lta smos ci 'tshal/ /legs mdzad khyod kyi ༅srog kyang ni/ /slong ba'i skye bo rnams la btang / /bdag la bdag nyid spangs nas ni/ /gzhan la bdag nyid blangs pas na/ /rtswa yis rin chen rigs chen ltar/ /dgyes pa mi nyams ldan pa yis/ /nyid kyi sku dang srog dag gis/ /lus can gshed mas zin rnams kyis/ /lus dang srog kyang 1—534

khyod kyis ni/ /lan brgya phrag tu bslu ba mdzad/ /'jig rten bdag lta'i bsam pa can/ /snying rje'i sems ni med pa ste/ /sdug bsngal 'jigs sam bde 'dod pas / /tshul khrims kun du blangs nas srung / /ngan 'gros bsnyengs slad ma lags la/ /bzhed pa'i 'gro ba'ang sgrub ma lags/ /dgongs pa dag pa 'ba' zhig gis/ /khyed kyis tshul khrims goms par mdzad/ /phyi rol rkyen gyis ma rdzogs dang / /rang sbyor phun tshogs med pa'i phyir/ /bsam pa rnam par dag pas kyang / /tshul khrims pha rol dag mi 'gyur/ /rtag tu gya gyu rnam spangs shing —/ /drang brtan rnams ni rtag bsten pas/ /yongs su dag pa'i las rnams kyis / /khyod ni gzhi rten gcig pur gyur/ /bzod pa'i pha rol phyin pa'i rgyu/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis mchod bya yang / /ma 'ongs sdug bsngal bsnyengs pa yis/ /gzhan nyid rang nyid la nyes pas/ /sdug bsngal mang pos gzir kyib ni/ /khyod kyis dga' ba'i thugs kyi ༅ni/ /nyon mongs rnams ni sran btsugs nas/ /skye bo nyon mongs can la brtse/ /gzir ༅bar gyur pa rnams la yang / /nyes pa rnams ni mi sems pa/ /bzod pa'i pha rol phyin 'dod phyir/ /byas pa nyid ni rjes lta bas/ /khyod kyis gzhan gyi don slad du/ /sku srog btang nas dgyes gyur gang —/ /de 'dra srog chags 'gum pa las/ /sos pa rnams la'ang byung ma gyur / /phan byed mchod pas dga' gyur pa/ /ngo mtshar che ba'i sems mi rtsi /mgon po khyod ni dgyes pa gang / /bdag gi de ni ngo mtshar dgongs/ /khyod ni lan 'ga' ma lags par/ /gtubs kyang sdug bsngal mi dgongs par/ /gshed ma bgyid pa'i sems can la'ang / /gtso bo thugs rjer gyur pa gang / /gang yang gshed ma nyid kyis ni/ /ral gri nyid kyis bcad byas nas/ /byang chub 1/de535

gnyer bar gzigs nas ni/ /byams pa la ni bzhugs par gyur/ /khyod kyi thugs ni rin po che/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sa bon te/ /dpa' khyod kho nas snying por mkhyen/ /de gzhan skye bos 'ol mi mchis/ /de ltar bdag nyid gyur pa yang —/ /sems can rtag tu sdug bsngal can/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas chos rnams la / /so sor brtags nas brtson 'grus bya/ /dka' spyad las ni ma bgyis par / /go 'phang rnyed dka' mi 'thob ces/ /de slad nyid la'ang ma gzigs par / /khyod kyis brtson 'grus legs par spel/ /khyad par yon tan rnyed nas ni / /nyes pa rnam par spangs pa dang / /sems can don du khur khyer yang / /thugs ni kun du mi bsnyel te/ /khyad par 'phags par bgyi ba la/ /khyod la thang lhod 'ga' ma byung / /de slad khyod kyi khyad par rnams/ /thog drung rim par dbyer ma mchis/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin pa ni/ /dag pa'i rjes su cis mi mchi/ /lta dang nga rgyal snang med pa/ /gang gi shes rab kyis ni bsal/ /thugs ni thugs rje chen po dang / /rtag tu rjes su 'brel slad du/ /ting 'dzin 'bras bur bcas pa yi/ /shin tu bde la'ang khyod ma chags/ /kha cig mu stegs pa rnams ni/ /longs spyod kyis ni nges legs 'thad/ /gzhan la gcig tu nyid kyis ni/ /longs spyod dgag pa ma mdzad do/ /gzhan dang thun mong ma lags pa'i / /bde ba gang de gya nom yang / /dam pa'i spyod ldan khyod 'dra la/ /gnod par bas kyi sman ma mchis/ /khyod kyi shes rab mtshungs min te/ /dud 'gro du ma rnams la yang / /gang zhig ye shes rnam dag phyir/ /ji ltar rjes su mchi mi bgyid/ /'dres pa la /2ni legs bshad nyid/ / /snying po skyon med nyi tshe zhig /khyod kyi kun bzhes thugs la bzhag /nyes bshad dug bzhin yongs su 1—536

spangs/ /legs bshad chen po sku srog gis/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i phyed tsam yang —/ /gang zhig shes rab rnam 'phel phyir/ /ji ltar rjes su mchi mi bgyid/ /khyod nyid gcig pus rnam mkhyen mdzad/ /rin chen snying po mkhyen khyod kyis/ /legs bshad srog gis mjal ①ba na/ /skyeb de dang de dag tu/ /byang chub slad du dpa' sru' bstan/ /sems can brtson 'grus 'phags pa ni/ /grangs med par ni gyur pa yang / /spyod med zha bo rnams kyi gang / /skye bos thob par mi nus so/ /de slad grangs med gsum dag tu/ /khyod ni de ltar brtson pa na/ /brtson 'grus 'ba' zhig 'grogs ༅gyur pas/ /go 'phang bla na med pa brnyes/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dad pa las spobs pa skyed pa zhes bya ba las rgyu'i sgo nas bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u gnyis pa'o// //yon tan thams cad cung zad gzigs/ /gsol ba na yang mnal mi mnga'/ /nye bar blangs pa brtan mdzad cing / /khyad dupar la ni thugs ni chags/ /mtho la phrag dog mi mdzad cing / /dman la rngan chen mi mdzad la/ /mnyam la 'gran pa ma mchis pas/ /khyod ni 'jig rten gtso bor gyur/ /bka' ༅bas sgrub la nyams mi mnga'/ /yun ring du ni mi gnas shing / /chags bcas kyang ni phal che ba/ /'bras bu las ni shin tu chung / /khyod ni yon tan rgyu rnams la/ /mngon dgyes 'bras bu rnams la min/ /yang dag sgrub pa de nyid kyis / /khyod ni ༅yon tan pha mthar phyin/ /thub dbang nyid ni dka' bas grub / /de ltar smra ba'i skyobo rnams/ /snying rje phongs pas mi sems pa /brtson 'grus mi g.yo blangs nas ni/ /ji ltar khyod kyi zhabs rdul yang / /bsod 1—537

nams skyeb mched 1gyur pa/ /de ltar khyod kyi longs khya/spyad pas/ /bdag nyid rab tu bskrun pa mdzad/ /'jig rten pa yi 'phags lam dang / /brtson 'grus shes rab kyis kyang ni/ /tshe rabs snga ma'i mthar yang ni/ /khyod ni yang dag byung ba yis/ /nyes pa nyams ( — smad rtsa nas bton/ /yon tan spel nas rnam par sbyangs/ /gzhung lugs bzang po des na khyod/ /grub mchog lhag par brnyes pa lags/ /rtag tu ngal zhing mgon med pa/ /slong zhing bde ba ma mchis te / /sems can rnams la nyams med pa'i/ /nyon mongs mang po spyod mthong nas| /ji ltar bdag gi rgyud la de/ /bag chags lhag ma'ang ma lus pa de ltar rnam pa thams cad du/ /nyes pa khyod kyis rab tu bcom/ /gzhan gyi phun tshogs bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /khyod ni gtso bor mthong nas ni/ /bdag gi yon tan dman pa'i phyir/ /gzhan min brtson 'grus phrin las can/ /ji ltar gzhan la de dag dang / /'dra ba tsam yang mi gda' ba/ /de ltar khyod kyis bsags bsags nas/ /bdag nyid la ni yon tan bsgrub④/ /chung dang dman dang 'tsho ba med/ /kha na ma tho chags bcas dang / /chim par mi byed legs mtha' med//thun mong gsal dang mi ldan te/ /'jig rten pa yis /3/dpe dngos kun/ /gegs bgyid pa dang sgrib pa can/ /re zhig pa dang nyi tshe ba/ /shin tu rnyed par sla ba lags/ /mang ba dang ni rab kyi rab/ /kun du mtsho dang dri ma gcod/ /tshim par mdzad dang bde mtha' can/ /thun mong min pa'i snang ba mnga'/ /khyod kyi yon tan bla med la/ /gegs bgyid skum mchis rtog ma mchis/ /brtan pa dang ni rgyun chags pas/ /dpe lta mchis par ga la 'gyur/ /nyan thos blo mchog rnams kyis kyang / /bskal pa rnams kyis ma rtogs pa/ /lha ma yin gyis 1—538

gting rnyed pa'i/ /khyod kyi dgongs 'dra ga la mchis/ /gang tshe khyod kyis ༅ dgongs pa'i dkyel/ /gting dang pha rol med brtags na/ /rgya mtsho zab pa nyid kyang ni/ /gnag rjes lta bur sa ler gda'/ /'dod pa'i mtha' la ma chags pas/ /gang zhig kha cig gis skyon min/ /khyod kyi bka' ni brtan bcas pa / /su zhig gis ni mjal /bar nus/ /chos rnams kun gyi 1mi bskyod pa/ /khyod kyis ngu brtan pa mngon bsam 5 na/ /sa yi brtan pa nyid kyang ni/ /shir sha'i ge sar rtse ltar chung / /bde ba 'dod pas phyi rol pa/ /nyi ma'i rjes su nyal byed de/ /khyod ni nyi ma dang mtshungs min/ /thun mong gi ni dbye bar brjod/ /thub pa khyod kyi ye shes kyi/ /snang bas mi shes rab rib dag /'joms pa'i thad na nyi ma yang / /me khyer tsam du mi spyod do/ /sbyor dang bsam pa dag pa yis/ /sngon yang nyes pa mi mnga' la/ /khyod kyi spyod pa bsam min pas/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni sus bsam nus/ /khyod kyi gsung thugs mdzad spyod rnams/ /dag pa'i gan na ston zla dang / /chu dang nam mkha'i dag pa rnams/ /dri ma can nyid lta bur gda'/ /gzhal du med pa'i yon tan rnams/ /dpe yi tshul kyis sus gzhal nus/ /khyad par la ni sbyor ba'i phyir/ /tshig tsam yang ni mang po yin/ /'jig rten legs pa gang ci'ang rung / /thams cad sngo na'ang der bas te/ /nyon mongs 'jig rten chos rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas chos la khyad mi 'khor ༅/ /bse ru'i rwa dang 'dra ba gang / /gang yang khyod kyi rjes 'gro slob/ /grol ba tsam gyis khyod dang mtshungs/ /rmad byung yon tan nyid kyis min/ /rin chen chos gang brnyes nas khyod/ /mchog tu gyur pa de nyid dang / /khyod du bsgrun zhing de dang ni/ /khyod dang bsgrun ldon kho nar bas/ /yang na de yang khyod mtshungs 1—539

min / /gang phyir gnyis ga mnyam pa ni/ /tshad ma mkhan gyis brjod mi nus/ /des ni sus kyang rtogs mi 'gyur/ /gang la spyi tsam bsgrun nas ni/ /cung zad brjod 7par bgyis rgya pa de/ /smra ba po yi rang dga' dang / /thabs dang gcam bu tsam du bas/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dad pa las spobs pa skyes pa zhes bya ba las dpe med par bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u gsum pa'o // //'gro las bdud las rnam par rgyal/ /rjes su dpag pas rnam par lhag /khyod kyi nyan thos kyis kyang ni/ /mnyam gnas bdud las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /khyod ni bdud las rnam rgyal te/ /'gro kun dad par mdzad pa yang / /bdag gi chos nyid rjes bsams nas/ /chen po ltar gang ma mthong ngo / /khyod ni stobs gnas ma yin yang / /gang gis rgyal bar bya ba'i rigs/ /de yis srid gzhan rgyal ba'i phyir/ /bdud kyi bran ༅/dang mngag gzhug rnams/ /sdang bas gol bar rtsol byed pa/ /mang po'ang gzhol bar bya ba ni/ /khyad par gnas la brten pa yi/ /bzod pa'i tshegs su mtshar mi che/ /g.yeng ba'i rkyen dang mjal na yang / /gzhan la mi bsten pa yis ni/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa ni/ /khyod bdag nyid kyis dgyes par mdzad/ /gang tshe bdud rnams mngon btul ba/ /de yi nub mo kho na la/ /nyon mongs shin tu che spangs pa/ /de nyid rmad du byung ba lags/ /gang gi de ltar bsam min yang / /lhag par nyon mongs las rgyal gyur / /skyebo 1gzhan dang thun mong gang / /mu stegs las rgyal de smos ci/ /'od zer phreng ba stong ldan pa'i/ /nyi mas mun bsal gang lags dang / /dpa' 1—540

bo khyod kyis mu stegs las/ /rgyal bar mdzad pa ci zhig mtshar/ /chags sdang gti mug bcas pa dang / /de nyid dang ni 'gro ba srid/ /phra rgyas spangs pa rnams kyis ni/ /rgol ba'i tshe na rnam dpyod yin/ /'dod chags bral bas chags bcas dang / /zhe sdang bral bas zhe sdang can/ /gti mug bral bas rmongs pa ste/ /gsum pos rtag tu gsum dag btul/ /btang snyoms gnas la gnas pa gang / /ngo mtshar min zhing dga' /khyeb min/ /'jug pa dang ni ldog pa'i phyir / /de ni ngo mtshar zhes bya ste/ /dam chos rab tu bstod pa dang / /dam chos ma lags spyod mdzad kyang / /dam pa dag dang tha ma la/ /khyod ni chags dang khro mi mnga'/ /yun ring por ni mngon 'dod pa'i/ /yid la re ba skong ba dang —/ /mi rigs pa ni rtsod pa yis/ /chos nyid la ni gegs byed la/ /dgra bcom pa dang mu stegs la/ /rjes su chags dang khong khro bar/ /khyod kyi thugs ni mi 'gyur na / /khyod la bstod du ci zhig mchis/ /gang zhig 'phel ba'i rgyu mtshan phyir/ /srog kyang khyod kyis mi dgongs na/ /gzigs pa dang ni gsan pa dang —/ /khyod kyis ma gzigs ma gsan bzhin/ /yon tan rnams la'ang ma chags la/ /yon tan can la'ang bzhed mi mnga'/ /kye ma'o khyod kyi thugs stobs ni/ /rab dang yongs su dag pa lags/ /phan tshun rjes su 'jug pa'i phyir / /nges par lus dang sems dag gi/ /mya ngan dga' sogs gnas skabs ni / /re dogs kyis kyang shin tu bsgribs/ /dbang po rnams ni rab dang ba/ /dus rnams rtag tu mi nyams pas/ /khyod shethugs rtag tu dang ba dag /mngon sum gyur pa bzhin du gda'/ /shin tu nyung ngu 'dod pa yis/ /'bad pa yis ni sbas na yang / /nyes zad shin tu ma lus pas 4/ /gzhan don gyis ni drangs 1/de541

pas na/ /rang bzhin dam pa legs gsungs dang / /mdzad spyod bzang pos bsgrags pas na/ /khyod kyi blo gros dgongs pa dag /rnam dag byes pa'i bar la grags/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dad pa las spobs pa skyes pa zhes bya ba las rmad du byung bar bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u bzhi pa'o// //gang gis khyod kyi sku mthong bas/ /sems ni dang bar ma gyur pa/ /de la mig ni med pa ste/ /yang na yod kyang don med pa'o/ /nye bar zhi la yid du 'ong —/ /'bar la gnod pa mdzad mi mnga'/ /dul la rngom brjid che ba yi/ /sku 'dis su zhig dad mi mdzad/ /gang yang lta dang zhi ba'am/ /yul ni shin tu rnyed pa na/ /thams cad chags dang bral 'gyur zhing / /'di ni mthong ba'i nang na mchog /khyod kyi sku de gang gis ni/ /lan brgya mthong dang gang zhig gis/ /dang por mthong ba de gnyis ga /'dra bar mig ni mgu bar mdzad/ /rnam par sdang ba'i sems ldan yang / /mthong bas ngoms pa cis mi 'gyur/ /khyad par la mkhas ma yin yang / /gang zhig yi dwags rnams kyis ni/ /khyod kyi sku ni mdzes pa'i phyir/ /blta bas mi ngoms rang bzhin pas/ /mthong ngo cog ni phyi phyir zhing —/ /dga' ba skyed par mdzad pa lags/ /dub par ma dgongs ngo mtshar te / /rjes su mthun pa'i don mdzad cing / /phrin las gsal bar gyur pa na/ /gang gi 1'bad pa med par 'phrul/ /rten gyi yon tan dag dang ni/ /brten pa'i yon tan phan tshun du/ /'tsham pas khyod kyi sku dang ni/ /yon tan phun tshogs mchog dang ldan/ /khyod la yon tan mi mnga' na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'di ni/ /gzhan la gang zhig la ni rten/ /gzhan mi bas ni rnam par 1—542

spras / /mtshan dang dpe byad bzang 'bar ba/ /khyod kyi sku las ma gtogs pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan 'di/ /gzhan gang zhig la legs gnas 'gyur/ /phun sum tshogs las lhag pa'i sku/ /gzhan dang mtshungs min thob pa ni/ /brten ①pa yi ni khyad par gyis/ /phun sum tshogs pa lhag par 'chang / /khyod sku rten pa'i yon tan la/ /nga dpal che zhes gsung gsung ltar/ /de yi yon tan rnams kyang slar/ /nged legs bkod ces gsung ba 'dra/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dad pa las spobs pa skyes pa zhes bya ba las sku la bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u lnga pa'o// //gsod dang bkres skom grang dro dang / /mi srun smad pa la sogs mang / /gsum la dub pa med bzod cing / /ngan song gi ni sdug bsngal yang / /'gro ba 'di dag thams cad ni/ /khyad med nyon mongs rnams kyis bcings/ /khyod ni 'gro ba'i nyon mongs dag /dgrol slad yun rings ⑤thugs rjes bsdams/ /bcings pa'i rgyu ni nyon mongs pas/ /'gro ba yis ni nyon mongs bzod/ /khyod ni thugs rje yis bcings pas/ /bzod pa gang de ngo mtshar lags/ /dang por khyod la phyag bgyi 'am/ /'on te gang gis 'khor bar khyod/ /skyon mkhyen yun ring de lta bur/ /bzhugs mdzad thugs rje che la bgyi/ /de ltar sdug bsngal btang snyoms nas/ /dben pa'i gnas su bzhugs par mdzad/ /shin tu gsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ /de ltar kyi yang bzod par mdzad/ /dben pa'i bde ba spangs gyur khyod/ /mang po'i nang du bzhugs pa gang / /de khyod thugs rje dus 'das pa/ /glags shig thod nas bgyis par bas/ /'jig rten spyod pa 'dra ba 1—543

mang —/ /ma 'ongs bde ba la brten nas/ /da ltar byung la 1gus pa yis/ /sems can rnams la rnam dpyad nas/ /rig pa yi ni mtsho nang nas/ /klu bzhin khyod kyi thugs rje yis/ /dgon pa zhi 1 gnas grong gi mthar/ /gdul ba'i don gyi slad du drangs/ /gzhan la chags shing dgongs pa yis/ /thugs rje btsun mos mi bya med/ /yang na khyod ni de chags pas/ /rang dang mthun pas spangs nas gang / /nyer zhi mchog la gnas bzhin du/ /thugs rje gtso dang ldan pas na / /rol mo mkhan gyi sgyu rtsal yang / /khyod kyi zhabs kyis 'dor bar mdzad/ /don dam pa ni ma brnyes pas/ /sngon ni de bzhin dka' spyod min/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni brnyes pa yis/ /zhi gnas bdag nyid spangs nas kyang / /rdzu 'phrul seng ge'i sgra dang ni/ /nyid kyi yon tan brjod pa gang / /de ni bzhed spyod mi mnga' ba / /khyod kyi thugs rje bstan pa lags/ /gal te sems can don mdzad 'di/ /sems can yod na kyemi 'gyur ba/ /gus pas gzhan du mi 'dra la/ /ji ltar mi bzad ltar brtse med/ /gzhan gyi don du rab bzang gi/ /nyid kyi don la brtse med pas/ /mgon po khyod nyid 'ba' zhig la/ /thugs rjes thugs rje ༅mdzad ma gyur/ /yang na khyod nyid dka' ba rnams/ /spyod pa ma nyams des ni mdzad/ /khyod kyis nyid don las lhag par/ /gzhan don rjes su gzigs par mdzad/ /'di ltar res 'ga' bstan pas gang / /gzhan don grub par mdzad slad du/ /khyod ni lan brgyar phyogs dag du/ /gtor ma bzhin du btang ba lags/ /gang zhig rjes su mi mthun pa'i/ /rol mo mkhan gyi bzo sogs ni/ /ngan pa'i las la'ang drang bar mdzad/ /de nyid de ni mi 'thad do/ /de ltar khyed la gnod mdzad kyang / /nongs pa can du mi rtsi 3/bas/ /khyod kyi bzhed pa kho na dang / /1/de544

mthun 'jug pa ni lags par gda'/ /gtong min yod de chags pa min/ /chags pa yod de dngos mi shes/ /kha cig dngos po shes na yang / /rjes su mthun min gtong ba yang / /gtong ba min la chags pa yang / /dngos po shes na rjes su mthun/ /thugs rje de yis spyod legs mang / /gang gi smra bar byed par nus/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dad pa las spobs pa skyes pa zhes bya ba las thugs rje la bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u drug pa'o// //tshig bzang ba dang don che dang / /bden pa dang ni snyan pa dang / /zab gsal gnyis sha'i don ldan dang / /bsdus dang spros pa dang ldan pa/ /nyon mongs 'joms dang rtsub min dang / /gsal dang bde blag rtogs pa dang / /sna tshogs don ni ma 'khrugs dang / /snying po can dang mang ba yang / /khyod kyi gsung ni de lta bu/ /khyod kyi dgra bos thos na yang / /thams cad mkhyen pa lags so zhes/ /su zhig nges pa bskyed mi 'gyur/ /rjes su chags dang bar ma dang —/ /sdang bas gnod pa byed pa la/ /nyes kun skyug par mdzad pa'i phyir/ /thams cad la ni thugs mnyam mnga'/ /mang po ril gyis snyan ma lags/ /bcos pa 'ga' tsam snyan pa lags/ /khyod kyi gsung ni don grub pas/ /thams cad legs gsung kho na lags/ /mos khams dbang po'i dbye ba yis/ /gang phyir bsam pa sna tshogs pa/ /de bas thabs la mkhas pa yis/ /skyes bu 'dul mchog kha lo sgyur/ /khyod kyi gsung ni rnam brtags na/ /gang zhig 'jam dang rtsub pa dang / /gang yang de gnyis ldan pa dag /thams cad ro gcig nyid du 'gyur/ /yun ring 'phel bar 'gyur ba ni/ /thugs rje brtson 'grus phun 1/de545

tshogs pas/ /dgongs pa yang dag shes rab kyang / /thams cad la ni brtson dang ldan/ /e ma'o shin tu yongs dag pa'i/ /phrin las rnams kyang rab tu bzo / /de yis rin chen gsung rnams kyi/ /snod 'di 'dra ba 'di bgyis so/ /snod kyi skyon dang ༅la pas na/ / na bar ①bdud rtsi 'di 'dra ba'ang / /ro ni phrogs par gyur pa ste/ /lha yi chu ni rgya mtsho ⑤bzhin/ /khyod zhal blta na rab sdug pa/ /de las mnyan na snyan pa yis/ /gsung 'di dag ni zla ba las/ /bdud rtsi 'dzag pa bzhin du gda'/ /sngo ba thi sogs dbye ba yis/ /mi sdug pa ni bstan pa dang / /byams pa dang ni snying rje yang / /spyod pa'i gnyen po'i phyogs kyis ni/ /khyod kyi gsung ni 'dod chags kyi/ /rdul rab zhi mdzad char sprin 'dra/ /zhe sdang sbrul ni gdon pa'i phyir/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dra ba lags/ /gzhan yang rten cing 'brel 'byung ba'i/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bstan pa yis / /de bzhin las bdag gir bya ba/ /bdag med pa gang ④dbyer med pas / /yang dang yang du mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib 'joms pas gdugs dang 'dra / /nga rgyal ri bo mngon 'joms pas/ /brgya byen mtshon cha 'dra ba lags/ /gal te 'di ni ma gsungs na/ /bde gshegs dgra bcom sangs rgyas dang / /de ltar rtogs nyid phun tshogs pa'i/ /khyod kyi bden gsungs sus rtogs 'gyur/ /don gzigs pas na mi slu ⑤ba/ /nongs mi mnga' phyir rjes su mthun/ /legs par sbyar bas go sla ste/ /khyod kyi gsung ni legs gsum ldan/ /zab pa dang ni snyan pa dang / /go sla dang ni legs sbyar dang / /gdul bya dang ni rjes su mthun/ /gdug pa la yang bden don phyir/ /re zhig dang por khyod kyi gsung / /nyan pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog mdzad/ /de nas yid la bsams bgyis na/ /rdul 1—546

dang mun pa dag kyang sel/ /longs spyod nyung ngu tsam zhig dang / /skyeb dang ni 'jig pa yang / /gzhan yang 'gro ba gzhan dbang la/ /nges par 'byung ba ston par mdzad/ /phongs pa rnams kyi dbugs 'byin cing / /bag med rnams ni skrag par mdzad/ /bde ba can dag skyo bgyid lasakhya/ /khyod gsung kun dang 'tsham par 'jug /yongs smin dbang gis shes rab ni/ /sgom pa'i rang bzhin skyed ⑤mdzad cing / /de las ldang ba'i dus su ni/ /thos bsam rang bzhin gyis kyang ni/ /mkhas pa rnams ni dga' ba bskyed/ /bar ma rnams kyi blo yang spel/ /tha ma'i rab rib rnam 'joms pas/ /gsung 'di skyobo kun la sman/ /shes rab spyan ni zag pa med/ /dang po bden pa skyed par mdzad/ /de 'og dbang po'i dbye ba yis/ /bsgom pa dang ni mi slob lam/ /lta ba dag la dgar mdzad cing —/ /mya ngan 'das par nye bar 'dren/ /nyes pa sel mdzad khyod kyi gsung //yon tan rnams kyi char yang 'bebs/ /'dul ba'i thabs la mkhas pa yis/ /sngon dus lo rgyus gsung ba'i phyir/ /skal can rnams la don dam pa/ /shin tu ma 'das pa yis kyang / /kun la ma thogs thugs mnga' zhing / /dgongs pa'ang kun du nyer gnas pas/ /de zhuslad khyod kyis lung bstan kun/ /thams cad la yang slu ④mi mnga'/ /khyod kyi nyan thos mchog rnams kyi/ /rigs dang smin dang mos pa yis/ /mi shes pas ni bsgribs pa'i tshig /khyod ni thugs dgongs ma nyams pas/ /gang slad dus ⑤min yul min dang / /snod min rnams su mi 'jug pa/ /de slad khyod gsung don mchis te/ /brtson 'grus legs par brtsams pa bzhin/ /khyod gsung yon tan cha tsam la'ang / /bdag gis bstod par ④nus ma yin/ /gang gis khyod kyang 'dod chung ba'i/ /rab tu gsal bar 1/de547

kun du 'dren/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dad pa las spobs pa skyes pa zhes bya ba las gsung la bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u bdun pa'o// //bgrod pa gcig dang thabs bde dang / /legs par 'brel dang nyes pa med / /thog ma bar dang mthar dge bas/ /khyod kyi bstan 'dra gzhan la med/ /gzhan rnams kyang ni thar don min/ /dka' kyibs thob cing bde 'gro min/ /mi rtag phan tshun 'gal ba ste/ /de lam 'bras bu bstan pa'i phyir/ /khyod kyi gzhung lugs de lta bu/ /gcig pu phongs la lta chags pas/ /byis pa gal te spyod bgyid na/ /lta dang 'dra ba'i dgra ma mchis/ /byang chub sems ni nyer blangs nas/ /gzhan don la chags thugs mnga' bas/ /khyod bskal bye bar skad cig bzhin/ /dmyal bar yang ni de bzhin bzhugs/ /'gro ba yi ni don slad du/ /sdug bsngal mang ltar gang ༅lags pa/ /de bsams khyod bstan ngan na yang / gnas par bgyi ba la thug na/ /nyon mongs bde ba chung byed pa'i/ /mi yi bdag po'i bka' lung gis/ /dmyal ba yi yang las rnams la'ang / /byas pa gzo bas 'jug par mthong / /phan pa gsung zhing phan pa mdzad/ /khyod kyi bstan pa ci smos te/ /mgo la zhugs ni 'bar bas kyang / /ci yi slad du sgrub rgya mi bgyid/ /zhi gnas ye shes rdzogs pa dang / /rtogs par gyur nas dad pa dang —/ /nyon mongs kun las rnam 'grel phyir/ /byis pa slob dang mkhas rnams kyis / /khyod kyi bstan pas rang dbang dang / /byang chub bde dang zhi ba dang / /khyod kyi yon tan bsngags pa dang / /legs pa bzhi po 'di kun thob/ /stong pa nyid ni gsung ba dang / /srid par smon pa mi mnga' dang / /mtshan ma med pa 1—548

rnyed mdzad pa/ /gang de chags sdang med pa'i phyir/ / dpa' bo /khyod kyi bstan pa 'di/ /mu stegs thams cad skrag mdzad la/ /bdud ni sems khong chud mdzad cing / /lha dang mi rnams dbugs ༅kyang 'byin/ /bdag tu lta bas 'dus byas la/ /smod med mya ngan 'das mi 'thad/ /de slad de yi mi mthun pa//'chi bdag gis ni 'tshe bar 'gyur/ /'chi bdag bstan pa khams gsum gyi/ /sa chen dag la spyod bgyid pa/ /mi thogs zlog pa ma mchis pa'ang / /khyod kyi bstan pas zil gyis mnan/ /skyes nas nges par 'jig pa'i phyir/ /'on te nyon mongs bzhin 'chi 'pho/ /khyod sras kyis kyang dbang thob phyir/ /de las 'di ni khyad ches 'phags/ /khyod kyi bstan pa'i lugs 'tshal ba/ /dga' na bskal par yang gnas la/ /gang du bdud kyis mi rdzi ba/ /der yang dga' mgur rab tu mchi/ /thabs sogs sgrub la mkhas pa yis/ /shes rab gsum po rnam 'phel phyir/ /gang tshe sems ni nges sbyar dang / /gzhag ④dang sdang ba zhes bya 'dis/ /lung gi don ni bsams pa dang / /bsgoms dang gus par mnyan pa yi / /dus gsum cha dbye khyod kyi ni/ /bstan las gzhan la mchis ma lags/ /rig pa snga ༅ phyir ma 'phel zhing / /bsam bya'i gnas dang bral ba'i phyir/ /mu stegs gzhan gyi mthong bzhin yang / /lta la srid pa'i gdon gyis dkrugs/ /drang srong skyes mchog khyod kyi bstan/ /de ltar legs pas khyab 'di la/ /ma gus gang lags de las ni/ /sdug bsngal chen po'ang ci zhig mchis/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dad pa las spobs pa skyes pa zhes bya ba las bstan pa la bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u brgyad pa'o// //1/de549

gang zhig snga mar smon lam mdzad/ /yang na mthong dang thos pa yang / /'gro ba rnams la smon mdzad pa/ /da ltar yang ni don ldan 'khums/ /khrod thos pas ni spro ba skyed/ /mthong bas dad pa skye bar 'gyur/ /khyod gsung thos pas dga' 'gyur te/ /bstan pas rnam par grol bar mdzad/ /kye ma'o gnas skabs thams cad du/ /skyedagu rnams la sman mdzad pa'i/ /chos bstan pas ni byed pa na/ /gang mthar bde ba sgrub pa'i phyir/ /khyod kyi sras kyis mgu bar 'gyur/ /'phel bas skyedagu rnams kyang dga'/ /gshegs pa na ni phan 'dogs mdzad/ /ldog pa na ni 'god pa mdzad/ /gang zhig dad pas brlan sems kyis/ /yon tan dran pa gsal bas kyang / /gal te khyod ni bde mdzad na / /de las ngo mtshar ma mchis lags/ /bsgrags pas sdig pa 'phrog par mdzad/ /khyod dran pas ni rangs par 'gyur/ /btsal bas blo gros skye'agyur te / /yongs su shes pas rnam par 'dag /de bzhin skyabs 'gro len pa dang / /sbyin dang slob pa rjes byed pa'i/ /'jigs 'joms mdzad pa ci ngo mtshar/ /gang zhig chos la mngon 'dod pas/ /khyod la bsu bas dpal du byed/ /bsten ①pas blo gros mchog tu 'gyur/ /bsten na 'jigs pa med par mdzad/ /bsnyen bkur bgyis pas bde bar 'gyur/ /glags skabs tshol bar byed pas kyang / /khyod kyi drung du nyer mchis na/ /phyi nas gdung ba dang ldan phyir/ /sman pa bzhin du de bzhin khyod/ /tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pas dag /bsam gtan phun sum tshogs pas dang / /shes rab phun tshogs mi 'khrugs pas//khyod ni bsod nams mtsho chen lags/ /mtshang 'bru ba la brtson pa ste/ / ba ra dwa ⑤dza la sogs kyang / /nges legs dang 'dra cis mi 'gyur/ /khyod la de ni ngo 1—550

mtshar ci/ /khyod sku bltar 'os rin chen te/ /legs gsungs mnyan 'os rin chen lags/ /chos ni spyad 'os rin chen pas/ /khyod ni rin chen 'byung gnas lags/ /'jigs pa mi bzad rnams su yang / /khyod ni dran pa tsam gyis gang //zhi bar gyur pa de la yang / /mtshar min gang zhig thugs rje'i bdag /khyod ni chu bos bdas pa'i gling / /smas pa'i bdag nyid skyob pa ste/ /srid pa'i 'jigs pas nyen pa'i skyabs/ /thar 'tshal rnams kyi 'dren pa lags/ /me tog gcig ni rab phul bas/ /gang zhig ngan 'gror lhung ma gyur/ /de la dus nges bstan pa la/ /mtshar min khyod sngon 'di 'dra lags/ /tshul khrims dag phyir snod kyi mchog /zhing gshin 'bras bu phun sum tshogs/ /srog chags kun la phan mdzad phyir / /grogs kyi phul yang khyod lags so/ /gang zhig gis khyod mthong tsam gyis / /skyon yon la ni mi mkhas pa/ /dud 'gro dang ni gzhan min 'gyur/ /de la drin sogs mtshar ba khyalags/ /phan 'dogs mdzad pas mdza' bshes te/ /'grogs na bde phyir snying du sdug /zhi phyir gcig tu yid du 'ong / /yon tan kun mnga' mchod 'os khyod/ /gang zhig mthong ba tsam gyis ni/ /ngan song gi ni sdug bsngal yang / /nye bar zhi ba de la yang / /gnas min 'jig rten dogs pa can/ /sdig pa med pas yid dang 'thad/ /sku gsung bzang bas dga' bar mdzad/ /don kun 'grub du /phyir dpal yangs te/ /yon tan legs rten khru bkra shis lags/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dad pa las spobs pa skyes pa zhes bya ba las smon lam gyi bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u dgu pa'o// //snga phyir sems gnas bsgrub slad du/ /rmugs la sogs pa zhi ba'i phyir/ /1—551

phyi rol g.yeng ba zhi don du/ /nang gi chog shes spangs pa'i phyir/ /khyed ni rngan then bgyid la skul/1/ /chom rkun bgyid pa tshar yang gcod/ /gya gyu can rnams rnal du 'god/ /dal bus bgyid la bzhen ②skul 'debs/ /zhi gnas nges par rdzogs nas ni/ /phyi nas bden la sbyar bar mdzad/ /bsgom pa khyad par mdzad slad du/ /sa bon med par spangs par mdzad/ /dul ba rnams ni lam la spyor // /dmu rgod rnams la btang snyoms mdzad/ /de slad skyes bu 'dul ba yi//kha los sgyur geb bla med mchog /thad du phyin nas khyod mtshang 'bru/ /gang zhig sa bon med par spangs/ /'on kyang de la btang snyoms min/ /phan pa'i dus la gzhes par mdzad/ /khyod ni nyam thag rnams la brtse/ /bde bar gnas la phan par bgyid/ /phongs par gnas la thugs rje bas/ /kun la phan par bzhed pa lags/ /gang zhig bar ma la phan bzhed/ /de ni shin tu ngo mtshar min/ /gang zhig slar yang byas 'joms pa'i/ /gnyen dang grogs rnams la ni bzhin/ /khyod ni dgra bo rnams la'ang byams/ /nyams par gyur la phan 'dogs mdzad/ /gtum po rnams la thusas brtse bas/ /khyod ni ya rabs rmad cig lags/ /skyeb gcig tu phyi rol gyi/ /bza' btung gos la sogs pa yi/ /nyon mongs pa yi dbang gis ni/ /lus tsam la ni phan byed dag /phan 'dogs bgyi slad pha ma dag /gal te bla mar 'tshal na go/ /khyod ni lhag par phan 'dogs pas/ /bla ma nyid gyur smos ci 'tshal/ /thar pa'i sa bon ji ltar yang / /de rnams dge ba la btsud nas/ /dus gcig yongs su smin slad du/ /dus ni kun du 'da' bar mdzad/ /rang gi don la mi lta bas/ /nyid kyi dgra bo ltar gyur cing / /g.yang sa'i mu na gnas rnams la/ /ra ba lta bur gyur pa'ang khyod/ /de nas ji ltar 1—552

snod gyur pa'i/ /yongs su smin par gzigs nas ni/ /slar yang thugs ni ma bsnyel zhing / /sman gdags bsam gtan la brtson lags/ /'jig rten gnyis shar sman gdags slad/ /'jig rten las ni 'da' slad du/ /mun par gyur pa'i 'jig rten la/ /khyod kyis shes rab snang bar mdzad/ /de las tha dad med pa yis/ /rgyu bcas rgyu ni med pa yang / /'phags pa'i lam nas 1 'god mdzad dang —/ /khyod kyi 'jig rten la ston mdzad/ /yul la nye bar spyad pa na/ /lha min spyod pa tha dad kyi/ /khyod kyi longs spyod thun mong bas/ /khyod la dbye ba mi mnga'o/ /gang du rgyu ni med pa la/ /khyod kyis bstan par rab btsud na/ /de la thar pa'i rgyu bcas la/ /mdor bsdus pas na smos ci dgos/ /bcom ldan khyod kyis skyeb dang / /na tshod rigs dang yul dang ni/ /dus kyi skyon med chos rnams kyis/ /'di dag kun la sman yon btags/ /'di ni sman grodang 'di mchog ces/ /khyod kyi ltos gepa bsal nas ni/ /de ltar yon tan 'phags 'dren pa/ /'bad pas ji ltar bdag nyid bzhin/ /khyod kyi nyan thos sred thu bral zhing / /ya mtshan 'dzin pa med rnams la'ang / /lha rnams thal sbyar smon bgyid cing / /ya mtshan che ba lta bur mchod/ /bdag nyid 'jigs pas bde thob pa'i/ /yul dag spangs par gyur nas ni/ /'gran zla bzhin du gcig nas gcig /mchog tu rjes su 'brang ba byed/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas 'khor ba yi/ /nying khur gyur pa byung ba brjid/ /des na mi yang lha rnams kyikhru/ /smon par bya ba nyid du gyur/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dad pa las spobs pa skyes pa zhes bya ba las lam la du'ajug pa la bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u bcu pa'o// //1—553

mnyel dang zhi bde nyams gyur dang / /skyebo ngan dang 'grogs pa dang / /mi mthun pa dang mang po yi/ /skyon yang yon tan bzhin dgongs shing / /gzhan la sman pa mdzad la chags/ /thugs rje yis ni thugs bcings pas/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum gyis ni/ /khyod kyis sdug bsngal mi dgongs so/ /'gro ba'i don slad ma chags pa'i/ /thugs kyis brtson pa mdzad pa gang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi/ /chos nyid bcom ldan de rmad do/ /zhi gnas bde ba ma thob pa/ /sngon mdzad gang de ngo mtshar min/ /khyod kyis zhi gnas thob pa yang —/ /spangs pa'i mdzad pa ngo mtshar tokhya/ /bshos kyang phal pa gsol mdzad cing / /res 'ga' smyung ༅ba dag kyang mdzad/ /nyam nga'i tshul ⑤du'ang gshegs mdzad cing / /rad rod can du'ang mnal ba mdzad/ /slar yang phyag gi bdud rtsi yis/ /gzhan rnams la ni phan pa mdzad/ /de nyid kyis ni mi 'grang ba'i/ /mi srun spyod pas phal pa bzhin/ /mgon khyod gtso bor gyur lags kyang / /gdul bya rnams la byams slad du/ /sku ngas brdo dang gcam tshul dang / /skad dang cha lugs sgyur ba'ang mdzad/ /mang po'i rang don mthar thug dang / /de ni khyod kyi che ba lags/ /de la mngon 'dod don la yang / /de lta'i sdug bsngal sdom ④ pa mdzad/ /kun gyis dga' mgur rang don phyir/ /bran bzhin bskos par bsgrims pa lags/ /mgon khyod rtag tu bdag nyid la/ /mnga' ma mchis pa'ang ma lags so/ /lci dang cha lugs yang dgongs la'ang 3/ /de tshe khyod la ga la ste/ /gang phyir gzhan ma spangs nas kyang / /sdug bsngal ldan pa mthar phyin pas / /khyod la gang dang gang du yang / /ji skad skul ༅yang mi spong ste/ /nyid 1—554

kyi sgrub pa bzang po las/ /'da' bar 'gyur ba ma mchis so pha 'am yang na gzhan legs la/ /byams pa'am yang na snying rje yis/ /khyod yon phrag dog gis gdungs dang / /de bzhin rgyu med dgra bo la/ /ji ltar khyod ni gnod bgyid la//phan pa lhur mdzad de lta burgya// /skyebo dag ni phan bgyid la'ang / /phan pa de ltar lhur mi bgyid/ /nyes rtog gdon gyis zos pa ni/ /phyir zhing shin tu mi bzad la/ /mgon po rang sems rjes mthun pas/ /khyod kyi rgya nyes pa mthong ba la / /khyod ni gnod bgyid dgra bo la/ /phan pa mdzad pa'i bshes lags te/ /rtag tu skyon dag tshol ba la/ /yon tan 'ba' zhig tshol ba'ang lags/ /shin tu dge ba'i spyod ldan pa/ /mgo dang yid dang tshig dag gis/ /khyod ni phyag 'tshal mchod 'os la/ /rtag tu bdag ni phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyod ni gang na dug bcas shing / /zhugs dang bcas par spyan drangs pa/ /der ni brtser bcas gshegs pa dang / /khyod la bdud rtsi can du gyur rgya / /shin tu phan tshun 'gal ba can / /sems can rnams kyi log rtog pas/ /mi bskyod de la phan 'jug pa'i/ /thugs ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzod pas mi snyan brjod ༅pa dang / /'khu ba dag ni bde legs kyis/ /mi snyan smra la bden pa ste/ /khyod kyis sdang ba byams pas btul/ /dgra rnams la ni 'bad min pas/ /thugs kyis kyang ni rtag tu btul/ /bzlog la yang dag 'jog mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog ma med dus goms pa yisabye / /mi yi rang bzhin mang po yang —/ /khyod kyis ngan song rnam bzlog nas/ /skad cig nyid la yongs su bsgyur/ /shin tu bzang min khams tsam yang / /yun ring gis ni 'phel mdzad pa/ /sman pa'i spyod pa rjes 'jug pa/ /sman mchog khyod la phyag 1—555

'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dad pa las spobs pa skyes pa zhes bya ba las dka' ba mdzad pa la bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u bcu gcig pa'o // //rtsub po dang 'jam bgyid gyepa dang / /'jungs pa rnams ni gtong phod dang —/ /gtum pa des 5/par bgyis pa gang / /de rde khyod kyi thabs mkhas lags/ /rang rig rjes su mi gcod cing / /dge ba gong du 'dren byed pa/ /skyeb gzhan du mdzad pa'i phyir/ /dge mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dga' bo dbang po nyer zhi dang / /nga rgyal khengs pa 'dud pa dang / /sor mo'i phreng ba'ang zhi — bgyis na/ /su zhig ngo mtshar skye mi bgyid/ /shin tu mchog don mdzad slad du/ /dmu rgod rnams ni bde ba yis/ /shin tu ngo mtshar gyur pa yis / /'dul mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi chos kyis 'u ros tshim pas / /gser las bgyis pa'i mal spangs nas/ /ran mang gting 3ba'i gnas mal du/ /brtan rnams bsod nyams nyal bar bgyid/ /gzhan gyi dbang gis lus tsam ni/ /shin tu tshim dang rjes mthun min/ /gang phyir gzhan gyis tshim byed las/ /tshim mdzad mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /khyod kyis dus dang bsam mkhyen pas/ /res 'ga' zhus na'ang mi gsung la/ /spros 'gyur gzhan la bstan pa dang / /drung du gshegs nas bshad pa'ang mdzad/ /rgyu ༅ min mkhas pa ma yin phyir/ /thams cad du ni tshig mi 'grub/ /de ni shin tu spangs mdzad phyir / /bden gsung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri med gos la tshon bzhin du/ /thog mar sbyin sogs gtam dag gis/ /sems la spro ba bskyed nas ni/ /phyi nas 1—556

chos ni bstan pa mdzad/ /rig dang thabs la mi mkhas pa'i/ /tshig gis sems ni 'gug stomi 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi bye/ sems ni bkug mdzad nas/ /'chi med gsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /'khor ba mi bzad gting nas ni/ /'gro ba nyon mongs drang slad du/ /khyod kyis gang zhig ma stsal ba'i/ /thabs dngaspyod pa de ma mchis/ /kha cig pha rol 'dod slad du/ /brtson 'grus ldan la thabs mi mkhas/ /thabs mkhas brtson 'grus med pa las/ /'dren mdzad mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /sku yi cha lugs rnam mang dang / /gsung gis so so'i skad bzhin du / /gdul ba'i bsam pa tha dad pa/ /de dang der ni khyod kyis mdzad/ /gzhan gyi cha lugs sna tshogs ni/ /don med yang na gzhan gsod phyir/ /don ldan sku ni sna tshogs pa'i/ /don kun mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag kun kyang dag pa dang / /mi 'gal ba dang mchod 'os dang / /brjid dang lha mi rnams la ni/ /sman 'dogs bkur ba sha stag lags/ /phyi rol rnams kyi spyod pa ni / /gzhan gsod pa dang smod pa ste/ /bkra shis gzhan don du ldan pa'i/ /spyod pa mnga' khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /smra dang bgyid pa phal cher ni/ /legs pa rngo thogs 3 ma lags kyi/ /bden par gsung ba khyed la ni/ /de gnyis gzhan du gda' ba lags/ /gzhan gyi spyod pa mig 3 ni gzhan/ /nyon mongs phal cher 'khrugs pa yang / /spyod pa dang ni don mthun pa'i/ /legs gsung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag nyid dag pa 'ba' zhig gis/ /khyod kyis 'gro ba'i dpal zhing mdzad/ /'di ltar rnam pa 'di 'dra'i zhing / /'jig rten gsum na mchis ma lags/ /gal te dbye byed rnams kyi ni/ /'ba' zhig khyod ni smad gyur na/ /de bzhin dpag med dge ldan pa'i/ /sgor gyur khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog 1—0 57

med srid pa nyam ༅nga bar/ /snga nas gcig tu nyams pa yi/ /sems can kun la sman slad du/ /khyod ni de ltar brtson pa lags/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dad pa las spobs pa skyes pa zhes bya ba las mkhas par bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u bcu gnyis pa'o// //gang phyir mya ngan gyis nyams pas/ /ston pa rnyed par dka' ba yang /slar yang dka' la brtson ldan pa/ /khyod la rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi khyod drin lan lon pa'i/ /sgrub de mchis snyam mi bgyid de/ /skye bo gang dag mya ngan 'das/ /de dag gis kyang lan ma lon/ /rang don byed par bdag mchog cing / /de ltar gang gis rmad byung gsungs/ /thog mar ma thogs phun sum tshogs/ /ston mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi chos la gnas de dag /rang don kho na bgyid par bas/ /de yi slad du 'o brgyal gang / /de la lan go ci zhig lon/ /khyod ni sems can gnyid log pas/ /rgyud la gzigs pa'i zhugs co ༅ ba/ /bag med gyur pa rnams kyi ni/ /grogs bzang bag dang bcas pa lags/ /gti mug mnal ni bcom pa'i phyir/ /shin tu sad khyod phyag 'tshal lo / /snod dang snod min sogs dpyod phyir/ /'jig rten mayo la slar phyag 'tshal/ /khyod kyis nyon mongs gzhom pa bshad/ /bdud kyi ④g.yo dag bstan pa mdzad/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin mi bzad brjod/ /'jigs pa med pa'i phyogs kyang bstan/ /gal te gzhan gyis khyargyud rnams kyi/ /nyon mongs bdud las rgyal gyur pa/ /bdud kun las rgyal smos ci 'tshal/ /phan dgongs thugs rje can gyis ni/ /sems can rnams la bgyi 'tshal ba/ /gang zhig khyod kyis ma mdzad 1—558

pa / /gzhan go ci zhig mchis lags kye/ /mgon khyod grangs dang 'phags pa dang —/ /bla ma yan lag gnyen 'dun gyis/ /dgongs pa mdzad pa gang lags pa / /de phyir kun bdag la phyag 'tshal/ /gal te chos ni 'di dag kyang ①/ /spo ba zhig tu btub na ni/ /gdon mi 'tshal bar khyod kyi ⑤ni/ /lha ④sbyin la brten kun la'ang stsol / /yo kyi ⑤mdzad par mi spyod gang / /de ni nges par bgyid mi rigs/ /gnas ma yin las ldog pa dang / /gnas la zhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de slad 'gro la brda sprod pa/ /'gro ba'i mgon po khyod kyis ni/ /'di ni phan tshun byed pa po/ /med pa skad du nges par gsungs/ /yo kyis mi spyod pa yis kyang / /gang phyir ldog pa'i mi 'thad na/ /de phyir gnas skabs thams cad du/ /lta bcas khyod la phyag 'tshal ༅/ /'jig rten rnams la thugs brtse bas/ /yun ring sa steng dam chos bshad/ /'jig rten gsum phan 'dogs nus pa'i/ /slob ma dam pa'ang mang du bskrun/ /bskrun nas gdul ba'i khyad par gyis/ /bstan pa rgyas ni btab nas kyang / /mngon du btul ba'i tshogs kyang ni/ /mdzes bzang yan chad btul lags pas/ /de ④ko khyod la sems can gyi/ /bu lon lhag ma ci mchis na/ /chos kyi sku yis ma lus pa'i/ /'gro ba dag dang ldan khyod kyis/ /slob dpon khu tshur bcing min phyir/ /bu lon lhag ma gzhan ci mchis/ /'di ltar rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /sku gdung til 'bru bzhin blags nas/ /mjug tu'ang khyod kyis shin tu ni/ /dka' spyad yal bar ma dor ro/ /yang na gzugs sku'i mthar yang ni/ /sems can don mdzad nyid gzigs nas/ /nyid kyi bde la chags mi mnga'/ /de la ltos ⑤pa dor bar mdzad/ /gzugs kyi sku dang chos 'di dag /gzhan don kho nar mdzad do zhes//1—559

'jig rten yid ches dka' 'di la/ /nga kyis mya ngan 'das pa bstan/ /de ni spyod bzang mthar thug pa'i/ /sems can gzhan don mdzad pa nyid/ /gang zhig thog ma dbus mthar yang / /khyod kyis ma nyams nyid du 'khums/ /de slad chos sku ma lus pa/ /sras kyi mchog la gtad mdzad de༅/ /gzugs sku til 'bru ltar bshig nas/ /yo ni yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /de ltar thog ma dbus mtha' ru/ /chos gzugs sku gnyis bdag nyid kyis/ /sems can don la phan mdzad phyir/ /bu lon mi mnga' la phyag 'tshal/ /yoma'o gnas pa e ma'o tshul/ /e ma'o yon tan e ma'o sku/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni chos rnams la/ /ya mtshan mi che 'ga' ma mchis/ /tshul khrims dang ni bsam gtan rgyu/ /de'i 'bras gzugs dang gzugs med pa'ang / /gang phyir yo kyis ma dgongs te/ /de phyir bas ⑤min nga phyag 'a༅/ /phan 'dogs mdzad cing blta na sdug /sku gsung phrin las zhi gyur pa/ /ma la'ang sdang bar rab bgyid pa'i/ /rmongs pa mi bzad pa la gzigs/ /yo la sdang bar byed pa la/ /sman mdzad pa ni bsam mi nus/ /de sman mdzad pa bsam min pas/ /rtag tu khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams rgya mtshor rin chen gter/ /yon tan 'byung gnas chos kyi tshogs/ /khyod la sems can gang 'dud pa/ /de dag la yang phyag 'tshal lags/ /khyod kyi zhabs rdul gyis brgyan pa'i/ /yul gang de la'ang phyag 'tshal nas/ /dge ba'i bstan pa la mkhas pa'i/ /mtshan gyis brgyan pa smos ci 'tshal/ /mgon khyod yon tan mi bas kyang / /bdag gi zho sha bas 'tshal bas/ /des na 'jigs pa mchis slad du/ /glo ba la ni gcags shing mchis/ /khyod ni rang sangs rgyas kyis min| /nyan thos mchog gtso bos ma yin/ /byang chub nye ba'i byang sems kyis/ /1—560

rtogs mi 'gyur na gzhan ci smos/ /khyod kyi rang gi ngo bo nyid/ /tshad ma mchis la bsam mi khyab/ /bstan min grangs kyang ma mchis pa/ /khyod bdag nyid kyis mkhyen lags grang / /bsam min tshogs des phun sum tshogs thob pa/ /gzhan don spyod pa ngo mtshar dge las kyi/ /yon tan cha tsam brjod par bdag rmongs pas / /rang don dgongs pas mi nus par yang byas/ /mtsho chen chab ni bas par ma gyur kyang / /skyobo'i gdung ba rab tu zhi bgyid ltar/ /khyod kyi yon tan cha tsam ma sgrogs kyang / /bdag ni mchog tu glo ba dga' zhing mchis/ /btsun pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa'i drung du ni/ /rjod lanyung mdzes pa ma yin ci zhig 'gran/ /'o na'ang bdag ni mi shes pa yis spel/ /skye bo'i rna bar ji ltar 'jug par 'gyur/ /bdag gis thab la dad pas spobs skyes pa'i/ /dge ba'i ༄las 'di'i 'bras bu 'khrungs pas ni/ /ngan rtog rlung dmar 'tshub ༅ mas dkrugs pa yi/ /'gro ba'i sems ni rnal du gnas par shog /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dad pa las spobs pa skyes pa zhes bya ba las bu lon med par bstod pa zhes bya ba ste le'u bcu gsum pa'o// //spel mar bstod pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po sa ti gtsi ṭa dang / slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po dag gi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ku ma ra ga la sha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong bsod nams bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //1—561

bsdur 'bras re'u mig bstod tshogs(42)1—564

004 ༄/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bstod pa/khya/༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ sarba ta thā ga ta lto 〉 ༅/ bod skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bstod pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo / /bstan pa 'gro ba kun gyi ②mchog gyur cing / /gzhan don rdzogs mdzad pa la rnam par mkhas/ /nyon mongs sbrul chen kun du 'byin mdzad pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /zag bcas bag chags thams cad spangs gyur cing / /don kun de nyid nges par gzigs mdzad pa/ /skyodagu thams cad don la brtson gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /dam chos rin chen 'byung gnas snod gyur cing / /lam mchog mya ngan 'das pa ston mdzad la/ /yid la re ba kun du rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /'jig rten rnams la rjes brtser mngon par gus/ /byams dang thugs rje yongs su bsgos gyur cing de/ /kun don spyod 1—565

pa yongs su rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun la phyag 'tshal 'dud//kun don bsam pa yongs su rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /gdul bya'i padma 'byed pa'i spyan dang ldan/ /rgya chen slob ma dam pa'i yon tan bskyed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bskal pa mtha' yas tshogs ni bsags gyur cing —/ /tshangs dbang lha dbang rnams kyis phyag byas la/ /sku la 'dom gang 'od kyis brgyan gyur pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /nyes pa'i rtsa ba ma lus bcom gyur cing / /ye shes me yis dri ma'i shing bsregs la / /shes rab dam pa yongs su rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /nyon mongs bag chags bcas kun rnam bcom zhing / /grags pa chen po kun du grags gyur la/ /mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis kyis rnam par brgyan/ /padma lta bu'i spyan ni rab rgyas shing / /btso ma'i gser gyi phung po 'dra ba yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bsod nams rgya chen rmad byung 'di yis ni/ /bdag nyid nyon mongs bag chags bcas 'byin cing —/ /'khor ba'i nyon mongs rgya mtsho chen po 'dir/ /nub par gyur pa'i 'gro ba 'don par shog /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bstod pa rdzogs so // //1/de566

bsdur mchan/565 ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung lasablangaspote bkod cingan〈〈pe 〉〉de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bstod pa bzhugs so/〈〈snar 〉〉de bzhin gshegasapa thams cad la bstod pa bzhugag ②〈〈pe 〉〉skyo tram̐/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉bsgom gyur cingan〈〈snar 〉〉bsgos gyur cigabasdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/(43) 1wa 567

0044 ༄/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstod pa/khya༄4/ /rgyagar skad du/ bha ga wān shākya mu ni ⑤sto tra/ bod skad du/bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstod pa/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo / /'jig rten 'das pa 'jig rten sgron ma mdzad/ /nga ni 'jig rten don mdzad blo gros bzang / /snang ba brnyes shing nyon mongs dri bsal ba/ /'jig rten snang mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sbyin la dgyes shing stobs bcu'i mchog mnga' ba/ /gdul bya 'dul bzhin gdul bya'i pha rol byon/ /bcom ldan lha dang mi dang klus mchod pa/ /gdul bya'i mthar phyin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan mchog 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad cing / /'dom gang 'od ni gser gyi kha dog 'dra/ /dge ba mtshan gyi dam pa'i gzugs mnga' ba/ /srid gsum mtshungs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pha rol gshegs pas gzhan gyi tshogs rdzogs shing / /pha rol phas rgol tshogs 'joms mi g.yo ba/ /sems can gzhan 1—568

gyi sems dang spyod la mkhas/ /pha rol tshogs 'joms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra bcom rgyal po nyon bcil nyudri bsal ba/ /'tsho ba dag cing brtul zhugs tshul khrims gnas/ /lha yi lha mchog dri med dri bral ba/ /thugs rje mchog ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chu bo bzhi brgal ④bden bzhi'i bka' mchid gsung / /mig sbyin bdud rtsi chos kyi bka' mchid gro can/ /mnyam thugs 'gro ba kun la byams pa'i thugs/ /chos la mnyam gnas mi rnams kha lo sgyur/ /yon tan mthar phyin yo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs rnam par dag dang ldan / /tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs lta bur snyan pa'i gsung / /thams cad dbyangs kyi yan lag gsung tshul rdzogs/ /bden pa snyan gsung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong pa mtshan ma med cing smon dang bral/ /zab mo blta dka' shin tu rtogs par dka'/ /thar la 'jug par mkhas pa'i blo gros can/ /thar pa'i lam dgyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyu la brten pa'i mkhas pa blo gros can/ /mtha' gnyis lta ba rtag tu mi mkhas pa/ /las kyi 'bras bu rnam smin kho nar gsung / /lta ba'i mun bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang nas ma byon gang du'ang gshegs ma lags/ /rtag tu dben pa'i chos rnams rab gsung ba/ /smig rgyu sgyu bzhin nga yir ④mi mnga' ba/ /dge ba'i chos tshul khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyodang mi skye gang du skyes khyam lags/ /skyedang 'jig dang gang du mi gsal ba/ /chos kyi gnas nyid ji ltar gnas la gnas/ /gnas dang mi gnas rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo / /de bzhin kho na ba /༅ bzhin yang dag gsung / /rtag tu mi g.yo de bzhin nyid la bzhugs/ /ri rab rdo rje rgyal mtshan 'dra ba'i sku/ /mi g.yo ri rab mtshungs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstod pa slob 1—569

po 4 cho kyi kyi dza dzo sod na dkan ma ga gsum 'bangs sa ma da pa gas // //bsdur mchan/568 ①ma' byang 'di〈〈pe 〉〉ltar bkod zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ne/6 be ba be pe si la ba gi5 9 ①〈〈 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga ②〈〈 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kho la〈〈 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma 4〈〈 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skye/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ bsdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/ (44)‘1—570

༄/ /dpal ldan rje btsun byang chub chen po'i bstod pa/ ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṭīmādma hā bo rnyi bhas ra ga su sto 〉/ bod skad du / dpal ldan rje btsun byang ༅ chen po'i bstod pa/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad dkar spyan mnga' rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /thugs rje'i go 'phang thams cad mayo/ /shākya seng ge kun du bzang / /ston pa la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /dpal stug dpal ldan gtso bo ste/ /zhi mdzad tshul khrims phung po can / /zhi ba dpal ldan dpal mdzad pa/ /zhi ba'i sku mngar bdag phyag 'tshal/ /grub pa bdag med gsung mdzad pa/ /kha na ma tho'i gnas ma mchis/ /lugs mkhyen dri ma mi mnga'i bdag /rnyog mi mnga' la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'gran zla nga rgyal mi mnga' zhing / /rnam rtog mi mnga' de bzhin gshegs/ /nyon mongs kun gyis mi bsgul ba/ /spros mi mnga' la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sna tshogs dbang phyug rnam grol mayo/ /sna tshogs gzugs can rnam par 'dren/ /sna 1—571

tshogs mtshan rnams yang dag rdzogs/ /'dod chags bral la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gdul dka' 'dul mdzad sems can mchog /dag pa thub pa zas gtsang sras/ /bde gshegs legs rtogs zhi mdzad pa/ /dge bar grags la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rnyog pa las grol 'dod pa'i dgra/ /rnyog pa mi mnga' padma 'chang / /mdzes pa'i sku mnga' thugs brtse'i snod/ /padma'i 'od mngar bdag phyag 'tshal/ /blo gros chen po brtson 'grus che/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa po/ /mchod pa chen po bstan pa che/ /sgra gcan chen por bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rig dang zhabs ni phun sum tshogs/ /sna tshogs dbang po dri med 'od/ /rnam dul cha byad yangs pa can—/ /skyon dang bral la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'phags pa gtsang mdzad kun la sman / /gzhan gyis mi thub nyams mi mnga'/ /bdag dang gzhan la phan pa'i mgon/ /dpag med 'od mngar bdag phyag 'tshal/ /lha yi lha ste lha chen po/ /lha yis phyag byas zad mi mnga'/ /tshad mar gyur pa lha yi dbang / /lha rdzas gzugs mngar bdag phyag 'tshal/ /don dam mchog tu gsal mdzad pa/ /mchog gi dbang phyug dam pa ste/ /mchog tu gzhan la phan mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bdud bzhi'i dgra las rnam par rgyal/ /zhi ba zhi mdzad de nyid mayo/ /de nyid snying po rtag tu spyod/ /ded dpon la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /dbang po thul ba nyon mongs thul/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po skyes bu mchog /tshangs pa dam pa mchog gyur pa/ /bsod nams zhing la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'dod chags bral ba bcom ldan 'das/ /khyod kyi sku nyid la bstod pas / /dmyal ba'i me nang gnas pa rnams/ /bsil ba'i gnas ni thob gyur cig /1—572

dpal ldan rje btsun byang chub chen po'i bstod pa mchog sred kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa'o// // 'di yang gangs can skad nyid du/ /rje btsun sprul pa'i sku mchog gi/ /bka' bzhin zha lu lo tsā ba/ /dge slong chos skyong bzang pos bsgyur// //bsdur mchan/571 ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung lasablangasate bkod cing chosatshan 'di〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na mi 'dugabasdur 'bras re'u migabastodatshogs/ (45)1—573

0046༄༅/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa bcu pa/༅༄lngo/ / rgya gar skad du/ budha sta ba da sha bod skad du/ge/ sangs rgyas kyi tshu)bstod pa bcu pa/sti/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gi byang chub rgyu ni dang por bskyed pa las/ /'gro la rnam par phan phyir 'chi med thar mdzad de/ /yang dag 'bar ba'i 'od 'phro bdud las rgyal ba can/ /rgyal ba shākya thub la rab tu phyag bgyi'o/ /thub pa'i rgyal po dam pa gzhan gyi mgon po mchog /gcig tu brtson pas tshangs pa mchog la nges gnas shing / /so so'i blo can phas ⑤rgol lag ldan dbang por ni/ /ri dwags bdag po shākya thub la phyag bgyi'o/ /thub pa mar me mdzad la sogs la ༅mchog thob pas/ /'bar ba'i rin chen dam pa thor cog la 'chang ba'i/ /'dzin ma'i bdag po tshangs dang rgas med kyis bstod pa/ /sdig spangs shākya thub la rab tu phyag bgyi'o/ /thub pa rgya che'i 'od zer rgyan gyis ༅yongs su bskor/ /me chu'i yangs pa dag dang rab rgyas gsal ba'i 1—574

'od / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten yul la khyab par spro ba can/ /shākya thub la deng ༅bdag rab tu phyag bgyi'o/ /thub pa skyes mchog bden pa mchog tu ston pa po / / 'jig rten ༅lha dang lha min mya ngan 'das bgyid pa'i/ /thabs mdzad pa la cho ga bzhin du mkhas pa ste/ /dge 'os shākya thub la rab tu phyag bgyi'o/ /thub pa'i dbus su mngon dgyes thugs rjes gnas pa ste/ /ting 'dzin mchog gis 'dod dang drag po rnam rmongs shing / /mchog gi bim pa lta bu'i zhal sgros phul dang ldan/ /dam pa shākya thub la rab tu phyag bgyi'o/ /thub pa'i chos 'dzin pa las nad dang rims 'phrog cing / /zhabs zung dag la 'phrog byed cod pan gyis rab mtshan/ /zung 'jug ting nge 'dzin la rtag tu bzhugs pa yi/ /mchog sbyin shākya thub la rab tu phyag bgyi'o/ /thub pa seng ge dam pa mi yi seng ge mchog/tshangs pa mi mjed bdag pos mchog gyur gdugs bsgreng zhing / /nor 'dzin gtso mo'i re ba'i phyag gis mngon btud pa/ /phyag 'os shākya thub la rab tu phyag bgyi'o/ /thub pa zhi byed rnams kyi gtsug gi bde gshegs te/ /ma lus nyes pa spangs shing yon tan chu yi gter/ /mtha' dag skye bo'i sdug bsngal sel ba gter lta bu/ /sdig sel shākya thub la rab tu phyag bgyi'o/ /thub pa brtson pas 'gro ba'i don sgrub mdzad pa la/ /mkha' lding bdag po'i mgon te ltung gyur gye sems can rnams/ /yang dag 'dren zhing pha rol bde bar mdzad pa yi/ /ston pa shākya thub la rab tu phyag bgyi'o/ /dpal shākya thub pa'i bstod pa bcu pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //'di ni dpal nags kyi rin po che'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa ste/ paṇḍi ta chen po de nyid kyi bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i gye dra ri dra pa rgya mtsho'i sdes bsgyur ba'i 1—575

yi ge pa ni blo dang ldan pa byams pa kun dga'o①// //bsdur mchan/574 ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs te bkod ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 rgya gar skad gu bca sta ba da sha bod skad du/ khu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpal shākya thub pa'i/ ngu)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉/bzhugs/ ci'ur〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phag⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lag 2)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gli575 zhu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dad/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstan lag zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gtsug rgyan/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de lta bur/ ⑥ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpaṇḍi ta chen po de nyid kyi bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i/ rtso〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉da/576 nyu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—ba'i yi ge pa ni blo dang ldan pa byams pa kun dga'o//bsdur 'bras re(1 mibakabastod tshogs/ (46)1wa 576

༄/ /yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa/ha ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ gu ṇa thu a paryarnya sto 〉/thu/ bod skad du/yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo /rgyal ba'i yon tan mtha' mi 'tshal bas gal te khyod bsngags mi brjod na/ /'ga' yang khyod bstod mi bgyid khyod kyi 'byor pa 'gro bas rtogs ma mchis /gang slad 'gro 'dis khyod la bstod pa bgyis kyang nongs pa ma mchis pa/ /de slad don 'dir bdag ni blo gros rab tu chung yang brtson pa lags/ /srid gsum dag la phan brtson blo mnga' ngan song gnas na'ang bsngags par 'os/ /rang don smon pa'i blo gros can ni mya ngan 'das kyang ma lags zhes/ /de slad khyod ni 'khor ba'i 'jigs pas mi ldog brtan zhing mi g.yo bas/ /'jig rten skye zhing 'chi bas nyam co thag yongs su bskyab par brtson pa lags/ /srid pa'i 'gro ba dag tu sdug bsngal rnams kyis smas pa'i sems can la/ /bdag gi blo gros rtsub 1—577

pos sdug bsngal rnam mang de dang de bsgrubs pas/ /de phyir bdag gis de dag rnams la bde ba bskyed phyir bzod bya zhes/ /de slad khyod ni 'gro la zhi ba'i bde ba bskyed slad brtson pa lags/ /sems can gang dag ma rig ldongs gyepas bsam pa rgud pa'i blo gros can/ /pha dang bur gyur rnams kyis bdag la gnyen snyam byams pas phan btags pa/ /de dag btang nas gcig pu thar par byed pa bdag gi tshul min zhes/ /de slad khyod kyis 'gro ba mgon med nges thar bgyi slad smon lam btab/ /sngon chad 'khor bar sdug bsngal kun du myong gyur tshe na bdag la ni/ /gang dag yun ring ngo shes byams sems ldan pas lan brgyar grogs byas pa / /bde ba thob tshe de dag bkol nas ji ltar yongs su spyad bya zhes/ /de slad khyod ni bdud rtsi'ang sems can kun dang thun mong gsol bar brtson/ /mchog sbyin 'gro bar sems can rnams dang lhan cig longs spyod 'das dgongs nas/ /de dag nges par yongs su mi gtong bas na khyod kyi bstan pa ni/ /ji ltar khyod nyid ne tsor 'khrungs tshe ljon shing gzhon nu lags spyad pa'i/ /ljon shing rgas par gyur kyang yongs su mi gtong de ltar brtson pa lags/ /gang slad 'gro ba mya ngan ma du 'das mya ngan khyod 'da' blo ma byung / /bde gshegs go 'phang brnyes par nus pa ma lags de mi mdzad/ /de slad khyod ni kun mkhyen yon tan gter dag brnyes mdzad slad du brtson/ /stobs bcu'i yon tan bdag gir mdzad pa las gzhan khyod la phra mi mnga'/ /gang su la la dag gis bde gshegs go 'phang brnyes pa de dag kyang / /'di bas shin tu smad pa'i gnas skabs dag tu lhung kyi/ba byung ngo zhes/ /de slad khyod kyis nyam ngar lhung cheba'i tshe yang bdag nyid smad ma mdzad/ /bdag la smod pa mi rung skyes bu dar ba zhum par bgyid ma gyelags/ /1—578

gang slad gal te rang la rag las 'bad pas byang chub thob gyur na/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang rnyed dka' ma lags snyam du khyod kyi ༅ blo gros byung / /de slad khyod kyis nyam nga'i dus su'ang kun mkhyen smon lam brtan bzlog pa/ /dman la dga' ba rnams kyi tshig dag khyod kyis khyad du bsad par mdzad/ /nyon mongs chu bo rab 'khrug pa dang ngan 'gro kha dag rtag tu gdangs pa dang / /so so'i skyebo'i g.yo dang sdig pa'i grogs po rtag par rgyun du gnas pa dang / /thub rnams rnyed par dka' zhes de ltar sems zhum 'gro ba gtong ba'i rgyu/ /gang lags de nyid khyod kyi thugs rje rtag tu skyeba'i rgyur yang gyur/ /ji ltar 'gro ba rnams la khyod blo shin tu byams pa skye ba ltar/ /'jig rten 'di dag rang la'ang byams pa'i blo gros skye bar mi 'gyur la/ /'jig rten phongs pa'i gnas skabs gyur na bdag nyid dag kyang gtong bar bgyid/ /khyod ni shin tu nyam nga'i dus su'ang 'gro ba gtong ba bzhed ma mchis/ /gang zhig skye bo dman dang phongs pa re ba'i bsam ldan mthong na yang —/ /brtse med 'bras bu 'dod pas spyod ⑤gzhan yon tan dag dang ldan tshol ba / /bsam brlag 'u de ni sbyin pa byed kyang slong ba rnams dang mtshungs so zhes/ /de slad khyod ni thugs rjes slong ba rnams la sbyin par bzhed la zhugs/ /'ga' khruzhig rang nyid ma dul bzhin du rigs par ldan pa'i tshig smra yang / /rang gi tshig dang 'gal bar spyod pas gzhan dag 'dul bar mi nus zhes/ /khyod kyis dgongs nas de slad 'gro ba mtha' dag thugs la bzhag mdzad nas/ /re zhig bdag nyid ma dul ba nyid dul bar mdzad phyir brtson pa lags/ /gang slad mkhas pa rnams kyi mi dge'i las kyang zhi ba'i bde bar 'gyur mod kyi/ /'on kyang 'phags pas mi dge ba dag kun du bsten 'os ma yin zhes/ /de slad khyod ni 1—579

rtag tu rang bzhin yongs su dag pas sdig las log /ngan song 'jigs pas ma lags lha yi bde spyad bzhed ༅pa'i phyir ma lags/ /gang dag 'gro la mi lta bdag nyid zhi bar 'gro bar bgyi slad spyod bgyid pa/ /des kyang ci ste brtson pa ma bsten slan ༅chad bsam rdzogs mi 'gyur na/ /gang gis 'gro ba ma lus bsgral phyir brtson pa brtsams pas ci smon guzhes/ /de slad khyod kyis rang gi bde la ma gzigs byang chub slad du brtson/ /khyod kyis 'byor pa chung ba'i tshe yang sbyin par bzhed pa ma spangs la/ /bdog pa chung yang slong ba rnams la zhum mi mnga' ba'i thugs kyis stsal/ /dbang phyug chen po mnga' yang tshul dang 'gal ba'i tha snyad mi mnga' la/ /na tshod lang tshor gyur kyang 'dod pa rnams la thugs ni chags mi mnga'/ /khyod kyis thos dang blo gros che ba'i tshe na'ang bdag bstod ma mdzad la/ /'gro ba yon tan chung ba gzhan rnams kyang ni mthon por bkur bar gyur/ /yon tan tshogs la gnas tshe nyid kyi spyod pa nyes pa chung ngu'ang bzung ④ / /'gro ba dmu rgod rnams la rtsol ba mi mnga' bde bar gnas pas bzhugs/ /khyod kyi thugs ni srid dang nyon mongs skyo bas zhi la dgyes gyur kyang / /thugs rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i yon tan skye bo rnams dang rjes su mthun/ /byed pa ma gtogs gzhan gyis 'bras bu mi myong bar ni 3 khyod mkhyen kyang / /'on kyang sems can rnams kyi 'byor pa skyed slad bsod nams gter rnams bdar/ /khyod la shes rab la sogs yon tan gang dag rtag tu mnga' gyur pa/ /de dag khyod kyis 'gro ba dag gi don rnams nyid du nye bar spyad/ /de las khyod kyi bsod nams 'bras bu gzhan du mchis pa ma lags la/ /de dag 'gro ba'i 'byor slad yongs su bsngos kyang don ma mchis ma lags/ /khyod la gzhan la sman pa'i thabs dang 'bral ba'i dus 1—580

'ga'a'ang byung ma gyur/ /thabs chung ma gyur 'bras bu ma mchis ma lags 'bras bu chung ma lags/ /bsod nams chung ngu rtsom nga/ dag la khyod ni mngon dgyes ma lags la/ /bsod nams chu bo dag gis ngoms par ma gyur chab kyi rgya mtsho bzhin/ /mtshan mo ston sha'i zla ba nya ba'i mdangs kyis nyams dgar gyur pa dang —/ /rdzing bu utpal rgyas pa gnyid bral mig la rngom brjid byed rnams dang / /ri bo ljon shing me tog rgyas pa brgya yis rtse mo dkrigs rnams kyis/ /gzhan la gcig tu sman ༅dgyes ④khyod kyi blo gros phrogs par rngo mi thogs3 / /'jig rten sdug bsngal dag gis smad tshe khyod ni nyid la byams pa yis/ /yul gyi dga' bsten nyams su blang bya min zhes thugs rje'i blos mkhyen nas/ /gling bzhi'i dbang phyug mnga' yang yul rnams kyis ni thugs kyang mi phrogs la/ /khyod kyis gzhan sman lhur bzhes mdzad pas dus dag shin tu 'das par bgyis/ /phyug cing 'byor pa slong ba rnams kyis legs par spyad par ma byas dang / /dur khrod ljon shing me tog rgyas pa'i spyod kyis g.yur za mtshungs so zhes/ /de slad bsod nams dman pa'i 'byor pa dag la slong rnams mi spyod pas/ /khyod kyi dkor nor slong ba ma mchis pa ni thugs la gcags par gyur/ /gang zhig brtse med srid pas tshong ba bzhin du 'bras bu'i phyir btsal nas/ /de ni 'bras bu yang ni slong ba rnams la sbyin par spro ma mchis/ /gang gi slad du khyod kyi gtong ba rnams dus gzhan la sman gyur pa/ /de slad de yi 'bras bu'ang slong ba rnams kyis rang gi lag 'upar bzung / /ri ngos ljon shing 'bras bu ༅ pa dag tu bya rnams lta bu dang / /dgon pa'i rdzing bu bskyed shing bzang pos bskor bar ngal rnams ltar/ /'dzem med slong ba dgyes pa khyod la bag phebs 'byor pa 'tshal ba yi/ /slongs mo pa 1—581

dag kun nas myur bar mngon du lhags nas khya sdod cing mchis/ /dpal 'byor 'bangs dang btsun mo rang gi sha dang srog kyang gtong ba na/ /khyod kyis sras gzhon rab sdug ston zla tshes pa dri med gzugs ldan pa'ang / /slong ba rnams la gtong bar mdzad la brtson par gyur pa ji lta ba/ /de ltar gtong la goms pa khrod kyi thugs la brtan pa nyid kyang byung / /gang zhig thos par gyur na'ang 'jig rten 'di la gnod pa /rko skye'agyur dang / /gang yang khyod nyid kyis kyang yun ring sku nyams bzhes par mi spyod pa'i/ /spyod pa de dag khyod la goms pas dus su rang gi ngang nyid gyur/ /de slad yon tan dag ni yongs goms ma bgyis spel bar dka' ba lags/ /ji ltar sman pa gdon gyis zin la gdon rnams bsal bar bgyid slad du/ /rdeg cing tshig rtsub zob spyod kyang zin pa nyid la rdeg gyemi bgyid/ /de ltar khyod kyang nyon mongs nyid la brtse dang bral bas spyod mdzad kyi/ /'gro ba nyon mongs gyur pa la ni khyod nyid thugs rje mdzad pa lags/ /khyod kyis rtag tu yon tan nor lhag rnams la gus pas bsag phyapa mdzad/ /mnyam pa rnams la yon tan goms par bgyi slad byams pa'i thugs kyis spyad/ /dman la thugs rjes brtson pa mchog gis yon tan rnams bskrun te/ /'gro ba rnams la khyod kyis ji ltar rigs par legs par mdzad par zhugs/ /ji ltar ma ma rang lus sna tshogs thabs tshul mang po 'dzin bgyid kyang / /gzhon nu'i nad bsal ched lags dga' babyed ma lags lus phyir ma lags pa/ /de ltar khyod kyang brtson pa chen pos yon tan bdag nyid bskrun mdzad pa/ /'gro ba'i longs spyod ched lags grags dang gzhan dag zil mnan ched ma lags/ /khyod kyi blo gros gzhan la sman pa'i thabs mkhyen mdzad slad zhugs gyur pa/ /'di ltar khyod nyid 1—582

thugs rjes rnam pa de dag nyid la zhugs lags gda'/ /khyod ni brtson 'grus 'phags pas brtsal khyab che yang mnyel bar ma gyur pa/ /de gsum dag gis khyod kyis gzhan sman ma bsgrubs cung zad byung ma gyur/ /khyod ni 'bad rtsol chen po can gyi phrin las mnga' bar mi bzhed la/ /spyod pa shin tu rmad du byung ba gcig tu bsam yas 'di yang byung / /gang slad khyod kyi khyasems can ma mchis pa 'di thugs su chud gyur kyang / /'di ltar sems can don gyi slad du grangs med dus su'ang srid par bzhugs/ /gang slad shes rab don dam bstan khyacing snying rje kun rdzob ston gyemadzad pa/ /de slad don bzhin dgongs mdzad khyod la sems can mchis pa ma lags kyang / /gang tshe khyod ni stobs bcu bskyed pa'i thugs rje dag dang ldan gyur pa/ /de tshe 'gro ba nyam thag rnams la khyod byams bu la pha byams bzhin/ /'gro ba gtugs dang nyon mongs bas pas byang chub mchog thob ma mchis la/ /nyon mongs phyogs pas rang las 'u)sman par bgyid pa'ang thob 'gyur ma lags pas/ /de slad khyod kyis byang chub brnyes slad brtson 'grus brtan pa mdzad pa na/ /nyon mongs nges par ma bsregs ran gyi dum bu bzhin du spang bu bar mdzad/ /khyod kyi nyon mongs dran dang mkhyen pas bzung bas yon tan sna tshogs 'grub/ /nyon mongs spang 3 bar gyur pa byang chub rgyur yang nye bar 'gyur lags te/ /'di ltar de yis khyod blo shol gom ba yul can du yang ma bgyis la/ /'gro ba rnams su skyeb brgyud pa'ang yon tan rnams kyi zhing du mdzad/ /'gro ba nyon mongs gyur dang sdug bsngal brgya dag byung bas bcom pa yis/ /rtsol dang bral zhing mgon ma mchis pas gang dang gang du spyod bgyid pa/ /'gro ba de ni nyon mongs dgra thul khyod kyi thugs rjes spyod pa na/ /srid pa len dang stong du dang 1—083

gnas pa dag la mnga' dbang mchis pa lags/ /ci yang med pa'i skyemached kyi ni yul can phra rgyas rnams ① bcom nas/ /de dag spangs pa'i thabs tshul gang lags dam pa'i tshogs la yun ring bshad pa mdzad/ /sa gsum sman pa'i thabs mkhas mnga' ba khyod kyis phyir yang drangs nas ni/ /dud 'gro dag tu'ang smon pa mdzad nas skyeb brgya phrag rnams kyang mdzad/ /sngon gyi mi dge'i phrin las rnam par smin par ma nges gang lags pa/ /de dag dud 'gro'i 'gro bar gshegs la gzhol ba khyod la mnga' mchis pas/ /khyod kyis rnam smin ched du drangs te thugs la dgongs pa'i don bsgrubs pa/ /drang srong gis bshad gsang sngags zhi bas dug gi shugs dag bzlog pa bzhin/ /khyod kyis rtag tu mi dge'i chos dang g.yul dag spang /bar gyur pa na/ /'gro ba dar mdzad mkhas pa khyod kyis 'gro ba de dang der spyod pa'i/ /tshul khrims ma 'bad brtul zhugs ldan pa bzhin du gyur pa ji lta ba/ /de ltar dam pa'i spyod lugs byang chub sgrub pa dag la goms par mdzad/ /ma bzhin res 'ga'a'ang thugs rje dag dang ma bral mgon ma mchis rnams kyis/ /sdug bsngal de dang de dag bsal slad 'gro ba sdug bsngal can dag tu/ /bsnyengs dang bral bar spyod pa mdzad pa khyod kyi thabs la mkhas pa ni/ /bsgrub par dka' dang brnyes par dka' ba 'ga' yang byung bar ma gyur lags/ /gang slad sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro ba sdig pa bying 'dul khyod la ni/ /dud 'gro'i 'gro ba dag kyang bde 'gro bzhin du don chen kho nar gyur/ /ngan song dag tu 'khrungs na'ang legs par spyod pa nyams pa mi mnga' ba/ /de slad khyod kyi sdig pa'ang yon tan 'gyur bar dge ba nyid dang mtshungs/ /khyod la legs brten kha cig byang chub gsum la blo gros ci rigs zhugs/ /de bzhin gzhan dag bsam gtan gzugs 1—584

med dag la go 'phang gzhag ①pa mdzad/ /kha cig gtong bar zhugs shing nges tshul mchid kyis 'tshal gyur pas/ /khyod kyis 'jig rten dag la sman yon ma btags pa ni 'ga' ma mchis/ /khyed kyis 'jig rten dag na 'gro ba gang rnams nges par thar ①'tshal ba/ /bde 'gror nye bar drangs shing dge ba yongs su yo pa nyid du mdzad/ /khyod kyis 'gro ba zhi mdzad slad du 'gro ba rnams su spyod pa na / /drang srong chen po gzhan dag dus bzhin byung bas zhi bar mdzad pa bzhin/ /gang slad khyod ni 'gro ba'i skye ba bcad dang rdzogs sangs rgyas mdzad ma gtogs par / /gzhan gyis skyeb zhi bar mi 'gyur snyam du blo gros nges gyur pa/ /de slad byang chub gzhol ba'i thugs mnga' khyod kyis srid rtse man chad kyi/ /lam rnams tshul bzhin ston par mdzad pas dus dag 'das par gyur pa lags/ /gang zhig rtogs par ma gyur pa yis 'jig rten ma rig ldongs tsa gyur la/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal mang por rgyu zhing 'chi bdag mtshams las mi 'da' ba'i/ /'phags lam 'jigs med sngon gyi drang srong che rnams rjes gshegs gang lags pa/ /de ni khyod kyis 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal mthar gtugs slad du nyid kyis mkhyen/ /ji ltar dus mtha'i tshe na nyi ma du mas chab bskams 'jig rten 'di/ /zhugs chen mched pa khros pa lta bus thal ba dag kyang sreg bgyid pa/ /de ltar dregs bral khyod kyis nyon mongs bsrabs par gyur pa'i bag chags kyang / /ye shes zhugs chen 'bar ba dag gis nges par bsregs par gyur pa lags/ /gang dag sa gsum bla ma rnams la nges par gnas par 'tshal ba snye dag /mun pa chung ngu dang yang lhan cig gnas par 'gal ba gang lags pa'i/ /yon tan mtha' yas de dag mngon par sangs rgyas tshe na dus gcig tu/ /shing la bya rnams gnas 'cha' bzhin du 1—585
