༄/ /sangs rgyas dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i bstod pa/ ༅/༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ budha a snyi ṣe (gyeka nā ma sto tratsho/ bod skad du / sangs rgyas dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i bstod pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bskal pa grangs med gsum/ /pha rol phyin rnams rdzogs pa yi/ /thub pa lha rnams kyi ston pa/ /mtho ris nas ni mi nang gshegs//nyi ma'i rigs te zla ba yi/ /sa yi bdag po zas gtsang dang / /gtso mo sgyu 'phrul lha mo yi/ /mngal du nying mtshams sbyor bar mdzad/ /der ni rin chen khang gnas shing / /lha yi mchog rnams bstod byed la/ /de la gsung ni mthon po yis / /dam pa'i chos ni ston par mdzad/ /lha rnams thal mo sbyar byas te/ /dus gsum du ni der blta ba/ /rdul med mu tig phreng ba ni/ /bai ḍūrya yi snod gnas 'dra/ /bdud rtsi rab sbyin gzugs can te/ /de 'os lha mo mdzes par gyur / /zla ba shin tu gsal ba'am/ /mu tig 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'dra/ /'byung ba 1—670

rnams kyang dbugs 'byin cing / /yid la re ba'i don rdzogs mdzad/ /de ni 'dod la stsol ba ste/ /'dod pa thams cad phun tshogs mdzad/ /skyed mos tshal ni lumbi nīr༅/ /'jig rten gtso mo song gyur te/ /sa bdag dang ni mas rnams dang / /mdun na 'don dang lhan cig gnas/ /der ni mya ngan med pa yi/ /yal ga la 'jus brtul zhugs gnas/ /mkha' la lha yi bu mo rnams/ /zla ba dang ni skar tshogs 'dra/ /skar ma rgyal la bab pa na/ /de'i sras rtsib ma'i logs nas ni/ /'gro la phan pa mkhyen pa yi/ /nyi ma shar ba bzhin du byung / /mtshan mchog yang dag rdzogs pa yi/ /gtso bo nyid kyi sku yi 'od/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser 'dra yis/ /phyogs rnams rab tu snang bar gyur/ /brgya byin ma ma'i cha byad can/ /smin ma bskyod pas zlog rgyapa mdzad/ /sa la gom bdun bor ba na / /gter dang padmas brgyan par gyur/ /bdag gi skye ba tha ma ni/ /'di yin yang srid yod min zhes/ /snyan pa'i gsung ni bsgrags nas kyang / /phyogs rnams kun du gzigs par gyur/ /nyi zla rin chen bum pa las/ /dro grang chu yi rgyun gnyis ni/ /dri ma med pa'i nam mkha' las/ /de yi dbu la bab par gyur//bde gshegs 'gro ba'i bla ma ni/ /rin chen sna tshogs bkram pa yi/ /seng ge'i gdan ni mthon po la/ /dgyes pas der ni bzhugs par 'gyur/ /brgya byin gnas kyi chu bo dang / /'jug ngogs las blangs lha yi chu/ /gser las byas pa'i bum pa yis/ /lha rnams kyis ni dbang bskur bstabs/ /lha yi gos dang phreng ba dang / /bstod pa la ni brtson pa yi/ /tshogs rnams du ma 'dus pa yis / /lha yi tshal ni gang bar gyur/ /rnga sgra rnams dang ca co yis/ /mkha' dbyings ma lus khyab par gyur/ /nam mkha' las ni me tog char/ /rgyun mi 1—671

'chad par bab par gyur/ /masar ①me tog gcal bkram pas/ /gnas gtsang ma yi gnas ltar gyur/ /ga bur tsandan phye ma yis/ /'jig rten mgon la gtor bar gyur/ /ri bo rgya mtshor bcas pa dag /gar mkhan gyi ni gos ltar g.yo/ /bcud rnams sna tshogs 'dzin pa gi /sa dag rnam drug g.yos par gyur/ /bung ba rnams ni sgra sgogs shing / /dus rnams kun du byung ba gi /shing rnams rang nyid 'dud pa dang / /me tog rnams ni 'bor bar gyur/ /blon po rgan dang mdun na 'don/ /bkra shis dag ni 'don par byed/ /sa dang mkha' dang grub pa dang / /mi 'am ci dang lhan cig spyod/ /nags na gnas pa'i lha rnams dang / /lha dang grub pa rig 'dzin mi/ /nang gi slas kyi bud med kyang / /rab tu dga' bas gar yang byed/ /long bas mig dang 'on pas thos/ /lkugs pa rnams ni sgra gsal dang / /nad pa nad las thar ba dag /skad cig der ni thob par gyur/ /ri dwags bya dang sdig sbrul dag /phan tshun 'tshe bar 'dod pa yi / /sems can thams cad de yi tshe/ /rtsod med 'tshe ba med par gyur/ /de tshe gang yang sdug bsngal dang / /nyes spyod byung bar ma gyur to/ /'gro ba 'di dag nad med cing / /bde zhing lo yang legs par gyur/ /de tshe kun du'ang mdun du ni/ /gter rnams der ni byung bar gyur/ /de tshe srid gsum rgyas par ni / /dga' zhing bde ba dag tu gyur/ /rgyal ba dbang bskur bsod nams gang —/ /bsod nams ldan ②pa'i sems kyis ni/ /nyan par byed pa de dag la/ /phun sum tshogs kun lag mthil gnas/ /tshe dang nad med dbang phyug dang / /dgra zhi rgyas dang rgyal dang grags/ /rdzogs sangs yon tan sgrogs pas/ /dad pa'i mi yis thob par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i bstod pa 1—672

0054༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dpal rdo rje 'dzin gyi dbyangs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṭībadzra rnya ra se gri ti bha ga bān ⑤ sto tras/bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dpal rdo rje 'dzin gyi dbyangs/dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam med mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog chos can/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel/ /yon tan kun mnyam mtha' med dngos grub stsol④ / /dri med mi g.yo mnyam med mchog rab chos/ /sems can khams la rtag mchog grub stsol ba/ /dngos grub mnyam dang mtha' med dpe bral ba/ /mnyam pa'i dpe nyid nam mkha' la med de/ /yon tan shas phra'i chas kyang mtshungs ma yin/ /rtag tu dri med thugs rje'i shugs las byung / /smon lam grub pa 'gag med chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don sgrub lhur mdzad mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang / /dpag med mi dpogs gnas nyid legs rdzogs pa/ /bde gnas gshegs kyang 1—674

thugs rje'i spyod mi g.yo/ / 'jig rten gsum la mchog gi grub stsol ba/ /'gag nyid mi 'gyur e ma'o chos nyid bzang / /mchog stsol sbyin mchog nyid gnas chos nyid brnyes/ /'jig rten gsum rtag dam pa stsol mchog sgrub/ /bde gshegs dus gsum mkhyen sgrib mi mnga' ba/ /kun gyi dam tshig gsum mchog grub bdag stsol/ /bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dpal rdo rje 'dzin gyi dbyangs rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po bityā ①ka ra pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ //1—675

༄/ /bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dpal rdo rje 'dzin gyi dbyangs kyi rgya cher bshad pa/tu ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badzra dha ra se gri ta bha ga ba ti sto tra ṭī kā/bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dpal rdo rje 'dzin gyi dbyangs kyi rgya za bshad pa/ 'jam pa'i mgon khyal phyag 'a༅ lo/ /gang zhig bstod du blo bzang rnams kyi blo gros dang / /tshig gis 'dod pa'i ༅sa ldan 'jug pa mi rnyed ༅ / /'phags pa gsung 'jam yon tan nam mkha' mtha' yas shing / /dag pa lta bu de la rtag tu bdag phyag 'a༅/ /mnyam med mi g.yo mnyam nyid chos mchog can/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i bstod pa ni gtsor gsol ba gdab pa yang yin te/ 'di ltar mjug tu/ kun gyi dam tshig gsum mapo grub bdag ༅/ /zhes bstod do④/ /mchog gi dngos grub gsol ba gdab par 'os pa de dag kyang gang zhe na/ gang dag rang yongs su dag pa'i bdag nyid can brtse ba za po'i dbang du ༅ pa/ brtse ba'i lngos ba gnyis byed pa/ de'i rjes sa mthan pa'i sa sgo rig daring 1—677

yon tan dang ldan pa rnams yin te/ rnam par ma dag pa'i bdag nyid can rnams ni rang la phan pa'ang bya bar mi nus so/ /yongs su dag pa'i bdag nyid can yin yang snying rje chen po dang bral na gzhan gyi don chen po mtshar cig mi byed de / rang rgyal ba dag bzhin no/ /snying rje chen po dang ldan du zin kyang gal te de'i 'bras bu dang tumathun pa'i yon tan dang bral ba nyid kyis nus pa med pa'i phyir brtse ba'i 'bras bu gnod pa sel ba dang / phan pa bsgrub mipa mi byed na de'i tshe gsol ba gdab pa'i yul ma yin par gyur te/ sems dang bcas pa rnams ni bdag nyid rdos non pa dbyung ba'i phyir/ 'phye bo dang long ba la sogs pa la gsol ba 'debs par mi byed do/ /de bas na yongs su dag pa'i bdag nyid can nyid shes par bya ba'i phyir/ mnyam med mi g.yo mastom nyid chos mchog can/ /zhes bya ba 'di gsungs so/ /brtse ba'i ngang du gyur pa nyid bstan pa'i phyir/thugs rje'i bdag nyid ces bya ba 'di gsungs so/ /thugs rje'i 'bras bu gnyis mdzad pa nyid brjod pa'i phyir/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel zhes bya ba dang /yon tan kun mnyam mtha' med dngos grub stsol/ /zhes bya ba 'di gsungs so/ /brtse ba'i 'bras bu gnyis dang mthun pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa nyid rab tu bstan pa'i phyir/ dri med mi g.yo mnyam med mchog rab chos/ /zhes bya ba 'di gsungs te/ 'di ni bsdus pa'i don yin no/ /tshig rnam par dbye ba ni/ de ni mnyam pa med pa'ang yin la mi g.yo ba'ang yin pas mnyam med mi g.yo ba'o/ /de ni mnyam pa med pa dang mi g.yo ba'ang yin la mnyam pa nyid kyang yin pas de skad ces bya ste/ mnyam pa nyid de lta bu de nyid mchog chos yin no/ /de gang dag la yod pa de dag la de skad ces bya ste/ 'dis ni de bzhin gshegs pa 1—678

rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyi chos kyi sku nyid bstan to/ /de la mnyam pa med pa ni glo bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag dang bral te rnam par dag pa'i mthar phyin pas dpe med pa'i phyir te/ su dang yang mnyam zhing mtshungs pa med pa'am/ 'di dang mnyam zhing 'dra ba 'ga' yang med pas na mnyam med do/ /'dis ni de bzhin nyid phyin ci ma log par yongs su dag pa bshad do/ /g.yo ba ni gzhan du 'gyur ba'o/ /g.yo ba med pas ni mi g.yo ba ste/ dus thams cad du gnyis su med pa'i chos nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa las mi 'da' ba zhes bya ba'i don to/ /'dis ni mi 'gyur bas yongs su grub par bshad do/ /mnyam pa rnams kyi ngo bo ni mnyam nyid de—/ dngos po 'ga' yang stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin las mi 'da'o/ /de'i phyir rang bzhin 'dis chos thams cad stong nyid du ro gcig cing mnyam mo/ /'di ni mchog kyang yin la chos kyang yin pas mchog chos te/ rtog ge dang lung gsal bas shes par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin nyid rigs pa dang ma bral ba yin no / /de ji lta zhe na/ rig par bya ba dang rig par byed pa'i mtshan nyid dang bral ba nyid 'dzin pa'i phyir te/ de 'dzin pa nyid kyi phyir chos kyang yin no/ /rnam pa gcig tu na mchog chos kyi mchog ste/ de ni rnam par bsgoms na sgrib pa thams cad spong ba'i phun sum tshogs pa'ang 'dren la yon tan ma lus pa'i 'byor pa'ang thob par byed do/ /yang stong pa nyid ni sems can gyi tshogs thams cad la'ang khyab na/ ci'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kho na'i chos kyi sku zhes bya zhe na / shin tu rnam par dag pa nyid kyis de dag gi rgyud kho na la gsal ba'i phyir te / gzhan dag la ni sgrib pas bsgribs te mi gsal bas med la dang ①'dra'o/ /gang dag la thugs rje'i bdag nyid ngo bo nyid yod pa de dag ni thugs rje'i bdag 1/de679

nyid can te/ de dag gi de ni bskal ba grangs med pa mi nyung bar rab tu gus par goms pa brgyud pas shin tu ngang du gyur pa yin no/ /'gro ba'i zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten gyi'o/ /sdug bsngal ni ci yang rung ste mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga'i rang bzhin no/ /gang dag la de sel cing 'dor ba'i ngang tshul yod pa de dag la de skad ces bya ste/ de dag gis bstan pa'i bsgoms pas sdug bsngal ma lus par ldog pa'i phyir ro/ /mnyam pa ni 'dra ba'i dngos po'o/ /mtha' ni mthar thug pa'o/ /stobs dang byang chub kyi yan lag la sogs pa'i yon tan gang dag yin pa kun la mnyam pa dang mtha' med pa de dag ni mnyam mtha' med pa'o/ /dngos grub ni yongs su grub pa'o/ /gang dag de stsol ba'i ngang tshul yod pa zhes tshig rnam par sbyar te 'gro ba la zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan dpe med cing khye so sor tshad med pa gang dag yin pa de dag stsol ba zhes bya ba'i tha tshig ste/ de dag gis bstan pa la nan tan byas pas 'gro ba mtha' dag la phan pa bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i phyir ro/ /de nyid kyi phyir kha cig ni/ yon tan kun rdzogs med pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /zhes 'don to / /kha cig ni/ yon tan kun mnyam mnyam med dngos grub stsol/ /zhes 'don to/ /'di ni gzhan bsgrim mi dgos par grub pa nyid du bstan pa'i phyir phan pa bsgrub pa'i mchog bstan par zad de/ mngon par mtho ba'i ngo bo 'khor los sgyur ba nyid la sogs pa phan pa gzhan yang stsol bar mdzad pa nyid do/ /dri med mi g.yo zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshig rnams ni khyad par gyi tshig bsdu ba yin te / gang dag la gzhan la phan pa'i rgyu phun sum tshogs pa so so yang dag par rig pa la sogs pa'i chos de lta bu mnga' ba de dag la de skad ces bya'o/ /de la 1—680

dri ma med pa ni rnam pa thams cad rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /mi g.yo ba ni yongs su mi nyams pa'i chos nyid kyis sam/ 'khor ba ji srid par gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /mnyam pa ni snga ma bzhin du dpe med pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /mchog gtso bo/ 'jig rten las 'das pa/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i chos rnams kyi rab ni mchog rab ste/ ma 'dres pa yin pa'i phyir gtso bo rnams kyi yang gtso bo zhes bshad pa yin no/ /yang na chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa la dmigs pa'i phyir gang dag la yul mchog rab yod pa ste/ de dag ni de rang rig pa'i ngo bo yin no/ /gzhan dag na re mchog ni don du gnyer bar bya ba'o/ /rab ni thams cad pas phul du gyur pa'i phyir ro zhes zer te/ 'dir tshig gi mdo ni de lta bu'i bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis mchog gi grub pa bdag la stsol cig ces bya ba yin te/ tshigs su bcad pa dang po dang tha ma 'di gnyis kho nar mngon par 'dod pa'i don gyi de kho na nyid thams cad rdzogs pa nyid du bstan to/ /'di las gzhan tshigs su bcad pa gsum ni klan ga ngan pa yongs su spang ba'i ched yin no/ /de la klan ga ngan pa ni 'di yin te/ ji ltar na mnyam pa nyid dang /so so yang dag par rig pa la sogs pa'i chos rnams mnyam pa med pa yin2 /'di ltar 'di dag dang mnyam pa nam mkha' rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa tshad med pa yod pas de nyid kyis 'di dag gi dper byas te/ ji skad du de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i mdo las/ su dag sangs rgyas chos rnams la/ /dper byed pa ni ji snyed pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas 'tsham min pas/ /'dren la skur pa 'debs par zad/ /de la gcig pu dper gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas chos dang mnyam rgyapa gang / /nam mkha'i khams su bstan pa ste/ /de la tshad ni gang na'ang 1/de681

med/ /nam mkha' ji tsam thub pa yi/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang //ye shes rnam grol ye shes gzigs/ /'di yang de tsam kho nar bshad/ /ces gsungs pa lta bu yin no/ /de ①bas na dpe med pa nyid mi 'grub po zhe na/de'i phyir/ mnyam pa'i dpe nyid nam mkha' la med de/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'di gsungs so/ /nam mkha' ni nam mkha' ste de dpe nyid du brjod par 'dod na yang bcom ldan 'das rnams la mnyam pa'i dpe nyid do/ /gang dag mnyam pas dpe yin pa de dag ni mnyam pa'i dpe'o/ /de dag gi ngo bo ni mnyam pa'i dpe nyid do/ /re zhig de yang med na lhag pa'i dpe nyid lta zhig ga la yod/dman pa'i dpe nyid ni mi dgag go/ /nam mkha' ji lta bu zhig ce na/ yon tan shas phra'i chas kyang mtshungs ma yin/ /yon tan gyi shas ni shas chung ngo / /de'i phra mo ni shin tu phra ba'i cha'o/ /de'i yang cha ni gang phan chad blos kyang dbri bar bya mi nus pa'o/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyi gnas skabs na yod pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi shas ni che ba dang / mi zad pa la sogs pa'i yon tan gang yang rung ba 'ga' zhig go/ /de'i phra mo ni de rtsom par byed pa'i rgyu'i gnas skabs na yod pa sa bcus bsdus pa'i yon tan no/ /de'i cha ni mos pas spyod pas bsdus pa'i byang chub kyi sems skyob thams cad do/ /cha de dang yang mtshungs pa ma yin zhing 'dra ba ma yin te/ 'di ni mnyam pa'i dpe nyid med pa'i rgyu yin no/ /ji ltar de dang yang nam mkha' mtshungs pa ma yin zhe na/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can khams la rtag mchog grub stsol ba ste/sems can gyi khams ni tshogs so/ /de la mchog gi ②grub pa stsol ba ste/ mchog ni stobs dang byang chub kyi yan lag la sogs pa'i yon tan no/ /de dag gi grub 1—682

pa ni yongs su grub pa ste/ gang dag la de skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du stsol ba'i ngang tshul yod pa de dag la de skad ces bya'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'du ba'i rgyud las ni/ /sems can khams la mchog grub gsal sgrub pa/ /zhes 'byung ste/ de la dan ①ni gang dag la sems can gyi khams la skal ba ji lta ba bzhin mchog grub pas gsal zhing khyab pa de sgrub pa'i ngang tshul yod pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /ci'i phyir de dag de lta bu yin zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag ni dngos grub mnyam dang mtha' med pa can yin no/ /de dag la rang gi yon tan yongs su grub pa mnyam pa med pa'i mtha' med pa yod pas gzhan la'ang rang dang mthun pa kho na'i 'bras bu mngon par sgrub par mdzad do/ /de'i phyir de dag ni dpe bral yin no/ /de ni dpes mtshon par bya ba la de la yod pa'i yon tan brjod par 'dod pa dang cha mthun pas rab tu sbyor ba yin te/ ji skad du/ yul dang dus dang bya ba la//sogs pas 'gal ba'i dpe yin na/ /mtshon pas bya ba dpe dang ni/ /'dra ba gang yin de dpe yin/ /zhes bshad pa lta bu'o/ /'di ni bcom ldan 'das rnams yon tan thams cad mnyam pa dang mtha' med pa'i dngos grub stsol ba nyid kyis dpe med pa nyid du brjod par bzhed pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi ༅ yon tan ni gal te cha shas dang bcas pa zhig tu gyur na de dag gi cha shas dang cha shas kyis kyang rtag tu sems can gyi khams la mchog gi dngos grub stsol bar 'gyur ba nyid na/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i gnas skabs na yod pa'i ༅yon tan rangs pa'ang / tshogs pas lta smos kyang ci dgos/ nam mkha' 'am gzhan yang rung ste/ tshad med pa yin yang gang gis na bcom ldan 'das kyi dper 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos can ma yin gyi/ tshad med pa tsam zhig tu mtshungs pa la dgongs nas 1—683

mdo las/ de la gcig pu dper gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas chos dang mnyam pa gang / /nam mkha'i khams su bstan pa ste/ /de la tshad ni gang na'ang med/ /ces nam mkha' dang 'dra ba 'di man chad de skad du gsungs par zad do/ /klan ga ngan pa gzhan yang gal te sa gsum gyi bla ma rnams thugs rje'i bdag nyid can yin na/ des na ji ltar dri ma med pa'i chos can yin/ snying rje ni sems can rnams sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa rnam par rtog pa'i bdag nyid yin pas de dang ldan na skabs med do/ /de nyid kyi phyir 'di ni bde ba 'gog pas na snying rje zhes bya'o/ /rnam par rtog pa yang thams cad rang gi rnam pa la phyi rol gyi ngo bor zhen nas zhugs pa yin pa'i phyir rang bzhin kho nas phyin ci log pa ste/ ma rig pa yin no zhe na/ de'i phyir 'dir/ rtag tu dri med thugs rje'i shugs las byung —/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos so/ /rtag tu dri med ni rtag tu dri ma med pa ste / smon lam grub pa zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ /thugs rje'i shugs ni byeng chags pa ste/ bar ma chad par 'byung ba nyid do/ /de las byung ba ni yang dag par byung ba'o/ /smon lam ni byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs na yod pa'i༅/'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces yid la spyon pa'o/ /de grub pa ni 'bras bu ste thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do/ /de lta bu zhig ci zhe ༅na/ mi 'gag chos nyid de/ chos nyid kyi rang bzhin gang la 'gag pa ste rgyun chad pa ② med par yod pa de ni mi 'gag pa chos nyid do/ /smon lam grub pa gang la mi 'gag pa'i chos nyid yod pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ /smon lam grub pa de'i 'bras bu ci zhe na/ 'gro ba'i zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so/ /'gro ba'i don ni phan pa ste/ bde 'gro gnyis 'thob pa dang / 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal 1—684

thams cad ldog pa'o/ /de bsgrub pa ni 'grub pa'o/ /de lhur mdzad pa ni der gzhol ba'o/ /ci de yul dang / dus kyis ༅mtshams so sor nges pa zhig yin nam zhe na/ ma yin te/ mtha' yas pa'o/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i yul dang dus mtha' yas shing ma lus pa yin te/ gang la de yod pa de la de skad ces bya'o / /gang dag la thugs rje chen po'i bdag ngo bo nyid dam rgyu yod pa de dag la de skad ces bya'o/ /de lta bu de ni rtag tu sprul pa sna tshogs kyi 'od zer gyi dra ba 'gyed pa la sogs pas rnam pa sna tshogs su snang zhing mdzes so/ /rtag tu zhes bya ba ni nye bar mtshon pa ste phyogs thams cad du yang zhes bya bar yang khong du chud par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'du ba las ni bdag nyid chen po'i thugs rje rtag rnam snang zhes 'byung ngo / /der ni tshig 'di thugs rje'i shugs las byung zhes bya ba 'di nyidani mjug ②sdud pa yin te/ gang dag la rnam par mi rtog kyang gzhan la phan pa mdzad pa rgyun mi gcod pa nyid kyis bdag nyid che ba yod pa de dag la de skad ces bya'o/ /'dir bsdus pa'i don gyi de kho na nyid ni 'di yin te / byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs na yod pa'i snying rje sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las yongs su bskyab par 'dod pa'i ngo bo rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa gang yin pa de ni rnam par rtog pa'i dra ba ma lus pa dang bral ba rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis 'phan rje par byed pa yin no/ /de bas na rgyu dang 'bras bu mi dbye bar nye bar btags pa'am 3/ bdag ces bya ba'i sgra rgyu'i rnam grangs yin pa'i phyir thugs rje'i bdag nyid ces bya'o/ /rnam pa gcig tu ni rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa'i snying rje de nyid bsgom pa mchog gis goms pa dang ldan pas 'bras bu sems can gyi rnam par rtog pa med par 'byung bar 'gyur te/1/de685

'dod pa dang mya ngan la sogs pa goms pa bzhin no/ /de dag gi snying rje de༅ni dmigs pa med pa/ phyin ci ma log ②pas don dam pa ba/ rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba/ ngang du 'gyur ba yin pas/ rje'i bdag nyid ces kyang bya ba la/de ni de 'phen par byed pa sngon 'byung ba'i chos kyi ming dang mthun par snying rje zhes kyang bya'o/ /gnas skabs des ②na ni mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir tshig thams cad kyi spyod yul ma yin te/ mi brjod du mi rung ba'ang 'dir 'di skad ces gang zhig rnam par mi rtog kyang yul ④dang dus thams cad du med pa thams cad du 'gro ba mtha' dag gi don mdzad cing / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po bas kyang lhag pa'i chos de 'ga' zhig yod do zhes bstan par bya bar zad do/ /'di nyid la glan༅ka ngan pa ji ltar na 'di smon lam grub pa mi 'gag chos nyid can yin/ ji ltar na mtha' yas pa'i bdag nyid chen po'i thugs rje rtag rnam snang ba yin te/ 'di ltar skyob pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'das na 'di thams cad kyang rjes su 'gro ba med par rgyun 'chad do zhe na/ de'i 'gag nyid mi 'gyur zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos so/ /'gag pa ni rgyun 'chad ④pa'o/ /'gag pa nyid 'gag nyid do/ /'gyur ba ni 'gro ba ste 'gyur ba zhes bya ba'i don to/ /gang zhig ce na/ thugs rje'i spyod pa ste thugs rje rnam pa gnyis sha'i'o/ /spyod pa ni spyod pa ste de nyid thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do/ /ci'i phyir mi 'gag ce na/ 'di ltar de ni mi g.yo ba ste/bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa yin pa'i phyir 'khor ba ji srid par 'byung ngo zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de lta yin pas de dag ni 'jig rten gyi khams gcig tu mya ngan las 'das pa nye bar bstan nas gzhan du skye1—686

ba la sogs pa nye bar ston pa nyid do/ /ji lta bu zhig ce na/ /'jig rten gsum la zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten gsum po la'o/ /mchog ni sangs rgyas kyi chos la sogs pa'o/ /grub pa ni yongs su grub pa ste de stsol ba'o/ /gang dag tu 'gag par mi 'gyur zhe na/ dpag med mi dpog par te/ gang dag la yon tan gyi tshogs ༅yongs su dpag tu med cing 'di tsam zhes yongs su chad pa med pa yod pa de dag ni dpag med de sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams so/ /de dag gis kyang midapog pa thu ste/ dpag tu med pa de dag kho na phan tshun 'di dag ni yon tan phun sum tshogs pa 'di tsam dang ldan no zhes bya ba du mi dpogs pa de dag tu nam yang rgyun 'chad ④par mi 'gyur ro/ /gnas nyid legs rdzogs pa/ bde gnas gshegs kyang zhes bya ba ni gnas gang la legs par rdzogs shing mthar phyin pa yod pa de ni legs rdzogs pa ste phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa nye bar ston pa'i gnas skabs so/ /'dir yang rang gi don nyid kyi rkyen yin no/ /de nyid bde gnas yin te 'di la gzhan la phan pa mdzad pa'i spyod pa yod pas so//'di ltar mya ngan las 'das pa nye bar bstan pas ni lus dang de'i longs spyod dag bstan par nga rgyal byed pa rnams kun du skyo ba babyed pas btul lo/ /'di ni 'di ltar mya ngan las 'das pa rnams kyang mdzad pa'i rgyun mi chad do zhes theg pa chen po'i tshul la ma goms pa rnams la mchog tu ya mtshan bakhyed pas de dag gi bsam pa'i ngor e ma'o chos nyid bzang zhes bya ba gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos nyid rang bzhin ni /da shin tu rmad du byung ba'i phyir bzang po yin no/ /theg pa chen po'i ngang tshul du gyur pa rnams la ni ya mtshan mi che ste / mya ngan las 'das pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /la la las ni bde gnas zhes bya 1—687

ba mi 'byung ste/ der ni sdeb sbyor mi tshang bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na nges pa med pa'i phyir brdar btags pa'i don la mngon par zhen par khya mi bya ste/ ji skad du/gdags pa brda rgyus byung ba ste/ /de yang smra du po'i 'dod rgyu'i ༅byung / /tha snyad don du byed pa ste/ /sdeb sbyor sgra yi cha ming bzhin/ /zhes bshad pa lta bu'o/de ni gsol ba gdab pa mchog stsol zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i 'bras bu mchog skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du sems can rnams la stsol bas na mchog stsol lo/ /'di yang gsol ba gdab pa'i rgyu yin te/ rtog pa dang ldan pa rnams ni sbyin pa po dag kho na la slong gi/ 'byor pa bdog kyang 'jungs pa rnams la ni ma yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das rnams ji ltar 'byor pa dang ldan pa yin zhe na/ sbyin mchog nyid gnas mchog nyid brnyes/ /zhes bya ba gsungs so//sbyin pa ni zang zing dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / chos sbyin pa'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad do/ /gang dag la 'khor gsum yongs su dag pas sbyin pa mchog shin tu yongs su dag pa de dag ni sbyin mchog can no/ /de dag gi ngo bo nyid ni sbyin mchog nyid do/ /gang dag la gnas mchog ste dbang phyug gam/ go 'phang ngam/ rtogs pa yod pa de dag ni gnas mchog can te/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams so/ /de dag gi ngo bo ni gnas mchog nyid do / /de nyid thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de sangs rgyas kyi sa kun du 'od yin no/ /sbyin pa mchog nyid kyis gnas kyi mchog nyid kyi ni sbyin mchog nyid gnas mchog nyid do/ /de brnyes pa ni de'i bdag nyid du bsgrubs pas thob pa ste/ ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su dag pa'i rgyus sangs rgyas nyid bsgrubs pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /yang na mchog gi sbyin pa sems can rnams la sbyin pas na sbyin pa 1/de688

mchog go/ /des na rang gi don gyi rkyen yin no/ /des gnas mchog nyid skyes pa ste gnas la phan pa byas pa kho nas go 'phang de bsgrubs / pa dang ldan pa'o/ /mchog sbyin zhes spyir smos pas mchog ngan ngon tsam sbyin pa tshangs pa la sogs pa dang yang mtshungs par shes par 'gyur bas yang / 'jig rten gsum rtag dam pa stsol mchog sgrub/ /ces bya bas khyad par du mdzad de 'jig rten gsum pa la'o / /'bras bu mchog sgrub cing 'grub 3/par mdzad pas na mchog sgrub pa'o/ /dam pa stsol ba sa bcu pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyi nang na mchog sgrub 'a)pa gang yin pa dag ni dam pa ༅stsol mchog sgrub pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'du ba las ni mchog gi dngos grub stsol zhes 'byung ste/ der ni mchog sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi dngos grub yongs su grub pa de stsol ba zhes rnam par bshad par bya'o/ /bde gshegs ni rab tu zhi bar phyir mi ldog par ma lus par gshegs pa'i phyir ro/ /gang dag la dus gsum la thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i mkhyen pa'i blo mnga' ba de dag la de skad ces bya ste/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar dag la thogs pa med pa'i ye shes gzigs pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de'ang ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag ni sgrib pa mi mnga' ba'o/ /sgrib pa ni chod cing sgrib par byed pa ste/nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa zhes bya ba gang yin pa'o/ /gang dag la de dag spangs pa'i phyir med pa de dag ni sgrib pa mi mnga' ba ste/'di ni bde bar gshegs pa'i 'bras bu yin no/ /la la las ni mgon po zhes 'byung gi bde bar ⑦gshegs zhes mi 'byung ngo / /der ni sdeb sbyor nyams te lan yang snga ma yin no/ /mgon po ni sa gsum gyi rje'o/ /kun gyi zhes bya ba ni phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa rnams so/ / dam tshig 1/de689

gsum mchog ces bya ba la sogs pa la1/ dam chig gsum zhes bya ba ni⑤/dam tshig gsum pa'i rgyud la brtson pa bdag la'am/ de las gsungs pa'i mchog gi dngos grub bam/ de rtogs pa'i rgyu mtshan bdag la stsol cig pa'o/ /rgyud gang las dam tshig ste nges pa gsum po sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun la dang ba'i bdag nyid 'byung ba de ni dam tshig gsum pa'o/ /yang na dam tshig ⑤gsum ni/ don kun grub par bya ba'i phyir/ /byang chub sems yongs mi gtong dang / /thub pa'i brtul zhugs brtan ⑤pa dang / /de nyid shes pa btsal ba spyad/ /ces bya ba 'di dag yin te/ rgyud 'di nyid lasazar rung ba nyid du ༅/ gang gi byang chub sems brtan zhing / /blo gros chags pa med gyur pa/ /de la 'di ni nges 'grub ste/ /the tshom nyid ni mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyi mchog ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /yang na rig sngags 'chang dang / 'khor los sgyur ba nyid la sogs pa'i dngos grub thams cad kyi nang na mchog gi dngos grub ste/ de nyid thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do/ /de grub pa ni yongs su grub pa ste mngon sum du byar rung ba nyid du sgrub pa de bdag la myur du stsol cig pa'o/ /gsang sngags bdag pos gsungs pa bstod pa'i rgyal po nyid/ /rnam par phye las bsod nams rgya chen gang thob des/ /sems can rnams myur 'jam pa'i mchog la brten nas ni / /bstod pa 'di lta bu yis nga snod du rab gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa dpal rdo rje 'dzin gyi dbyangs kyi rgya cher bshad pa mang du thos pa'i slob dpon zhi ba 'tsho 'phags pa 'jam pa'i mchog gi zhabs kyi padma'i rdul la brten 1/de690

0056༄/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga la bstod pa/ 3 ༄lngo/ /rgya gar skad du/ pañtsa ta thā ga ta sta balnga / bod skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga la bstod pa/ gsung gi mnga' bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten gsum mgon yon tan mtha' med pha rol phyin/ /'o ma'i mtsho ltar dkar yangs mdzes pa'i sku dang ldan/ /mnyam med node bzhin nyid dngos seng ge'i khri la bzhugs/ /thub mchog rnam par snang ba de la phyag 'tshal lo / /mdangs ldan nor bu mthon ga chen po ltar 'phro ba'i/ /'od kyis phyogs rnams ma lus snang bar mdzad pa po/ /'jig rten gsum na rmad byung glang po'i khri la bzhugs/ /bsnyengs bral sangs rgyas mi bskyod de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /rin chen dbang bskur 'byor pas 'gro don mdzad la mkhas/ /bsod nams tshogs mnga' ri rgyal mngon sum rgyu 'dra zhing / /gser gyi rgya mtsho lta bus rta yi gdan la bzhugs/ /thub pa rin chen 'byung ldan de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /rma bya'i 1—693

rigs gsal brgya ༅yis mdzes byas snang ba yi/ /'od kyis phyogs kun khebs pas mngon dga' padma ni/ /rā ga'i ri bo ltar mdzes rma bya'i gdan bzhugs pa/ /thub pa dpag med 'od mnga' de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam chos 'od zer tshogs kyis mun pa sel mdzad pa'i/ /'od kyi snang bas nam mkha'i cha kun rnam par 'gengs/ /bai ḍūrya yi mtsho ltar mkha' ldeng gdan la bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas don yod grub pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /seng ge glang po rta dang rma bya mkha' lding gdan la rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ /sku mdog rim bzhin dkar dang sngo dang ser dang dri med dmar dang ljang gyur cing / /byang chub mchog dang sa reg mazog sbyin ting 'dzeen mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i phyag rgyas mtshan/ /rang rigs rin chen cod pan ldan pa'i ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid de la 'dud/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bstod pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ladma yi ra warma ④dang / shu po gyi lo tsā ba ༅ dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing shus te ④gtan la phab pa// //bsdur mchan/693 mang byang 'di〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkog ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ཿ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nyid/ ༅ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mdzad de la mgosaphyag 'tshag694 rgya/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mchog rgya/ gye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bang gdan/ du 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ga ba 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nga kā ra/ sni 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba ja milotsā ba/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba te/1—694

0057༄/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi bstod pa//rgya/༄lngo/ /rgya gar skad du/ sasta ta thā ga ta sto traḥ gro/ bod skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la ba phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i bla ma lha mi 'jig rten phyir mchod cing / /thugs rjes gsal zhing gzhan la phan pa'i thar pa ston/ /srid gsum chu chen mthar phyin bde 〈zhor son rjepa po/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo / /srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' dang pha rol med pa 'di/ /'jig rten nub cing 'dug pa rab tu gzigs nas kyang / /phan gdags phyir ni chos rnams ༅ston pa gang yin pa/ /rgyal ba gtsug tor mnga' ba de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi zla dag las 'das pa'i gzi brjid mnga' ba des/ /ye shes dang ni spyod pa'i ngang tshul rnams las kyang / /rgya mtsho'i 'jing ltar gting dpag nus par mi 'gyur ba'i//sangs rgyas thams cad skyob pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi grags pa zla ba'i 1—696

'od zer 'dra ba yis/ /sa stengs mtha' dag rab tu brgyan par snang ba dang / /u dusgru ra'i me tog bzhin du rmad byung ba/ /thub dbang chen po log dad sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri ma med cing rtag tu phan par mdzad pa dang / /chags pa med pa gang gi dri ma med pa'i thugs/ /rnam par 'phro bas mun pa'i thibs po rab bcom zhing / /lha yis mchod pa'i gser thub de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /btso ma'i gser gyi phung po'i kha dog 'dra ba yi/ /gzi brjid 'bar ba nyi ma stong bas lhag pa mnga'/ /skyebo kun gyis phyag byas 'jig rten mchog gyur pa / /'od srungs mtshan gsol gang yin de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer mang pos padma'i tshal phye rjeltar/ /gsung gi 'od zer mang pos 'jig rten sad par mdzad/ /ston pa shākya thub pa thugs rje phyasgon ma can/ /mya ngan 'das ston gang yin de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi byang chub skye ba gcig gis thogs gyur cing / /byams pa zhes bya dga' ldan gnam gyi gnas na bzhugs/ /sa stengs bde bar gshegs par 'gyur ba gang yin pa/ /de la bdag nirtag tu dad pas 1phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das pa'i rgyal ba bdun po dang ni (phyis gshegs pa/ /brgyad pa byang chub sems dpa' bdag gis bstod pa rje rta yis/ /bsod nams mtha' yas dpag med bdag gis gang thob pa/ /des ni sems can rnams kyang skyon dang bral gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi bstod pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ladma ga ra warma dang rta/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing shus te thugatan la phab pa 1/de697

bsdur mchan/696 ①mtshan byang 'di gzhung lasablangasate bkod ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉4/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉dag ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lo'agro bar ston/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 rab tu/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉'jingag ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bskyod697 ①〈〈pe 〉〉dum 'go〈〈snar 〉〉rdu 'a/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gig ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'byeg ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje'i/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gig ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nas/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snyinganasartag tu/ thor〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dag dngaka ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉dpa ⑫〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ches ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sha ldor dngan ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉/zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 zhusate/ ⑩〈〈pe〉〉cha bo 'o/bsdur 'bras ze'i1 migabastod tshogag/(57)1wa 698

0058༄/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad la bstod pa/ba ༄za༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ aṣṭa ta thā ga ta sto traḥ snye/ bod skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad la bstod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan gyi me tog rgyas shing dag pa la/ /dpe byad bzang po'i 'bru chags mdzes pa'i sku/ /gang gis mthong thos dran yang dpal gyur pa/ /mtshan gyi rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen zla ba padmas rab brgyan zhing / /shes bya kun la mkhas pas mkhyen pa 'phags/ /rgya mtsho lta bur zab pa'i thugs mnga' ba / /sgra dbyangs rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser ltar lhang nge ba/ /nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i gzi brjid 'bar/ /dri med gser gyi mchod sdong lta bu'i sku/ /gser bzang dri med snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mya ngan 'das shing bde ba'i mchog brnyes pa/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gdung ba zhi mdzad cing / /'gro drug mgon dang dpal du gyur pa po/ /mya ngan med mchog dpal 1—699

la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sgra chen pos pha rol rgol ba 'joms/ /rgya mtsho lta bur zab pa'i sku mnga' zhing / /'gro ba'i dug gsum ma lus sel mdzad pa/ /chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi blo gros gting dpag dka' ba'i tshul/ /rnam dag chos kyi dbyings la kyirol mdzad cing / /shes bya ma lus mngon sum gzigs pa po/ /chos blo mngon par mkhyen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i nad gso mdzad pa sman pa'i mchog /bai ḍūrya ltar dang pa'i sku mnga' zhing —/ /sku yi 'od kyis 'gro ba sgrol mdzad pa/ /sman pa'i rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje kun la snyoms pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i sngug bsngal sel/ /dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ /bai ḍūrya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma lta bur ma rig mun pa sel/ /zla ba lta bur nyon mongs gdung ba sel/ /dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ /bai ḍūrya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mi'i ston pa sman pa'i rgyal po ste/ /bcom ldan 'jig rten gsum na skyabs mdzad pa/ /dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ /bai ḍūrya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni 'jig rten gsum gyi sman pa ste/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rtsad nas gcod/ /sems can thams cad bde la rab tu 'god/ /bai ḍūrya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes spyan gyis 'gro ba kun la gzigs/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro ba kun la khyab/ /dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ /beeḍūrya yi ༅'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rlung dang mkhris pa bad yin 'dus la sogs/ /'byung ba bzhi po 'khrugs par gyur pa la/ /nad kyi gnyen po grophyag g.yas a ru ra/ /sman pa'i rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku mdog mthing ga utpal sngon po 'dra/ /phyag g.yon bdud rtsi 1—700

sman gyi lhung bzed bsnams/ /dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ /bai ḍūrya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyes pa rgya mtsho dag ni gzhar /3 spangs nas/ /yon tan rgya mtsho dag gi ⑤pha rol byon/ /thams cad mayo pa lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /bai ḍūrya yi 'od la phyag 'a༅ lo/ /dku lam rgya chen yongs su dag gyur pas/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur gzhan don mdzad/ /dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ /bai ḍūrya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigs 'khrungs shing/ /gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa/ /gser gyi 2 lhun po lta bur mdzes pa'i sku/ /shākya'i rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad la bstod pa slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa rdzogs so // //1—701

༄ ༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ su pra bha ta pra bha ta sto —⑤/ bod skad du / rab tu snga bar nam langs pa'i bstod pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mnga' bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha yi tshogs dang grub pa dri za'i gtso dang sdom brtson dbang rnams kyis/ /bstod tshig sna tshogs dag gis lha yul sa stengs ②rnams su bstod mod kyi/ /bdag kyang ji ltar nus pas 'phags pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bstod bgyi ste/ /nam mkha' la ni mkha' lding 'phur zhes bung ba rnams ni cis mi 'phur/ /mi mthun phyogs spangs gyur pa lus pa med pa'i skyon ni zad gyur la/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog can padma rgyas pa lta bur yangs pa'i spyan/ /dpal ldan mdzes pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba'i/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba yo ni rtag tu rab tu snga bar nam langs pa'o/ /bdud kyi dpung las rnam par rgyal ba nyam nga'i ④lam ni gcod mdzad pa/ /sa gsum phan par 1—703

mdzad pa 'khri shing dra ba gsum po 1 dral mdzad pa/ /zhi ba'i bde ba stsol nya bar mdzad pa mi shes ri bo 'jig mdzad pa/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod ni rtag tu rab tu snga bar nam langs pa'o/ /gang zhig lha min mi dang lha rnams kyi yang sngon du bde ba'i gnas thob pa/ /ma lus pa yi sa yi khams su 'jig rten bdun / bsdus dbyangs gsangs jamathon po sgrogs/ /shed las skyes pa bsgo byed rang byung padma'i skye gnas can ni gnyid log gyur/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod ni rtag tu rab tu snga bar nam langs pa'o/ /shar gyi ri bo'i rtse yi 5ngos la gnas shing dmar pa'i 'od kyis rnam gnon 6pa/ /mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms par byed pa /skye dgu rnams kyi mig gcig pud/ /nyi ma de yang myos pas 'phyan zhing rnam pa kun du gnyid log gyur/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod ni rtag tu rab tu snga bar sad pa'o / /glang po'i mche /ltar dkar bsil gsal 7ba'i zer can ri bong mtshan/ /mtshan mo thig le lta bur mdzes pa kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu gang / /dman pa'i mdangs dang bral bde yang rnam pa kun du gnyid log gyur/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod ni rtag tu rab tu snga bar sad pa'o/ /rab mchog lag pa bzhi pa bcu drug phyed phyed phyogs kyi gdong pa can/ /bzlas dang nyes pa'i cho ga shes shing nges brjod rig byed 'don pa po/ /dri med padma'i skyeganas tshangs pa de yang rab tu gnyid log 'gyur/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod ni rtag tu rab tu snga bar sad pa'o / /gangs kyi ri bo'i rtse la gnas shing sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs pa 'chang / /grong khyer sum brtsegs bsreg par nus gang stag gi pags pa'i gos gyon pa/ /rtse gsum can rtags rari mchog bu mo dang ni lhan cig gnyid log gyur/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod ni rtag tu rab tu snga bar sad pa'o/ /'bar ba'i rdo rje lag na 1—704

thogs shing lha min rnams kyis thub dka' ba/ /lha yi gtso bo bde sogs bdag po rmongs pa'i bsam pas rnam par 'khor/ /mtshan mo min dang mtshan mo gnyid log 'dod pa'i 'dam du nges par bying / /stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod ni rtag tu rab tu snga bar sad pa'o/ /utpal sngon po'i 'dab ma ltar sngo padmo ltar dkar yangs pa'i mig /lha min gtso bo thams cad bcom gyur thams cad byed po ༅sna tshogs gzugs/ /khyal 'jug kyang ni yun ring gnyid log mngal gyi gnas las thar ma gyur/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod ni rtag tu rab tu snga bar nam langs pa'o / /gang zhig ral pa ser skya'i tshogs ldan khyadamar po zangs mdog khrag gi mig /phyugs bdag dga' ba'i dus su gcig tu chags pa 'joms par nus pa po / /'dod pa'i lha yi mda' sreg lus can me lha de yang gnyid log gyur/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod ni rtag tu rab tu snga bar sad pa'o/ /zla ba kha ba ku mu ta mtshungs chang 'thungs ②mig ni dmar gyur la/ /'dod pa brtan sra sgeg po thong gshol lag na 'dzin par brtson/ /stobs can de ni nam gru'i mgul ༅nas 'khyud cing 'di na nyal bar gyur/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod ni rtag tu rab tu snga bar sad pa'o/ /glang chen gdong can mche ba gcig ༅pa rnam pa kun du bgegs byed pa/ /'gram pa'i ngos gnyis myos chu rab 'bab bung ba sgra gsangs ④mthon po sgogs pa yi/ /tshogs kyi bdag po yang ni chang gi btung bas rab tu ⑦myos par gyur/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod ni rtag tu rab tu snga bar sad pa'o/ /zar ma'i me tog ltar sngo gang gi lag pa mchog na mdung thung thogs/ / padmo gsar ⑧pa lta bu'i lus can gdong drug lha min khrung khrung gsodakhya/ /mig gsum ldan pa gzhon nu'i tshul can de yang gnyid mthug log par gyur/ /stobs 1—705

bcu mnga' ba khyod ni rtag tu rab tu snga bar sad pa'o/ /zas la rab chags dman lus rtag par rnal 'byor rjes su dga' gyur pa/ /gnod pa sna tshogs rnam mang dang ldan ༅yi dgas lta bur tshig pa'i lus/ /zla dpung 'gro ba rnam bral gang yin gcer bu de rnams kyang gnyid log /stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod ni rtag tu rab tu snga bar sad ༅pa'o/ /bas mtha'i gnas chen 'di na drang srong ngan spong e gi ra sa ༅dang / /kun du rgyu sogs gnas 'jog rgyas pa grog mkhar ba dang dga' byed rnams/ /gzhon nu sa yi skye gnas chags shing rmongs pa /khya rnams kyang gnyid log gyur6/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod ni rtag tu rab tu snga bar sad pa'o/ /gshin rje chu lha ༅lus ngan gnod sbyin 'dre dang lto 'phye'i dbang po dang / /de bzhin 'jig rten skyong gzhan lha yu la sa stengs ④nam mkha' la gnas pa/ /gzhon nu ma la rab chags zur gyis lta de rnams kyang gnyid log gyur/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod ni rtag tu rab tu snga bar sad pa'o/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshor bying gyur gti mug dra bas khebs pa'i lus/ /thub pa ser skya gzegs zan kun du 'khor zhing blun po'i cobasam pa can/ /zhi ba'i bde ba yongs su nyams khyade rnams kyang rgyaganyid log gyur/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod ni rtag tu rab tu snga bar sad pa'o / /mi shes mtshan mo mun parasred pa'i mal cha mthug gyon cing / /yul gyi sngas rten la ni rab mthug gnyid log gyur pa'i tshe/ /dge dang mi dge'i 'bras bu yongs su 'gre ldog ༅byed pa na/ /rtag pa nyid du gnyid sad gang yin de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chu 'gram dag tu ba lang rigs brgya rnams kyis chu 'thungs te/ /ngoms nas 'gro bar gyur na'ang chu la bri bar mngon pa med/ /de bzhin thub pa snyan ngag mkhan brgyas yang dag bstod gyur kyang / /yon tan rgya mtsho legs pa'i 1—706

gter chen zad par 'gyur ①ma yin/ /rab tu nam langs khyod gcig pu yi ye shes spyan phye bstod gyur pas②/ /'jig rten gsum mgon rta bdun 'od kyis las( 'di rtag tu snang byas te/ /sna tshogs lam thob lam ngan las bzlog 'byor ldan dpal gyi bya ba khya dag /dogs med ④rang dgar bde blag dngos grub rnam pa kun du spyod gyur cig / rab tu snga bar nam langs pa'i ⑤yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la kha che'i rgyal po ṭīha ri sha de bas bstod pa rdzogs so// // rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta rā dza 1sto na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba khe'u brgad yon tan dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o//④ //bsdur mchan/7༷3 ①mar byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltar bkod/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tra/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉steng / ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngan 7༷4 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsog ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gcig ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gsang /⑤〈〈snar 〉〉ri'i rtse'i/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gnang non/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉yo〈〈snar 〉〉gu⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'aza cing / ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po ge ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsig ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mo'i/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉des ni/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyig khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dreg7༷5 ① 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ༅ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bam/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mthug ④〈〈pe 〉〉'gug༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gagog ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nus pa sgra gsangan ⑦ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉neb rgya ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉padma sar/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bas she7 6 ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnamasadang ldan pa'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉bsag ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sogag ④〈〈snar 〉〉mag3/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ge ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ༅/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bdag ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stengaka༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi lha dang lha min/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 pa ⑫〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na ga ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sregasapa/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'dre log1—707

phyag 'tshal ba'i bstod pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ aṣṭa ma hā sbra na tsi ta ban da nā ma sta ba༅/bod skad du/ gnas chen po brgyad kyi mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba'i bstod pa/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bltams dang byang chub mnyam med chos kyi 'khor lo dge ba bskor/ /mchod rten thog mar 'jig rten gsum mchod dang gyo ldan cho 'phrul chen po dang / /gangs ri'i kha dog ltar gsal lha las babs pa'i gnas 'di dang / /gang du bde gshegs mya ngan 'das pa de la spyi bos bdag phyag 'tshal/ /yangs can wā rā ṇa sī ngu/byis pa gsod ri 'jigs rungs byebacings 'gram dang / /mnyan yod dang ni byang chub shing drung ku sha'i grong mchog ser skya lumbi rī ༅/ /ko shambi tshudang mdzod mthug bamanyam pa'i grong mchog dpa' skyong yul 'khor dang / /stobs bcu ldan pa'i mchod rten gzhan gang yin pa de la'ang spyis phyag 'tshal/ /kha che dang ni rgya yul kha ba ya mun zhes 1—709

pa ①dang / /siṅga la dang yoṭi ② byu shing 'phel ba ga mang ba kha ko la/ /bal yul kā ma byu ⑤dang bum pa'i klong mchog kāgyi ④bzang po'i yul/ /stobs bcu ldan pa'i gdung bcas gzhan gang yin pa de la'ang spyis phyag 'tshal/ /ti se gangs ri gangs can la gnas mas per dang ri rab rtse/ /klu gnas rnam rgyal nor sbyin gnas dang rig 'dzin grub pa'i gnas/ /tshangs dang khyab 'jug gnas dang phyugs bdag nyi ma zla ba'i gnas/ /stobs bcu ldan pa'i mchod rten gzhan gang yin pa de la'ang spyis phyag 'tshal/ /stobs bcu las byung rin chen snying can mchod rten brgyad po gdung bcas bam las grub/ /sol ba de bzhin rin chen ༄mchod rten gangs dang dngul 'dra rab mdzes pa/ /sa 'og sa stengs lha yul rtser bzhugs mchod rten ji snyed ④ma lus dang / /sangs rgyas sku gzugs gang bzhugs de la nyin re bzhin du spyi bos phyag bya'o/ /gnas chen po brgyad kyi mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba'i bstod ba kha che'i rgyal po dziXha ri sha de bas yum gyi ched du mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po rā dza shrīsto na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba khe'u brgad yon tan dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// //⑧ 1—710

bsdur mchan/7༷9 /7mtshan byang 'di gzhung labacablakhos te bkod do/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sba na tsi bya banda na ma stosab/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dad/ ṣyo 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba ra ṇa ge ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rung / ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ri ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sham bi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dga'/710 (7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpa/ ② 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snangaḍi/ (1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po/ma ru/ ( rngu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kan gi⑤ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉maṇḍa/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉srid/ (3〈〈pe 〉〉༷ ⑧〈〈pe〉〉/maṅgast+waṃbasdur 'bras ze(1 migabastod sna gas/ (6༷)

0061༄/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brjod bskal bzang rgyan gyi phreng ba/khya ༄lngo/ /rgya gar skad du/ ta thā ga ta nā ma saṅgi ti kālbi sha bha dra a /co / lo ga ra mā la nā ma/ bod skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brjod bskal bzang rgyan gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas thams cad la gus pa'i gtsug gis phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdzes snang bskal par rnam par brgyan zhing du/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal yul 'khor srung rgyasras stong / /sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas rin po che/ /sna tshogs bkod pa'i rgyal pos bskal bzang 'dir/ /rgyal 'gyur lung bstan sangs rgyas stong dag dang / /rdzus skyes mched gnyis la yang phyag 'tshal nas/ /rgyal kun yul rigs 'od dang yab yum sras/ /rim gro shes rab can mchog rdzu 'phrul can/ /'dus tshad tshe tshad bstan pa gnas pa'i tshad/ /sku gdung mchod rten tshul dang sems bskyed tshul/ /re re'ang bco lnga bco lngas rgyas gsungs mod//'dir ni gus pas mtshan tsam brjod par bya/ /bde gshegs 'khor ba 'jig 1—712

dang gser thub dang / /'od srungs shākya'i skyes mchog byams pa dang / /seng ge rab gsal thub pa me tog dang / /me tog gnyis pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyu skar bzang dang ded dpon lag chen dang / /stobs chen rgyu skar rgyal po rtsi sman dang / /snyan pa dang ni tog dang 'od chen dang / /grol ba'i phung po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad nyi ma'i snying po dang / /zla ba 'od 'phro 'od bzang mya ngan med/ /skar rgyal dang ni rab gsal phreng thogs dang / /yon tan 'od la'ang gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /don gzigs dang ni mar me mthu ldan dang —/ /sman pa dang ni nges pa mdzod spu dang / /brtan ldan lha yi dpal dang gdul dka' dang / /yon tan rgyal mtshan rnams la'ang phyag 'tshal mo sgra gcan mchog 1ldan tshangs dbyangs tshig brtan dang / /mi 'gying 'od mdzad lhun po chen po dang / /rdo rje dang ni sdom can mi bsnyengs pa/ /rin chen rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad spyan ⑤stobs sde me tog 'od zer ②dang / /ye shes dgyes dang gzi chen tshangs pa dang / /'od dpag med dang klu sbyin ④brtan par gshegs/ /don yod mthong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtson 'grus sbyin 'udang bzang skyong dga' bo dang / /'chi med seng ge rgyal mtshan rgyal ba chos / /mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po kha lo sgyur༅// /dgyes par gshegs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chu lha dang ni yon tan yan lag dang / /spos kyi glang po rnam phyogazigs 'brug sgra dang / /legs sems yid bzang dri med zla ba dang / /grags chen rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtsug na nor bu drag shul seng ge'i stabs/ /ljon tshu/pa rnam rgyal can dang shes rab brtsegs/ /legs gnas dang ni blo gros yan lag skyes/ /blo mtha' yas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo /1—713

gzugs bzang dang ni mayo ldan 'od zer dang / /brtul zhugs brtan dang bkra shis bden pa'i tog — /padma sred med bu dang lag bzang dang / /ye shes 'byung gnas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan 'od 'phro tshangs byin rin 'byung gnas/ /lha yi me tog dang ni don legs sems/ /chos kyi dbang phyug blo gros spobs pa brtsegs/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan phan bzhed phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par rol ldan mun bral sgra gcan lha/ /ri bo'i rgyal mtshan tshogs 'od rin chen snying / /shin tu mthor gshegs skar rgyal ru rings dang / /yon tan grags pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi zla nyi 'od skar mkhan seng ge'i tog /dus mkhyen rgyal po dpal snying srid mtha' gzigs/ /glog 'od gser gyi ri bo seng ges byin / /gzhan gyis mi thub rgyal mtshan phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog dga' grags pa brtson 'grus brtan grags rdzogs/ /bsnyengs bral mchod 'os lha dang sgon chen dang —/ /'jig rten 'od dang spos dri zhim po dang / /yon tan mchog 'dzin mun bral phyag 'tshal lo/ /seng ge'i 'gram dang rin chen grags skyon zhi/ /bdud rtsi 'chang dang mi'i zla shin tu gzigs/ /rab brgyan nor 'od ri bo brtsegs pa'i tog /chos 'byung don nges ①ldan la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos khya byin rin chen 'byung gnas skye dbang mtshungs/ /stabs kyis gshegs dang blo gnas gdugs mdzes dang / /gtso bo shin tu 'phags pa dpal seng sgra/ /rnam par rol ldan rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu 'od me tog ri dang klu dga' dang / /spos kyi dbang phyug shin tu grags stobs lha/ /yon tan 'phreng ldan ②klu'i lag mig rgyan ༅dang / /legs par sbyangs pa'i blo la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /zil gnon mtha' yas spyan dang bden pa gsung / /nyi ma'i 'od dang nges ①blo mtha' 1—714

yas gzugs/ /rnam snang rin chen tog dang the tshom spangs/ /'jig rten 'das pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rnam par gnon dang rtogs mdzad dang —/ /me tog rgyal mtshan ri dbang rgyal gzi chen/ /don mdzad gzigs dang grags yas rin chen lha①/ /don mkhyen blo rdzogs rnams la phyag 'tshal mo mya ngan med dang dri bral tshangs lha dang / /sa dbang me tog spyan dang rnam 'byes sku//chos 'od kun gzigs yon tan 'od gsal dang / /dri med zla ba'i zhal la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen 'od dang rin chen tog dang ni/ /grags pa'i bla ma 'od byed gzi dpag med/ /dus mkhyen seng ge'i sku dang mkhas blo dang / /rgyal dka' yon tan phung po phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla ba'i tog dang mthu ni thob pa dang / /mthu rtsal mtha' yas zla ba dri med dang / /don rnams thams cad gzigs dang dpa' bo dang / /'byor ldan bsod nams sgron ma phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan 'od 'phro blo ni yangs pa dang / /legs skyes nor lha yid gnyis spong ba dang / /'dzin pa dpag med mchog sred choms rgyamed dang / /mi gnas pa dang der gnas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs ④chen gtso bo 'gro ba'i 'od zer dang / /phal chen rgyal dang ④gzi brjid mtha' yas dang / /don blo sman pa'i rgyal po tha ba spangs/ /rims nad med dang legs byin phyag 'tshal lo/ /grags byin me tog byin dang skyes bus byin/ /rdo rje'i sde dang phal po byin pa dang / /zhi ba'i blo gros spos glang sred med bu/ /des pa dang ni mi tshugs phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi zla glog gi tog dang mchod pa dang / /dpal sbas spudang ni ye shes nyi ma dang / /don grub lhun po brtsegs dang dgra 'dul dang / /padma dgra bcom grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes 'gros dang nyon mongs bral ba dang / /'dam bu dang ni 1—715

spos // bzang yul 'khor rangs/ /lha grags srid mtha' gzigs dang zla ba dang / /sgra gcan rin chen zla la phyag 'tshal lo/ / seng ge ༷rgyal mtshan dang ni bsam gtan dgyes/ /rdzogs ldan rnam rol yon tan rin chen dang / /dgra bcom grags pa pad ngos mdzod spu ldan/ /spobs grags rdo rje nor bu phyag 'tshal lo / /tshe dpag med dang nor bu bkod pa dang / /dbang chen yon tan 'byung gnas lhun po grags/ /'od zer bcu pa ma smad glang po'i 'gros/ /yid 'thad ④ rin chen zla ba phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi ba rab gsal rgyal po kha lo sgyur༅/ /dga' ba'i dbang phyug gtsug na rin po che/ /bsnyengs bral rin chen snying po zla ba'i zhal/ /dri ma med grags zhi brjid phyag 'tshal lo/ /dga' tog ༅ sgra gcan lha dang na tshod bzang / /lha dga' rin chen phung po mdzes par gshegs/ /seng ge'i phyogs pa shin tu mthor gshegs dang / /skye dbang blo gros bzang po phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten 'od dang rin chen gzi brjid dang / /skal ldan shing rta kun rgyal dga' ba bkod/ /stegs mdzad dang ni spos glang blo 'od 'phro/ /ri bo'i rgyal mtshan spos bzang phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos brtan /dang ni gzi brjid drag shul can/ /chos kyi nor bu bzang phyin ༅bde gshegs zla/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang seng ge zla ba dpal/ /legs skyes thub med tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo / /grags pa bshes gnyen dang ni bden pa dang / /dka' thub chen po lhun po'i 'od zer dang / /yon tan brtsegs pa mchod grags chos grags dang / /sbyin 'od glog 'byin bden gsung phyag 'tshal lo/ /'tsho byed na tshod bzang po legs tshogs can/ /rnam nges blo gros srid mtha' nor bu'i spos/ /rgyal dgyes seng ge'i 'od zer rnam snang mdzad/ /grags mchog thugs rab gzhungs2/ la'ang 1—716

phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu zla ba drag shul 'od zer dang / /brtul zhugs thub med 'gros mchod nor bu'i tshogs/ /'jig rten bla ma glang seng zla ba dang / /rin 'od sgra gcan sbed la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan rgya mtsho 'od zer ༅/ldan pa dang / /rab tu zhi stabs 'jig rten bzang po dang / /mya ngan med pa shugs bcu stobs dgyes dang / /mthu dpal mthu thob mthu chen phyag 'tshal lo /yon tan snying po bden par spyod pa dang / /dge mchog rgyal po skar ༅rgyal 'od zer che / /glog 'od yon tan rgya chen rin po che/ /dpal 'od dang ni bdud 'dul phyag 'tshal lo/ /go bgos seng ge'i phyag dang me tog bzang / /rin chen mthon po dang ni rgya mtsho dag5/ /sa 'dzin don blo mnga' ba yon tan bsags/ /yon tan tshogs dang rin me phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten zla ba dang / /dbyangs snyan tshangs pa'i tog dang tshogs can gtso/ /seng ge'i stabs dang drag shul byin pa dang / /chos dbang gzi 'od 'od chen phyag 'tshal lo / /rin chen grags pa tshogs gsal grags mtha' yas/ /'od zer don yod / ༅lha yi drang srong dang / /skyedabang dge 'dun brtan dang phyogs bzang dang —/ /tog dang yul 'khor me tog phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi blo gros rlung gi shugs ltar gshegs/ /legs bsam grags pa snang ldan lha tshogs dang / /yon tan bsrungs don blo gros bsnyengs pa med/ /grogs brtan 'od gnas mtshungs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor zhabs thar pa'i gzi brjid ngos bzang dang / /blo bzang ༅kun du gzi brjid ye shes mchog /tshangs par gnas dang bden pa gsung ba dang / /blo bzang dang ni stobs byin phyag 'tshal lo/ /seng stabs me tog tog dang shes 'byung gnas/ /me tog byin dang yon tan snying po dang / /1—717

rin chen grags pa grags pa rmad byung dang / /mi tshugs bsnyengs med nyi 'od phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs gshegs lha yi mthu rtsal ye shes dgyes/ /lha bden nor bu'i snying po yon tan grags/ /ye shes dpal dang bcings med brtul zhugs brtan/ /lha yi gzi brjid ①rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs thub dal bzhud brtul zhugs dka' thub dang / /'od zer ⑤phung po dang ni gzi brjid che/ /tsam pa ga dang dga' mdzad tshogs can bzang / /dbang po'i rgyal mtshan dgyes chen phyag 'tshal lo / /sna ma'i me tog 'od dang tshogs can 'od/ /skrun mdzad mdangs 'gro don legs nges pa dang / /khyu mchog dang ni lag bzang 'od zer che/ /bsam byin bsod nams 'od la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen dbyangs dang rdo rje'i sde dang ni / /'byor ldan seng ge'i stobs dang dri med spyan/ /'od srungs dang ni blo gsal ye shes 'gros/ /gzi brjid drag shul 'od chen phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma'i 'od dang dri ma med pa'i 'od/ /gzi brjid rnam 'byes khangs med sbrang rtsi'i zhal / /zla 'od glog 'byin rab zhir gshegs pa dang / /mi 'khrugs dgra bcom grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi yon tan zhing bzang bkod rgyal po/ /mngon par 'phags dang sbyin sreg 'od 'phro dang / /pad dpal rin chen bkod dang shin tu bzang / /rin chen mchog dang thugs gzhungs phyag 'tshal lo rgya mtshos byin dang tshangs tog ⑤zla ba'i gdugs/ /'od 'phro dri med rgyal po ye shes grags/ /kun rgyal yon tan 'od dang sgra grags dang / /zla rgyas rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /padma'i ④'od zer brtul zhugs bzang po dang / /sgron rgyal glog gi 'od dang 'od zer rgyal/ /skar mkhan grags rdzogs padma'i snying po dang —/ /rgyal dang spyan mdzes rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnyog pa med don dang 1—718

ni drag shul sde/ /bsod nams gzi brjid mthu rtsal thogs med blo/ /sgra gcan blu lha dang shes phung snokha lo sgyurami/ /skye gematshungs me tog tog la phyag 'tshal lo / /sgra gcan 'dzin dang sman chen rgyu skar rgyal/ /sman rgyal bsod nams glang po gcod khyamadzad dang / /rnam grags rgyal po nyi ma'i 'od zer dang / /chos mdzod blo gros bzang po phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan dbang mtshungs dang ni rdo rje'i sde / /shes rab brtsegs pa legs gnas blo sbyangs 5khye dang / /tshangs dbyangs yon tan mchog dang 'brug sgra dang / /mngon shes tog dang tog 'od phyag 'tshal lo / /dge ba tshangs pa skyes mchog spyan sdug pa/ /klus byin bden pa'i tog khye dang brgyan pa dang / /zhum pa med pa'i dbyangs dang rin chen 'od/ /dbyangs byin rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /seng ge dang ni 'od zer sna tshogs dang //ye shes dpa' bo pad phung me tog rgyas bye / /mthu stobs bsod nams phung po gzugs mchog dang / /skar mkhan zla ba sgon ma phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzi brjid phung po byang chub rgyal po dang / /mi /zad mngon rtogs spyan dang yan lag rgyas/ /yul 'khor shes rab mchog ma gzi chim mdzad/ /shes byin mgon po 'jam dbyangs phyag 'tshal lo/ /chags pa med pa'i mdzod dang gtso bos byin/ /gtso bo ༷ye shes mthu rtsal 'od 'phro can/ /dbang po dang ni shugs 'chang skar nyargyal dang —/ /'od bzang grags pa byin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs bzang dang ni rgyal po don grub dang / /seng ge'i sde zhes bya dang nor lha'i bu/ /grags pa rgyal ba rgya chen snying po dang / /bsod nams 'od zer smrang 'don phyag 'tshal lo /sgron ma'i rgyal po dang ni ye shes brtsegs/ /lha mchog tsas bdag grol brnyes gtsug gi gser/ /sgra gcan bzang po thub dka' thub gsal dang / /zla ba'i 1—719

'od zer rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gser 'od legs byin lha yi yon tan dbang / /chos gdugs bsod nams lag dang chags med dang / /ye shes gya nom blo gros zhib mo dang /༅ /gzi byin thams cad rtsi sman phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam grol tog dang 'od mdzod 2ye shes rgyal/ /'jigs mdzad chu bo spangs dang thogs med grags/ /bden pa'i phung po dbyangs snyan ri dbang mtshungs/ /chos brtsegs rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar pa'i gzi brjid legs mdzad rab zhi'i sku/ /yid 'ong gsung dang blo sbyangs ༅chu yi lha/ /'gros mchod seng logs chos kyi mthu rtsal dang / /skal ④bzang rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo /mi 'khrugs mdog dang gzi brjid rgyal po dang / /rtogs mdzad spyan legs don la gnas pa'i blo/ /snang ba'i 'od zer spos ༅gzi kun dga' mdzad / /don yod gshegs dang khro bcom phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs mchog legs gshegs rab sbyin grags pa dang / /'od gtsang lha yi nyi ma shes rab byin/ /mnyam par gzhag 3pa'i bdag nyid gzi mdangs dang / /rgyal rigs skal ldan shing rta phyag 'tshal lo/ /gser mchog rnam grol gtsug dang chos ldan dang / /spos gnas dregs pa spongs byedang ye shes mdzod/ /tshangs par gshegasadang tsandan kyi mya ngan med / /seng ge'i 'od zer rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yul 'khor tog dang pad snying gzi mtha' yas/ /lha 'od shes rab me tog mkhas pa dang / /ye shes 'byor ldan dang ni tshangs pa'i dbyig /phyag na rin chen dbang ldan phyag 'tshal lo / /rdzogs par gsung dang mchog khrigasung mchod 'os dang / /skar rgyal nyi ma dang ni 'dam las brgal / /ye shes brnyes dang grub pa rma bya dang / /chos byin rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phan par bzhed dang ye shes ldan grags pa/ /1—720

'od zer dra ba dang ni rnam par bcom/ /bee ḍūrya snying me tog lha rgyal po/ /zla ba dang ni dran 'od phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'od yon tan mchog 'od rin chen dpal/ /skyes bu zla ba sgra gcan bdud rtsi'i 'od/ /'jig rten mchog dang skar 'od zhi ba'i stabs/ /ye shes rgya mtsho rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ri dbang rab zhi yon tan mtha' ༅stobs dang / /lha dbang dang ni dbyangs snyan ngos bzang dang / /don gnas yon brjid mkhyen ldan zla med dang / /nga ro dpag med rgyal ba phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od bzang thugs gzhungs don dgongs gti mug bral / /dbyangs kyi yan lag khyad 'phags mchog mdzes gshegs/ /zhi don skyon med blo sbyangs ༅dge ba dang / /pad bu mdzod 'od zer 'bazang po phyag 'tshal lo / /spobs pa'i mdog dang stegs bzang tshogs dbang dang / /bsnyengs phyo bral ye shes bzhed 3pa spobs pa'i spyanadu / /blo mchog zla ba rin chen zla 'od dang / /bsnyengs med rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzigs pa che dang tshangs dbyangs dbyangs bzang dang / /shes rab che stegs blo gros zla med dang / /rdo mkhregs ḍābyang chub blo gros ljon shing dbang tso/ /gdangs snyan bsod nams stobs la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthu dpal 'phags pa dgyes dang mthu stobs dang —/ /skar ma dgyes dang sprin sgra spyan sdug zhal/ /ye shes bzang ldan 'byor ldan yon tan phung / /gsal ba rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo /chos kyi rgyal mtshan ye shes nga ro dang / /nam mkha' mchod sbyin skyeng ro shes 'god 3 dang —/ /yon 'od gzi brjid drang srong dbang blo ldan/ /spobs tshogs mchod sbyin bzang po phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla zhal shin tu gzigs dang rdul bral dang / /yon tan tshogs dang tog ldan bsod rgyal mtshan/ /yul 'khor spobs pa rin 1—721

chen rab sbyin dang / /zla dgyes seng ge'i stobs la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang sgyur rgyal po bdud rtsi gsal ba dang / /bsam gtan snyoms medang 'khrug med dri ma zhi/ /phyogs ma bslad dang mdzes pa zhal bzang dang / /shugs gnas ye ldan gsung dbang phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzi brjid chen po blo gros zab bdud rtsi/ /chos kyi stobs dang mchod ldan me tog 'od/ /khams gsum mchod gnas sgra gcan nyi ma'i snying / /lhas mchod thar pa'i rgyal mtshan phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge gtsug bdud rtsi'i 'od dang rdo rje dang / /brtan pa rin chen phung po mdzes gshegs dang / /nyi ltar gshegs dang dag 'od yon tan gtsug /dpal rdzogs rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /seng ge'i stabs dang gyen 'phags me tog byin / /'od 'gyed padma dang ni ye shes dgyes/ /bkodamadzes gti mug med gnas rma med pa/ /tog gi rgyal mtshan rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde dgongs gti mug med rgyal cho ga mkhyen/ /dag pa'i rgya mtsho rin chen mnga' mi mnga' /dga' mdzad rma bya'i nga ro ma zhum khyedang / /srid sred dri ma spangs la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyod pa'i stegs dang lha mang snyan bsgrags dang / /rin stabs phyag pad bsnams dpal dgra las rgyal/ /'byor grags yul 'khor bzang dang me tog 'od/ /seng ge'i nga ro rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla ba ltar shar 'joms pa'i mchog mi g.yo / /phan ldan gshegs dang bsod nams sgron ma'i rgyal/ /dbyangs bskul go'u ta ma mdangs kyi stobs/ /blo gnas rang bzhin zla bzang phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub yan lag me tog bkra shis dang / /legs ston ye shes gzi stobs dge ba'i sgron/ /mthu rtsal brtan po lha dgra tsherab zhi dang / /nyi zhal thar pa'i brtul zhugs phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshul khrims 'od dang brtul zhugs 1—722

gnas rdul 1 med/ /snying po 'phags dang mig sman rgya'aphel bar mdzad/ /spos 'od dus mkhyen 'od dang dran pa'i dbang / /thogs med rgyal mtshan rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub mchog bgrod spyod gsal rin chen dgyes / /chos dbang lha thams cad pa bshes gnyen che/ /bshes gnyen bzang po rab tu zhi ba'i stabs/ /bdud rtsi bdag po lhun 'od phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pas bstod dang snang ldan gzi brjid 'bar/ /snang ba gzigs dang legs spyad rnam par smin/ /legs dgyes mya ngan bral dang rin chen 'od/ /spyod ldan bsod nams stobs la na phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan rgya mtsho rmad byung nga rgyal spong /bdud brlag mdzad dang bag chags rgal ba'i stabs6 / /mi phyed blo mnga' rgya mtsho dag mdzad dang / /tshogs can grol rgyal dga' 'od phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang rgyal ye shes rin chen shin tu bsil/ /tshangs rgyal ye shes dgyes dang rdzu 'phrul tog /skye dbang mtshungs dang sa yi dbang phyug dang / /nyi dgyes sgra gcan 7zla ba phyag 'tshal lo/ /me tog 'od dang sman bdag mdangs mnga' dang / /bsod nams dgyes dang dga' stobs dbyangs snyan dang / /chos kyi dbang phyug tshangs dbyangs spyod bzang dang / /'khrul pa med pa'i blo la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbyangs chen snyan par grags dang tog ldan dang / /gzi brjid rnam grags 'gro ba'i dbang phyug rdodang / /ljon pa gti mug rab zad sto dpag med dang / /zla bzang spobs yas tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtul zhugs bstar dang mchod gnas mya ngan brgal/ /dge tshedagyes 'gro ba'i blo gros dgyes par gshegs/ /zhabs mdzes utpal dul gnas me tog dang / /spobs pa mtha' yas 'od zer phyag 'tshal lo/ /drang srong gsal ba yon tan brtson 'grus snying / /lha bdag rin chen mthon po 1—723

gsal ba dang / /skal ldan shing rta bsod nams blo gros dang / /sbyin sreg 'od 'phro gzi phung phyag 'tshal lo/ / seng ge'i stabs chadang mi g.yo rab gsal dang / /'od spyod glu dbyangs glu dbyangs 'khor lo 'dzin/ /dbyig mchog 'jig rten dga' kyedang chos zla dang / /dga' 4ba mtha' yas grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sprin tog shes rab 'gros dang spos bzang dang / /nam mkha'i dbyangs dang lha dang lha rgyal dang / /nor bu gsal dang nor bzang sgron ma dang / /rin chen nga ro'i dbyangs la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyedabang rgyal po sgra gcan sbed khya pa dang / /dge mdzad seng blo rin chen grags pa dang / /don mjad rje mdzad mtha' gzigs dang srid me 3tog /mdzod spu ༅spobs pa mtshungs med phyag 'tshal lo /ye shes rnam 'byed nga ro seng mche ba/ /mdzes gshegs bsod nams sgron ma bkra shis ldan/ /yul 'khor myang med blo gros sems blo ldan/ /chos sgron shin tu gzigs la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /shugs 'dor stobs chen shes rab me tog dang //brtan pa'i dbyangs dang bde ldan don gsung dang / /dgyes pa gsal ba seng ge'i zhal gtsug yiphud/ /snang mdzad rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal bzang 'dir 'byung sangs rgyas stong gi mtshan/ /gang gis thos shing gus pas yisdig kun sreg /rgyal ba kun mthong ngan song sdug bsngal spong / /bzod ldan bde ba mchog brgyud myang 'das 'thobayi/ /byang chub sems dpa' mchog dga' rgyal po yi/ /drin gyis legs bsgos rgyakha che paṇa chen gyis/ /sbyar 'di gzhan las don lngas khyad par 'phags/ /de lta'ang nyes tshul sdig kun so sor bshags//bdag gi mos blos 'bad pa cher byas pa'i/ /dge ba 'di dang mtha' yas dge ba kun / /'gro ba kun sbyin kun kyang rgyal ba yis/ /kun du rjes bzung kun 1—724

bsdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/(61) 1wa 727

0062 ༄khya/ /sbyor ba bzhi'i lha la bstod pa/1༄lngo/ /rgya gar skad du/ yo ga tsa tu ra de rtawa sto tra nā ma/ bod skad du / sbyor ba bzhi'i lha la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sten 1 mtshon seng ge'i khri stengs na/ /sku drang dgongs pa shin tu gzhag 5 /rdo rje skyil krung der bzhugs nas/ /gang du ting 'dzin yongs 'du ba'i/ /ting 'dzin rgyal po zhes bgyi la/ /mnyam par gzhag cing dgongs mkhyen pa'i/ /de bzhengs 'phrul gyi spyan gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas zhing gzigs khyod la 'dud/ /sku gnas nyi shu rtsa gnyis nas/ /'od zer bye ba khrag khrig ni/ /brgya stong drug cu drug cu ni/ /'byin pa'i sku de la phyag 'tshal/ /mi mjed phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du/ /'od kyi snang bas khyab byed pa / /'od des reg pa'i sems can rnams/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges gyur pa'i—/ /'gro ba 'dren la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ba spu'i 'od dang rang bzhin 'od/ /1—728

mi mjed phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du/ /'od kyi snang bas khyab byed pa/ /'od kyis nyareg pa'i sems can rnams/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges gyur pa/ /'gro mgon shākya seng ger phyo'adud/ /lngags 'od bye ba khrag khrig ni/ /brgya stong rtse las pad 'dab stong / /de stong —bde gshegs thugs mnga' bzhugs/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing du gshegs byon cing / /pha rol phyin drug chos ston mdzad/ /chos thos sems can byang chub nges/ /'gro mgon sprul pa'i sku la bstod/ /seng ge rnam grol ting 'dzin gyis/ /g.yo ldegs ltas chen bco brgyad kyis/ /mi mjed phyogs bcu'i ngan song kun/ /rgyun 'chad (lha mi'i skal mnyam byas/ /tshe rabs dran zhing sangs rgyas 'dud/ /ngan song skyob la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /mi mjed phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams/ /'od kyis zil mnan lham me ni/ /lhang nger bzhugs pa'i sku la bstod/ /rang bzhin sku brtan lha rnams kyis/ /mchod rdzas mchod de dbu stengs sun/ /byin gyis me tog khang brtsegs gyur/ /rang 'od mi mjed phyogs bcu'i zhing / /kun snang sems can mthong nas kyang / /rang mdun 'dug ste chos ston snyam/ /sku gcig du mar snang la bstod/ /rang 'od phyogs bcu'i zhing khyab nas/ /sems can ji snyed 'khod pa yis/ /rang 'khor bcas pa snang byed pa'i/ /gser 'od shākya seng ger gye'adud/ /gzungs dang ting 'dzin rab thob pa'i/ /stong nyid mtshan med spyod yul can/ /rdol med pa yi smon lam ldan/ /chos mnyam gzung dang bzod rab thob/ /blo chen sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thogs na med spobs ldan bstan pa ni/ /zad mi shes shing so so ni/ /yang dag rig pa khong du chud/ /mngon shes chen po rnam par rtse —/ /mngon shes ma nyams phyag 'tshal bstod/ /snyan pos tshig snyan le lo 1—729

med / /brtson 'grus lus srog mi lta zhing / /tshul 'chos kha gsag kyigrags pa med—/ /khe dang bkur ste'i sems med pas/ /zang zing med par chos ston pa/ /chos zab bzod pa dam pa rtogs/ /mi 'jigs thob la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhum med bdud kyi las las 'das/ /las dang nyon mongs phyir rgol bcom/ /phas kyi rgol bas zil mi non/ /nyan thos rang rgyal rtogs dka' ba/ /las sgrib rgyun chad phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par dbye zhing bstan la mkhas/ /bskal pa grangs med smon lam rtsis/ /bzhin 'dzum thog ma khro gnyer med/ /snyan cing 'jam pa'i tshig dang ldan/ /chos rab rtogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pha rol tshigs bcad dbyangs brjod mkhas/ /spobs pa mi chod 'khor mtha' yas/ /zil gyis mnan pa mi 'jigs ldan/ /bskal pa bye ba mtha' yas par/ /bstan pa ye shes 'byung mkhas bstod/ /chos rnams sgyu ma smig rgyu dang / /chu zla rmi lam sgra brnyan dang / /mig yor nam mkha' dri za'i grong / /sprul dang gzugs brnyan khong chud pa'i/ /sems zhum med la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sems can sems rgyu shes pa phra/ /spyod mkhas khong chud byas la mkhas/ /sdang med bzod rlabs chos mnyam rtogs/ /chos zab ldan zhing gting dpag dka'/ /sems chos dbang thob las nyon mongs/ /lta sgrib la sgrol phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rten pa rtogs pa bstan la mkhas/ /rten 'byel tshul mi zad shes zhugs/ /lta dang bag nyal kun sbyor spongs ༅/ /las dang nyon mongs zhi la mkhas/ /kun ldang bral la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bden pa rab rtogs ye shes mkhas/ /chos rnams sgra brnyan lta bur mos / /chos bstan tshad med 'jigs dang bral/ /bdag nyid ji ltar khong chud mkhas/ /zhing khams rnams dgongs rmi lam zin/ /grangs med sangs rgyas dran 1—730

la bstod/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba nyer ༅/'gro mkhas/ /sangs rgyas dpag med gsol btab mkhas/ /sems lta ༅ nyon mongs zhi la mkhas/ /ting 'dzin brgya stong mngon par sgrub/ /rnam rtse ye shes rtogs la bstod/ /bzang rin chen 'byung la sogs/ /khyed kyi yon tan bskal par ni/ /mtha' yas brjod kyang mi lang ste/ /de sogs sems dpa'i tshogs la bstod/ /dgra bcom zag zad nyon mongs med/ /dbang gyur sems ni rnam par grol/༅/ /shes rab shin tu rnam par grol༅/ /cang shes glang po bya ba byas/ /byed pa byas shing khur bor ba /rang gi don ni rab thob pa/ /srid pa kun sbyor yongs su zad/ /yang dag pa yi bka' yis ni/ /sems ni shin tu rnam par grol/ /sems dbang pha rol mchog thob pa'i/ /nyan thos dge slong tshogs la bstod/ /dge bsnyen pha dang dge bsnyen ma/ /chos mthong ba yi tshogs la bstod// //༄4/ /chos sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha la bstod pa/ /zobasam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /stong pa bco brgyad chos kyi sdong po la/ /pha rol phyin bcu mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /tshad med bzhi yi lo 'dab rgyas pa la/ /skye 'gag med pa'i 'bras bu so sor smin/ /sa bcu chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhing khams thams cad gser gyi sa gzhi la/ /rin chen rnam pa mang po gcal du bkram/ /me tog puṇḍa rī sha 5char bzhin 'bab/ /yum gyur dge ma khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gnas med ji ltar nam mkha' bzhin/ /spros pa med cing snang ba med/ /khrod kyi thugs ni nam mkha' 'dra/ /nam mkha' mtha' dang dbus med pa/ /sangs 1—731

rgyas rnams kyi chos nyid de/ /dus gsum las ni shin tu 'das/ /dmigs med chos sku phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bla ma bsu skyel chos snyan bstod/ /gtsug lag mchod /1rten rjes bsgrubs shing / /phud byas phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan/ /'khor mangs khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yi dam brtan g.yas zhabs gnas te/ /mi g.yo brtan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsdu ba bzhi ni goms byas pas/ /phyag dang zhabs gnyis dra bas 'brel/ /myur 'du'i snga ⑤ltas phyag 'tshal lo bza' bca' btung zhim byin rtags su/ /phyag zhabs 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags/ /sku bdun shin tu mtho ba ste/ /btung zhing nyams bde'i snga ltas bstod/ /srog gcod spangs sogs yon tan gyis/ /rting yangs sku che drang ba ste/ /sku tshe ༅ring ba khyod la bstod/ /dge ba'i tshogs sogs blang byas pas/ /zhabs gong mtho zhing spu gyen 'khyil/ /mi mnyam chos ltas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig bzo rim gro gzhan byin sogs/ /e na'i 3byin pa lta bu ste/ /myur 'dzin snga ltas phyag 'tshal lo / /bdog pa thams cad btang byas pas/ /phyag ni brla steng slebs pa ste/ /dul ba'i snga ༅ltas phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs spyod la sogs yon tan gyis/ /gsang gnas spubs su nub pa ste/ /bu mang snga thu ltas phyag 'tshal lo/ /stan sogs gzhal med khang byin pas/ /gser gyi kha dog mdog 'jam pa/ /gnas sogs bzang po thob phyag 'tshal/ /slob dpon la sogs rim gro byas/ /sku rabs g.yas 'khyil mdzod spus brgyan/ /mnyam pa'i snga ltas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi snyan mi spyod yon tan sogs/ /seng ge'i ro stod spyan blum mdzes/ /thub med snga ltas phyag 'tshal lo/ /nad pa rnams la sman sogs byin/ /phyag sor rgyas shing ro mchog ldan/ /nad nyung snga ltas can la bstod/ /zam stegs la sogs byas pa 1—732

yis / /chu zheng gab cing spyi gtsug ldan/ /mnga' chen mnga' la phyag 'tshal lo / /yun ring tshig snyan nyams bde smras/ /ljags yang srab pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /yan lag lnga ldan gsung mnga' bstod/ /yun ring tshig 'khyal spangs pa yi/ /seng ge'i 'gram pa lta bu ste/ /tshig mnyam snga ltas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rim gro mnyam med 'tsho dag pas/ /chems mnyam shin tu dkar ba ste/ /'khor ba snga nas bsags ltas can/ /bden zhing phra ma med tshig gis/ /tshems thags bzang zhing bzhi bcu tshang / /'khor ba dbyer mi phyed la bstod/ /ma chags mi ldan blta byas pas/ /ba rdzi spyan gyi dkar nag dbyes/ /kun nas mdzes pa'i snga ltas can/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan ldan bstod/ /'du dben sen mo rtezangs mdog 'dra/ /sems can phan sems sen mdog snum/ /rigs rgyud mtho phyir sen mo mtho/ /sor zlum kha na ma tho med/ /dge ba'i tshogs rdzogs sen mo rgyas//dge ba rtsa grub sor mo gzhol/ /'tsho bas dben pa rtsa mi mngon/ /nyon mongs mdud grol rtsa mdud med/ /long bu mi mngon dbyen chos mnga'/ /mi mnyam sgrol bas zhal mnyam yin/ /seng ge'i seng ge'i 'gros bzhud bstod/ /glang po co glang po'i 'gros bzhud bstod/ /ngang pa ngang pa'i stabs bzhud bstod/ /khyu mchog khyu 'umachog 'gros bzhud bstod/ /mthun pa'i lam lnga g.yas phyogs bzhud/ /lta mdzes mdzes par bzhud la bstod/ /thugs g.yo mi mnga' mi g.yo bzhud/ /sku legs yon tan ston pa ste/ /sku sbyangs sdig pa sbyangs pa yin/ /chos ston sku rim gzhol la bstod/ /sku gsung thugs gtsang sku 'jam pa/ /rnam dag sku mnga' ༅ sku rnam dag /chos 'dul mdzes pas yo byad rdzogs/ /yon tan yangs bzang sku che mdzes/ /mnyam pa'i thugs mnga' sku mnyam bstod/ /'jam 1—733

pa'i chos ston sku ni gzhon/ /mi zhum thugs mnga' sku zhum med/ /mi dge spangs pas sku rnam rgyal/ /'byung zad sku mkhregs khyod la bstod/ /yan lag rnam gro mdzes gzigs pa dag /nga rgyal de'u 3bcom sogs kyis/ /phyal zlum phyal phyam khyal ma zhom/ /chos zad yang dag bzlog pas ni/ /phyal ni phyal le bzhugs la bstod/ /chos zab thugs chud yon tan rdzogs/ /ste zab ste ba g.yas phyogs 'khyil/ /'khor mdzes la sogs yon tan gyis/ /mdzes gtsang sku la rme ba med / /yang zhing byams pa'i yon tan sogs/ /phyag 'jam phyag ris zab cing snum / /bzo dang bslabs pa'i yon tan sogs/ /phyag ris ring zhing zhal mi ring ga/ /gzugs skyes gzugs brnyan snang la bstod/ /'jam pa sngon btang yon tan rdzogs/ /ljags 'jam ljags srab ljags dmar ba/ /bsnyengs pa mi mnga' yon tan rdzogs/ /glang chen 'brug sgra nyams che'i gsung / /srid sbyor 'das sogs yon tan gyis/ /chems kyi mche ba zlum zhing rno/ /chems mnyam rim gyis gzhol la bstod/ /shes rab ri la bzhugs sogs kyis/ /shangs mtho shangs gtsang ldan la 'dud/ /gzigs pa rnam dag yon tan rdzogs/ /spyan ring spyan dang rdzi ma stug /smin 'jam smin ring dkar nag phyed/ /smin snum smin mnyam khyod la bstod/ /chos mchog yangs shing don ldan rdzogs/ /snyan ring snyan 'jam snyan ma nyams/ /phas kyi rgol ba'i bdud sogs kyis/ /dpral yangs dpral ba legs par ༅grub/ /smon lam shin tu rdzogs rtags su/ /dbu rgyas dbu skra bung ba ltar/ /gnag pa khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thugs 'jam mi gsung brlang khrugasung bral/ /bsgom spang bag nyal spangs sogs kyis/ /dbu stug dbu 'jam dbu mi stug /dri zhim dbu mi rtsub la bstod/ /phyag zhabs 1—734

dpal be'u bkra shis 'khyil/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu yis/ /brgyan pa (1da la phyag 'a'athab bstod/ /sbyor ba ①/bzhi'i lha la bstod pa rgyazhes bya ba paṇḍi ta bye〉da po ratna krirtis mdzad pa rdzogs so// // bal po ma hā pa na'i rang 'gyurazhu/// //bsdur mchan/728 kyimatshan byang 'di gzhung las 55༄sa te bkod cing /〈〈pe 〉〉sbyor ba bzhi'i lha la bstod pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//〈〈snar 〉〉sbyor ba bzhi'i lha la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ gye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stan/④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉steng / ⑤ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag729 ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉deg ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉go ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stengaka 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ra/༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉steng du/ ke〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'dun/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉seng go〈〈snar 〉〉seṅge/ 3/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thog ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bgo ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉mnyag〈〈snar 〉〉mnyan/730 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsag ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spangag731 ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nye/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 yongs bskyed/ ༅④ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrog 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉buṇḍa ri/732 ༅ 〈〈snar 〉〉mchog ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lnga/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtingag ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rga ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṇi'i/ dhi༅ 〈〈pe 〉〉lda733 khya 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mdog zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pag /༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉khyung mchog khyung / ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mda'/734 kyi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnamag ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bi'u/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phyag ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa//rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bslang / du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdug735 khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ba/ zhu/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 pa/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 bal po ma hā pa na'i rang 'gyur/1—735

0062༄༅/ /mags pa chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan la bstod pa/1 ༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā paṇḍi ta gī rti sa dza sto 27/ bod skad du / mkhas pa chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan la bstod pa/ 'jam pa'i godabyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo gros rgya mtshor tshig gi 4me tog snyan tshig ze'u 'brus rnam par sbud pa bstod dbyangs kyi/ /phreng ba spel legs dag gis rab brgyus dri med chun pos gang gi mgul la brgyan gyur pa'i/ /blo gsal stong gis khyed kyi rang bzhin bsngags par gyur mod de lta na yang bdag rmongs pa/ /dad pa'i stobs kyis ji ltar nus bzhin cung zad bstod la mkhas pa rnams kyis bzod par gsol//sgyu ma'i phreng ba'i las kyi tshul gyis rmongs gang srid pa'i chu gter du/ /bsod nams gru chag blo gros lus bying bshes gnyen dam pas na dor ba yi/ /lus can rnams la byang chub yan lag drug phrag gsum gyi gzhung lugs kyi/ /rlung drag gtsubs pa'i dba' sherlabs 'thor bas dam pa'i go 'phang pha rol son/ /grub pa 1—737
