dri med dge slong dge 'dun rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom brtson dang / /brtul zhugs grub la blo gros gsal ldan rtog ge'i dbang po'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /khyed kyi zhabs rdul rnyog /pa med la rnam pa kun tu gtugs slad du/ /gangs can 'di na 'gran zlas dben par mngon du gyur bzhin kho bos 'tshal/ /dam pa khyod kyi legs bshad bsod nams sprin/ /dge ba'i lo tog 'phel ba'i char rgyun can/ /snyan pa'i 'brug sgra zab mo stong ༅sgogs pas/ /skal ldan blo gros gnyid log rnam par bskul/ /khyod kyis chos ༅ sgrub gzhung mang 'chad pa dang / /legs bshad rtsom dang kha don rgya chen dang / /ting 'dzin dri med 'khor lo mchod pa'i tshul/ /rnam dag lta ba spyod lam dag pa dang / /gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i tshul la nyer bsten pa/ /khyod phyokyi kun spyod de dag thams cad la/ /rgol ba gzhan gyis kun nas mi rdzi bas/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pa gzhan la sngon ma mthong / /rnam pa sna tshogs rin chen rang bzhin dkon mchog gzhal med dpal ldan gtsug lag khang chen dang / /dga' ston dam pa sa 'u /gsum la grags༅ chags bral khyod ni dpal dang 'byor bas phyorab dge zhing / /thub pa'i sku gzugs gsung rab rje/dag pa rin chen las bsgrubs ༅kun nas mdzad pa rgya che ba/ /khyod mtshungs ma mchis de slad bdag blo spro ba'i chu klung dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin rnam par 'phel/ bsod nams dri med zla zer zil gnon byams pa'i 'od zer rab 'phros pas/ /nam mkha'i zla ba rnyog can des ni khyod kyi dpal rab ma bzod dekyi/ /gzugs brnyan tshul gyis rgya mtsho'i klong grodu 'jug pa 'dod pa nyid snyam du/ /bdag gi blo gros de ltar sems pas mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes par gyur/ /gdung rgyud dri med yon tan rgya che ni༅/ /blo gros mtshungs med mkhas pas nyer bsten zhing / /gzhan la 1—738

phan dgongs phongs pa'i bste gnas sa/ /mdzad pa rgya chen nye bar zhi ba can/ /khyod mtshungs ma mchis de slad dpe bral ba/ /khyed la rnam kun bstod par nus ma lags/ /'on kyang cung zad bstod pa'i ༅spro ba dang / /dge slong mkhas pa byang ༅ 'od zer gyis 0/ /rjes su gnang ba thob nas gang snang ba/ /de bzhin 'di ni bdag gis gsal bar sbyar/ /mchog tu rmad byung grags pa rgyal mtshan la / /mkhas pa bde bar gshegs pa'i dpal bdag ④ gis/ /legs par bstod la bsod nams gang yod pa/ /des ni 'gro kun bla ma la gus shog /bdag nyid chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan la bstod pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ga ta shrīs khru sbyar ba rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur ma na/737 ༅mab byang 'di gzhung las ༅sa te bkod cing / 〈〈snar 〉〉bdag nyid po po grags pa rgyal mab la bstod pa bzhugs so// 〈〈snar 〉〉kornyi sto bstod/ ༅〈〈snar 〉〉dpag ④ 〈〈snar 〉〉gig rgya〈〈snar 〉〉ze la/gye〈〈snar 〉〉rgyug 3〈〈snar 〉〉chagag 〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 1〈〈snar 〉〉rba/738 gro〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ༅〈〈snar 〉〉snyog du 〈〈snar 〉〉steng / ༅〈〈snar 〉〉kyi ma za/ de 〈〈snar 〉〉yo/༅〈〈snar 〉〉 ga 3 〈〈snar 〉〉 dang / du〈〈snar 〉〉pa la byung / bye/〈〈snar 〉〉rabag ༅〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/skyo〈〈snar 〉〉gle nga/〈〈snar 〉〉kleng / 0〈〈snar 〉〉bar/ ci〈〈snar 〉〉ba/739 tsho〈〈snar 〉〉'di/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gri ༅ 〈〈snar 〉〉snang thob nas de lag ༅〈〈snar 〉〉dag 'u〈〈snar 〉〉spyo1—739

0064 ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po la bstod pa/nya ༄lngo/ /rgya gar skad du/ pa ra ma na gu ru rnyarmā 3rā dza sto tra nā ma/bod skad du/ bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab rgyas rta yi dpung gi dba' rlabs phreng ba mtho zhing zhags pa ral gri mdung rnon 5gyis/ /chu la rgyu ba rab mang 'jigs rung rnga chen sgra ldan hor zhes bya ba dus mtha' yi/ /chu gter 'di ni mtha' dag mkhas pa'i bla ma gang gi zur mig rol pas 'jig rten rnams/ / zhi slad rab mchog 6rgyal ba'i tshul la zhi mdzad chos kyi rgyal po de ni rgyal gyur cig /nub phyogs bod kyi ri la shin tu dri med 'char ba thob cing shar phyogs dag gi yul/ /rim pas mnan pa gang gi rmongs pa las skyes shin tu rab rgyas mun pa bcom byas nas / /sems can byang chub grong khyer phyin slad chos gsung 'od zer 'a dra bas rab mtshungs sangs rgyas la / /rab tu gsal mdzad chos kyi rgyal po mchog 1/de7 1

gi 'od zer phreng ldan de ni rgyal gyur cig / gnyis ldan tshu mtha' dag skye bo rnams la phan pa bgyid slad rgyun du rab mchog rgyal ba yi/ /khyu mchog sems can dag la brten — gang rdzogs ldan la ni rkang pa bzhi dang gsum gang 5la/ /rkang pas mnan 6dang gnyis ldan dag la rkang zung gis rgyu rtsod la rkang gcig lhag ma can / /gang gis sa la rdzogs ldan bzhin du rgyu mdzad 3chos kyi rgyal po de ni rgyal gyur cig /gang zhig 'jig rten dag na sa gzhi 'byung po 'dzeen byed nyi ma dag kyang 'jig rten nid / /snang ba dag nang ldan par byed cing sprin rnams char pa 'bebs byed rlung yang g.yo/ /zla ba bdud rtsi'i rgyun ni rnam par spro byed nam mkha'i 11go skabs sbyin la rab tu dpa'/ /de bzhin chos kyi rgyal pos zol med snying rje sems can kun la rab tu 'jug par byed/ /bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po la bstod pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta snyan ngag mkhan chen po laspri ga ras sbyar ba'o / / paṇḍi khude nyid dang / lo tsā ba ngashong ston gyis dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/741 1mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈snar 〉〉bom dam pa chos kyi rgyal gyi rgyal po la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sadru ru rtarma/ /〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rba/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mthong / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rsā / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rab mchog zhi slad/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'khor lor/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 rab/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lam/742 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gang gis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bgyi / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas bstan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa de/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ldan/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sman/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mab/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 rgyun du/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mkha'/ 〈〈pe 〉〉na—742

seng ge'i sgra la bstod pa/①༄ ༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ si ha nā da lo ke shwa ra bhas ra ga su stu ti/bod skad du/ rje btsun 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra la bstod pa/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid pa'i gnas ni grangs bral bgrang 'dod 'dir yo la/ /'od ldan snyan ngag mkhan po ches cher dga' ba'i gtam/ /yon tan tshogs brjod de ltar bdag ni blo ngan yang / /'gro ba gnyis su mngon bstod sar pa'i tshig dag 'god/ /rgya chen srid pa'i pha rol byang chub ston mdzad pa/ /dus ring thang gcig bzhin du byas te brtse bas sku bzung nas/ /sems can gnas pa ma lus kun mkhyen de nyid la 'god mdzad/ /'gro ba'i mgon po brtse ldan seng ge'i sgra de rgyal gyur cig /gang tshe ri bong mtshan ma mkha' la 'od dang 'gro ba mtshon/ /gang gang chos mkhas sgrub byed bi shwa /rma bzhin/ /ma lus dkar ba'i snying po nyams dga'i dngos mdzad pa/ /de yang seng ge'i sgra ste 1—744

'od zer 'phro zhing rgyal gyur cig /dbu la rin po 'bar ba 'bad pas gnas par mdzad pas shi/ /legs byas rang bzhin sgron me 'di ni nyer 'dzin mdzad pa lags/ /de ltar gang zhig lag 'gro lta bu'i the tsom bdud ni 'joms/ /pha rol rgol las rnam rgyal seng ge'i sgra des khyed la srungs/ /'gro ba gsum gyi sa la mkhas shing bdud kyi phyogs ni 'joms/ /lag 'gro'i bdag por gnas pa'i nad ni 'joms shing bzhugs/ /gang gi rtse gsum dmyal bar 'gro ba'i rtsa ba 'joms pa ste/ /mchog ldan re tu'i sras po seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phul byung dkar ba'i rab lta bu yi shel gyi bgrang phreng yang / /dge ba mdzad pa'i phyag tu thogs pas gshin rje yang dag gnon/ /rab tu mdzes pa nor bu'i rol pa brtse dang tshul khrims ldan/ /dges pa'i spyan ldan seng ge'i sgra des khyed la srung gyur cig /snying la 'bab pa'i gang gi ral pa mdzes pa'i zer 'di ni/ /'bar zhing g.yo ba sa 'dzin lag 'gro lhag ma la ni nyal/ /'od gsal mkhar rol 'o ma'i rgya mtshor ind+ra nī la bzhin/ /seng ge'i sgra des khyed la shis pa mtha' dag ston gyur cig /'gro ba rnam par phongs pa'i thabs su gyur pa'i rkyen gang yin/ /bdud bcu po rnams ral gri'i so yis zhi mdzad pa/ /srid pa gsum gyis zhabs la btud pa seng ge'i sgra de yis/ /de ni 'gro ba'i nad dang nyer 'tshe 'joms shing sel gyur cig /ri dwags bdag po yang ni dpal ldan lha rigs skyabs 'os te/ /bde gshegs theg pa rig mngon pa yi nga rgyal kun las grol/ /bde gshegs phrin las rnam rgyas gang gi sku la 'dzin mdzad pa/ /seng ge'i sgra des khyed kyi mngon par 'dod don ༅ gyur cig /de ltar bdag gis yo kyi yon tan tshogs ni yongs su brjod pa las/ /zhi ba'i rang bzhin dge ba'i 'bras bu bsags pa'i 1—745

tshogs rnams kyis/ /ma lus 'gro ba 'di dag dga' ba'i bdag po'i lag tu ma lhung zhing / /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la kun nas rab tu 'jug gyur cig /mgon po 'di yi gzugs kyi rang bzhin sku ni kun nas thob gyur te/ /ma lus 'gro ba ji snyed 'di ni rnam par 'dren pa nyid gyur cig /kun nas gtsang mar byas pa skyebo'i bzhin gyi me long 'di/ /dpal thob ldan pa snyan ngag mkhan gyi bdag po gnyis skyes srung bas byas/ /rje btsun 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge'i sgra la bstod pa rdzogs so// //dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rgyal ba spyan snga rin po che'i bka' bzhin zha lu lo tsā ba dge slong rnyasmo pā la bha dras bsgyur ba'o// //1—746
bsdur mchan/744 skye chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du med pas dpe bsdur byung med/baspur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/(65)1wa 747

rin po che'i phreng ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ lo ke shwa ra ratna mā la sta bo nā ma/ bod skad du / 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dri med thugs ni snying dang snying rjes brlan/ /lam mkhyen nyid dang thams cad mkhyen nyid la sogs don dang tshig /gsal bar 'doms shing yongs su rdzogs dang rnam par dag pa'i sku / /ye shes lhag pa'i bdag pos rol bar mgo bos phyag bgyi'o/ /gdul bya'i dbye ba'i dbang las gcig kyang du mar snang ba ni/ /chu snod rnams su gnas pa'i ri bong can dang mtshungs gang las/ /khyod ni gsal bar gzhan la phan pa'i rjes su song de'i phyir/ /e ma'o rdzu 'phrul mchog tu rmad byung sku ni rigs pa lags/ /skyebo mu stegs pa rnams rab tu sad cing gdul don du/ /yongs rdzogs zla ba'i zhal ni rnam par sgeg pa'i dpral ba yi/ /gnas las lha sras dbang phyug chen po 1—748

nges phyung bas/ /lha yi shin tu lha dang chen po'i mi yi dbang phyug khyod/ /legs rgyas chen po'i mtshan mnga' khyod kyi phrag pa las/ /phyi rol dag tu phyung ba mes po lha yi bu nyid ni/ /padma'i skyob pa rnams gdul zhing rab tu sad phyir te/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dbang phyug gtso la mgo bos phyag bgyi'o/ /khyab 'jug pa yi skyebo gdul zhing rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /srid sgrub dag kyang phyag na padma 'dzin pa'i thugs ga las/ /nges par phyung 'di srid pa'i dbang phyug nyid de de'i slad du/ /mchog gi skyes bu khyod nyid lags te mchog gzhan yod ma yin/ /nyi zlar gus bcas stobs kyis bsnyen bkur rim gro brtsams rnams la/ /yang dag bstan phyir mthon mthing mdzes pa'i spyan ni gang dag las/ /ri bong can dang nyi ma nges phyung sa la mig rnams kyi/ /nang gi mun nag 'joms pa de la bdag ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di na dpal mor rim gro bsnyen bkur sbyor ba po rnams ni/ /gdul dang nges par sad phyir bcom ldan dbyangs cin ma 'di dag /rgyal ba'i sras po khyod kyi mche ba'i rtse las rab phyung bas/ /mngon 'dod shes rab 'bras bu ster ba de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rlung gi skyeb pa rnams gdul dang mi zad lam grub phyir/ /de nas 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal gang zhig las nges phyung 'di/ /rlung lha mchog gi bla ma sa la skyeb pa rnams kyi/ /spyod lam rnam bzhi'i 'bras bu ster ba de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /chu lha pa rnams gdul dang zhi ba'i lam 'dod ldan rnams kyi/ /yang dag khong du chud phyir bde gshegs sras po'i lto ba las/ /yang dag phyung ba chu lha'i gtso bo yang ste myur ba ru/ /'dod dgu'i dbang phyug nyid kyi 'bras bu ster la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /mthun pa'i 'bras bu la sogs mngon par 'dod rnams nges gdul zhing / /yang dag grub phyir rab mchog 1/de749

mtshan ldan zhabs kyi padma las/ /gang zhig nges par phyung ba bcom ldan nor 'dzin mar grags pa/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po mnyam med de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /khyod ni srid las gol kyang de la yang dag gnas pa ni/ /sems can tshogs la snying brtse nyid las srid pa'i spyod tshul gyis/ /srid mtha'i bar du brtan pa bdag ni rtag gnas gyur snyam du/ /dam pa'i bsam pa chen po'i mchog gyur khyod la phyag bgyi'o/ /nam mkha'i bar du snang ba'i 'jig rten khams rnams khyod nyid kyis/ /rang gi zhabs gcig mthil gyis kyang ni rnam par gnon pa ste/ /bskal ba'i mtha' ru srid pa sred par 'bar ba drag po'i me/ /khyod kyi dbugs kyi rlung gi stobs kyis nges par bcil bar gyur/ /rang gi mdzub mo gyen du gtod de 'dzin pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis/ /lhun po'i tshigs rnams du ma g.yo bar gyur cing sen mo yi/ /sbubs kyis gyen du 'dzin pas rgya mtsho'i chu yang lus ma gyur/ /e ma'o 'di lta'i nus pa khyed las gzhan du ci zhig mthong / /mchog tu gnyen gshin zla ba gzhon nu'i mdzes pa yang dag par/ /ston pa'i sku mchog 'di yang lang tsho ma yi yin nam ci/ /'jigs byed drag po gnon las mi ldongs ci yang dub ba dang —/ /gdul dka' ba yi bdud 'joms pa ni khyod kyi spyod tshul lags/ /kye lags 'di ltar po po'i skyobo'i ril phreng dang mtshungs par/ /rang gi dbu skyes mchog tu mdzes pa'i lan bu 'khyog po de/ /de nyid me yis nyon mongs bud shing spar bar byas pa yi/ /du ba'i phreng ba lta bu dri med yo la snang bar 0/ /zla zer cung zad 'phros pa yis ni cung zad khyab khyod kyis/ /nag po'i phyogs zad chung du'i cha bcas 'od kyi mdzes pa ni/ /srid pa rnams su 'dod pa gang gyur ri bong can gang de/ /khyod zer cung zad las ni ma lus bsam pa rnam par mdzes/ /1—750

mthun par 'gros pa'i ngan pa'i lam can lugs 'joms shing / /mi dang mi min bsam pa ston la lam dang lam/ /yang dag thob byed gzhan don spyod tshul mchog gis na/ /mdzes ldan rgyal ba sa yi dbang phyug la phyag bgyi'o/ /khyod ni srid dang mya ngan 'das la mi gnas kyang / /'od gsal rang byin brlab sbyor la zhugs phan pa ni/ /ma lus skye bo'i mi dge zhi mdzad dge ba yi/ /mdzes pa'i sa yi dbang phyug rgyal la phyag bgyi'o/ /rigs kyi 'od zer dpag med phreng bas yang dag dkrigs/ /rang gi phyag gi chu skyes 'dzin pa las skyes bde/ /dga' ba rjes mthun thob pa yang dag dga' bde yis/ /mdzes ldan rgyal ba sa yi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ /chos kyi dbyings las kun mchog snying rje rang nyid gtso/ /gang zhig dge ba la sogs tshogs rnams yang dag rdzogs/ /rnam par rtog spangs mthu las sgra yi ston pa po/ /mdzes ldan rgyal ba sa yi dbang phyug la phyag bgyi'o/ /de bzhin nyid dang nyid min gnyis med bde ba brgyas/ /yongs su gang bar mdzad pa brgya phrag chos kyi gtam/ /shin tu bden zhing rigs par gsung bas rnam mdzes pa/ /'dzin ma'i dbang phyug rgyal po mchog la phyag bgyi'o/ /mchog de'i rang gi sku ni 'gro la rab 'phro ba/ /mtsho skyes spyan gyis shin tu mdzes par gyur pa yi / /ma lus sems can rnams kyi myur ba'i thar mchog gi /rgyal po 'dzin ma'i dbang phyug dam par bdag phyag 'tshal/ /mchog tu sprul dang longs spyod rdzogs pa gzhan don dgyes/ /stong nyid gos med chos 'dzin pa la dgyes pa can/ /rnam byang chub las dngos grub dam pa 'dzin dbang po/ /'dzin ma'i dbang phyug rgyal po mchog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /mchog tu lhan skyes dam pa'i rgya mtshor zla zhal gyi/ /sgo las thams cad gsung ba ma lus ngag tshig ni/ /mya ngan 'das 1/de751

pa'i mtshan nyid rjes mthun rgyan gyi phul/ /dbang phyug 'dzin ma'i rgyal po dam par phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten dbang phyug bstod pa rin po che yi phreng ba ni/ /dpal ldan nags kyi rin chen zhabs kyis bgyis pa las/ /de yis gtsang ma'i dge ba gang zhig thob gyur pa/ /de nyid kyis ni 'jig rten kun du bzang por gyur / /bstod pa rin po che'i phreng ba 'di ni rdzogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po nags kyi rin po che'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'o / /mkhas pa chen po de nyid kyi spyan sngar dge slong rgya mtsho'i sde zhes bya bas bal yul ye rang gi grong khyer chen po'i 'dab dpal go bi tsand+ra'i gtsug lag khang chen por bsgyur ba'o// //1—7bya2
bsdur mchan/748 1 chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du med pas dpe bsdur byung med/bsdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/(66)

༄/ /tshogs kyi dbang phyug gi bstod pa/ ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ga ṇi shwa ra su sta baḥ/ bod skad du/ tshogs kyi dbang phyug gi bstod pa/ tshogs kyi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs chen rgyal po rgyal bar 'grub mdzad pa/ /mche ba gcigs byed glang chen dbang po'i zhal/ /gdong mdzes skyes bu mchog gi mtshan nyid can/ /tshogs dbang rgyal po mchog la phyag bgyi'o/ /lha rdzas rin chen mchog gis brgyan pa'i sku/ /zhabs gdub g.yo zhing rgyas pa'i zhabs zung ni/ /cig car kun rdzob don dam bden mchog nyid/ /tshogs mchog rgyal po'i dbang por phyag bgyi'o/ /dam pa'i dag bas gzhom bya'i g.yul du 'jug /g.yul rgyal 'bar ba'i mtshon cha phyag na bsnams/ /zhabs mchog 'dzin ma'i dbang phyug cod pan te/ /rgyal mchog tshogs kyi dbang por phyag bgyi'o/ /'dam skyes dam pa lta bu'i phyag dang zhabs/ /ma lus rab 'byam rnam par 'phro mdzad cing / /mchog gi gzhu 'dra'i dri ma med 1—754

spyan can/ /rgyal po tshogs dbang mchog la phyag bgyi'o/ /yon tan 'byung ba'i grags 'chang 'phags mchog ni/ /'dzin ma'i dbang po'i stobs las stobs gyur bgegs/ /phyag gi stobs 'dra bdud las nges rgyal ba/ /dbang phyug tshogs mchog rgyal la phyag bgyi'o/ /skye bo gter dang rin chen ros tshim zhing / /bdud rtsi chen po'i ro mchog rgyas gyur pas/ /srid 'jigs 'jigs pas nyam thag bzod pa'i mchog /rgyal dbang tshogs kyi mchog la phyag bgyi'o/ /brtson pas legs bsgrubs mtshan nyid bde ba ni/ /sems can yid kyi shing rta gang ba'i bde'i/ /gtam la mngon par zhen pa'i bden pa mchog /tshogs mchog dbang phyug rgyal por phyag bgyi'o/ /bgegs kyi bdag po dam pa la ni bstod pa'i me/ /nags kyi rin chen gyis byas dge ba rab thob pas/ /bgegs zad srid las rgyal ba'i pha rol sbyin pa las/ /skye bo don dam tshul du mnyam pa nyid gyur cig /tshogs kyi dbang phyug gi bstod pa zhes bya ba/ /slob dpon dpal nags kyi rin chen zhabs kyis mdzad pa yang dag par gang ba'o/ /'di ni dngos grub brnyes pa'i dbang phyug paṇḍi ta chen po de nyid kyis dpal bal po'i yul gyi grong khyer chen po ye rang gi dgon pa shrī go bi tsand+ra nas/ dngos grub mchog gi bka' drin gyis btsa' ba'i phyir skyes su stsal ba/ dge slong rnal 'byor spyod pa rgya mtsho'i sde zhes bya ba'i spyi bor thob pa las/ mi 'phrogs pa'i gus pa dang yid dga' ba mu med pas / skal pa chen po'i snyim par gzung zhing yi dam du bgyis te/ nor bu rgyas pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por bod kyi skad du bsgyur nas gzhan la'ang sbyin par bya ba'i chos su bgyis pa'o/ /'dis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mngon par 'dod pa mtha' dag bdag dang gzhan du 'byor par gyur 1—755

0068༄/ /dpal ri khrod zhabs kyi bstod pa rin po che/—1 ༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṭīsha ba ra pā da sto tra rasne/ bod skad du/dpal ri khrod zhabs kyi bstod pa rin po che/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin mchog gi rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /nam mkha'i ngo bo rnam pa thams cad mchog rang bzhin/ /'dod pa sel ba des na sha yig gis brjod pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpal ldan ri khrod pa la 'dud/ /rtag par byung zhing yod kyang rgyu yis bstod pa yi/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ro la mnyam par gzhag gyur pa/ /des na 'di ni ba yig gis na yang dag brjod/ /mgon po ri khrod sdom brtson dbang po la phyag 'tshal/ /rtag tu rgyal ba skyes mchog rnams kyi gsang chen la/ /dgyes shing gzhan dag chos rnams la ni dga' mdzad pa/ /de lta bu ni ra yi yi ges brjod pa ste/ /rnal 'byor ri khrod par grags de la phyag bgyi'o/ /yig gsum gyis bshad ri khrod pa la rab btud nas/ /yon tan chu 1—7du7

gter su zhig gis ni bstod par nus/ /'on kyang bdag ni bla ma khyed la dad dbang gis/ /bstod par 'dod pa de slad bstod par bgyi ba lags/ /rab tu sra zhing mi phyed thabs kyi rgyud dang bcas/ /shes rab gzhu ni mngon sum dag tu bsnams nas ni/ /lhan cig skyes pa bdag med mngon sum rang nyid kyis/ /nyams su myong ba'i mda' bkang 'gro bar gtogs rnams kyi/ /thog ma med pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i sdig pa rnams/ /yongs su sbyang ba'i phyir dang nyon mongs shes bya yi/ /sgrib pa la sogs 'ben la bsnun par gyur pa na/ /phug pa lags te kye brtan po khyod ni a la la'o/ /bdag med nyid kyis rgyas btab yang dag mtha' yis ni/ /'khor las khyod kyi dpral ba'i mthar ni mdzes mdzad de/ /e ma'o gzhan don bdud rtsi dag la sred ldan pa/ /khyod ni dgra med dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ma lags sam/ /'dod chags dang ni gzhan pa sdang byed gti mug ste / /gsum po 'di dag 'jig rten dug tu rab tu grags/ /de dag thams cad ma lus sel bar mdzad pas na/ /dgra bo drungs phyung dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs bcings pa lags/ /gang zhig 'dod la chags bral gtam gyis dman gyur cing / /sra ba'i dregs pas che dang mtho tshig rnam grol ba/ /rnam dag ngag gi rdo rje'i rna rgyan bzang po dag /snyan gnyis dag la 'phyang ba de la phyag bgyi'o/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid rdo rje mi rus phreng ba dag /gang gi mgul pa mchog gi rin chen mgul rgyan te/ /nges par 'gro ba rgyas mdzad nam mkha'i rang bzhin gyi/ /rnal 'byor dbang po bla ma de la phyag bgyi'o/ /srog gcod pa dang bral bas khyod kyi phyag dag la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal ldan gdu bu nges bcings te/ /sbyin pa la sogs pha rol phyin drug rnam dag pa/ /ma ru'i phreng ba drug ni nges par 1—758

bcings pa lags/ /ma dag 'dod chags btsan thabs dag kyang nges gsal ba'i / /rnam dag nyid la reg pas skra yi srad bu ni/ /gnyis kyi 'khor lo'i rang gi lte bar nges dkris bcings/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das pa rnam dag pa'o / /skyebo skrag pas nyam thag pa dang mi rnams kyi/ /rang la gnod byed khro ba'i rnam pa rab zhi'i slad/ /khyed zhabs chu skyes rtsa ba dag la zhabs gdub dang //de nyid phyir na dpung rgyan zung dag dkris par 'dod/ /'gyur med sems kyi thal bas sku la nges par ni/ /khyab par mdzad de ba spu nges par gang ba nyid/ /de slad khyod kyi sku ni me long 'dra ba ste/ /dpal ldan rdo rje'i sku can bla ma khyod la 'dud/ /phung po yi ni lus la dga' bar 'dzin pa yi/ /'dod chags la sogs rnams kyang sbyang ba'i slad du ni/ /thal ba dag gis sku la yang dag byugs pa yi/ /dpal ldan khyod la bdag ni skyabs su mchis pa lags/ /ral pa ring gnyis khyo shugs zung ste 'di dag ni/ /gsal por rab tu phye bas de ni bstan pa yin/ /ral pa ring po bde chen 'khor lor gnas pa ni/ /'od gsal ba yis byin rlabs zung du 'jug pa 'di/ /seng ge yis ni 'jigs par byed pa'i sgra bsgrags pas/ /gang phyir glang po cher skrag 'jigs pas nyam thag pas/ /gzhom med bdag nyid sgra yi rang bzhin rwa yi ni/ /skad kyi bgegs rnams la ni mgon khyod de 'dra'o/ /khyod kyi ma ru'i phreng ba'i rgyan ni rmad byung ba/ /'di yi phyed dmar ba ni kun rdzob bden pa ste/ /phyed nag pa yang don dam pa yi rang bzhin lags/ /de dag gcig nyid 'dud pa gang lags rab tu shis/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin bde ba rgyas mdzad pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi bcos min de nyid do/ /de slad khyod kyi sku la rnam par bkra ba yis/ /rma bya'i mjug ma 'chad pa rmad byung 1/de759

chenapo lags/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis rtsa 'di dag dang grangs mnyam pa'i/ /dbang phyug yon tan mchod phyir thogs pa rnam par 'chang / /zhi bde'i sa bon rang gi snying ga'i phyogs na ste/ /dpal ldan ri khrod khyed la rtag par phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub phun sum tshogs pa'i gter gyi mchog /dam pa'i sku yi rdo rje dag dang ldan na yang / /de las khyod kyis gcig tu sems can don grub phyir/ /sna tshogs byed pa rnams kyang nges par gzung ba lags/ /kha yig gis ni a ye bdud sde dum bur byas/ /de nas ga yig sems yongs shes pas mkha' la gshegs/ /gti mug sogs sel de slad kha dang ga dag gis/ /nam mkha'i sku ste mkha' 'gro yang ni khrod nyid lags/ /kun gyis bkur ba'i mu stegs ngan pa'i 'dod pa bcom/ /mi rnams bde gshegs go 'phang la ni 'god bar mdzad/ /legs par 'dus la dam chos rab bstan phan pa dag /gtan bde dam pa'i lam du bde bar bgrod pa'i gnas/ /rdzu 'phrul rnam 'phrul brgya phrag gnas kyis gang ba yi/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs par byed pa'i bum pa thogs/ /e ma gzhan don phul byung bsags pa'i rgyal ba ni/ /ri khrod dam pa 'di yin khyod zhabs la 'dud do/ /de ltar bla ma dam pa sha ba ra dbang bstod pa yi/ /rin chen brtul zhugs dam pa nags kyi rin chen gyis byas 'dir/ /dge ba gang thob de yis srid pa'i chu gter bying ba dag /phyung nas kun gyis lhun skyes bde 'byor myur du sa thob shog /ces pa dpal sha ba ra'i zhabs kyi bstod pa rin po che rdzogs so// //mkhas pa chen po dpal nags kyi rin chen gyis mdzad pa rje btsun dam pa de nyid kyi spyan sngar chos zob gzhon nu dpal gyis ding rir bsgyur ba'o// //1—760
bsdur mchan/757 1chos tshan 'di〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du med pas dpe bsdur byung med/bsdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/ (68)1wa 761

༄/ /dpal ldan bla ma nags kyi rin chen gyi bstod pa bdun pa/1༄lngo/ /rgya gar skad du/ sprigu ru ba na ratna sto tra sabha kai /bod skad du / dpal ldan bla ma nags kyi rin chen gyi bstod pa bdun pa/ dpal ldan bla ma nags kyi rin chen gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bal po'i yul gyi rgyal po bde bar gshegs pa yi/ /lugs la rtag tu rjes su brtson pa la bkod cing / /mkhas pa rnams kyi mdzod gyur mthar thug yon tan gyi/ /tshogs kyi zab mo snang mdzad dge slong rgyal po ste/ /rnam par grags shing mtshungs pa med pa'i grags pa yi / /rgyal mtshan bla bre dar dpyangs zab cing rgya che'i blo/ /sku yang sems can rnams kyi skyabs ni gcig pu ste/ /theg chen yang dag rtogs pas grub pa'i mtha' yi mdzod/ /nags kyi rin chen zhes bya sdom brtson mchog gi blo/ /gnas brtan 'di na gnyis med chos kyi de nyid rig /'dul ba'i sdom pas yang dag sdom la mngon par brtson/ /phas rgol glang po'i dbang la ri dwags rgyal po lags/ /phyag 1—762

'tshal sdom brtson chen po'i rgyal po rnams kyi mchog /mchog gi tshul la rab tu rnam par nges pa skye /skye bo sdug bsngal dag las 'byin byed gcig pu mchog /mchog tu nags kyi rin chen gnas brtan chen po lags/ /chags bral sems can ma lus pa dag sad par mdzad/ /phyag gi chu skyes dag gis mtshon gyi gzhu 'chang ba/ /'dzin pa'i mthil gyi rgyan du gyur pa mdzes pa'i sku/ /gnas brtan chen po nags kyi rin chen rab tu mdzes/ /dga' bral dga' ba'i glang po la sogs dri ma yi/ /dri ma dri ma med cing bral ba nyams su myong / /srid dang srid pa ma yin gnyis kyi 'ben la mda'/ /gnas brtan chen po nags kyi rin chen skyabs su gyur/ /dga' bral dang po'i bdud rtsi'i btung ba bdag la dgyes//dgyes shing nges la dul ba'i yan lag brgya phrag gis/ /sems can brgya phrag tshogs rnams yongs su smin pa dag /rtsi mdzad gnas brtan chen po nags kyi rin chen no/ /bdud sde la sogs rnams kyi kha la ro med mdzad/ /kha yi chu skyes dag ni dgra yis gang ba 'joms/ /skye mched 'dar ba'i phas rgol ri yi dbang po 'khru / /khrus mdzad nags kyi rin chen gnas brtan chen po'o/ /dpal ldan bla ma nags kyi rin chen gyi bstod pa bdun pa 'di ni rdzogs so// //yul ma ga jo nas byung ba'i dge bsnyen dam pa nyi ma pa zhes bya bas mdzad pa'o / /'di ni spyan mnga' chos kyi rgyal pos gser gyi me tog dang bcas pa'i bka' lung gis/ rtse thang lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// //1—763
bsdur mchan/762 nyuchos tshan 'di〈〈sde 〉〉kho nar yodabasdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/(69)1wa 764

0070༄༅/ /skyes pa rabs kyi bstod pa/①༄dze/ /rgya gar skad du/ dzā ta ga sta ba/ khye das sha ba le gu ṇi ra ༄tsho༅/ /bod skad du/ skyes pa rabs kyi bstod pa/ khyab bdag stobs bcu mnga' sha wa li tsasde bi zu / bi sto/ /dza sunda ni kā bi bsto na dza ḍabye ta kwa tse dasmra ba'i ma 'dres spyod pa dbang 'byor ba'i/ /skyeba'i rgyud du rnam par 'jug 'di blun yang bdag gi nam yang ma / ye na bskyo pha lo da yas yi bha babye byā hi tāḥrmā sha ba/ ste nastu khya nu brnyi nī mu ni / don yod 'bras bu 'byung phyir ma la rdul tsam/ des na bstod dang rjes su 'brel kha ra nā mā lasbra te sa ra tī/ byuṣṭha lambha na larnyi naḥsha ma dṛ shā mā bee ṇi kāḥsaṅku ba'i ca co tshig dang ming dag dmigs/ sems kyi dmigs las 'gongs zhi ba'i lta ba ma 'dres yon tan ḍā / bā rtswa go tsa ra tsā tu yāndi ga la yā sbru lā hi bo mā dṛ shaṃ/ ratna n+yasbu ni dhe ru pā mchog /tshig gi spyod yul nyid gyur cha shas che long 'di 'dra ba/ chu gter sa yi sgang bur rin chen zu pu li ne ji birbha baspyorji nā mantabhinda ta ram̐ gadro ta ru ba / byosgyu ni (rje ti ༅/gsal gyur don med rnams kyis ni/ /tha dad nang nas zab cing gsal la 'od ldan len par byed pa bzhin/1—765

yā bo bo dhe pa thā nu yā na ma hā tā muṅgā ti nī gasmo ḍā mā sdille sha hi to da ye dzi nā kṛ gangazang chub lam rjes su theg pa chen po jo ba las kyis/ bdag la phan pa 'byung rgyal ba yā bi pyas nī santa tiḥ/ si dri kā pa tsitaḥpu na ti bha ga bān so krirgya/ mā nā dra dhu brtse ba rgyud sde tshan dag byed bcom ldan yang dag grags da ni shes nā dho yā sgo ga bi sā ri ḍo ga ta mā lhags ge ba bo dha gu ṇaḥ/ uṅgā ma dī ra dasu rā ga bya'i longs spyod dri bral lta ci smos byang chub yon tan glang po myos pa chags pa'i ba shi no bṛbho pu rorlu di nī/ mā lo gyu bya ti brti nā pra ṇi hi tā bo dzha rnyi yo yantu yā/dbang gyur gnas kyi myos ma la/ /bzlog par ma nus zhugs pa gcig nas khyod kyi byang chub la/birgya sunta i bā ma rāsta yi tsi re dharmā snyi ṣe ga griyadhe nā shambi ta ke sha rānta ma mṛ dza na lha rnams ring nas khyod la chos kyi dbang bskur dpal bzhin thugs dag bkod/ de yis mgul ral pa tha pusgo pa hā ram̐ di baḥ/ grudruḥkha gla pi to da rī gi ri da rī rānt+rarnya ra la spri shā/ma spro me tog nye bar za ba/ bkres pa'i sdug bsngal nad kyis ri sul bar du gnas gyur pa'o/ /dṛspro shā ba ga ghā ta nai ga ra bha sī byā spyo da yā smra ta dhīḥ/ yaslo balka li stag mo phru gu mthong nas za bar rtsom gzigs gcig tu brtse bas bskyab pa'i blos/ /gang khyod shing shun gyis dzī dza ṭi dza na ba ṭī murtos mudṛs bān sthā ṇadhe na bha bān bha bā dri bi ba ra byā brti dzā ni ral pa bcings te btags nas sku dag borades na skyob pa khyod srid pa'i ri bo'i khung bur 'khor ba'i lus de ti dzā/ lngazi le ya si to pa lā dri ba ha lo mā tai ga 〉 bi bha tā kānta dzā na ra brti can rnams la/ /dkar rdo ba ri glang po nyid bzung dgon par mi 'khyam pa lus dzā ta nu dhri tā mustsotta ye byā pa dām/ shi lerje shi thi lo pa le tsa la ya tā muktasta lngadru bzung chang 'phongs pa rnams la ri dbang yangs pa rdo ba g.yo ba bor khyod kyis bdag 'gram ta 7tu/ ma bye mas ri rghaṃ ni tārnya ma li nāste na kṣa tā bṛtta yag yaslo kāsba ra du sems ser sna dri ma can des nyams spyod pa rnams gang 'jig rten nam 1—766

tsand+ra tsand+ra ba pu khya tsand+ra pra bha stu twa lnga/ gaspu ṣārnya shi sa shi khā ma ṇi ru tsā dasto mkhar zla ba zla ba'i lus zla 'od nyid tshe khyod kyis skyon mthar byed gtsug phud gtsug gi nor bu 'od ldan dī dzā yātho ne/ nā lāslu na mi pā ra binda ma si nā pyoskṛtta spu le shi ra/ ste ṣpe byin gnyis skyes slong ba la/ sdong bu bcad bzhin ladmaral gris bcad rtsa ba dbu/ des na 'di ṣāñdza ga shā ga to si gu ru tā mutīṣa bsgrub ni/ bā lāṅgā la sa ro dza ko ma la ta ju dag 481 rnams la bla ma rnams kyi gtsug tor bzhin du mgo la'o/ /byis pa byis pa latsho skyes 'jam pa lus rgyas tra kā nātho na/ paryāstusna tsa lasgru khaṇḍa ga sbyo to dā dzābyu bhā bā nu gān/ pā dzā sbyo bu don gnyer la/ gtsug phud bzung chung ma yang dang po dang rjes mthun/ rgyal dzi na te na nu na ma bha ba raṅga nā rna mu sa sasgo bāgyi ta pasgra lo tsa na da li yadzñā la sā ba de yis bdud kyi bu mo rnams kyi kha ji ma mig 'dab ma gang dra ba snyan tshig maze ram̐/ sha lla swasna bī tsā ri khro ba na zu bā bhū tā pu rā pakṣi khri/ snyinda sheṣa ga le dza 'dar mal gnyid rnam dpyod nags sagyur nasagrong bu yis tha dad la lus 'gro ga khya bi sa le dzñā ཿpa thā / si nā/ bistu re ga mi te bra ta sbyo 〉 yas tha kā piñdza le/la ma tshang med rgan po'i lam bsngags rgya chen bgrod pa brtul zhugs bzung gang mgon te nā dzñā ma ru hūṃ ki rī ṭa ki ra ṇa sgo yi āspa rda bo ga tā/ ya61spu pha lā shi nī sha sha de yis shes cod pan 'od mdzes go 'phang / gang zhig lo ma chu dang 'bras bu za ba'i ta rnu rta nā tha bi bhraspu rā/ taṅgā lā ti tha ye kṛ pā ri tsa yā dā ti byu mā be da na ri bong lus ni mgon khyod bzung ba na/ de dus 'gron la brtse bas yongs su 'gris pas sbyin byar rig ya na / ༅rū hoḥspu ṭa bi spu liṅga ma na larnye nā byu na pi kṣi tā/ bisdo maṇḍa la nas zhugs 'phro me stag me la de nas ltos pa med thig le'i dkyil 'khor mtshan ma pāñtsa ṣpe sha sha ma yo yu rya sho lagyu te/ yasgo pā ru ṇa dṛṣṭi nā ga la zu bā kṛ tā sgru bo ri bong rang bzhin khyod kyis grags pa mtshon par byed/ gang 'khros skya rengs mthong byas nas 1—767

tāñdza lo dza la pu rā mā gas tā bā ri dhe/ be lhaste shī ba ro dha swā dza la la baspyo do ha se sar pa nyid chu chu grong bkug chu gter dus mtha' rnams su chu bzhin chad pa yang dag lagyu te/ twartsorsā ti sha rmā sha le sha ra tsa nā zathe ya sā musto ba/ se bhā ro bi mtshon/ khyod kyi spyod pa phul byung cha shas bag tsam bkod pa dang legs pa las byung tshogs langs bu la pra sā da bi ga sastosbya tsitā sha su me/ te nā tyanta pa ro pa kā ra nir taḥswārje bi pa rab dang rgyas pa gus pa stug po'i cha yis bdag/ de yis shin tu gzhan phan nges dga' rang gi don mnā da ro/ byu yatparba bi dzā pa rārba bi du hūṃ yā ṣpe ga tā no dza naḥ/la gus pa zhan/ /thams cad mkhyen pa gzhan don la mkhas theg pa gcig par skyobo rnams gyur cig /dzā ta gas ba utsārsā dzñā na ya sha saḥ// //skyes rabs kyi bstod pa slob dpon ye shes grags pas mdzad pa'o// //'di ni rgya dpe las bod kyi skad du/ zhwa lu lotsā ba dge slong dharma pā la bha dras bsgyur ba'o// //1—770

0071༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa la bstod pa/①༄༅༅/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan bzang po'i chos kyi legs par grags pa'i gsung / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sras po bde bar gshegs pa'i sku / /'jig rten gsum spyan srid gsum sgron me gcig pu pa/ /ye shes rab tu grub la brtson pas phyag bgyi'o/ /thugs rje'i 'byung gnas de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa can/ /rnam par 'dren pa dran mkhyen bde ba'i go 'phang gnas/ /srid par gcig tu gzhan gyi don la nges par 'byung / /sgol dka' sgol ba de nyid kho nar phyag bgyi'o/ /sngon gyi tshe rabs rjes su rig cing rab mchog yon tan tshogs kyis brgyan pas sku ni rab tu mdzes/ /ye shes rgyan dang lhab lhub dang ldan rgya chen brtse ldan ma 'ongs rjes su rigs dang bcas/ /sems can don dang theg gsum gcig pa'i ye shes chu yis skye bo mtha' dag ljon shing dbang bskur ba/ /shākya'i sras po bde gshegs sku yi yon tan mnga' ba ye shes phung po de la phyag 1—772

bgyi'o/ /sa dang pha rol phyin dang dge ba rab mchog bcu po thams cad kyis/ /gang zhig nye bar rgyas byas bsod nams tshogs kyi pha rol son/ /stobs bcu'i yon tan brnyes pas tshogs kyi mthar son pa/ /srid dang srid bral rgya mtsho sgol mdzad de la phyag bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yon tan dang bsod nams kyi tshogs dang sa dang pha rol tu phyin pas gang ba bla ma dam pa mchog gi man ngag gi dam pa'i chos kyi rnga bo che rigs pa dang rnam par bkra ba'i tshig gis brgyan pa sangs rgyas kyi myu gu byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan can grags pa bzang po dang thugs rje dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bsil ba can tshogs thams cad kyi pha rol tu son pa la bstod pa/ lha'i yul mthar gnas pa'i shākya'i dge slong dge legs dpal mgon gyis gsol ba btab ste ha ri puñdza'i yul gyi shākya'i dge slong chos kyi nyi ma zhes bya bas rnam par bkra bar bkod pa mgo bo la thob bo zhes/ bdag dang 'gro ba rnams la dge bar gyur cig /bdag gi bsod nams las 'di yis/ /ma 'ongs sangs rgyas nyid gyur te/ /'khor bar sdug bsngal sems can rnams/ /mya ngan 'das la rab 'god shog/ //1—773

0072༄/ ngas mchong chem mo ba'i'i tshib ri ba (sde 3 / / / /le'ur byas pa/ ༅ ༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ kā la su tsa ma ha ༅ tsa turku ri ga/ bod skad du / dus mchod po mo bzhi'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ thams cad mayo pa ༅phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la zhugs rnams kyis/ /skyabs gsum dag la bskyabs pa dang / /gzhan yang bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /rdzogs phyir dus mchod dam bca'o/ /ston pas legs par gsungs pa yis/ /dus mchod bzhi ni 'di yin te/ /cho 'phrul che dang mngon byang chub/ /chos 'khor lha las babs pa'o / /skar ma chu dang sa ga dang / /chu stod ༅tha skar rim bzhin nya/ /me tog u dum wa ra dang / /bsing ma khug chos spang brgyan rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du kha 'bus stethu / /kha ta co ga khu byug dang / /sha ba rim bzhin sgra 'byin te/ ༈/mdor na khyim rtsis dang sbyar na/ /bum glang sharka ṭa dang srang / /nyi ma gang ldog rgyal du rtsi/ /phyi tshes gcig nas nya yi bar/ /zla phyed cho 'phrul chen po yin/ /1—775

mnyan yod na ri lag len dar/ /bdud btul ba yi dus yin pas/ /cho 'phrul chen po zhes kyang grags/ /mdo sde mdzangs blun dag las gsungs/ /de nas dgung zhag dgu bcu'i nya/ /nyin zhag 'phrugs gcig rdo rje'i gdan/ /gnas mchog de na dus mchod 'di'i/ /lag len dar bar gsungs pa yin/ /mngon byang chub dang bltams 1pa ni/ /'dul ba'i gleng gzhi nyid las gsungs/ /mdo sde rgya che rol pa las/ /lhums su zhugs pa zhes bshad do/ /bcu gnyis pa dang chen po las/ /mya ngan 'das pa zhes bshad do/ /de nas zhag ni zhe dgu 'das/ /tshes bzhi'i nyin zhag bden bzhi'i chos/ /wa ra ḍā ser bskor ba des/ /de na 'di yi mchod pa dar/ /rgya cher rol pa'i mdo dang ni/ /sil bu las ni de ltar gsungs/ /de na bcu phrag bcu yi nya/ /ston 'bring hor zla dgu pa la/ /mchod pa yangs pa can na dar/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas nas ni/ /ston pas dbyar gnas mdzad nas byon/ /mu stegs ston pa btul ba'i phyir/ /cho 'phrul chung ngu zhes kyang bya/ /'di ni mya 'das sil bu dang / /phran tshegs zhes bya'i lung las gsungs/1 /de nas phan yon bstan pa ni/ /dus chen bzhi la mchod pa ni / /dam bcas ma chag byas pa yis/ /phan yon spyi ni dpag med kyang / /mdor bsdus pa ni 'di lta ste/ /dkon mchog gsum la ma gus dang / /bla ma grogs po sun phyung dang / /nad pa pha ma bsnyen mi bkur/ /dad zas za zhing le lo byed/ /rgyun gtor chag dang dbul 'phongs la/ /sbyin pa gtong bar mi byed pa'i / /las rnams myur du zad nas kyang / /byang chub thob par the tshom med/ /dus mchod bzhi ni ma chag na/ /gzhan yang dge slong sman pa ni/ /brgyad kyi sma yang bsos par 'gyur/ /sdig grogs yul dang nye du dang / /ma brtags brgyad 1—776

dang dge slong ma/ /'du 'dzi sha chang bye mo'i gtam/ /de dag la chags dman ma yin/ /bla ma dam tshigs nyams pa dang / /byang chub sems la ngan sems bskyed/ /rnyed phyir chos 'dra ston pa dang / /sdig la sbyor dang dge 'dun gyis/ /yo byad brkus dang rtsa lhung byung / /dkon mchog spong dang 'tshams med byas/ /bstan la zhugs nas rtsod pa byed/ /mdza' shes sgyugs dang bcu po ni/ /dmyal bar skye bar gsung ba'i lam/ /myur du zad nas kun mkhyen thob/ ༈ /dus 'dir 'chi ba blu ba dang / /mi mthun 'dums dang mchod rten brtseg /rnying pa gso dang yi rang bas/ /bsod nams dpag med thob par 'gyur/༈/dus bzang gzhan yang bstan pa ni/ /bla ma dang ni mdza' bshes dang / /byang chub sems dpal gshegs pa'i dus/ /nyi zla sgra gcan gdon gyis zin/ /mu ge sde brtsod yams nad 'byung / /dus chen bzhi dang bcu gnyis la/ /de bzhin gshegs dang dam pa'i chos/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos kyi/ /rjes su slob pa'i dge slong dang / /bla ma pha ma lha bzo ba/ /'gro ba'i nad gso sman pa rnams/ /zas skom rin chen sman sogs kyis/ /mchod na skyeb thams cad du/ /gnas dang longs spyod grogs la sogs/ /de dag mchog tu gyur pa thob/ /lha yi bsrungs dang bar chad med/ /sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims ldan/ /snying rje gzhan gyi dbugs 'byin cing / /nad med 'dod pa chung ba dang / /gzhan gyis bkur ba'i 'os su byung / /'tsho ba rnam par ma dag dang / /dam tshig nyams pa 'byang bar byed/ /dge 'dun byang chub sems dpa' dang / /gnyen bshes rnams kyis rgyan ①du gyur/ /gnad gcod sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing / /shi 'phos gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /tshe rabs kun tu dal 'byor lus/ /thob nas 1—777

rab tu byung ba dang / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten byed cing / /bslab pa gsum dang 'bral mi 'gyur/ /dus chen bzhi dang tha mal pa'i/ /khyad par sil bu myang 'das las/ /sa ya phrag brgya'i 'gyur du gsungs/ /nyi ma gza' yis zin pa'i dus/ /bye ba phrag ni 'bum 'gyur dang / /zla ba bye ba bdun 'gyur ro / /dus chen bzhi la nyi zla zin/ /de dag bsod nams khyad par 'phags/dus mchod chen po bzhi'i tshig le'ur byas pa kha che'i paṇḍi ta shākya shris ①mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇḍi ta de ki dang sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi bsgyur ba'o // // 1—778

bsdur mchan/775 ①chosatshan 'di〈〈sde 〉〉na med pas〈〈pe 〉〉gzhir bzung nas〈〈snar 〉〉dang bsdur ba yin la/mtshan byang 'di gzhung las blangs nas bkod cing 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du dus mchod chen po bzhi tshig le'ur byayopa bzhugasazhes pa snang /②〈〈snar 〉〉hā/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉chag ④〈〈snar 〉〉bstod/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉te/776 ①〈〈snar 〉〉brta na 777 ①〈〈snar 〉〉brgyan/778 ①〈〈snar 〉〉shrīthegabasdur 'bras re'u migabastod tshogs/(72)1wa 779

007 ༄/ /e ga ṅgā tha'i don 'grel/①༄༅༅/ /srid pa gsum gyi bla ma gnas skabs kun tu 'gro ba rnams la phan mdzad pa/ /mkhas shing gsal ba'i blo dang bsam gtan mngon shes thugs bsgom pa / /stobs bcu mnga' ba rnal 'byor dang ni mayo par ldan pa khyod 'dra las gzhan pa/ /lha yul sa la yod min 'jig rten 'dir min rnam thos bu yi gnas na'ang med/ /legs spyad dam pa rmad byung gcig tu mdzes pa mi yi mig la mdzes rnams dang / /bde bar gshegs pa dri med 'jig rten las 'das dge ba'i gsung dang mtshan rnams kyis/ /nye bar bsags pa'i sku ni gzi brjid 'phreng ba ldan pa khyod dang mtshungs pa ni/ /lha yi pho brang gnas mchog dag na'ang med la phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dag na'ang med/ /snyan cing mnyen la dag cing ma 'khyugs ༅gsung gis mi dang lha rnams la/ /khyab bdag khyod kyis de nyid bshad pa brtsal te khyod dang mtshungs pa ni/ /mang du 'di ci thub pa gang gis rnam 1—780

dpyod bcas pas dogs med par/ /ri dang nags su bcas pa'i nor 'dzin yangs pa kun tu rgyus kyang rnyed ma lags/ /zhi dang dul la dgyes shing yang dag gsung ba lha dbang phyag byas pa/ /rgyags dang zhe sdang ma rig bral zhing yang srid spangs gyur pa/ /gdul bya'i bsams pa ji bzhin 'jam zhing phan pa'i gtam gyis dga' mdzad pa/ /skyes bu khyu mchog khyod dang 'dra ba'i dge sbyong chen po gzhan dag ga la zhig /de ltar stobs bcu mnga' ba skar rgyal bstod pa ji bzhin bdag gis kyang / /nyin dang mtshan du ches cher 'bad pa'i blo gros las ni rang gi brtson 'grus kyi/ /mtsho chen pha rol son te khyad kyang pha rol gnon pa rgya che bas / /'gro ba ma tshang med pa'i skyob pa de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' bo nyid gyur cig /'di slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'o// //rgya dpe las bod kyi skad du zha lu lo tsā bas bsgyur pa'o/ //༅maṅga le/ /lan cig zhus so// //1—781
dza /

༄/ /kye'i rdo rje bsdus pa'i don gyi rgya cher 'grel pa/ / ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ he badzra pi⑤ṇḍatho ṭī kā/ bod skad du/ kye'i rdo rje bsdus pa'i don gyi rgya cher 'grel pa/ dpal kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo /'jig rten spyod pa rnam par spangs byas rgyal ba'i rang bzhin rtag tu byung zhing khyab / /gnyis gnyis med cing dri bral dbang po ①min bde kun mkhyen e skru④ mchog zhi ba/ /thugs ni thugs min thugs de beems po ma yin kun du dbang po thams cad pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ngo bo nyid sku bdud rtsi la ni rtogs ched phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan brgyad po rab bcom las byung rnam par thar rnams gtso bo'i zhal brgyad rnams/ /stong pa nyid rnams bcu drug phyag dang thugs rje rnams kyang thod pa 'di rnams te/ /'gyur med lnga bcu rjod byed de nyid bkod pa phrag par mgo yi phreng ba can/ /cod pan la ni mi bskyod zla phyed rdo rje'i phreng ba thod pa'i bdag nyid mnga'/ /byams pa la sogs rnams dang rnam thar zhabs 1—785

bzang rnams kyis bdud rnams mnan te bzhugs/ /nyon mongs shes bya bsdus dang sbyor ba brang 'gro phyag rgya stag gi pags pa yis/ /gang la bdud sogs sgrib rnams cha tsam lta bur sems can don du brgyan de la/ /btud nas 'di yi rgyud kyi gsang ba 'chad byed 'grel pa bdag gis bri bar bya/ /sems can kun la phan 'dod pa/ /sa bcu rnams kyi dbang phyug po/ /dpal ldan rdo rje snying po yis /rnal 'byor pa yi lam thob ched/ /'bum phrag lnga pa'i rgyud chen las/ /nyung ngu'i rgyud ni legs phyung ba'ang / /brgya phrag bdun ni phyed bcas pa/ /rdo rje'i tshig mang ldan pa 'dir/ /kye yi rgya rdo rjes bskul bas na/ /gzhung ni stong phrag drug pa ste / /rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rjes 'brang gang / /de 'dis ⑤rgyud 'di ༅ gsal don du'o / /snyigs ma lnga yi dus 'di ru/ /slob dpon gang rnams 'byung 'gyur ba/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa ston byed cing / /yang dag lam la gnas min la/ /'grel pa med par nyung ngu'i rgyud/ /ston par byed pa tshul ngan pa/ /gzhan gyi bud med nor 'dod pas/ /dmyal bar 'gro bar ches brtson pa/ /mngon shes lnga sogs med par ni/ /kha cig 'grel pa byed par 'gyur/ /rtog ge'i bstan bcos nga rgyal gyis/ /rnal 'byor spyod la brnyas par byed/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /'bad pas dbang gis gzung nas song / /bdag ni rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes/ /mi 'ga' mi la smra bar 'gyur/ /tshul khrims sdom pa 'dzin pa yi / /dge slong kun la phyag mi byed/ /sa la rdo rje 'dzin rang nyid/ /gos dkar can bdag phyag 'os zer/ /sten 'ubyed tshong pa dmangs rigs dang / /gang rnams zhing pa'i las la dga'/ /rmongs pa dam chos 'tshong byed pa/ /spyad bya ma yin longs spyod pa/ /bdud kyi rigs gtogs de rnams ni/ /slob ma 1—786

rnams kyi bla mar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i zol gyis ni/ /rang gi nyes byas sbed byed cing / /de rnams skyon rnams spang bya'i ched༅/ /nges par smra bar byed 'gyur te/ /slob dpon yon tan gzung bya yi/ /skyon ni slob mas nam yang min / /skyon 'dzin 'dir ni dngos grub med/ /'di la nges par the tshom med/ /snying rje med cing khro la gdug /khengs shing chags la ma bsdams dang / /rang bstod bla mar slob ma ni/ /blo dang ldan pas mi bya'o/ /tshig 'di slob ma rnams la ni/ /rnam pa kun du smra mi byed/ /brtse med zhing las byed pa gang / /khro zhing gnad du snun ༅par byed/ /gdug cing dge slong skye bor sdang / /rengs pa shes pa ngan pas khengs/ /'dod chen spyad bya min don gnyer/ /shin tu chang 'thung ma bsdams ༅pa/ /rang la bstod pa 'dir brjod cing / /yon tan can la skyon 'byin byed/ /dbang bskur mchog thob rdo rje yi/ /slob dpon la ni de bzhin gshegs/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pas/ /dus gsum byon nas phyag byed ces/ /dgongs te bshad pa mi shes shing / /ming tsam gyis ni rmongs pa rnams/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po rnams smad nas/ /ngu 'bod du ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' spyi bo nas/ /byang chub shing drung dbang bskur gang —/ /dbang bskur mchog thob gyur pa de/ /rdo rje slob dpon de bzhin gshegs/ /phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /lus gang 'jig rten khams rnams te/ /der gnas bya phung po lnga rnams kyis/ /dus gsum byon nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas cod pan rin po che/ /sna tshogs dngos rnams 'jig rten khams/ /der gnas sangs rgyas phyag byas gang / /rnal 'byor rdo rje slob dpon de'o/ /ji ltar brda yis bshad pa la/ /rnam snang gci ba khu ba dag /1—787

mi bskyod pa dang 'od dpag med/ /de ltar slob dpon rdo rje 'chang / /bshang gci khu ba phyag rgya rnams/ /ji ltar slob dpon ster byed bzhin/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub rnams/ /de ltar rdo rje 'dzin pas stsol/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam pas/ /slob ma rnal 'byor pa rnams las/ /dkyil 'khor byang chub shing drung du/ /dbang bskur sngar dang phyis de bzhin/ /dgongs pas bshad dang dgongs min dang / /ji bzhin sgra dang ji bzhin min/ /de bzhin nges don drang don te/ /rgyud ni mtha' drug mtshan nyid can/ /slob dpon yon tan gang rnams 'dir/ /tha snyad kyis ni bstan de rnams/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i yon tan te / /mngon shes drug sogs mtshan nyid rnams/ /brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan / /bzod ldan drang ①po g.yo sgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /snying rje ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas/ /de nyid bcu rnams yongs su shes/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /dang ba'i bdag nyid dbang po thul/ /gsang sngags 'chang byed slob dpon no/ /yon tan bshad pa 'di rnams ldan/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur/ /dge tshul khyim pa min de dag /bcu rnams dge slong 'dir mtshungs min/ /bslab pa'i gzhi bcu ldan pa dang / /bslab pa'i gzhi lnga ldan pa dang / /bslab pa'i gzhi yi mtha' ldan pa/ /de gsum mtshungs pa min par bshad/ /ji ltar rtsa ba'i rgyud du gsungs/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gnas/ /gang de cung zad bla ma ni/ /mnyes byed slob ma la brjod bya / /bdag med mas zhus rdo rje can/ /ji lta'i rim pa bzhin du ni/ /bslab pa'i gzhi ni sbyin ched du/ /tshig ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /dang por bslab pa'i gzhi lnga rnams/ /gso sbyong sogs dang yang dag ldan/ /mi dge bcu po 1—788

yongs spong ba/ /byin nas dge bsnyen nyid du bya/ /de nas bslab pa'i gzhi rnams ni/ /bcu po byin nas dge tshul bya/ /de nas bslab gzhi bye ba ni/ /byin nas dge slong brtul zhugs bya/ /de nas so sor thar shes nas/ /de nas bye brag zoba'i lugs/ /de nas mdo sde shes byas nas/ /rnam shes zab rang chos las/ /de nas shes rab pha rol phyin/ /dgongs pa dbu ma shes bya ste/ /de ltar rgyud gzhan mnyan nas ni/ /de nas kye'idor shes par bya①/ /theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung las/ /theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas dang 'dir/ /theg pa chen po gsum pa ste/ /sangs rgyas pa la bzhi pa dang / /lnga pa thub pa'i dgongs pa min/ /rnam pa thams cad mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong nyid dang por rgyu yin te/ /smon lam las ni snying rje phyis/ /'gro ba'i don byed 'bras bu'o/ /rang don byas nas gzhan don ni/ /byed pa gang de blo ldan yin/ /rang sdug bsngal can dbul po gang / /de yis gzhan la ji ltar sbyin/ /bde ldan dbang phyug phun tshogs pa/ /sems can don la snying rjes brtson/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu don gnyer bas/ /ji srid rgyu mngon ma byas pa/ /de srid dang por rgyu med pa'i/ /'bras bu gang las ②'byung bar 'gyur/ /theg pa che las theg pa gzhan/ /gnyis po 'di ru brjod pa ni/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs nyams rnams/ /ngal so'i ched du'o de nyid min/ /chos rnams kun gyi stong pa nyid/ /nges 'byung byed par bdag gis bshad/ /nges 'byung byed pa'i rgyu de dang / /de nas smon lam dbang las ni/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid 'bras bu che/ /dmigs pa med par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sems can chos dang dmigs pa med/ /snying rje 'di ni gsum du bshad/ /nyi che'i don byed cung zad 1—789

pa / /sems can chos la dmigs pa ste/ /grub pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /sa bcu la gnas bdag nyid kyi'o/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'gags gyur cing / /sa kun la gnas bdag nyid can/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi dmigs med de/ /'gro ba'i don rnams mdzad par bshad/ /rgyu ni gang 'dra gang 'dra ba/ /de 'dra de 'dra'i 'bras bu der/ /ko tra ba las 'ga' zhig tu'ang / /sā lu nyid ni skyemi 'gyur/ /sa bon de bzhin ljon de bzhin/ /ljon shing de bzhin 'bras de bzhin/ /thog ma bar dang tha mar yang / /thub pa'i bka' ni dge ba yin/ /dang por rtog bcas rgyu las ni/ /'bras bu rnam rtog bcas 'byung gis/ /sangs rgyas pa kun la rtog ①las/ /tha mar 'bras bu stong nyid min / /dang por zhing rnams sbyang don du/ /ko tra 1ba rnams 'debs byed cing / /phyi nas sbyangs pa'i zhing la ni/ /sā lu'i ④sa bon 'debs pa bzhin/ /las kyi sar skyes mi rnams ni/ /ma dag zhing yin zhes bshad do/ /ma dag 'gro drug skyes pa ste/ /dge dang mi dge'i 'bras bur brjod/ /mi yi skye ba dag zhing la/ /dmigs med snying rje'i sa bon ni/ /btab pas gang zhig de yi phyir/ /stong nyid dpag bsam ljon shing 'byung / /stong nyid dpag bsam ljon shing las/ /dmigs med thugs rje'i 'bras bu ni/ /sems can kun gyis bsam byas nas/ /'byung ngo 'di la the tshom med/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos rnams la / /skal ba bral ba'i bdag nyid la/ /phyag rgya dkyil 'khor sngags sogs gang //yid 'ong bdag gis bstan pa yin/ /phyag rgya dkyil 'khor sngags sogs kyis/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /ston par byed pa ma 'ongs pa'i/ /slob dpon rnams ni bdud kyi rigs/ /de phyir dge slong theg chen la/ /ston byed rdo 1—790

rje 'chang bshad de/ /theg pa gsum po yongs shes shing / /chos kyi bsdu ba ston byed pa'o/ /rig ①byed grub mtha' rnal 'byor rnams/ /dbang phyug sogs kyis byas pa dang / /sangs rgyas pa yi sngags rgyud la/ /stong pa nyid la khyad par yod / /gang zhig mi shes rmongs bdag nyid/ /slob ma ma lus ltung bar byed/ /byed po med par las yod min/ /las dang bral na 'bras bu med/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po khyadrag chen po / /'byung dang sdud par byed pa po/ /rang nyid 'phrog po rang byed po/ /rang nyid rgyal po rang gtso bo/ /de ltar dbang phyug sgyu ma ni/ /dbang phyug gis kyang bshad pa ste/ /mu stegs zhi ba'i grub mthar ro/ /glu ༅yi chos su khyab 'jug gis/ /gdul dka' 'dul bar byed pa de'ang / /de yang legs par rnam skyong byed/ /gang tshe gang tshe sa gzhi 'dir/ /chos ni mnyam chung nyid gyur cing / /chos ma yin pa 'jug byed pa/ /de'i tshe nga ni bdag skyed /༅/de / /legs pa rnams ni bsrung don dang / /nyes par byed rnams 'jig byed du'o / /chos ni gnas pa'i don ched ༅du/ /dus dang dus su bdag 'byung ngo / /phyin ci log tu chos ston pa/ /thams cad de ltar yongs mkhyen nas/ /bdag la kye yi rdo rje des/ /'grel pa bya ched nges par bskul/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sku mchog 'jig rten gsum gyis mchod pa dri ma med pa dang / /chos zhes bya ba bde dang sdug bsngal dngos spangs longs spyod rdzogs sku ston pa po/ /sprul pa mkha' la rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bcas pa sgyu ma mig 'phrul mtshungs pa la/ /btud nas bsdus pa'i rgyud 'di gsang tshig nges don bdag gis nyung ngu bshad par bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis kye yi rdo rjer nyung ngu'i rgyud 'di ru dang ches cher gsal ba gang / /sngon du 'bum phrag lnga po rnams kyi /khyadang po'i rgyud tshogs su dang tshigs bcad brgya 1/de791

phrag gcig /stong gis bsgyur ba rnams kyis mngon par brjod pa 'bum pa dang yang rgyud kyi rgyal po'i tshogs/ /gzhan du'ang mi rnams la ni rgyal bas bstan pa mdzad ni ①'grel pa rnams kyis don rtogs so/ /gang zhig 'grel pa med par nyung rgyud nges par gtugs ⑤la gsang tshig ston byed pa/ /de ni long ba chu la sbrul zhugs yun rings lon pa'i rjes la blta ②ba bzhin/ /rgyal bas mtha' dag rgyud du nges don kho na ma yin drang ba'i don yang bstan/ /gal te drang don 'grel pas gsal bar byas na nges pa rtogs ched don med do/ /rgyal bas mtha' dag rgyud ni dgongs pas bshad dang dgongs min bshad do ④gzhan pa ni/ /ji bzhin sgra dang ji bzhin sgra min nges pa'i don dang drang ba'i don yang bstan/ /phung po phyi sa la sogs dri ma bcas gang de nams 'dir ⑤ni lha nyid min/ /lha yi zhal dang phyag rnams rdzogs sangs rgyas min rtog pas ched du kun brtags yin/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis mtha' drug gis bskor 'dus pa la sogs rgyud rnams gang gsungs pa/ /bstan bcos mkhas pa'i nga rgyal gcog byed de ni rtog gos rtogs bya ga la yin/ /me long la ni pra phab mtshungs pa dus rnams gsum po yang dag rig pa 'di/ /dngos dang dngos med rtog pa'i dra ba bral ba'i ye shes gang yin gnyis med nyid/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi bde ba chen por khu ba 'bab pa sum cu rtsa gnyis rtsa/ /gsungs te mgrin par son cing de bzhin snying ga lte ba gsang bar gang yin pa'ang / /ci zhig 'bab pa rkang lag tshigs dang lag pa'i sor mo'i tshigs su son pa ste/ /de rnams rgyal bas kye yi ④rdo rje snying pos bdag la gsungs pa'ang med/ /gtsug lag dge slong skyobo la gsungs gang de'ang ma ga dhwa༅skad gzhan pa min/ /sde snod gsum du bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs gang de ni 1—792

gnas brtan sde pa'i lugs su ste/ /nges par nad gzhan de la'ang sman gzhan 'di ste nad 'di gzhom pa'i ched ①du'o/ /thub pa'i don la sogs la rton ⑤pa rnam bzhi 'di yin tshig 'bru sogs la min/ /gang zhig lha dang lha min klu dang gnod sbyin skad rnams dang ni gzhan gyis kyang / /chos rnams cig car ston mdzad 'jig rten dpe spangs ngo mtshar byed pa bcom ldan gyis/ /gsung dbyangs de 'di'ang legs sbyar mtshan nyid can gyis e 4 sa yā khyazhes sogs kyis/ /gtsug lag bshad ces zo'adi skyobo mkhas pa rnams kyis ④mtshar bya cis ma yin/ /rnam pa thams cad mchog ldan mig 'phrul dang mtshungs sgyu ma lta bu mkha' 'gro ba'i / /bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gang byis pa mkhas pa rnams kyis rtogs byed nges bshad de/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan rnams dang ni dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu rnams kyis spras/ /phung po khams dang dbang po rnams dang yul rnams bcas pa dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa'o/ /blun po rnams ni rten cing 'brel ba skyozhing 'byung bar rig par rtag tu 'dod/ /'jig dang skyeb tshes grangs rgyu ba la sogs rtsis rnams rgyud gzhan du bstan to/ /skyebo byis 'ga' 'o ma med par zho 'dod ba med par ni 'o ma dang / /ba byung yang ste ⑤spyod bral 'dir ni shes med pa la skyon ci zhig /kye yi rdo rje yis ni bde mchog 'khor lo dang ni gdan bzhi shes par bya/ /bye yi rdo rje dang ni bde mchog 'khor lo nyung ngu 'di ni gdan bzhis shes par bya/ /mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas tshig dang bde mchog chen pos nges don shes par bya/ /de la sogs pa'i rgyud rnams ni/ /rgyud gzhan rnams kyis rtag tu ni/ /bstan ④dang rgyas bshad kyis shes bya/ /'grel pas lam 'dod rnams kyis so/ /zhes pa kye'i rdo rje'i 'grel pa stong phrag drug par 'dod pa'i lha 1—793

la bstod cing rgyud la 'jug pa ste yongs su bcad pa dang po'o// //da ni rgyud bstan pa brjod par bya ste/ 'dir dang por re zhig brjod par bya ba dang / rjod par byed pa dang / 'brel ba dang / dgos pa dang /dgos pa'i dgos pa rnams mngon par yang dag par gzigs nas gdul bya'i skyo bo nges pa dang bral ba rnams la rang gi sems kyi bsam pas skyob 'di nyid la sangs rgyas nyid stsol bar mdzad pa ni/ e tha gyi kyiyi ge la bzhugs pa/ mkha' 'gro ma'i dra bas bskor ba/ kye'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa/rdo rje snying pos gsol ba btab pa/ bdag med mas kyang zhus pa/ kye'i rdo rje 'bum phrag lnga pa las/ nyung ngu'i rgyud gzhung phyed dang bcas pa'i bdun brgya pa 'di bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas bstan to/ /'dir brjod par bya ba ni bcom ldan 'das kye'i rdo rje bdag med ma ②dang bcas pa'o/ /'di rtogs par byed pa'i le'u'i tshogs kyi rgyud kyi rgyal po ni rjod par byed pa'o/ /brjod par bya ba dang rjod par byed pa de dag gi phan tshun brjod bya rjod byed kyi mtshan nyid ni 'brel ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la sogs pa'i dbang bskur ba byin pa ni dgos pa'o/ /dbang bskur nas de kho na nyid gsal bar byas pa ni dgos pa'i dgos pa'o zhes pa 'di rnams mngon par yang dag par gzigs nas te/ gdul bya'i skye bo nges pa dang bral ba rnams la zhes pa nyan thos kyi sdom pa dang bral ba rnams la'o/ /rang gi sems kyi bsam pas zhes pa 'dod pa lnga la nye bar longs spyod pa'i sems kyis so/ /skyob 'di la sangs rgyas nyid rab tu ster ba zhes pa ni yang dang yang du mi'i skyeb la ste/ lha dang lha min la sogs pa la ni min no/ /1/de794

e tha gyi ༅yi ge la bzhugs pa zhes pa bde ba thams cad kyi gzhi la bzhugs pas so//mkha' 'gro ma'i dra bas yongs su bskor ba zhes pa phung po dang khams dang skyemached kyi mtshan nyid can gyis so/ /kye'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa rdo rje snying pos gsol ba btab pa shes rab bdag med mas yongs su zhus pas/kye yi rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa brtag pa chen po sum cu rtsa gnyis pa las nyung ngu'i rgyud rdzogs par byang chub pa dang / sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi brtag pa gnyis pa le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi bdag nyid can phyed dang bcas pa'i bdun brgya pa'i gzhung ༅gi tshad kyis khya/bsdus pa'i rgyud ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas yang dag par bstan te/ 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bden pa dag gis 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub kyi ched du bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa dag gis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa dang / de kho na nyid bsgom pas so zhes pa'o/ /rgyud 'dir brjod par bya ba ni kye'i rdo rje yin la/ kye'i rdo rje'i rgyud ni rjod par byed pa'o/ /brjod par bya ba de yang rjod par byed pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa ste/ dang po rdo rje rigs kyi le'u'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / de nas sngags kyi le'u'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / de nas lha'i le'u'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang /de bzhin du lha dbang bskur ba'i le'u'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / de kho na nyid kyi le'u'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / /spyod pa'i le'u'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / brda dang gnas gtan la dbab pa'i le'u'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang / rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo 'du ba'i le'u'i ngo bo nyid du gnas pa dang —/ rnam par dag pa'i le'u'i ngo bo nyid du gnas pa dang / mngon par 1—795

dbang bskur ba'i le'u'i ngo bo nyid du gnas pa dang / mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i brtag pa'i rgyal po'i le'u'i ngo bo nyid du gnas pa'o zhes pa yongs su bcad pa bcu gcig ni brtag pa dang po la'o/ /de nas sgyu ma'i dra ba'i brtag pa la / sgyu ma zhes pa ni mkha' 'gro ma ste/ dra ba zhes pa ni tshogs pa'o/ /sdom pa ni 'dus pa ste te ru ga dang bcas pa zhes pa nges pa'o/ /'di nyid du dang po re zhig rab gnas dang sbyin sreg dang thab khung dang las rab 'byam dang / mchod pa'i le'u'i ngo bo nyid kyis bzhugs pa dang / de nas dngos grub gtan la dbab pa'i le'u'i ngo bo nyid kyis bzhugs pa dang / de bzhin du rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi dang/ dgongs pa'i skad kyi le'u'i ngo bo nyid kyis bzhugs pa dang / rgyud thams cad kyi phyag rgya bsdus pa'i don gyi le'u'i ngo bo nyid du bzhugs pa dang /kye'i rdo rje mngon par 'byung ba'i le'u'i ngo bo nyid du bzhugs pa dang / phyag rgya rnam par dag pa dang / bris sku dang glegs bam 'bri ba nges pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis bzhugs pa dang / bza' ba'i cho ga'i le'u'i ngo bo nyid kyis bzhugs pa dang /padma can gyi mtshan nyid dang / slob ma 'dul ba'i le'u'i ngo bo nyid kyis bzhugs pa dang —/ lha rnam par dag pa dang / sngags btu ba'i le'u'i ngo bo nyid kyis bzhugs pa dang / sngags bzlas pa'i le'u'i ngo bo nyid kyis bzhugs pa dang /lhan cig skyes pa'i don gyis sbyor ba dang rjes su gnang ba'i gleng gzhi'i ngo bo nyid kyis bzhugs pa dang / de ltar le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi bdag nyid kyi rgyud kyi ngo bo nyid kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kye'i rdo rjes rdo rje snying po la bos par gyur te/ der bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' srul pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po ni ye shes te bde ba chen po'o/ /1—796

de nyid rje btsun gsang ba las ches shin tu gsang ba ste rnam par rtog pa'i bsgom pa la dga' ba rnams la sba bar bya zhing shin tu sba bar bya ba'o/ /e ma ①rdo rje snying po snying rje chen po legs so legs so/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang sems dpa' chen po dang dam tshig sems dpa'i snying po kye'i rdo rje zhes bya ba nyon cig ces bya ba bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs te/ bzhugs pa'i gnas kyi mthar brjod pa'o/ /de'i phyir sngags bzhugs pa'i gnas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa brjod par bya ste/ phyi nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bskul ba'i gsung ngag dang rdo rje snying pos gsol ba 'debs pa'o zhes pa'o/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga rnams la bzhugs so zhes pa bzhugs pa'i tshig go/ /'o na 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na zhes pa'i tshig gang yin pa de ci/ ston pa po thams cad mkhyen pa'i yin nam 'on te sdud par byed pa gsol ba 'debs pa po'i yin/ gnyi ga ltar na drang ba'i don du skyon yod de/ 'dir gal te 'das pa'i dus su thos pa de nyid gsung bar byed na/ de'i tshe ma 'ongs pa'i dus la ye shes med de gzhan las thos nas yongs su mkhyen pa'i phyir ro/ /ci ste sdud par byed pa po'i yin na de'i tshe 'di skad kyi yi ge la sogs pa don med de/ /rdo rje sems dpas ma gsungs pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /de'i phyir ngag 'di dgongs pa'i skad gzhan gyis ②nges pa'i don du rtogs par bya ba'o/ /'di yi nges pa'i don nyid ni/ /e yig cha byad bzang po gang / /dbus su thonagyis ②rnam brgyan pa④/ /bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog /ces pa bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /de nyid 1—797

ni ston pa po nga ste bde ba chen po'o/ rgya /thos pa ni mkhyen pa'o/ /bdag gis ni bdag nyid kyis so/ /dus gcig na ni skad cig gcig gis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ni bde ba chen po'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ni dgongs pa'i skad kyis phung po lnga rnams so/ /de rnams kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje btsun mo zhes pa la sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi bya ba rdo rje btsun mo rnams ni yul gyi chos can nam mkha' la sogs pa'i khams rnams te/ srog 'gro ba dang 'ong ba'i bye brag gis yon tan gcig dang gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi dang lnga'i bye brag gis gtsug tor dang dpral ba dang mgrin pa dang snying ga dang ste ba'i padma rnams kyi bha ga rnams su dang / lte ba dang gsang ba dang rdo rje nor bur yon tan gsum gyi dbye bas gnas pa rnams te/ dga' ba la sogs pa'i dbye bas byang chub kyi sems de rnams su bzhugs so zhes pa'o/ /zlog tsapas ni de las bzlog pa yon tan zad pas rdo rje nor bu dang gsang bar dang —/ yul zad pas lte ba dang snying ga dang mgrin pa dang dpral ba dang gtsug tor te 'di rnams su bzhugs te/ rgyu mthun pa la sogs pa'i dbye bas so zhes pa'o / /de ltar khams dang phung po la sogs pa rnams sgrib pa med pa nyid kyis rdzogs par brjod par bya ste bde ba chen po'i las so/ /e yig ni spyan ma'o/ /cha /yig ni mā ma gī'o/ /ma yig ni gos dkar mo'o/ /yā yig ni sgrol ma'o/ /thu yig ni rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /te yig ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'o zhes pa'o/ /de nas phung po rnams te/ e yig ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /sha yig ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /smin yig ni don yod grub pa'o/ /sa yig ni rin chen dbang po'o/ /ma yig ni 'od dpag tu med pa'o/ /ye yig ni rnam par 1—798

snang mdzad do/ /bha yig ni dri rdo rje ma'o/ /ga yig ni ro rdo rje ma'o/ /wān yig ni gzugs rdo rje ma'o/ /sa yig ni reg bya rdo rje ma'o/ /rba yig ni sgra rdo rje ma'o / /ta yig ni chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje ma'o/ /thā yig ni sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'o/ /ga yig ni 'jig rten dbang phyug go/ /ta yig ni sa'i snying po'o/ /kā yig ni nam mkha'i snying po'o/ /ya yig ni phyag na rdo rje'o/ /wāka yig ni kun du bzang po ste/ de ltar skye mched bcu gnyis rnams so/ /tsi yig ni rengs byed ma'o/ /tta yig ni nga rgyal ma'o/ /ba yig ni rmugs byed ma'o//dzra yig ni shin tu brtson 'grus ma'o/ /yo yig ni shin tu sngon mo'o༅/ /ṣita yig ni drag spyan ma'o/ /bha yig ni gnod mdzes so/ /ge yig ni gtsug tor ro//ṣā yig ni bgegs mthar byed do/ /bi yig ni shes rab mthar byed do/ /dza yig ni padma mthar byed do/ /hā yig ni gshin rje mthar byed do/ /ra yig ni shes rab dang thabs kyi bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' gtso bo sum cu rtsa bdun pa'o / /de ltar sum cu rtsa bdun byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams rim pa ji lta bar yongs su dag pa rnams te/ khams drug rnams dang / phung po drug rnams dang / yul drug rnams dang / dbang po drug rnams dang / las kyi dbang po'i bya ba drug rnams dang / las kyi dbang po drug ༅dang / bde ba chen po'o zhes pa ste bzhi pa zad pa las nguso/ /de'i phyir dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi rnams dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi rnams dang / dbang po lnga rnams dang / stobs lnga rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun rnams so zhes pa'o / /de ltar bde ba chen po las ngo bo nyid las chos kyi sku ste/ bzhi pa zad pa 1/de799

las gnyid stug ①po zad do/ /gnyid stug po zad pas rmi lam zad do/ /rmi lam zad pa las sad pa zad pa'o/ /de rnams zad pa las rim pa ji lta bar lhan cig skyes pa dang / chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / sprul pa'i sku rnams su rim pa ji lta bar 'gyur te/ ye shes dang / sems dang / ngag dang / lus sgrib pa med par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir/ thams cad nas ni phyag zhabs sogs/ /kun nas spyan dang dbu dang zhal/ /kun nas thos ldan 'jig rten du/ /thams cad g.yogs nas bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i phyir/ cha med kun 'gro khyab pa po/ /phra zhing zag med sa bon no/ /rdul med rdul bral dri ma med/ /nyes pa spangs pa skyon med pa/ /shin tu sad pa sad pa'i bdag /kun shes kun rig dam pa po/ /rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid 'das/ ye shes gnyis med tshul 'chang ba/ /de ltar sgrib pa thams cad las rnam par grol ba sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can bcom ldan 'das kye'i rdo rje sa bcu gnyis kyi dbang phyug ni ston la'o②/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po sa bcu'i dbang phyug ni gsol ba 'debs pa po'o zhes pa kye'i rdo rje'i 'grel pa stong phrag drug par ston pa po dang / gsol ba 'debs pa po dang —/ rjod par byed pa dang / brjod par bya ba dang / 'byel lar bya ① ba dang —/ bzhugs pa'i gnas nges pa ste yongs su bcad pa gnyis pa'o// //da ni rdo rje snying pos gsol ba 'debs pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis ④lan gyi gsung gsal ba bya ba ⑤ste/ rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ ci yis zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /ci yis rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur/ /ci ltar byang chub sems dpar 'gyur/ /ci phyir sems dpa' chen po lags/ /ji ltar dam tshig sems 1—800

dpa' gtso/ /zhes pa rdo rje snying po'i gsol ba 'debs pa gsan nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi phyed rdo rje zhes par brjod/ /sems dpa' srid pa gsum gcig nyid/ /shes rab rigs pa 'di yis ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes par bshad/ /byang chub la gnas sems dpa' de/ /byang chub sems dpar brjod par bya/ /ye shes chen po'i ros gang ba/ /sems dpa' chen por brjod par bya/ /rtag tu dam tshig la gnas pas/ /dam tshig sems dpar mngon par brjod/ /ces mdor bstan pa'i rgyas par bshad pa ni 'bum phrag lnga par rab tu gsal te/ de'i phyir de nyid la 'jug par bya'o/ /der bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi phyed rdo rje zhes bshad gang / / tha gyi ༅yi ger de rab grags/ /sku gsung thugs ni mi phyed pa/ /yi ge cha kyis ༅mngon brjod bya/ /sems dpa' srid gsum gcig nyid ni/ /yi ge e yis brjod par bya / /e yig shes rab dang lhan cig /cha yig rigs gsum bdag nyid can/ /lte ba'i dbus gnas dpa' bo ni/ /ze 'bru gsang ba'i spyod yul can/ /rang 'dra'i shes rab ②dang ldan te/ /rdo rje sems dpar rab brjod bya/ /phyag gnyis he ru ga ru bshad/ /de nyid 'jig rten gsum bskyod nyid/ /de nyid ngo bo nyid du brjod/ /sangs rgyas sku de bde ba che/ /de nyid ye shes rdo rjer 'gyur/ /de nyid lhan cig skyes dga' nyid/ /rgyu mthun par yang de nyid can/ /rdo rje rtse gcig pa ru brjod/ /de yang bzhi pa'i gnas skabs zad/ /rnam dag mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'o/ /byang chub la gnas gang yang ni/ /snying ga'i padma'i dbus gnas par/ /rgyu yig kho na /༅sems dpar bshad/ /mi bskyod pa ni de kho na / /thugs kyi rdo rjer de nyid brjod/ /khyab 'jug nyid de phyag bzhi pa/ /de 1/de801

nyid dza la dza la bhyo/ /de nyid chos kyi sku ru bshad/ /chos 'khor lo gnas rdo rje can / /khyad dga'i dga' ba'i tshul 'chang ba/ /de nyid rnam smin du yang bshad/ /gnyid stug zad par byed pa'o/ /ye shes chen po'i ros gang ba/ /sems dpa' chen por de brjod bya/ nayi ge ༅ni yang dag brjodanya/ /mgrin par longs spyod 'khor lo'i dbang / /'od dpag med du mngon brjod bya/ /de nyid gsung gi rdo rjer bshad/ /padma'i phyag can de bzhin gshegs/ /de nyid mchog tu dga' bar bshad/ /skyes bu byed par rab brjod bya/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam gyi / /de yang rmi lam gnas skabs zad/ /de nyid longs spyod rdzogs skur 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis mchos ston mdzad/ /de nyid bde byed rab tu brjod/ /zhal gsum rnam pa phyag drug ste/ /ki ṭi ki ṭi rdo rje de/ /te ru sha nyid gsum par 'gyur/ /rtag tu dam tshig la gnas pas/ /gang zhig gnas pa de brjod bya/ /dam tshig ri bong 'dzin khu ba/ /bde ba chen po dpral bar gnas/ /bdud rtsir legs gnas sems dpa'o/ /lo gyi yi ger yongs bshad bya/ /de nyid rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /sku yi rdo rje de kho na'o/ /tshangs pa sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /de nyid yongs su brjod par bya/ /dga' ba tshangs pa'i ngo bo ste/ /gzugs kyi sku ru de brjod bya/ /de nyid phyag na 'khor lor bshad/ /sku ni sprul pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /bzlog pas de yang dri ma med/ /de nyid sad pa zad pa nyid/ /de nyid pi tsu badzra 'gyur/ /zhal brgyad he ru ga ru brjod/ /dpa' bo chen po zhabs bzhi pa/ /bcu drug phyag dang yang dag ldan/ /de ltar sku yi dbye ba yis/ /te ru ga ni bzhi par bshad/ /ngo bo nyid can las chos 'gyur/ /chos las longs spyod rdzogs pa nyid/ /de las sprul pa'i skur 1—802

'gyur te/ /de ltar sku ni bzhi yin no/ /tshangs pa sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /gsung gi rdo rje dbang phyug che/ /khyab 'jug thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /zhes so/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud du rgyas bshad pa/ /rigs ni gsum du brjod par bya/ /ngo bo nyid dang ldan pas ni/ /rigs bzhi zhes par bshad pa yin/ /mdzad pa bzhi yi dbye ba yis/ /rigs rnams kyi ni rnam gzhag de'o / /sangs rgyas lam ni mngon 'dod pa'i①/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas shes par bya/ /zhes pa'o/ /e ༷gyi ༅ yi ge ni rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ rgyu yig ni thugs rdo rje'o/ /༅yig ni gsung rdo rje'o/ /lo yig ni sku rdo rje'o/ /e /ni rgyu dang ༅dang oṃgyi yi ge re re'i ming 'di yis rtogs par bya ba'i don gzung bar bya ba'i yi ge dang ming gis ni ma yin no/ /'dir ming gi dngos por med de gal te yod na ni de'i tshe yid dang mig gis gzung bar bya bar 'gyur ba zhig na/ de ltar yang ma yin no/ /de'i phyir rna bas ming tsam gzung bar bya la/ 'di yis rtogs par bya ba'i don ni yid dang mig gis gzung bar bya ba'o/ /bum pa dang snam bu la sogs pa'i don ni 'jim pa dang / 'khor lo dang / dbyug pa dang /chu dang / skud pa dang / thags bzangs dang / gnas dang / snal ma la sogs pas grub pa ni ming gis bskyed 'u/par byas par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /ming gi sgra tsam gyis te sa la sogs pa dri ④la sogs pa'i chos kyi rgyur gyur pa 'jim pa lta bu ni ma yin no zhes pa bcom ldan 'das kyi lan gyi gsung nges pa'o/ /da ni yang rdo rje snying pos gsol ba 'debs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis lan bshad par bya ste/ rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ ci yis kye yi rdo rje lags/ /mtshan bsdus pa ni 'di lta bu/ /he yig gis ni ci zhig bshad/ /rdo rje yis kyang ci 1—803

brjod bya/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' srul pa/ /he yig gis ni snying rje che/ /rdo rje'ang shes rab brjod par bya/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid rgyud/ /de ni nga yis bshad kyis nyon/ /zhes mdor bstan pa 'di ༅rgyas par bshad pa ni/rtsa ba'i rgyud du ste/ de nyid la 'jug par bya'o/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sems can chos dang dmigs pa med/ /snying rje 'di ni rnam gsum bshad/ /chen po'i sgra las dmigs pa med/ /he yig gis ni mngon brjod bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sngar gyi /yig de nyid do/ /rdo rje'i sgras kyang e yig ste/ /rnam pa kun don stong pa nyid/ /gang zhig 'di dag snyoms 'jug pa/ /rnal 'byor sgra yis brjod par bya/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid rgyud/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du brjod par bya/ /rnal 'byor thabs kyi sgra yis min/ /shes rab kyes kyang 'gyur ba min/ /'di ni rnal 'byor rgyud ces bya / /kye yi rdo rje gnyis med pa'o⑤/ /'dus pa la sogs thams cad ni/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid des/ /thams cad rnal 'byor rgyud yin te/ /shes rab thabs kyi ming rnams kyis/ /gang du thabs ni legs gnas shing / /rnal 'byor ma rnams kun spyod pa/ /kun rdzob rnal 'byor ma rgyud du/ /byis pa rnams la bdag gis bstan/ /gang du thabs ni 'pho byed cing / /shes rab yang dag gnas 'gyur ba/ /thabs kyi rgyud nyid du ni bshad/ /ji ltar de ltar kun rdzob tu'o/ /phyag rgya dkyil 'khor bsgom pa rnams/ /ji lta ji ltar rnam dpyad pa / /de lta de ltar rnam par gzhig /skye 'jig mtshan nyid can rnams so/ /shes rab thabs dag snyoms 'jug pa/ /dbyer med mtshan nyid rdo rje gsum/ /shes dang shes bya dag gcig pa/ /stong nyid snying rje gnyis med pa'o/ /stong nyid 1/de804

mtshan ma med pa dang / /de bzhin smon pa med pa dang / /mngon 'dus ma byas rnam par thar/ /rnam pa bzhi rnams yongs su grags/ /snying rje byams pa dga' ba dang / /bzhi pa yang ni btang snyoms te/ /de rnams tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi ste / /chos kun rnam par mi rtog las/ /sgrib pa med pa'i chos kyis ni/ /gnyis med de yis btags pa'o/ /shes rab thabs bdag de bzhin no/ /rdo rje'i sku rnams gnyis su med/ /phung po drug dang khams de bzhin/ /yul dang dbang po rnams kyang ste/ /bya ba las kyi dbang po rnams/ /de ltar gnyis med nyid du gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni/ /e cha yi ger rab tu gnas/ /phyi nas rigs gsum dbye ba yis/ /rigs lnga rnam par dbye ba las/ /rigs drug rnams kyi dbye ba yisal/ /de bzhin brgyad du rnam dbye bas/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid rgyud/ /nga yis bstan par bya yis nyon/ /zhes pa bcom ldan 'das kyis ②lan gyi gsung nges par bstan pa ste/ de ltar rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du rab tu gzhag ②pa'i nges pa'o/ /da ni rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi skyeb dang gnas pa'i rgyu brjod par bya ste/ rgyud 'dir rnal 'byor ma rnams ni phung po lnga rnams dang / khams bzhi rnams dang / skyemached drug rnams te zla ba'i cha bco lnga'i dbye bas bdag med ma la sogs pa rnams so/ /de rnams kyi skyeb dang gnas pa'i rgyu ni byu yig ste/ he ru ga ni gnyis pa'o/ /de'i phyir de rnams kyi don / /mnyam nyid ye shes rnam shes dang / /lha rnams ji ltar 'byung bar 'gyur ba'o/ /de bzhin du/ lta stangs dgug dang brda chen dang / /nus pa rnam pa mang po rig /rengs par byed dang sgod pa nyid/ /sde rengs byed dang mngon spyod pa/ /la sogs pa gzhan yang bshad par bya yis/ kye'i rdo rje ④snying 1/de805

po khyod nyon cig ces pa lha skye ba dang gnas pa dag gi rgyu'i nges pa'o/ /da ni de'i yang bskyed pa'i rgyu brjod par bya ste/ dang po tshe re zhig e cha 'gyur/ /zhes pa e cha gyi yi ge ni 0te ru sha'i dang du po'i rgyu'o/ /rgyu yig ni gnyis pa'i bskyed pa'i rgyu'o zhes pa nges pa'o/ /de las dngos po skye ba ni/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i dbye ba las/ /yul dang dbang po'i sbyor ba yis/ /rnam shes rnams kyi so so'o/ /dngos po'i 'ching bas 'ching bar 'gyur/ /dngos po'i 'ching ba de yis rnam par shes pa rnams dang mig la sogs pa rnams 'ching bar byed do/ /de yongs ④shes pas grol bar byed/ /yul dang dbang po rnams 'gog pas de yongs su shes pas zhes pa'o/ /de'i phyir dngos po nyid kyis rnam grol byed/ /lha'i mig la sogs pa rnams kyis 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i yul mthong bas rnam par shes pa drug rnams grol te/ de ni rnam par shes pa 3 gzhan no zhes pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pas so/ /de bzhin du de gzugs gzhan la sogs pa yang ste/de'i phyir/ thams cad nas ni phyag zhabs sogs/ /kun nas spyan dang dbu dang zhal/ /kun nas thos ldan 'jig rten du/ /thams cad khyab par byas nas bzhugs/ /da ni sngar bshad pa'i shes rab dang thabs dag gis don dam pa'i bsgom pa brjod par bya ste/ dngos po bsgom byas zhes pa la sogs pas so/ /'dir nam mkha' la dngos po bsgom bya ni rmi lam lta bu'i ste rdul phra rab kyi chos nyid las 'das pa'o/ /de yongs shes pa ni dngos po med pa bsgom par bya ste/rnam par rtog pa dang bral ba'i sems kyis snang brnyan mthong ba'o/ /rtog pa dang bral zhing ma 'khrul ba ni mngon sum zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nyid rnam pa bzhi ste / dbang po'i mngon sum dang yid kyi mngon sum dang / rnal 'byor gyi 1—806

mngon sum dang / rang rig pa'i mngon sum zhes pa ste/ shes pa de nyid ni nye bar ston par byed pas 'jug par byed pa dang thob par byed pa dang / nyams su pyong ba'i mtshan nyid can no zhes bya'o/ /snang brnyan de nyid dpe dgu rnams kyis bsgrubs te/ 'di lta ste mig yor dang / sprul pa'i grong khyer dang / sgra brnyan dang —/ rmi lam dang / sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor dang / smig rgyu dang / me long gi gzugs brnyan dang / chu zla dang / nam mkha' zhes pa'o/ /shes rab e yig tu 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du he ru ga zhes pa dngos po med pa bsgom bya ste shes rab kyi ye shes so/ /he ru yi ni bde ba chen po ste/ shes rab ji lta bar thabs kyang de bzhin no/ /de yongs su shes pa dngos po med par bsgom par bya ba ste thabs su 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin nyed kyi khyesgra las rgyu ji ltar bar de ltar 'bras bu'o zhes pa'o/ /e cha gyi yi ge shes rab dang thabs kyi bdag nyid can gyi lus gnas te lte bar gnas pa'o/ /de ltar na lus gnas ye shes chen po ni/ /kun du rtog pa thams cad spangs par 'grub ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i rtog pa dang bral ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ye shes rtog pa'i dra ba dang bral bas zhes pa nges pa'o/ /de nyid rdo rje sems dpa' 'jig rten gsum kun du bskyod pa'i te ru ga ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o/ /dngos po kun la khyab pa po/ zhes pa phung po drug dang / khams drug rnams dang / dbang po drug rnams dang / yul drug rnams dang / las kyi dbang po drug rnams dang /las kyi dbang po'i bya ba drug rnams te dngos po 'di rnams la khyab pa po ye shes kyi sku'o / /lus la gnas kyang lus skyes min/ /zhes pa skye ba dang 'jig pa'i dngos po med pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir gang mkha' 'gro ma dra ba sdom pa brtag pa 1—807

gnyis par dngos grub gtan la 'bebs pa'i le'ur 'chad par 'gyur ba rdo rje snying pos tagasol ba btab pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi lan gyi gsung de ni kun rdzob tu byis pa'i skye bos rtogs pa'i don du bskyed pa'i tshul gyis khyadabang po gnyis kyi bde ba bstan pa'o zhes pa'o/ /'di lta ste/ rdo rje'i bsnying pos gsol ba btab pa/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dam pa'i bde ba bde chen na bu/ /rdzogs pa bsgom pa med pa ste/ /bskyed pa yi ni dgos pa ci/ /zhes pa la 'dir rdzogs pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba ni rtog pa dang dbang po gnyis kyi bde ba dang bral ba ste/ de nyid sangs rgyas nyid ster bar byed pa yin na de'i phyir rtog pas dkyil 'khor bskyed pa dang phyag rgya bskyed pas dgos pa ci yod ces pa'o /tshig 'di gsan nas bcom ldan 'das kye'i rdo rjes bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'di/ /e ma dad pa'i shugs kyis nyams/ /zhes pa kun rdzob tu ste/ lus kyi dngos med gang la bde/ /bde ba smra bar mi nus so/ /khyab bya khyab byed ngo bo yis/ /bde bas 'gro ba khyab pa po/ /ji ltar me tog la gnas dri/ /me tog dngos med las mi rtogs/ /de bzhin gzugs sogs dngos med pas/ /bde ba dmigs pa nyid mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa kun rdzob kyis so / /de nyid du slar yang don dam par 'gog pa 'di lta ste/ dngos nga dngos po med pa nga / /zhes pa rnam pa thams cad pa'i shes rab bo/ /dngos po rtogs phyir sangs rgyas nga / /zhes pa mngon par shes pa drug can thabs so/ /rmongs pa gang rnams nga mi shes/ /'di ltar gyur pa'i gang zhig le los bcom pas kyang ste de rnams ni dbang po gnyis kyi bde bas nye bar bcom pa rnams so zhes pa la sogs pas snga ma dang phyi ma drang ba dang nges pa'i don nyid de le'u de nyid du rgya cher 1—808
